1966.h: James (back) isn't listed on the injury report for Sunday's game against Detroit.
1966.s: James will suit up in the second half of this back-to-back set after sitting out Saturday's win over Milwaukee. With the star forward back in the lineup, Dean Wade will likely shift to the second unit.

1966.h: James (back) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Bucks, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.
1966.s: James will be held out of the front end of this back-to-back set, with his next chance to play coming Sunday against Detroit. With the star forward sidelined, Dean Wade (ankle), Jabari Walker and Kentavious Caldwell-Pope are candidates for increased playing time.

1966.h: James (back) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Bucks.
1966.s: The 76ers are considering giving James the night off Saturday for the first leg of a back-to-back set. If James sits out, Kentavious Caldwell-Pope stands out as the most likely candidate to step into the starting lineup.

1966.h: James (rest) is set to play in Friday's preseason game against Boston, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.
1966.s: The 76ers will give most of their rotation some additional reps for the preseason finale. It's unclear what kind of workloads the key players will see Friday.

1966.h: James (rest) won't be available for Saturday's preseason contest against the Celtics, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.
1966.s: The Sixers will be resting several players for this contest, and James is one of the many projected starters who will be taking a seat alongside Joel Embiid and Jaylen Brown. The 76ers will manage James' workload carefully with an eye toward having him ready for the regular-season opener against the Knicks on Tuesday, Oct. 20.

3195.h: Conley (coach's decision) didn't play during Tuesday's 121-113 loss to the Pistons.
3195.s: Conley wasn't expected to be a significant part of Boston's Opening Night backcourt mix. The 39-year-old point guard is serving as a veteran presence in the Celtics' locker room.

3195.h: Conley (rest) is expected to play in Tuesday's game versus the Pistons.
3195.s: Conley didn't play in Friday's 125-120 preseason overtime victory over the 76ers, the Celtics' final exhibition, though the veteran is in line to suit up Tuesday to begin the 2026-27 campaign against Detroit. Conley most recently averaged 4.5 points, 1.7 rebounds and 2.9 assists over 18.4 minutes per contest in 54 regular-season games with the Timberwolves in 2025-26. His role is mostly to provide guidance and…

3195.h: Conley (rest) is not expected to play against the 76ers on Friday, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports.
3195.s: Conley is not one of the players Grande listed in either the starting lineup or of those who will dress for Friday's preseason finale. Conley should be available for Boston's regular-season opener against Detroit, but what his role and playing time will look like remains to be seen, given that he's projected to work behind Derrick White and Payton Pritchard.

3195.h: Conley will come off the bench in Saturday's preseason game against the 76ers, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports.
3195.s: Conley started in Thursday's exhibition with Derrick White (rest) unavailable, but White is back and starting, so Conley will return to a reserve role. The 38-year-old veteran will provide some emergency depth for the Celtics at the point guard position this season, but he's not expected to have a significant role in the rotation.

3195.h: Conley will start in Thursday's preseason game against Cleveland, Bobby Krivitsky of Forbes.com reports.
3195.s: Conley signed a one-year deal with the Celtics in July and will get the start in Boston's first preseason game of the 2026-27 campaign. The 2007 No. 4 overall pick started in 15 games for the Timberwolves in 2025-26, averaging 7.5 points, 3.9 assists, 2.2 rebounds and 1.1 steals over 24.1 minutes per contest in those appearances.

3202.h: Durant (not injury related) will play in Thursday's preseason game against the Thunder, Will Guillory of The Athletic reports.
3202.s: The veteran forward will return to action after sitting out Sunday's loss to the Mavericks. According to Guillory, head coach Ime Udoka said Durant and the rest of the Rockets' starting five are expected to play about one half of the team's preseason finale.

3202.h: Durant pushed back Monday on the idea of playing reduced minutes in his 20th season, per Ben DuBose of USA Today.
3202.s: The future Hall of Famer logged 78 regular-season appearances last year, his most since 2018-19 with the Warriors. Durant also averaged 36.4 minutes per game before going down with an ankle injury and missing five of Houston's six playoff contests. However, it doesn't sound like the 37-year-old perennial All-Star is ready to take it easy for the contending Rockets in 2026-27. Durant trails only LeBron James among…

3202.h: Durant (ankle) averaged 26.0 points per game during his first season with Houston and continued to cement his place among the NBA's all-time great scorers, moving into the top five on the league's career 30-point games list.
3202.s: Durant led the Rockets to a 52-30 record and a playoff berth despite battling injuries late in the year. Houston made no major changes to its core during the offseason, so Durant should once again operate as the club's primary scoring option while chasing another deep postseason run.

3213.h: Horford (back) isn't listed on the injury report for Monday's game against the Nuggets.
3213.s: Horford was held out of Saturday's loss to Phoenix in the second half of a back-to-back set, though he'll be back in action Monday. His return will leave fewer minutes available for the likes of Graham Ike and Charles Bassey (knee), who is listed as probable.

3213.h: Horford (back) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Suns.
3213.s: As expected, the veteran big man will sit out the second leg of this back-to-back set due to lower-back injury management. With Draymond Green (back/rest) expected to join Horford on the inactive list, Graham Ike and Georges Niang are candidates for increased burn, especially if Charles Bassey (knee) is downgraded from questionable to out.

3213.h: Horford (rest) won't play in Tuesday's preseason game against the Lakers, per Nick Friedell of The Athletic.
3213.s: The veteran center isn't making the trip to Las Vegas for this exhibition. He'll look to return for Friday's preseason finale versus Portland. Horford isn't expected to begin the season as a starter despite Kristaps Porzingis' (undisclosed) absence, per Dalton Johnson of NBC Sports Bay Area.

3213.h: Horford (rest) is expected to play in Saturday's preseason game against the Kings, per Nick Friedell of The Athletic.
3213.s: The veteran big man sat out Wednesday's exhibition versus Portland for rest purposes. Horford figures to receive some burn Saturday before the Warriors turn to some of their younger players in the second half.

3213.h: Horford (rest) is out for Wednesday's preseason game against Portland, per Tomer Azarly of ClutchPoints.com.
3213.s: The veteran center is getting a maintenance day Wednesday. His next chance to play comes Saturday against the Kings.

3442.h: Jordan will start Saturday against the Nuggets.
3442.s: Jordan has been out of the rotation through the first two games of the season, but with Yves Missi (knee) unavailable, he will draw the start against Denver's Nikola Jokic. Across seven starts last season, Jordan averaged 3.9 points, 7.0 rebounds and 1.0 blocks per game.

3442.h: Jordan was a DNP-CD during Tuesday's 116-110 preseason win over Oklahoma City.
3442.s: Jordan was available but didn't see the floor despite New Orleans going deep into its bench. The veteran center is expected to provide depth behind Yves Missi and could have difficulty finding consistent playing time when the Pelicans are healthy.

3442.h: Jordan re-signed with the Pelicans on Tuesday, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.
3442.s: The terms of the agreement are not yet clear, but it figures to be a one-year contract for the veteran's minimum. The 37-year-old center, who's entering his 19th season in the NBA, offers the Pelicans leadership and a veteran presence for their young big men like Derik Queen, Yves Missi and Karlo Matkovic. Jordan made 16 regular-season appearances in 2025-26 for New Orleans, averaging 4.4 points, 6.3 rebounds and…

3448.h: Lopez is not listed in the starting lineup for Wednesday's preseason game against Denver, Joey Linn of SI.com reports.
3448.s: Lopez will come off the bench Wednesday after starting in Saturday's loss to the Raptors. The veteran has had a quiet preseason, averaging 3.5 points and 5.0 rebounds over 11.2 minutes per contest (two games).

3448.h: Lopez is in the starting lineup for Saturday's preseason matchup with the Raptors, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.
3448.s: Head coach Tyronn Lue will use the preseason to find what groups mesh best, so a strong showing from Lopez on Saturday would help his case for a starting role. As a starter last season, Lopez averaged 10.8 points, 4.9 rebounds, 1.8 triples and 1.3 blocks per contest on 45/37/74 shooting splits.

3448.h: Lopez won't start Sunday's preseason game against the Warriors, Joey Linn of SI.com reports.
3448.s: The veteran big man will come off the bench in favor of Isaiah Jackson. Lopez and Jackson are expected to compete for the starting center role ahead of the regular season, though it's worth noting that Jackson has spent time working with the first unit in training camp.

3448.h: Lopez is not guaranteed the Clippers' starting center role, as Isaiah Jackson has been working with the first team during training camp, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.
3448.s: Lopez started 40 of his 75 regular-season appearances in 2025-26, averaging 8.5 points, 3.6 rebounds, 1.3 assists and 1.2 blocks across 21.8 minutes per game on the campaign. The 38-year-old will face plenty of competition for minutes throughout the season, as Jackson could take Lopez's spot in the starting five. Additionally, Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot) could fight for minutes once he's cleared to return.

3448.h: The Clippers are picking up the $9.2 million team option on Lopez's contract for the 2026-27 season, per Chris Haynes of NBA TV.
3448.s: Lopez was thrust into a starting role following the Ivica Zubac trade last year, and he appears to be the early favorite for the top center gig once again in 2026-27. That said, the Clippers figure to try and upgrade the position this offseason. Lopez averaged 8.5 points, 3.6 rebounds and 1.3 assists in 21.8 minutes per contest over 75 regular-season games in 2025-26.

3975.h: Curry (rest) is not listed on the injury report and is available to play Monday against the Nuggets.
3975.s: Curry didn't play Saturday against the Suns due to rest, but the star floor general isn't listed on Sunday's injury report, so he should be available to suit up Monday. That means Brandon Williams, who started at point guard versus Phoenix, should return to the bench. Curry is averaging 23.5 points per game despite shooting a mere 29.4 percent from three-point range in his two appearances this season.

3975.h: Curry (rest) won't play Saturday against the Suns.
3975.s: Curry told reporters after Friday's loss to the Grizzlies that he will "probably not" play Saturday, and the star floor general won't suit up in the second leg of this back-to-back set. With Curry out, a committee of De'Anthony Melton, Will Richard, Brandon Williams and Gary Payton will cover his minutes in the Warriors' backcourt. Curry will aim to return against the Nuggets on Monday.

3975.h: Curry told reporters after Friday's loss to the Grizzlies that he will "probably not" play against the Suns on Saturday, Nick Friedell of The Athletic reports.
3975.s: Curry played 30 minutes during Friday's game against Memphis, finishing with 24 points (5-15 FG, 3-10 3Pt, 11-11 FT), four assists and two rebounds in a 111-108 loss. Brandin Podziemski (back) won't play Saturday, and if Curry joins him on the bench in street clothes, then De'Anthony Melton, Will Richard, Brandon Williams and Gary Payton would all be candidates to enter the Warriors' starting lineup.

3975.h: Curry (ankle) is available for Wednesday's game against the Lakers.
3975.s: Curry injured his ankle during practice Sunday. He carried a probable designation ahead of this contest, but he now officially has the green light to suit up. While Curry's presence could mean less work for others, there are still minutes available due to the absence of Brandin Podziemski (back). As a result, De'Anthony Melton and Gui Santos should be more involved than originally projected.

3975.h: Curry (ankle) is listed as probable for Wednesday's game against the Lakers.
3975.s: Curry suffered an ankle injury during Sunday's practice. Head coach Steve Kerr didn't seem overly concerned, though the multi-time All-Star will carry an injury designation ahead of Opening Night versus Los Angeles. If Curry suffers a setback and can't get on the floor, De'Anthony Melton would presumably see even more action, considering Brandin Podziemski (back) has already been ruled out.

3978.h: DeRozan (rest) is available for Friday's preseason game against the Lakers, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.
3978.s: DeRozan received Wednesday night off but will return to action in Friday's preseason finale. He'll come off the bench while the Nuggets start Trevon Brazile in Aaron Gordon's (rest) stead.

3978.h: DeRozan (rest) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Clippers, Katy Winge of Altitude Sports reports.
3978.s: The Nuggets' starters will all suit up versus Los Angeles, though the team will be without its top bench option. DeRozan has had a quiet preseason, averaging 4.7 points, 1.3 rebounds and 1.3 assists across 10.2 minutes per contest. However, it's reasonable to assume he will be much more productive come the start of the regular season. DeRozan is expected to play in Friday's preseason finale against the Lakers.

3978.h: DeRozan appears set to operate as the focal point of Denver's second unit this season, with head coach David Adelman planning to put the ball in the veteran forward's hands frequently, according to Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette.
3978.s: The plan provides a strong indication that the Nuggets intend to keep their starting five intact while utilizing DeRozan as their primary offensive option off the bench. The 37-year-old has spent nearly his entire career as a starter, but his scoring and playmaking ability could give Denver a dependable offensive engine whenever Nikola Jokic and Jamal Murray are off the floor.

3978.h: The Nuggets are signing DeRozan (hamstring) on Friday, per Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com.
3978.s: The Nuggets may have lost Peyton Watson to the Cavaliers earlier this week, but they've quickly made a move to upgrade their roster. DeRozan, a six-time All-Star, should assume a significant role with Denver after averaging 18.4 points, 4.1 assists, 2.9 rebounds and 1.0 steals in 31.2 minutes per game across 77 regular-season appearances for the Kings in 2025-26. The veteran forward is in line for a usage decrease…

3978.h: The Kings waived DeRozan (hamstring) on Monday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
3978.s: With the Kings unable to find a suitable trade, the two sides will simply move on. With this news, DeRozan suddenly becomes one of the most intriguing free agents on the open market. In 2025-26, DeRozan averaged 18.4 points, 4.1 assists, 2.9 rebounds and 1.0 steals in 31.2 minutes per game across 77 regular-season appearances.

3992.h: Harden (ankle) will play and start Sunday's preseason game against the Magic, Serena Winters of FanDuel Sports Network Ohio reports.
3992.s: Harden missed Cleveland's preseason opener due to right ankle soreness, but he will play Sunday. He will likely see fairly limited action in his return, given that it is the preseason.

3992.h: Harden (ankle) has been ruled out for Thursday's preseason game against the Celtics, Serena Winters of FanDuel Sports Network Ohio reports.
3992.s: Harden is dealing with right ankle soreness and will be held out of Cleveland's preseason opener. With the veteran guard sidelined, Jaylon Tyson will join Donovan Mitchell, Peyton Watson, Evan Mobley and Jarrett Allen in the starting five.

3992.h: Cleveland and Harden agreed Thursday to a three-year deal worth $97 million, per Chris Fedor of The Cleveland Plain Dealer.
3992.s: The expectation earlier this offseason was that Harden would re-sign on a new multi-year contract with the Cavaliers, and the deal is now in place. The star guard is entering his age-37 campaign but looks to have plenty left in the tank as an early-round fantasy player, having averaged 20.5 points, 7.7 assists, 4.8 rebounds and 3.1 three-pointers per game in 26 regular-season appearances for the Cavs in 2025-26.

3992.h: Harden declined his $42.3 million player option for 2026-27 on Monday and is working on a new multi-year deal with the Cavaliers, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
3992.s: After averaging 20.9 points, 6.2 assists, 5.2 rebounds and 2.0 steals through Cleveland's first 13 postseason games, Harden struggled mightily as the Cavaliers got swept by the Knicks in the Eastern Conference Finals. While a disappointing end, it was still a successful postseason run for the new-look Cavaliers. Having Harden decline his option for a longer deal should lead to more guaranteed money for him while…

3995.h: Holiday (hand) isn't listed on the injury report for Wednesday's game against the Suns.
3995.s: Holiday sat out Friday's preseason finale due to right hand soreness, though he'll return to action in Wednesday's regular-season opener. The veteran guard appears likely to begin the season with the second unit, and he faces competition for playing time from Scoot Henderson and Vit Krejci.

3995.h: Holiday is out for Friday's preseason finale against the Warriors due to right hand soreness.
3995.s: The 36-year-old veteran will skip Portland's final exhibition game with some soreness in his shooting hand, but this shouldn't be anything that impacts his status for Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Suns. With Holiday unavailable, expect more minutes for Scoot Henderson and Vit Krejci.

3995.h: Holiday won't start Tuesday's preseason game against the Kings, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
3995.s: Holiday got the starting nod in Monday's blowout win over the London Lions, though he'll slide to the second unit in the second leg of this back-to-back set. Damian Lillard, Scoot Henderson, Deni Avdija, Toumani Camara and Donovan Clingan will start against Sacramento.

3995.h: Holiday won't start Wednesday's preseason game against the Warriors, Jason Quick of The Athletic reports.
3995.s: Holiday has been a full-time starter for most of his career, though he isn't guaranteed to begin the 2026-27 campaign in a starting role. The Trail Blazers will start Damian Lillard, Ja Morant, Toumani Camara, Deni Avdija and Donovan Clingan in their preseason opener.

3995.h: Holiday is expected to spend more time on the wing this season, per Ramona Shelburne of ESPN.com.
3995.s: The veteran point guard averaged 16.3 points and 6.1 assists per game last year, his most since 2022-23 with the Bucks, but Holiday is likely to see fewer ballhandling responsibilities now that Ja Morant and Damian Lillard are manning the backcourt. Toumani Camara is the favorite to start at small forward for Portland, but Holiday is positioned for a very significant role off the bench and is worthy of a late-round…

4251.h: George (rest) is expected to play Tuesday versus Detroit.
4251.s: George didn't suit up for Friday's 125-120 preseason overtime win over Philadelphia to rest, though he is anticipated to be ready to go Tuesday versus the Pistons. The 36-year-old appeared in only 37 regular-season games for the 76ers in 2025-26, averaging 17.3 points, 5.3 rebounds, 3.6 assists and 1.7 steals over 30.7 minutes per outing. Now paired with Jayson Tatum (rest), George still has All-Star upside, but he…

4251.h: George (rest) won't play in Friday's preseason finale against the 76ers, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports.
4251.s: George and the rest of Boston's regulars won't suit up for the final exhibition but should be good to go for Tuesday's regular-season opener against the Pistons. George registered 13 points (3-10 FG, 2-7 3Pt, 5-6 FT), five rebounds, four assists and five steals over 25 minutes during his Celtics debut against the 76ers last Saturday.

4251.h: George (rest) is in the Celtics' starting lineup against the 76ers on Saturday, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports.
4251.s: George will suit up in a Celtics uniform for the first time and face his former team in Saturday's exhibition contest. His playing time figures to be limited until the Celtics' regular-season opener against the Pistons on Tuesday, Oct. 20.

4251.h: George (rest) isn't in line to play Thursday versus Cleveland, Zack Cox of the Boston Herald reports.
4251.s: The Celtics are holding several key contributors out of the starting lineup Thursday. Jordan Walsh is drawing the start at power forward.

4251.h: Head coach Joe Mazzulla praised George's experience Tuesday, per Justin Turpin of WEEI.com.
4251.s: George has big shoes to fill in Boston this season, stepping into the role as one of Jayson Tatum's running mates following Jaylen Brown's exit. Staying on the court has been a major concern for George, who has made at least 70 regular-season appearances just once in his past seven seasons. However, he should push for mid-round fantasy value when healthy after averaging at least 16.0 points, 5.0 rebounds, 3.5…

6430.h: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
6430.s: Butler, who underwent surgery after suffering the injury Jan. 19, has progressed to individual court work but still has several rehabilitation milestones to clear. His next step involves landing comfortably after a game-speed jump. Coach Steve Kerr is hopeful Butler can rejoin Golden State for the latter portion of the season, though no official return date has been announced. The 37-year-old forward remains a…

6430.h: The Warriors hope to have Butler (knee) back early in 2027, per Keith Watkins of Yahoo Sports.
6430.s: Butler is still months away from retaking the floor, according to Nick Friedell of The Athletic, so a season debut at some point in December might be too optimistic. The star forward remains without a definitive timeline for a return after undergoing ACL surgery in early February, which typically carries at least a nine-month recovery period. Butler makes sense as an injury stash at the end of fantasy drafts, but…

6430.h: Butler has been cleared to participate in light on-court activities, Evan Webeck of the California Post reports.
6430.s: Butler tore the ACL in his right knee in January before undergoing surgery in early February. The star forward still does not have a clear timetable for a return to game action, though it's encouraging to see his progression thus far. The 37-year-old appeared in 38 games during the 2025-26 regular season, averaging 20.0 points, 5.6 rebounds, 4.9 assists and 1.4 steals across 31.1 minutes per contest.

6430.h: Butler (knee) is still in the relatively early stages of his recovery and has only recently begun getting back on the court, according to Danny Emerman of SFStandard.com.
6430.s: There remains significant uncertainty surrounding his return timeline, as his injury typically carries a nine-to-12-month recovery window. A return sometime between Christmas and March appears to be a reasonable range for now, though fantasy managers shouldn't put much stock into a specific target date until Butler progresses further in his rehab.

6440.h: Harris (calf) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Kings.
6440.s: Harris is still ramping up from a left calf strain and will miss a fourth consecutive contest to begin the regular season. His next opportunity to make his season debut will come Wednesday at Utah in the second leg of this back-to-back set. Julian Champagnie and Keldon Johnson will likely continue seeing increased playing time while Harris is sidelined.

6440.h: Harris (calf) is out for Saturday's game against the Mavericks.
6440.s: Harris has yet to play for the Spurs this season, and this will be a third consecutive absence for the veteran forward. With Harris on the sidelines, Devin Vassell and Julian Champagnie should be in line for more playing time Saturday and beyond.

6440.h: Harris (calf) is out for Friday's game against the Rockets.
6440.s: The veteran forward still isn't ready to make his Spurs debut due to a left calf strain. Harris is up against a quick turnaround if he wants to suit up in time for Saturday's matchup with the Mavericks. Both Devin Vassell and Julian Champagnie stand out as worthy streaming candidates until Harris is cleared to play.

6440.h: Harris (calf) will not be ready for the regular-season opener Tuesday against the Thunder, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
6440.s: "He's ramping up. He's progressing," coach Mitch Johnson said. "He still needs some more progressing on the court." With Harris still not ready to return, the Spurs will likely utilize their three-guard lineup quite a bit, and guys like Julian Champagnie, Keldon Johnson and Harrison Barnes could find more minutes.

6440.h: Spurs head coach Mitch Johnson said the team will not rush Harris (calf) back to the court, Jared Weiss of The Athletic reports.
6440.s: "It's a calf strain, the seriousness is what it is," said Johnson. "We won't rush him at all. I guess the question will be is he ready for the season opener? Totally questionable and we will not push that at all. So, we'll take it slow. There is no concern of this level of seriousness, and at the same time, we will not rush him at all." It sounds like Harris, who has already been ruled out for the preseason, is in…

6442.h: Irving (knee) isn't listed on the injury report for Monday's game against the Heat.
6442.s: Irving sat out Saturday's loss to the Spurs in the second leg of a back-to-back set but is set to return to action Monday. The star point guard's return will leave fewer minutes available for the likes of Sergio de Larrea, Marcus Sasser and Walter Clayton, especially if Cooper Flagg (shoulder) is upgraded from questionable to available.

6442.h: Irving is out for Saturday's game against the Spurs due to left knee injury management, Christian Clark of The Athletic reports.
6442.s: The Mavericks are taking a cautious approach with Irving since he's played only a few games since returning from the ACL injury he sustained in March 2025, so it's not surprising to see him sit for rest purposes. His next chance to play will come against the Heat on Monday, and in the meantime, Marcus Sasser is expected to replace him in the backcourt against the Spurs.

6442.h: Irving (knee) has been downgraded from questionable to doubtful ahead of Saturday's game against the Spurs.
6442.s: It looks like Irving will end up missing the second leg of the Mavericks' back-to-back set Saturday while managing a knee issue. Marcus Sasser figures to enter the starting lineup if Irving is indeed ruled out against San Antonio.

6442.h: Irving (knee) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against San Antonio.
6442.s: Irving may sit out the second leg of this back-to-back set due to left knee injury management. If the star floor general is held out of Saturday's contest, Marcus Sasser and Sergio de Larrea would be candidates for increased minutes. Naji Marshall could also see increased playmaking duties if Irving joins Cooper Flagg (shoulder) on the inactive list.

6442.h: Irving (knee) will be on a minutes restriction in Friday's game against the Pacers, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.
6442.s: Irving will suit up for the front end of this back-to-back set, though he'll see limited playing time. As a result, Marcus Sasser could pick up a few extra minutes. Over 24 minutes in Wednesday's season-opening loss to Houston, Irving posted 15 points, four rebounds, two assists and one steal.

6450.h: Leonard is out for Sunday's game against the Timberwolves due to left knee swelling, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.
6450.s: Leonard wasn't listed on the injury report for Sunday's game, and this late scratch is a huge blow for Toronto since Leonard is a key piece on both ends of the court for the Raptors. Leonard is averaging 19.5 points, 7.5 rebounds, 1.5 assists and 3.5 steals per game in his first two appearances. With the star forward out, Allen Graves is expected to take his place in the starting lineup. Leonard is expected to…

6450.h: Leonard (rest) is expected to play in Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Bulls.
6450.s: Leonard sat out Friday's preseason finale but figures to play when the Raptors open the regular season at home against Chicago. The star forward appeared in two games this preseason, averaging 13.5 points, 3.0 rebounds and 2.0 steals in 19.6 minutes per contest.

6450.h: Leonard will be rested for Friday's preseason finale against the Pistons, Omari Sankofa II of the Detroit Free Press reports.
6450.s: Leonard will sit out the second leg of this back-to-back set. His status ahead of an Opening Night matchup against the Bulls on Wednesday is not in doubt.

6450.h: Leonard (not injury related) will make his preseason debut Tuesday against the Knicks, Esfandiar Baraheni of The Athletic reports.
6450.s: After missing the first two preseason contests, Leonard has the green light for game action. The Raptors have brought him along slowly, and it's likely he will play a limited role in his first game back with the Raptors.

6450.h: Leonard (not injury related) won't suit up for Saturday's exhibition against the Clippers, Tomer Azarly of ClutchPoints.com reports.
6450.s: Leonard will miss a second straight preseason game while ramping up his workload following the offseason, but he's not dealing with an injury. His next chance to play in the preseason will come Tuesday against the Knicks.

6475.h: Thompson (rest) is in line to play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Nets, Will Manso of Local 10 Miami reports.
6475.s: Miami intends to deploy most of its starters for this exhibition. The veteran sharpshooter should receive some playing time in the first half.

6475.h: Thompson (rest) is out for Saturday's preseason game against the Timberwolves, Eric Nehm of The Athletic reports.
6475.s: The 36-year-old vet will receive a maintenance day Saturday, but he should be back in action for Wednesday's preseason meeting with the Nets. Tim Hardaway should be more involved in the rotation Saturday with Thompson unavailable.

6475.h: Thompson is the clear front-runner to open the season as Miami's starting shooting guard, Anthony Chiang of the Miami Herald reports.
6475.s: While the Heat are expected to hold a competition for the job during the preseason, Thompson's floor-spacing ability makes him a natural fit alongside Bam Adebayo and Giannis Antetokounmpo. The veteran sharpshooter made 38.3 percent on 7.6 three-point attempts per game with Dallas last regular season and has converted 38.7 percent from deep over the past three regular seasons.

6475.h: Thompson cleared waivers and officially agreed to a two-year, $11.5 million contract with the Heat on Sunday, Sam Amick and Darnell Mayberry of The Athletic report.
6475.s: Miami acquired Giannis Antetokounmpo this offseason, but the Heat are now adding Thompson in hopes of bolstering the team's chances of winning another championship. The 2011 No. 11 overall pick is coming off his worst season, averaging 11.7 points, 2.1 rebounds and 1.4 assists across 21.7 minutes, all career lows, in 69 regular-season games with the Mavericks. 2990992.s: Smart will be held out of the second leg of this back-to-back set due to a left forearm strain. The veteran guard will join Fred VanVleet (knee/rest) on the inactive list, opening up minutes for Reed Sheppard, Bruce Thornton and Bogdan Bogdanovic.

2990992.h: Smart (forearm) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Hawks.
2990992.s: The veteran guard was a late addition to the injury report due to a left forearm strain. Both Smart and Reed Sheppard (knee) are in jeopardy of joining Fred VanVleet (knee/rest) on the inactive list for the second leg of this back-to-back set, so Bogdan Bogdanovic and Bruce Thornton could see increased playing time.

2990992.h: Smart will come off the bench in Thursday's preseason game against the Thunder, Jackson Gatlin of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
2990992.s: Smart drew an opportunity to start in Sunday's exhibition, finishing with 20 points in 24 minutes. He'll retreat to a bench role Thursday with the usual starting five getting one final dress rehearsal before the start of the regular season.

2991043.h: LeVert (coach's decision) did not play in Wednesday's 128-116 loss to Washington.
2991043.s: LeVert opened his Milwaukee tenure outside the rotation, a disappointing development for a veteran capable of providing scoring and secondary playmaking. He'll need to work his way into a meaningful role before warranting consideration in most fantasy leagues.

2991043.h: LeVert (coach's decision) was inactive for Wednesday's 128-126 preseason victory over Oklahoma City.
2991043.s: LeVert was among several Milwaukee veterans who did not suit up Wednesday. There is no indication that his absence was injury-related, and he will have another opportunity to play Sunday against Charlotte.

2991043.h: LeVert was traded from the Pistons to the Bucks on Tuesday along with two second-round picks in exchange for Taurean Prince and Gary Harris (groin), Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
2991043.s: LeVert will depart from the Pistons after just one season, during which he averaged 7.4 points, 2.7 assists and 2.0 rebounds in 19.3 minutes per contest across 60 regular-season appearances. The 31-year-old is likely to operate in a reserve role while serving as a veteran presence for a young Bucks team during the 2026-27 season.

2991070.h: Grant (rest) is off the injury report for Wednesday's season opener against the Jazz.
2991070.s: The veteran forward had sat out the end of the preseason for maintenance purposes. Grant is expected to open the season in a significant role off the bench in his debut campaign for the Grizzlies.

2991070.h: Grant won't play in Friday's preseason game against the Hornets due to soreness, Chris Herrington of The Daily Memphian reports.
2991070.s: Grant is dealing with "general soreness," so he will sit out the Grizzlies' final preseason contest. He'll likely be ready to go on Opening Night against the Jazz.

2991070.h: Grant appears to be among the Grizzlies' candidates for a starting role entering the preseason, Damichael Cole of The Commercial Appeal reports.
2991070.s: Memphis experimented with Grant in several lineup combinations during training camp, including extended work alongside GG Jackson. Grant's ability to switch defensively, attack the basket and space the floor gives coach Tuomas Iisalo flexibility, though it's unclear whether the veteran will ultimately start or operate as one of the Grizzlies' primary options off the bench.

2991070.h: The Grizzlies are trading Ja Morant (elbow) to the Trail Blazers for Grant and Kris Murray on Monday, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
2991070.s: Trade speculation had surrounded Morant's name for several months, and Memphis is finally pulling the trigger on a deal. The Grizzlies took Cameron Boozer with the No. 3 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, but Grant still has a chance to start at small forward with his new team in 2026-27. Last regular season, Grant averaged 18.6 points, 3.5 rebounds, 2.1 assists and 2.4 three-pointers in 29.7 minutes per game…

2991139.h: Dunn will start in Wednesday's game against Sacramento, Tomer Azarly of ClutchPoints.com reports.
2991139.s: Dunn will get the start against the Kings to begin the 2026-27 campaign. The 32-year-old started 68 regular-season games in 2025-26, averaging 7.6 points, 3.5 rebounds, 3.8 assists and 1.6 steals over 27.9 minutes per contest in those appearances.

2991139.h: Dunn (rest) is expected to play in Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Kings.
2991139.s: Dunn sat out Los Angeles' preseason finale but should be back in action Wednesday. The veteran guard started 68 of his 82 regular-season appearances in 2025-26, though he isn't guaranteed a starting role to begin the 2026-27 season.

2991139.h: Dunn (rest) has been ruled out for Wednesday's preseason game against the Nuggets, independent Clippers reporter Joey Linn reports.
2991139.s: After appearing in each of the Clippers' first two preseason games, Dunn will be sidelined Wednesday for rest purposes. The veteran guard's next chance to suit up will come in the club's regular-season opener Oct. 21 against the Kings, when he could see an elevated role with Bradley Beal (knee) ruled out.

2991230.h: VanVleet (knee) is off the injury report ahead of Monday's game against the Hawks.
2991230.s: VanVleet missed the second half of the team's back-to-back set Saturday as he continues to ease back into play following a torn ACL last season, but he will be available Monday. Through two appearances, VanVleet is averaging 10.0 points, 8.0 assists, 3.0 steals and 2.5 rebounds in 31.0 minutes per contest.

2991230.h: VanVleet (knee) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Hawks.
2991230.s: VanVleet will sit out the second leg of this back-to-back set due to right knee injury management, though he'll likely be able to return for Monday's rematch with Atlanta. In the meantime, Marcus Smart and Reed Sheppard (knee), who is listed as questionable, are candidates for increased burn. If Sheppard is also ruled out, Bruce Thornton could join the rotation.

2991230.h: VanVleet (rest) is unlikely to play in the second leg of the Rockets' back-to-back set Saturday against the Hawks.
2991230.s: Head coach Ime Udoku told reporters this past Tuesday that VanVleet would be sidelined for one leg of back-to-back sets to open the season, per Will Guillory of The Athletic. Since the Rockets played Friday, VanVleet figures to observe Saturday's contest in street clothes, so Marcus Smart will likely enter the starting lineup alongside Amen Thompson in the backcourt. VanVleet played 32 minutes during Friday's…

2991230.h: VanVleet will sit out one game of back-to-back sets to open the season, Will Guillory of The Athletic reports.
2991230.s: This was mentioned several times during the offseason, and coach Ime Udoka confirmed that plan Tuesday. Whether or not these restrictions will stay in place for the whole season remains to be seen. Marcus Smart will start in the games that VanVleet takes off. The first back-to-back set begins Friday against the Spurs.

2991230.h: Head coach Ime Udoka said Sunday that VanVleet won't face any minutes restrictions to begin the regular season, though the team may exercise caution in back-to-back sets, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.
2991230.s: VanVleet didn't play in 2025-26 due to a torn ACL, though he's set to return as Houston's starting point guard this season. The veteran floor general saw his numbers dip with the Rockets in 2024-25, when he averaged 14.1 points, 5.6 assists, 3.7 rebounds and 1.6 steals in 35.2 minutes per game across 60 regular-season appearances. While he's expected to play a sizable role in 2026-27, Amen Thompson could handle…

2991235.h: Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could be out "a week or two" due to his right soleus strain, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.
2991235.s: The veteran big man can be considered week-to-week until the Rockets offer another update on his status. In the meantime, Clint Capela is expected to see increased playing time behind Alperen Sengun. Jabari Smith is also likely to see more minutes at center in Adams' stead.

2991235.h: Adams has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Hawks due to a right soleus strain.
2991235.s: Adams sat out Saturday's win over the Hawks in the second leg of a back-to-back set, though he's now being ruled out due to a right soleus strain. Clint Capela and Jabari Smith will likely see increased burn for as long as Adams is sidelined.

2991235.h: Adams (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Hawks.
2991235.s: As expected, Adams will sit out the second leg of this back-to-back set due to left ankle injury management. His next chance to play will come in Monday's rematch versus the Hawks. With the veteran big man out, Clint Capela will likely see a bump in minutes.

2991235.h: Adams (rest) will likely be sidelined for Saturday's game against the Hawks.
2991235.s: Head coach Ime Udoka indicated before the start of the regular season that Adams and Fred VanVleet (rest) would both be sidelined for one game of back-to-back sets to open the year, per Will Guillory of The Athletic. Adams played only nine minutes off the bench during Friday's 114-110 win over the Spurs, and if he's indeed ruled out for Saturday, then Clint Capela would take on a larger workload off the bench behind…

2991235.h: Adams (calf) is available for Friday's game against San Antonio.
2991235.s: Adams missed Wednesday's season-opening win over the Mavericks but will shed his questionable tag and return to action Friday. He's expected to operate as Alperen Sengun's primary backup.

2991350.h: Caruso exited to the locker room in the second quarter of Monday's game against the Suns due to an apparent right ankle injury, Rylan Stiles of SI.com reports.
2991350.s: Caruso appeared to turn his ankle before limping to the locker room. He can be considered questionable to return until more information comes to light.

2991350.h: Caruso is not listed in the starting lineup for Wednesday's game against the Spurs, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
2991350.s: Caruso started in the 116-89 loss to the Rockets in the Thunder's final preseason contest. However, as expected, he will return to the bench versus San Antonio.

2991350.h: Caruso will start Tuesday's preseason meeting with Indiana, Justin Martinez of The Oklahoman reports.
2991350.s: Chet Holmgren (quadriceps) will remain on the inactive list, opening the door for Caruso to enter the starting five. He'll be joined in the first unit by Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Cason Wallace, Jalen Williams and Isaiah Hartenstein.

2991350.h: Caruso (rest) is available for Tuesday's preseason game against the Pacers, Justin Martinez of The Oklahoman reports.
2991350.s: Caruso didn't travel with the Thunder for their loss to Atlanta on Monday, but he'll return to action in the second leg of this back-to-back set. With the veteran swingman back in action, fewer minutes will be available for the likes of Brooks Barnhizer, Josh Dix and Otega Oweh.

2991350.h: Caruso (rest) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Hawks, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
2991350.s: Caruso and the rest of the Thunder's regulars won't travel to Atlanta but are expected to suit up Tuesday, when they host Indiana. The veteran wing has averaged fewer than 20 minutes per game in each of his first two seasons in Oklahoma City, but his positive real-life impact has been undeniable.

2993874.h: Anderson (knee) was a full participant in Monday's practice, Josh Lewenberg of TSN.ca reports.
2993874.s: Anderson missed Saturday's preseason opener against Miami due to a right knee contusion, but his return to full practice suggests the issue was minor. The veteran forward's next opportunity to play will come Saturday against the Clippers.

2993874.h: Anderson (knee) has been ruled out for Saturday's preseason game against the Heat, Josh Lewenberg of TSN.ca reports.
2993874.s: Anderson will miss the Raptors' preseason opener after sitting out Thursday's scrimmage with a right knee contusion. His next opportunity to suit up in the preseason will come next Saturday against the Clippers.

2993874.h: Anderson sat out of Thursday's scrimmage due to a bruised right knee, Josh Lewenberg of TSN.ca reports.
2993874.s: Anderson's knee injury is considered to be minor, but his availability will be worth monitoring heading into Toronto's first preseason matchup against Miami on Saturday. The 33-year-old signed a one-year deal with the Raptors in July and is competing for a spot in the frontcourt rotation heading into the 2026-27 campaign.

2993874.h: Anderson agreed to a one-year, $3.9 million contract with the Raptors on Thursday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
2993874.s: Anderson will join Toronto with the hope of providing depth in the frontcourt. He's bounced around to five different teams over his last two seasons, most recently suiting up for Memphis, Minnesota and Utah a year ago. Anderson averaged 6.2 points, 3.5 rebounds, 2.9 assists and 1.0 steals in 43 regular-season appearances during the 2025-26 campaign.

2995706.h: Head coach Kenny Atkinson said Friday that Hezonja is "going to be in the mix" for a spot in Cleveland's rotation to begin the 2026-27 campaign, Chris Fedor of Cleveland.com reports.
2995706.s: The Cavaliers essentially have four of their starting five confirmed, and Peyton Watson (hamstring) appears likely to slot into that fifth spot. However, training camp will be important in determining who else fills out the rotation. Hezonja, the fifth overall pick in 2015, hasn't played in the NBA since the 2019-20 season but has plenty of experience overseas. The Cavaliers boast a deep roster heading into training…

2995706.h: Cleveland's acquisition of Peyton Watson adds another versatile forward to a frontcourt that already has plenty of competition for Hezonja and others.
2995706.s: Watson is coming off a breakout season in which he averaged 14.6 points and 4.9 rebounds while shooting 41.1 percent from three across 54 regular-season outings, and his new four-year, $88 million contract indicates he'll command a substantial role. Hezonja's path to consistent playing time consequently becomes more complicated, leaving him with limited fantasy appeal unless injuries thin Cleveland's rotation.

2995706.h: Hezonja agreed to a one-year, $2.8 million contract with the Cavaliers on Sunday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
2995706.s: Hezonja is set to return to the NBA for the first time since the 2019-20 campaign after spending the past six seasons overseas. The 2015 first-round pick earned 2025-26 Liga ACB MVP honors after a standout season with Real Madrid. In his return stateside, the 31-year-old is likely to serve as forward depth off the bench for the Cavaliers and could see his role increase if his scoring ability from Europe translates…

3032976.h: Gobert (rest) is expected to be available for Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Heat.
3032976.s: Gobert was one of many Timberwolves regulars who sat out the preseason finale, though the big man should be available Wednesday. He averaged 5.8 points, 5.8 rebounds and 1.5 assists in 19.9 minutes per game across four appearances this preseason.

3032976.h: Gobert (rest) won't play in Friday's preseason finale against the Bulls, Chuck Swirsky of the Bulls Radio Network reports.
3032976.s: Gobert, Anthony Edwards, LaMelo Ball and Ayo Dosunmu are all resting for the final exhibition. Gobert should be good to go for Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Heat.

3032976.h: Gobert (rest) is in the starting lineup for Monday's preseason game against the Knicks.
3032976.s: After resting Saturday, Gobert will return to the starting lineup at Madison Square Garden. In two preseason games, the veteran center is averaging 6.5 points, 8.0 rebounds and 1.0 assists in 17.8 minutes per contest.

3032976.h: Gobert (rest) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Heat.
3032976.s: Gobert and several other prominent Timberwolves players will be idle for Saturday's exhibition contest. The veteran center's next chance to play is Monday against the Knicks.

3032976.h: Gobert continues to work on expanding his offensive game, including participating in three-point drills with his teammates, Andrew Dukowitz of ZoneCoverage.com reports.
3032976.s: Gobert said shooting was an area of emphasis during the offseason and noted that competing with teammates in drills has helped make taking jumpers feel more natural in game-like situations. While it's unclear whether three-pointers will become a meaningful part of his offensive role, Gobert has worked on his perimeter shooting in previous offseasons as well.

3032977.h: Antetokounmpo (rest) is expected to play in Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Timberwolves.
3032977.s: After sitting out Friday's preseason finale, Antetokounmpo is gearing up for his regular-season debut with Miami. Over three preseason appearances in 2026, the superstar forward averaged 15.7 points, 7.7 rebounds, 6.7 assists and 1.7 combined steals-plus-blocks in 18.6 minutes per showing.

3032977.h: Antetokounmpo (rest) won't play in Friday's preseason game against the Magic, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
3032977.s: The superstar forward will sit out Miami's preseason finale, joining Bam Adebayo (groin) on the inactive list. Antetokounmpo figures to be available for Wednesday's regular-season opener against Minnesota.

3032979.h: Schroder will start in Tuesday's preseason game against the Nets.
3032979.s: Schroder will roll with the first five in Tuesday's meeting against his former team. The veteran guard most recently appeared in 30 regular-season games for Cleveland in 2025-26, averaging 8.2 points, 2.3 rebounds and 4.3 assists over 24.2 minutes per contest.

3032979.h: The Cavaliers traded Schroder and cash considerations to the Hornets on Friday in exchange for Tre Mann, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
3032979.s: The two sides are effectively swapping backcourt depth with the move. Schroder averaged 10.8 points, 4.9 assists and 2.7 rebounds in 24.2 minutes per game across 70 regular-season appearances between the Cavaliers and Kings in 2025-26, and he gives the rebuilding Hornets a veteran presence as a backup point guard behind Coby White.

3037789.h: Bogdanovic signed a one-year contract with the Rockets on Tuesday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
3037789.s: After the Clippers declined their team option on Bogdanovic's contract, the veteran sharpshooter is set to head to Houston. The 33-year-old saw inconsistent burn with Los Angeles in 2025-26, averaging a career-low 7.4 points along with 2.6 rebounds and 2.2 assists in 19.7 minutes per showing across 23 regular-season appearances (three starts). He shot a career-worst 34.7 percent from deep last season but is a career…

3037789.h: The Clippers declined Bogdanovic's team option for 2026-27 on Monday, Jake Fischer of BleacherReport.com reports.
3037789.s: Bogdanovic has battled injuries the past two seasons, and even when he was available last year, he was hardly part of the Clippers' regular rotation. Regardless, he should still draw attention on the open market as a sharpshooting wing. Bogdanovic's 34.7-percent mark from deep last year was a career low, as he'd never dropped below 36 percent in any of his previous eight seasons.

3059318.h: Embiid has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Detroit due to right plantar fasciitis management.
3059318.s: Embiid will be held out of the second leg of this back-to-back set after posting a 28-point triple-double in Saturday's win over Milwaukee. Adem Bona will likely see a significant bump in minutes in Embiid's stead.

3059318.h: Embiid (rest) is off the injury report for Saturday's game against the Bucks.
3059318.s: The star big man told reporters following Thursday's comeback win over the Cavaliers that he'd play only one half of this back-to-back set, so he's in line to sit out Sunday's showdown with the Pistons as opposed to Saturday. With LeBron James (back) a candidate to miss Saturday's contest, Embiid could have more usage on his plate.

3059318.h: Embiid (rest) will play in Friday's preseason finale against Boston, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.
3059318.s: Embiid was held out of Saturday's game against Boston for maintenance and there is no injury to report. He will get some final reps Friday ahead of Opening Night.

3059318.h: Embiid (rest) is out for Saturday's exhibition against the Celtics, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.
3059318.s: Head coach Nick Nurse is resting most of the vets for Saturday's exhibition, so Jabari Walker could get all the run he can handle. Embiid should return for Friday's preseason rematch with Boston.

3059318.h: Embiid (rest) is set to play in Thursday's preseason game against the Nets, per ESPN.com.
3059318.s: The 76ers are planning to have their entire Opening Night starting lineup available Thursday. Embiid, who sat out the preseason opener, should get some run in the first half while Philadelphia gets its first look at its new-look roster.

3059319.h: Wiggins (rest) is in line to play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Nets, Will Manso of Local 10 Miami reports.
3059319.s: The Heat plan to give the majority of their starters some playing time Wednesday. Wiggins figures to see some action in the first half.

3059319.h: Wiggins (rest) won't play in Saturday's preseason game against the Timberwolves, Eric Nehm of The Athletic reports.
3059319.s: Wiggins will skip Saturday's exhibition for maintenance reasons, but he should return for Wednesday's preseason game against Brooklyn. Wiggins' absence should open up minutes for Myron Gardner and Simone Fontecchio.

3059319.h: Wiggins (illness) is available for Thursday's preseason game against New Orleans, Anthony Chiang of the Miami Herald reports.
3059319.s: Wiggins has overcome an illness that bothered him earlier this week and cost him some practice time. His status for the start of the regular season is not in question.

3059319.h: Wiggins is dealing with an illness, per Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel.
3059319.s: Wiggins was limited at practice Wednesday and sat out Tuesday's scrimmage, per Eric Nehm of The Athletic. His status is in question for Thursday's preseason game against the Pelicans, but Wiggins isn't in jeopardy of missing regular-season action.

3059319.h: Wiggins' versatility should allow him to fit comfortably alongside Giannis Antetokounmpo and Miami's other high-usage players this season, according to Heat reporter Zachary Weinberger.
3059319.s: Head coach Erik Spoelstra praised Wiggins' ability to adapt to playing alongside other stars, noting that the veteran has become increasingly effective playing off the ball despite previously serving as a No. 1 option. Spoelstra also highlighted Wiggins' ability to defend opposing teams' top players while remaining capable of creating with the ball, giving Miami flexibility in how it utilizes him within its revamped…

3062679.h: Hart (ankle) isn't listed on the injury report ahead of Tuesday's game against the 76ers.
3062679.s: Hart was held out of New York's preseason finale with ankle soreness, but as expected, he'll be ready to go for the 2026-27 regular-season opener. He started 52 of 66 regular-season appearances a year ago, averaging 12.0 points, 7.4 rebounds, 4.8 assists and 1.1 steals in 30.2 minutes per game.

3062679.h: Coach Mike Brown doesn't expect Hart to miss Tuesday's regular-season opener Tuesday against Philadelphia, Kristian Winfield of the New York Daily News reports.
3062679.s: Hart was held out of Thursday's preseason matchup against the Raptors due to right ankle soreness, but it doesn't appear as though he's in any danger of missing the season opener. It'll be worth monitoring his status over the next few days, but all signs point to him suiting up Tuesday.

3062679.h: Hart (ankle) has been ruled out for Thursday's preseason game against Toronto, Stefan Bondy of The New York Post reports.
3062679.s: According to Steve Popper of Newsday, Hart is dealing with right ankle soreness. His next chance to play will come in Tuesday's regular-season opener versus Philadelphia. Mohamed Diawara will draw the start in Hart's place Thursday.

3062679.h: Hart isn't listed in New York's starting lineup for Thursday's preseason game against the Raptors.
3062679.s: Head coach Mike Brown said pregame that New York's starters will see increased playing time in the team's preseason finale. However, it's unclear if Hart will suit up given he isn't listed in the first unit.

3062679.h: Hart (rest) is in line to play in Thursday's preseason game against the Raptors, James L. Edwards III of The Athletic reports,
3062679.s: Thursday's exhibition is serving as a dress rehearsal for the Knicks. Hart's leash could theoretically extend into the second half as a result.

3064290.h: Gordon (rest) is expected to play in Thursday's regular-season opener against the Thunder.
3064290.s: Gordon sat out Friday's preseason finale but should return to the lineup in Oklahoma City on Thursday. The veteran forward is coming off an injury-plagued 2025-26 season in which he appeared in only 36 regular-season games (33 starts), averaging 16.2 points, 5.8 rebounds and 2.7 assists in 27.9 minutes per showing.

3064290.h: Gordon (rest) won't play in Friday's preseason finale against the Lakers, Jovan Buha of The Athletic reports.
3064290.s: Gordon is being held out of Denver's final preseason game for maintenance purposes, but he should be fine for Thursday's regular-season opener in Oklahoma City. Trevon Brazile will start in Gordon's place Friday evening.

3064290.h: Gordon is focused more on his health in an effort to avoid soft-tissue injuries after two injury-riddled seasons, Bennett Durando of The Denver Post reports.
3064290.s: "I need to be here much earlier and stay much later," Gordon said. "And I need to invest a lot more time warming up and a lot more time cooling down so I can be available for these guys." After appearing in just 51 regular-season games (42 starts) in the 2024-25 season, the veteran forward played in just 36 outings (33 starts) last regular season. Gordon missed 38 of Denver's 48 games from Nov. 22 to March 5 due to…

3064290.h: Gordon (calf) said he got his mind and body right during the offseason, and he's "ready to go" for the 2026-27 season, Harrison Wind of TheDNVR.com reports.
3064290.s: Gordon labored through a left calf issue during Denver's postseason run last spring, missing three of the Nuggets' final four games in their first-round loss to the Timberwolves. However, he's had plenty of time to recover, and it appears he'll enter training camp at 100 percent. Gordon averaged 27.9 minutes per game last season over 36 regular-season contests, but his playing time could dip this upcoming season due…

3064290.h: Gordon (calf) could see more usage for Denver in 2026-27 after Peyton Watson was shipped to Cleveland.
3064290.s: Much like teammates Christian Braun and Cameron Johnson, Gordon experienced an injury-plagued 2025-26 campaign but maintained strong productivity when healthy. Gordon averaged 16.2 points, his most since his time with Orlando, 5.8 rebounds, 2.7 assists and 1.7 three-pointers in 27.9 minutes per game over 36 regular-season appearances, and Watson's departure presents one less obstacle for usage.

3064440.h: LaVine (rest) will play in Friday's preseason game against San Antonio, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.
3064440.s: LaVine didn't play in Tuesday's exhibition versus Portland. However, he will suit up for the Kings' final preseason game before Opening Night. The 31-year-old will be looking to bounce back during the 2026-27 campaign after averaging 19.2 points, 2.8 rebounds and 2.3 assists over 31.4 minutes in just 39 regular-season games in 2025-26.

3064440.h: LaVine (rest) will not play in Tuesday's preseason matchup against Portland, Matt George of ABC 10 Sacramento reports.
3064440.s: LaVine is among eight Kings players ruled out for Tuesday's contest. His next opportunity to play will come Friday against San Antonio in the preseason finale.

3064440.h: LaVine is healthy entering training camp, Kings general manager Scott Perry said Monday, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
3064440.s: LaVine underwent season-ending surgery in February to repair a torn tendon in his right fifth finger, an injury that limited him to 39 regular-season appearances in 2025-26. He averaged 19.2 points per game while shooting 47.9 percent from the field and 39.0 percent from three, and his healthy status entering camp puts him on track to resume a prominent role in Sacramento's backcourt.

3064440.h: LaVine (hand) exercised his $49 million player option for 2026-27 on Monday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
3064440.s: LaVine underwent season-ending surgery on his right hand before the 2025-26 All-Star break. He averaged 19.2 points in 39 regular-season games last season and was a two-time All-Star before being traded to the Kings in February of 2025. The Kings are listening to trade offers for LaVine and Domantas Sabonis (knee), but their hefty contracts are making things difficult. If LaVine stays in Sacramento, he would likely…

3064482.h: Portis won't start Wednesday's game against the Timberwolves, Zachary Weinberger of ClutchPoints.com reports.
3064482.s: Portis drew the start in Friday's preseason finale but will return to the second unit Wednesday. The veteran big man is expected to play a sizable role off the Heat's bench this season.

3064482.h: Portis will start Friday's preseason finale against Orlando, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
3064482.s: With Giannis Antetokounmpo (rest) and Bam Adebayo (groin) sidelined, Portis will enter the starting five. He's expected to operate as one of the Heat's first men off the bench in the regular season.

3064514.h: Randle is expected to make his Nets debut in Tuesday's preseason opener against the Hornets, C.J. Holmes of the New York Daily News reports.
3064514.s: Randle has been a full participant throughout training camp and will get his first opportunity to play alongside his new teammates Tuesday. Coach Jordi Fernandez has experimented with using Randle in several ways offensively, including as a ballhandler, in dribble handoffs and as a playmaker out of the short roll.

3064514.h: Randle said he's looking forward to playing alongside Michael Porter after Brooklyn acquired him this offseason, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports.
3064514.s: After acting as the top-scoring option for most of his Knicks tenure, Randle's usage took an expected dip over his last two years in Minnesota. He lost plenty of playmaking duties to Anthony Edwards with the Timberwolves, but Randle is now in line for a considerable bump in ball-handling responsibilities with the rebuilding Nets. The veteran forward figures to be a focal point of the offense alongside Porter in…

3064560.h: Kornet (rest) is available for Friday's preseason game against the Kings, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
3064560.s: Kornet will play in the Spurs' preseason finale after getting the night off Wednesday. After averaging 6.5 points, 6.1 rebounds, 1.8 assists and 1.0 blocks in 21.0 minutes per contest over 68 regular-season appearances (25 starts) in 2025-26, the big man is once again expected to operate as Victor Wembanyama's primary backup.

3064560.h: Kornet (rest) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Suns, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
3064560.s: Kornet has appeared in all three of the Spurs' preseason games. As a result, he will take the night off Wednesday, with his final opportunity to suit up before the start of the 2026-27 campaign coming Friday versus Sacramento.

3064560.h: Kornet is in the starting lineup for Monday's exhibition in Utah, Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News reports.
3064560.s: Victor Wembanyama (rest) is sitting this one out, so Kornet will get some time to shine in the first unit. Over 25 starts during the 2025-26 regular season, Kornet averaged 7.8 points, 6.5 rebounds, 2.2 assists and 1.4 blocks per contest.

3078576.h: White (rest) is expected to play in Tuesday's game against Detroit.
3078576.s: White didn't suit up for Friday's 125-120 preseason overtime win over the 76ers to rest but is expected to play versus the Pistons. The 32-year-old averaged a career-best 16.5 points along with 4.4 rebounds, 5.4 assists, 1.3 blocks and 1.1 steals over 34.1 minutes in 77 regular-season games in 2025-26. White did have some trouble finding the net, especially from deep, though he reportedly worked on his shot during…

3078576.h: White will not play in Friday's preseason finale against the 76ers, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports.
3078576.s: Most of Boston's regulars are getting the night off. White is expected to be in action for Tuesday's regular-season opener against the Pistons.

3078576.h: White (rest) is in the Celtics' starting lineup against the 76ers on Saturday, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports.
3078576.s: White and other prominent Celtics players like Jayson Tatum (rest) and Paul George (rest) will be on the floor for Saturday's exhibition contest. It'll be White's first preseason game as he gears up for Boston's regular-season opener against Detroit on Tuesday, Oct. 20.

3078576.h: White (rest) isn't in line to play Thursday against Cleveland, Zack Cox of the Boston Herald reports.
3078576.s: The Celtics appear to be resting their starters for this exhibition. Mike Conley is starting at point guard Thursday.

3078576.h: White could see a slight uptick in offensive responsibility following Boston's acquisition of Paul George in exchange for Jaylen Brown and other assets, John Schuhmann of NBA.com reports.
3078576.s: George's ability to space the floor and operate off the ball should fit well alongside White. However, Brown's departure leaves significant shot-creation opportunities that White may be asked to fill. His versatile stat profile already gives him a high fantasy floor, and a modest increase in usage would further boost his value.

3102529.h: Capela isn't in the starting lineup for Thursday's preseason game against Oklahoma City, Jackson Gatlin of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
3102529.s: Capela drew the start in Sunday's exhibition, but he'll retreat to the bench for Thursday's preseason finale. Alperen Sengun will draw the start at center after receiving Sunday off for rest purposes.

3102529.h: Capela (coach's decision) did not play during Friday's 135-117 preseason win over the Mavericks.
3102529.s: Capela, Marcus Smart and Jae'Sean Tate didn't leave the bench during the preseason opener, but there were no injuries reported. Capela is slated to be the third-string center behind Alperen Sengun and Steven Adams this season.

3102529.h: Capela is feeling healthy after trimming down his weight this offseason, per Ben DuBose of USA Today.
3102529.s: Capela could occupy the backup center role to open the season due to the uncertainty surrounding the status of Steven Adams, who's coming off ankle surgery. Alperen Sengun will handle the lion's share of the minutes at center, likely leaving Capela to fight for scraps off the bench in any event.

3102530.h: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of the second toe on his right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.
3102530.s: Nurkic will begin the 2026-27 season on the sidelines, and given the tricky nature of foot injuries for big men, it wouldn't be shocking to see his absence extend beyond this initial four-week window. Jaren Jackson will likely spend more time at center while Nurkic is out, and there will be more minutes available for Jaxson Hayes and Mo Bamba.

3102530.h: Nurkic (foot) is listed as out for Tuesday's preseason game against Denver.
3102530.s: Nurkic is dealing with a foot issue, so he will miss Utah's second preseason game on the schedule. With Kyle Filipowski (back) also sidelined, Jaxson Hayes, Mo Bamba and Jonas Aidoo should handle the bulk of the minutes at the center position.

3102530.h: Nurkic didn't participate in Monday's practice due to a right foot injury, Shreyas Laddha of The Salt Lake Tribune reports.
3102530.s: Nurkic logged 11 minutes in Sunday's preseason-opening win over Denver, posting four points (1-5 FG, 2-2 FT, 0-2 3Pt), five rebounds, four assists, one steal and one block. The big man can be considered questionable for Tuesday's preseason rematch against Denver until the Jazz offer an update on his status.

3102530.h: Nurkic (nose) is projected as Utah's top starting center for the 2026-27 season after the Jazz lost Walker Kessler to the Lakers this offseason, Jared Koch of SI.com reports.
3102530.s: Nurkic was highly productive when available for the Jazz, averaging 10.9 points, 10.4 rebounds, 4.8 assists and 1.3 steals in 26.4 minutes per game across 41 regular-season games (36 starts) last year. The veteran big man will have a new partner in the frontcourt with Jaren Jackson now in the fold, so it'll be interesting to see how the two big men mesh in 2026-27. Nurkic should be ready for the start of training…

3102530.h: Nurkic (nose) intends to sign a two-year, $22 million contract to return to the Jazz, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
3102530.s: Nurkic was a full-time starter for the Jazz since November of the 2025-26 campaign due to the absence of Walker Kessler (shoulder). The former averaged 10.9 points, 10.4 rebounds, 4.8 assists and 1.3 steals over 26.4 minutes per game across 41 regular-season games (36 starts) last year, but Nurkic missed the last two months of the season after undergoing surgery on his nose in mid-February. He should be 100 percent…

3102531.h: Porzingis is contemplating his future in basketball as he deals with recurring symptoms from the autoimmune condition termed as postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
3102531.s: Charania also notes Golden State has started exploring trade routes for Porzingis, who is already considered out indefinitely to begin the 2026-27 season. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect the big man to get back on the floor anytime soon, whether it be for the Warriors or perhaps another team, and it sounds like stepping away from the game is on the table for Porzingis at this point.

3102531.h: Porzingis (undisclosed) won't travel with the Warriors and remains out indefinitely, Luca Evans of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.
3102531.s: Porzingis is going to miss the start of the regular season, and fantasy managers should treat his return as an if, not a when. The Warriors have not released any additional info on Porzingis' absence, saying it's an undisclosed health issue. Given Porzingis' medical history, both sides are going to proceed with the utmost caution.

3102531.h: Porzingis (undisclosed) returned Wednesday to the Warriors' practice facility, per Anthony Slater of ESPN.com.
3102531.s: Head coach Steve Kerr still has no update on Porzingis' timeline for a return, per Luca Evans of the San Francisco Chronicle. With so much camp time missed, the big man's status for the start of the regular season remains in serious doubt at this point after the Warriors announced Wednesday that Porzingis remains out indefinitely with an undisclosed health issue.

3102531.h: Porzingis (undisclosed) remains away from the team, per Anthony Slater of ESPN.com.
3102531.s: Porzingis has yet to report to Warriors training camp while dealing with an undisclosed issue. He's running out of time to make a preseason appearance, and it sounds like the big man is in real jeopardy of missing the start of the regular season at this point.

3102531.h: Porzingis (undisclosed) remains out indefinitely, per Anthony Slater of ESPN.com.
3102531.s: The Warriors still aren't ready to offer up a return timeline for Porzingis, who's battling an undisclosed issue. The big man carries plenty of upside on a per-game basis in the later rounds of fantasy drafts, but he's reached the 60-game mark just one time in the past eight regular seasons.

3112335.h: Jokic reiterated Monday that he intends to sign a new contract with the Nuggets next offseason, Brendan Vogt of TheDNVR.com reports.
3112335.s: "I'm going to sign next year, if they want me," Jokic said, adding that his decision to hold off on an extension this summer was purely business. The three-time MVP passed on a four-year extension worth $278 million and can become eligible for a five-year deal worth approximately $360 million next summer. Jokic has repeatedly expressed his desire to spend the remainder of his career in Denver, so his decision to…

3112335.h: The Nuggets added another playmaker with the signing of DeMar DeRozan on Friday to pair alongside Jokic to help handle the offensive pressure in 2026-27.
3112335.s: Jokic averaged a triple-double for the second straight season in 2025-26, though it's possible the addition of DeRozan slightly cuts into his ball-handling responsibilities. Regardless, the presence of DeRozan, a six-time All-Star, as opposed to the more defensive-minded Peyton Watson, should aid Jokic's efficiency as well as his ability to find open looks all around the court in 2026-27.

3133603.h: Oubre will start Monday's game against the Bucks, Scott Agness of FieldhouseFiles.com reports.
3133603.s: Andrew Nembhard (neck/back) has been ruled out Monday, opening up a spot in the starting five for Oubre. The Kansas product also started the 2026-27 opener and finished with four points, two rebounds, three assists, one steal and one block in 28 minutes against New Orleans.

3133603.h: Oubre is not in the starting lineup for Friday's matchup with the Mavericks, Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com
3133603.s: Jarace Walker will replace Oubre in the first unit for Friday's game. Oubre saw 28 minutes as a starter in the Pacers' season opener, but his playing time may be reduced to the lower 20s in the reserve role.

3133603.h: Oubre agreed to a two-year deal worth nearly $17 million to sign with the Pacers on Wednesday, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
3133603.s: After spending the past three years with the 76ers, Oubre is heading to Indiana for his 11th NBA season. The veteran swingman averaged 14.1 points, 5.0 rebounds, 1.6 assists, 1.4 steals and 1.7 three-pointers in 31.5 minutes per tilt over 50 games during the regular season, shooting a career-high 36.0 percent from deep for Philadelphia in 2025-26. All signs point toward Tyrese Haliburton (Achilles) being ready for…

3133626.h: Williams will start Monday's game against Phoenix, Brandon Rahbar of DailyThunder.com reports.
3133626.s: Chet Holmgren (knee) won't play in the second leg of this back-to-back set, joining Jalen Williams (leg) and Cason Wallace (shoulder) on the inactive list. As a result, Williams will join the starting five for the first time since Feb. 12.

3133626.h: Williams (rest) is available for Tuesday's preseason meeting with the Pacers, Justin Martinez of The Oklahoman reports.
3133626.s: Williams was one of several Thunder players who didn't travel with the team for Monday's loss to Atlanta, though he'll return to action Tuesday. The 31-year-old forward faces plenty of competition for frontcourt minutes in 2026-27 after averaging 6.5 points, 3.3 rebounds and 1.4 assists in 15.3 minutes per contest across 56 regular-season appearances (two starts) in 2025-26.

3133626.h: Williams (rest) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Hawks, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
3133626.s: Williams and the rest of the Thunder's regulars won't travel to Atlanta but are expected to suit up Tuesday, when they host the Pacers. Williams has averaged 15.5 minutes per game over the past three seasons in Oklahoma City, starting 10 of his 194 regular-season appearances.

3133626.h: Williams will come off the bench in Wednesday's exhibition against the Bucks, Brandon Rahbar of DailyThunder.com reports.
3133626.s: Williams started for a resting Jalen Williams in Tuesday's preseason opener, but J Dub is back, so Williams will shift to the second unit. It will be tough for Williams to find meaningful minutes in Oklahoma City this season while the main guys are healthy.

3133626.h: Williams is in the starting lineup for Tuesday's preseason game against the Pelicans, Justin Martinez of The Oklahoman reports.
3133626.s: The Thunder are resting all of their regular starters for this pre-season opener, and Williams will benefit from that to get the nod at power forward. The veteran will play in his ninth season in the NBA and seventh with the Thunder, and he should have the same depth role he's had throughout his career in OKC.

3133628.h: Turner (rest) is available for Friday's preseason game versus the Pacers.
3133628.s: Turner was one of several key Bucks players who sat out Wednesday's loss to the Bulls, but he's been given the green light to return in Milwaukee's preseason finale. The veteran center will look to bounce back in 2026-27 following a lackluster first year with the Bucks, during which he averaged 11.9 points, 5.3 rebounds, 1.6 blocks, 1.5 assists and 0.7 steals in 26.9 minutes per game across 71 regular-season starts.

3133628.h: Turner (rest) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against Chicago, Cameron Ezeir of CBS58 reports.
3133628.s: Turner started in all three of Milwaukee's preseason games thus far, averaging 10.3 points, 4.0 rebounds, 1.0 steals and 2.7 blocks over 21.7 minutes per contest. It's unknown if he will suit up for Friday's preseason meeting with the Pacers, Milwaukee's final exhibition before the start of the regular season on Oct. 21 in Washington.

3133635.h: Carter (coach's decision) did not play in Wednesday's 132-125 loss to Atlanta.
3133635.s: Carter wasn't called upon in Orlando's season opener, suggesting he'll primarily serve as backcourt depth. The veteran guard will likely need an injury or a rotation adjustment to receive consistent playing time.

3133635.h: Carter will sign a one-year, $3.5 million deal with the Magic, Shams Charania of ESPN reports Wednesday.
3133635.s: Carter will be penciled in as the third-string point guard ahead of Opening Night, behind Jalen Suggs and Anthony Black. During the 2025-26 regular season, Carter appeared in 53 contests between the Bulls and Magic, posting averages of 6.4 points, 1.7 rebounds and 1.6 assists.

3134903.h: Payton (rest) is out for Wednesday's preseason game against the Trail Blazers, Dalton Johnson of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.
3134903.s: Payton is among several rotation players Golden State is holding out Wednesday during a preseason back-to-back. The veteran guard remains in the mix for a reserve role after appearing in a career-high 73 games during the 2025-26 regular season.

3134903.h: Payton agreed to a one-year, $3.9 million deal with the Warriors on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
3134903.s: Payton lingered on the open market, but he'll ultimately return to Golden State for his 11th NBA season. In 73 regular-season games last season, the 33-year-old averaged 7.5 points, 3.6 rebounds and 1.7 assists in 15.6 minutes per contest. Payton isn't likely to see significant usage during the 2026-27 campaign but will provide valuable veteran depth in the Warriors' backcourt.

3134907.h: Kuzma (rest) will play in Friday's preseason game against Indiana.
3134907.s: Kuzma was one of multiple Bucks regulars who were held out of Wednesday's loss to Chicago, though he's set to return to action in Milwaukee's preseason finale.
