The veteran forward started 43 of his 69 regular-season appearances last season, averaging 13.0 points, 4.5 rebounds and 2.7 assists in 26.2 minutes per contest. He figures to continue seeing meaningful playing time in 2026-27.

3134907.h: Kuzma (rest) won't play Wednesday against the Bulls, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.
3134907.s: Kuzma is joining a number of Milwaukee regulars on the sidelines for this exhibition. Friday's matchup with the Pacers is his next chance to play.

3134907.h: Kuzma will start Sunday's preseason game against the Hornets, Sam Perley of the Hornets' official site reports.
3134907.s: Kuzma shifted to a reserve role for Wednesday's preseason game against the Thunder, but he will return to the starting five Sunday. Kel'el Ware, who took his starting spot versus Oklahoma City, will shift back to the bench.

3134907.h: Kuzma won't start Wednesday's preseason game against the Thunder.
3134907.s: The Bucks will try out their double-big lineup Wednesday, with Kel'el Ware entering the starting five in Kuzma's place. The veteran forward logged 20 minutes in Monday's preseason-opening loss to the Timberwolves, posting one point (0-6 FG, 0-2 3Pt, 1-2 FT), five rebounds and one assist.

3134908.h: Poeltl (rest) is expected to play in Wednesday's regular-season opener against Chicago.
3134908.s: Poeltl sat out Friday's preseason finale but should be back in action Wednesday. Across four preseason outings in 2026, he averaged 7.8 points, 3.5 rebounds, 1.5 steals and 1.3 assists in 20.8 minutes per tilt.

3134908.h: Poeltl (rest) has been ruled out for Friday's preseason game against the Pistons, Omari Sankofa II of the Detroit Free Press reports.
3134908.s: Poeltl will get the night off in the second half of this back-to-back set, though he should be good to go for Wednesday's regular-season opener against Chicago. With the big man out Friday, Trayce Jackson-Davis will likely see increased burn.

3134908.h: Poeltl is moving well and "looks good" ahead of training camp, Raptors general manager Bobby Webster said, according to Ryan Wolstat of the Toronto Sun.
3134908.s: Webster added that spending time at home helped Poeltl reset ahead of the upcoming campaign. The positive update suggests the veteran center is in good shape entering camp, though his workload and status will be worth monitoring as Toronto begins preseason preparations. Injuries limited Poeltl to 46 regular-season appearances in 2025-26.

3134916.h: McLaughlin will start in Monday's preseason matchup with the Jazz, Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News reports.
3134916.s: The Spurs are resting their usual starters for Monday's exhibition, so it'll be McLaughlin starting alongside Julian Champagnie, Keldon Johnson, Harrison Barnes and Luke Kornet. McLaughlin and Ja'Kobi Gillespie figure to handle the point-guard duties for San Antonio on Monday.

3134916.h: McLaughlin agreed to a one-year, $3.3 million deal to return to the Spurs on Monday, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
3134916.s: The 30-year-old guard is back with San Antonio for 2026-27 after originally coming from the Kings as part of the De'Aaron Fox trade back in 2024-25. McLaughlin played a career-low 6.4 minutes per game over 44 regular-season appearances last year, so he's likely to serve as emergency depth at point guard and provide a veteran presence for the Spurs' young guards.

3135045.h: Allen (knee) isn't listed on the injury report for Wednesday's game against the Nets.
3135045.s: Allen missed three straight preseason games due to a nagging knee issue, but he'll be good to go for Opening Night. Depending on how his knee holds up, Allen could be in line for major usage, as Coby White (calf) and Kon Knueppel (hamstring) will be sidelined for the regular-season opener.

3135045.h: Allen (knee) didn't play in Friday's 117-98 preseason loss to the Grizzlies.
3135045.s: Allen missed a third consecutive contest due to right knee soreness. If he's unable to play in Wednesday's regular-season opener against Atlanta, Sion James and Royce O'Neale could see increased minutes.

3135045.h: Allen (knee) did not play in Wednesday's 114-93 preseason loss to the Celtics.
3135045.s: Allen missed Sunday's game due to right knee soreness and remained sidelined for Wednesday's defeat. His final chance to suit up during the preseason will come Friday against the Grizzlies.

3135045.h: Allen will not play in Sunday's preseason game against the Bucks due to right knee soreness.
3135045.s: Allen performed well in the Hornets' opening preseason game, posting 13 points in 14 minutes, but he will miss Sunday's contest with a knee injury. Sion James and Royce O'Neale could see extra action with Allen out of the lineup.

3135045.h: Allen is starting Tuesday's preseason opener against the Nets.
3135045.s: Allen is filling in for the injured Kon Knueppel (hamstring) on Tuesday. He's also auditioning for a starting job in the event that Knueppel can't suit up for Opening Night.

3135046.h: Jones will start in Sunday's preseason opener against the Jazz.
3135046.s: Jones will get the spot start with Jamal Murray (personal) unavailable, and he'll be joined in the first unit by Christian Braun, Cameron Johnson, Aaron Gordon and Nikola Jokic. Jones can rack up the dimes and defensive stats when given the minutes, so he'll be someone to consider as a streamer whenever he gets the opportunity to fill in as a starter this season.

3135046.h: Jones agreed to a one-year deal Thursday to remain with the Nuggets, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
3135046.s: Jones has bounced around the league since being drafted in 2015, making stops in Minnesota, Memphis, Washington, Phoenix, Orlando and Dallas before joining the Nuggets in March 2026. He appeared in 11 regular-season contests with Denver, though he averaged only 2.2 points, 1.3 rebounds, 1.2 assists and 0.1 steals over 8.4 minutes. With that in mind, Jones was once one of the most reliable backup point guards in the…

3136193.h: Booker (rest) is available for Friday's preseason game against the Jazz, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.
3136193.s: Booker will return from a two-game absence due to rest purposes. The star guard will be joined in the first unit by Jalen Green, Dillon Brooks, Miles Bridges and Khaman Maluach in the absence of Oso Ighodaro (hip).

3136193.h: Booker (rest) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Spurs, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
3136193.s: Booker will get another night off Wednesday. His final chance to get on the floor this preseason will come Friday against the Jazz.

3136193.h: Booker (rest) isn't expected to play in Wednesday's preseason matchup against San Antonio after sitting out the Suns' full morning shootaround, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.
3136193.s: Phoenix appears to be taking a cautious approach with several rotation players, though no specific injury designation was provided for Booker. The star guard will have one more opportunity to see preseason action Friday against Utah before the regular season gets underway.

3136193.h: Booker is not playing in Saturday's preseason game against the Spurs due to rest, Hayden Cilley of ClutchPoints.com reports.
3136193.s: Booker won't be an option for Saturday's game due to rest, as the Suns are managing his workload carefully with the start of the regular season right around the corner. Booker's next chance to play will come in the rematch against San Antonio on Wednesday.

3136193.h: Booker is feeling the healthiest of his career this year, per Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic.
3136193.s: Booker is looking forward to his 12th year with the Suns in 2026-27 and is set for another huge campaign as the team's top-scoring option. The star guard stands out as a safe investment in the early rounds of fantasy drafts, having played at least 64 games in each of the past eight seasons while averaging at least 25 points, five assists and nearly four rebounds plus one steal in all of the last four years.

3136195.h: Head coach Mike Brown said Towns (rest) and the rest of New York's starters will see increased playing time in Thursday's preseason game against Toronto, James L. Edwards III of The Athletic reports.
3136195.s: Towns was held out of Tuesday's loss to the Raptors due to rest purposes, though he'll be back in action for New York's preseason finale. The big man's return figures to result in James Wiseman heading back to the bench.

3136195.h: Towns expressed frustration Sunday regarding his ongoing contract negotiations with the Knicks, Steve Popper of Newsday reports.
3136195.s: "Simply put, I want to do something that can keep the team together, and that can work with the Knicks and also values me," Towns said. "And, I mean, none of those things have come close to happening." Towns is eligible for a four-year extension worth roughly $277 million and has indicated a willingness to take less than the maximum to help New York retain its championship core, but the Knicks have reportedly…

3136195.h: Towns could see his playmaking responsibilities expand this season as New York looks to build on an adjustment that proved effective during last year's playoffs, Jared Schwartz of the New York Post reports.
3136195.s: Head coach Mike Brown indicated that the Knicks intend to feature Towns at the elbow more frequently, allowing the big man to facilitate with the ball in his hands. The approach could give Towns more opportunities to create for teammates while opening additional actions for OG Anunoby and Mikal Bridges away from the ball.

3136195.h: The Knicks want Towns to take a pay cut on a potential contract extension, per Stefan Bondy of The New York Post.
3136195.s: Towns is under team control for 2026-27 before having a player option for 2027-28. Jalen Brunson is eligible for an extension next year, so Towns may have to settle for a discount in order for New York to maintain its championship core in the future. The star big man appears to be a pretty safe second-round pick in fantasy drafts this year, having averaged at least 20 points, 11 rebounds and three assists along with…

3136196.h: Lyles (rest) is expected to be available for Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Heat.
3136196.s: Lyles sat out the preseason finale but should be available Wednesday. He's expected to provide frontcourt depth for the Timberwolves in 2026-27.

3136196.h: Lyles (rest) has been ruled out for Friday's preseason game against Chicago, Alan Horton of the Timberwolves Radio Network reports.
3136196.s: Lyles is one of many Timberwolves players sitting out the team's preseason finale. His next chance to play will come in Wednesday's regular-season opener against Miami.

3136196.h: Lyles will start in Saturday's exhibition in Miami.
3136196.s: Lyles will start for the resting Jaden McDaniels on Saturday. Cody Williams will also have the chance for quality minutes in Saturday's exhibition with Jonathan Kuminga (rest) and Anthony Edwards (rest) also unavailable.

3136196.h: Lyles said Monday that he hopes to provide veteran leadership and confidence to Minnesota's locker room during the 2026-27 season, Andrew Dukowitz of ZoneCoverage.com reports.
3136196.s: The 30-year-old forward returns to the NBA after spending last season with Real Madrid, where he averaged 13.5 points and 4.5 rebounds in EuroLeague competition. Lyles signed a one-year deal with Minnesota in July and appears willing to embrace a mentorship role, though he could also contribute to the Timberwolves' frontcourt rotation following the offseason departures of Julius Randle and Naz Reid.

3136196.h: Lyles will sign a one-year deal with the Timberwolves, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.
3136196.s: Lyles returns to the NBA after a stint overseas with Real Madrid. Presumably, he'll compete for a depth role in the frontcourt. Across 650 career regular-season NBA games, Lyles holds averages of 7.6 points, 4.3 rebounds and 1.1 assists.

3136777.h: Tate (coach's decision) did not play during Friday's 135-117 preseason win over the Mavericks.
3136777.s: Tate, Marcus Smart and Clint Capela were all sidelined during Friday's preseason opener, but there were no injuries reported. Tate is still expected to make the Opening Night roster, but his role will be limited as a veteran presence on a contending team.

3136777.h: Tate agreed to a one-year, $3.07 million contract with the Rockets on Thursday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
3136777.s: The Rockets' longest-tenured player, Tate will return for a seventh season in Houston. The veteran forward may still have to fight for his spot on the roster in training camp, however, as Scotto notes that Tate's deal is partially guaranteed for only $1.04 million. Tate largely found himself outside of the Houston rotation in 2025-26, averaging just 8.8 minutes per game over 46 appearances.

3138160.h: Martin (thumb) is out for Monday's game against the Heat, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.
3138160.s: Martin will miss his fourth straight game to begin the 2026-27 season. His absence won't have any effect on the Mavericks' rotation, and he can be considered week-to-week moving forward.

3138160.h: Martin (thumb) is listed as doubtful for Monday's game against the Heat.
3138160.s: Martin is expected to remain on the inactive list for a fourth consecutive contest due to a right thumb sprain. His potential absence wouldn't affect the rotation.

3138160.h: Martin (thumb) has been ruled out against San Antonio on Saturday.
3138160.s: Martin has yet to suit up for a regular-season game due to a right thumb injury. His next chance to play is Monday against the Heat, but given the nature of the injury, he can be considered week-to-week until the Mavericks provide a more clear timetable for his return.

3138160.h: Martin (thumb) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.
3138160.s: Martin will miss a second consecutive contest as he continues recovering from a sprained right thumb. His next opportunity to make his season debut will come against the Spurs on Saturday in the back half of a back-to-back set.

3138160.h: Martin is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Rockets with a sprained right thumb.
3138160.s: The veteran forward isn't ready to make his season debut. His next chance to do so comes Friday, when the Mavericks face the Pacers on the front end of a back-to-back set.

3138196.h: Johnson (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Golden State.
3138196.s: As expected, Johnson will be shut down Monday while battling a right ankle sprain. Bryce Hopkins drew the start in Johnson's place Saturday and could have an opportunity to do so again Monday, though Trevon Brazile could also factor into the mix given a lack of depth at forward.

3138196.h: Johnson (ankle) is doubtful to play Monday against the Warriors.
3138196.s: Johnson is on track to miss his second straight game Monday, which could result in another start for Bryce Hopkins and additional minutes for Trevon Brazile. With Johnson looking unlikely for Monday, it would be wise to bench him in weekly fantasy formats.

3138196.h: Head coach David Aldeman said that Johnson is "day-to-day" due to his sprained right ankle, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.
3138196.s: Johnson won't play Saturday against the Pelicans, but it sounds like the ankle sprain he's dealing with is relatively minor. For now, Johnson should be considered questionable for Monday's meeting with the Warriors.

3138196.h: Johnson (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against New Orleans.
3138196.s: Johnson exited Thursday's season-opening loss to the Thunder with a right ankle sprain and will now be held out of Saturday's contest. His next chance to play will come Monday against the Warriors. DeMar DeRozan, Trevon Brazile and Alpha Diallo (wrist), who is listed as questionable, are candidates for increased playing time in Johnson's stead.

3138196.h: Johnson is questionable to return to Thursday's game against the Thunder due to a right ankle sprain, Katy Winge of Altitude Sports reports.
3138196.s: Johnson picked up the injury at some point during the first half. DeMar DeRozan and Alpha Diallo could see more opportunities if Johnson is unable to return.

3146557.h: Landale (nose) is available for Friday's game versus Charlotte.
3146557.s: Landale must've sustained a nasal fracture in Wednesday's Opening Night win over Orlando, but he's playing through the injury. He'll likely be wearing a mask until the issue is fully resolved.

3146557.h: Landale won't start Friday's preseason finale against the Mavericks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
3146557.s: With most of Atlanta's regulars resting, Landale started and totaled 17 points (7-11 FG, 1-3 3Pt, 2-2 FT), six rebounds, five assists, three steals and two blocks across 21 minutes in Monday's 113-110 preseason win over Oklahoma City. The Hawks are back to full strength Friday, sending Landale to a reserve role.

3146557.h: Landale is starting Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
3146557.s: Most of the Atlanta starters are resting Monday. Landale should split the center minutes fairly evenly with Zuby Ejiofor.

3146557.h: Landale (ankle) will return to the Hawks on a one-year, $14 million deal, Shams Charania of ESPN reports Tuesday.
3146557.s: The Hawks will quickly lock up their backup center before he hits the open market. Across 68 regular-season games in 2025-26, Landale shot 51.5 percent from the field with averages of 10.6 points, 5.7 rebounds and 1.7 assists in 22.1 minutes per game. Look for him to back up Onyeka Okongwu moving forward.

3147657.h: Head coach Mike Brown said Bridges (rest) and the rest of the Knicks' first unit will see increased playing time in Thursday's preseason game against Toronto, James L. Edwards III of The Athletic reports.
3147657.s: Bridges sat out Tuesday's loss to the Raptors but will suit up for Thursday's preseason finale. With the veteran swingman back in the lineup, Jordan Clarkson, Bruce Brown and Tyler Nickel will likely see fewer minutes.

3149673.h: Siakam has been eligible since July 6 to sign a three-year extension worth up to $207 million with Indiana, according to Zion Brown of the Indianapolis Star.
3149673.s: Pacers general manager Chad Buchanan declined to discuss the team's extension plans, saying he prefers to keep contract matters confidential out of respect for players and their agents. Siakam's current contract runs through the 2027-28 season, so there doesn't appear to be immediate pressure for the two sides to reach a new agreement.

3149673.h: Siakam remained one of Indiana's most productive players in 2025-26, providing consistent scoring, rebounding and veteran leadership during a rebuilding campaign.
3149673.s: The four-time All-Star can now look forward to complementing a returning Tyrese Haliburton (Achilles) as the Pacers' top frontcourt option and should remain heavily involved offensively. Indiana made no significant offseason additions that would impact Siakam's workload heading into 2026-27, and the fact that Indiana is projected to be competitive is great news for his outlook.

3150844.h: Wagner is not in the starting lineup for Monday's preseason game against the Wizards.
3150844.s: With Day'Ron Sharpe (shoulder) back in action, Wagner will shift to a reserve role. As a starter Thursday against the 76ers, the veteran center totaled six points (2-3 FG, 0-1 3Pt, 2-2 FT), four steals, three rebounds and one assist across 18 minutes.

3150844.h: Wagner is in the starting lineup for Thursday's preseason game against the 76ers, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.
3150844.s: The Nets will be without Day'Ron Sharpe (shoulder) for this preseason contest, meaning Wagner will get the nod at center. It will be an opportunity to see how Wagner plays alongside Julius Randle, who will get the nod at power forward.

3150844.h: Wagner did not participate in Germany's latest FIBA World Cup qualifying window as he turns his attention toward the upcoming NBA season.
3150844.s: Wagner appeared in 36 regular-season games for Orlando last campaign, averaging 6.9 points and 3.2 rebounds in 11.9 minutes per contest. The 29-year-old projects to be a reserve frontcourt option for the Nets in 2026-27 after signing a two-year deal with Brooklyn this offseason. His limited playing time makes consistent fantasy value unlikely. Wagner could become a streaming option in deeper formats if injuries…

3150844.h: Wagner agreed to a two-year, $19 million deal with the Nets on Wednesday, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.
3150844.s: Wagner will move on from Orlando after six seasons with the franchise. The deal is fully guaranteed and includes a second-year mutual option. During the 2025-26 regular season, after successfully recovering from an ACL injury, Wagner averaged 6.9 points and 3.2 rebounds in 11.9 minutes per contest.

3155526.h: Brooks said he will play Friday against Memphis for the final preseason game, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.
3155526.s: After resting Wednesday against the Spurs, Brooks said he's looking forward to this tune-up game against his former teammate, Jaren Jackson. There's no word on how many minutes the starting group will play Friday.

3155526.h: Brooks is unlikely to suit up for Wednesday's preseason meeting with San Antonio after sitting out the full morning shootaround, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.
3155526.s: Brooks joins a lengthy list of Phoenix players expected to be unavailable, opening additional opportunities on the wing. With the Suns' preseason schedule wrapping up Friday against Utah, his next appearance could come in that contest.

3155526.h: Brooks, who was formally charged Tuesday with driving under the influence for an incident that took place on March 6, is focused on preparing for the upcoming 2026-27 season, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.
3155526.s: Brooks has been a fiery competitor to start camp, and his teammate Devin Booker stated Thursday that he isn't concerned about any potential distractions. "Nah, we already addressed it as a team back in February or March, when it happened," said Booker. "We kept everything in-house. He addressed the team also. We're moving on." Brooks is in line to open the upcoming 2026-27 season as part of the starting lineup after…

3155526.h: Brooks did not participate in Canada's latest FIBA World Cup qualifying window as he gears up for the 2026-27 NBA season.
3155526.s: Brooks is coming off the best offensive season of his career, averaging 20.2 points, 3.6 rebounds, 1.8 assists and 1.0 steals across 56 regular-season starts for Phoenix. The 30-year-old also signed a three-year, $73 million extension with the Suns in August that keeps him under contract through 2029-30. Brooks should remain an important part of Phoenix's starting lineup alongside Devin Booker. However, Brooks'…

3155526.h: Brooks agreed to a three-year, $73 million extension with the Suns on Wednesday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
3155526.s: Despite appearing in only 56 regular-season games in 2025-26, Brooks had a fantastic campaign, averaging a career-high 20.2 points along with 3.6 rebounds, 1.8 assists and 1.0 steals across 30.4 minutes per contest. He's not the most efficient shooter. However, the 30-year-old is capable of producing on both ends of the floor while also providing leadership and toughness. Brooks should continue to be a vital piece…

3155535.h: Looney will come off the bench for Tuesday's preseason matchup against Golden State, with Walker Kessler making his preseason debut, Ryan Ward of SI.com reports.
3155535.s: Looney will shift to a reserve role after previously working with the starting unit. Kessler's return adds another option to the Lakers' frontcourt rotation and could impact Looney's playing time as the team prepares for the regular season.

3155535.h: Looney will start Thursday's preseason game against the Kings, Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com reports.
3155535.s: Looney started Monday's preseason-opening win over Sacramento but shifted to the bench in Tuesday's loss to Golden State. He'll join Luka Doncic, Austin Reaves, Adou Thiero and Quentin Grimes in the first unit Thursday.

3155535.h: Looney will start in Monday's preseason opener against the Kings, Khobi Price of The California Post reports.
3155535.s: Walker Kessler (finger) is out, so Looney will draw the start in the Lakers' first preseason game. Joining him in the first unit for Monday's game will be Luka Doncic, Quentin Grimes, Ziaire Williams and Matisse Thybulle.

3155535.h: Looney will sign a one-year, $3.9 million deal with the Lakers, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
3155535.s: The Lakers add some additional depth to their frontcourt. Presumably, Looney will slot in as the third-string center behind Walker Kessler and Sandro Mamukelashvili. With the Pelicans in 2025-26, Looney appeared in 21 regular-season games and averaged 2.8 points, 5.6 rebounds and 1.6 assists.

3155942.h: Sabonis (undisclosed) is available for Friday's preseason finale against the Spurs, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.
3155942.s: Sabonis is back for the preseason finale after a three-game absence. He'll likely start Friday, which should push Precious Achiuwa back to the second unit.

3155942.h: Sabonis (undisclosed) will not play in Tuesday's preseason matchup against Portland, Matt George of ABC 10 Sacramento reports.
3155942.s: Sabonis joins several Sacramento regulars on the sidelines Tuesday, though no reason for his absence was provided. With both Sabonis and Maxime Raynaud (knee) unavailable, the Kings will need to rely on other frontcourt options against the Trail Blazers. Sabonis' next opportunity to suit up will come Friday against San Antonio.

3155942.h: Sabonis (undisclosed) was a full participant during Monday's practice but remains questionable for Tuesday's preseason game against the Trail Blazers, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
3155942.s: Sabonis has missed two straight games for undisclosed reasons, but it sounds like it's a minor issue. If the veteran big man doesn't suit up Tuesday, his final chance to play during the preseason will come Friday in San Antonio.

3155942.h: Sabonis (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's preseason game against the Warriors, Jason Anderson of The Sacramento Bee reports.
3155942.s: This will be Sabonis' second straight missed preseason game, and the Kings have not yet listed an injury for him. His next chance to play will come Tuesday against Portland. Maxime Raynaud and Precious Achiuwa should see a boost with Sabonis unavailable.

3155942.h: Sabonis (undisclosed) has been ruled out for Thursday's preseason matchup with the Lakers, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
3155942.s: After supplying four points (1-2 FG, 0-1 3Pt, 2-2 FT), three rebounds and three assists in 10 minutes during Monday's preseason-opening loss to the Lakers, Sabonis will be held out of Thursday's contest for undisclosed reasons. The big man's next opportunity to suit up in the preseason will come Saturday against Golden State.

3899664.h: Fontecchio is not listed in the starting lineup for Wednesday's preseason game against Brooklyn.
3899664.s: Fontecchio came off the bench in the first two preseason contests but got the start in Saturday's loss to Minnesota. In three preseason games in 2026, the 30-year-old has averaged 8.0 points and 2.0 rebounds over 16.4 minutes per contest. His final opportunity to play before the start of the 2026-27 campaign will come Friday in Orlando.

3899664.h: Fontecchio will start in Saturday's preseason game against the Timberwolves, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
3899664.s: Fontecchio is getting a spot start, with all the usual Miami starters receiving a rest day. Over nine starts last season, Fontecchio averaged 11.9 points, 4.1 rebounds, 2.4 assists and 2.4 triples per contest.

3899664.h: Fontecchio will return to the Heat on a one-year deal, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
3899664.s: Miami will secure some additional shooting to spread the floor for Giannis Antetokounmpo. During 70 regular-season games in 2025-26, Fontecchio averaged 8.5 points, 3.0 rebounds, 1.4 assists and 1.8 three-pointers in 16.7 minutes per contest.

3907387.h: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.
3907387.s: Simmons had a quality preseason, averaging 10.5 points, 4.0 rebounds and 4.0 assists over 17.4 minutes per contest (two games). The 30-year-old was on track to suit up for the Kings on Opening Night, though those plans were halted after he suffered a torn Achilles tendon during practice. Now, Simmons will focus on rehab. However, it's unknown what the future holds regarding his career in the NBA.

3907387.h: Simmons suffered a season-ending right Achilles tear during practice Sunday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
3907387.s: Simmons was seemingly poised for a comeback campaign after being out of the league since the 2024-25 season, but his return will be delayed due to a suspected Achilles tear suffered during practice. It's a heartbreaking development for the 30-year-old pro, who was performing at a high level throughout the preseason and expected to start on Opening Night. His injury figures to impact the Kings' offensive plan, likely…

3907387.h: Simmons (rest) is available for Friday's preseason finale against San Antonio, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.
3907387.s: Simmons will return from a one-game absence for rest purposes. He's expected to open the regular season as a member of Sacramento's starting five.

3907387.h: Simmons (rest) won't play in Tuesday's preseason game against the Trail Blazers, Matt George of ABC 10 Sacramento reports.
3907387.s: Simmons will get the night off Tuesday. His final chance to play in the preseason will come against the Spurs on Friday.

3907387.h: Simmons is expected to remain in Sacramento's starting lineup alongside rookie guard Darius Acuff for the Oct. 21 regular-season opener against the Clippers, Marc J. Spears of Andscape reports.
3907387.s: Simmons is aiming to play all 82 games this season after struggling to stay healthy in recent years. The veteran last appeared in more than 51 regular-season games during the 2020-21 campaign, when he played 58 contests for Philadelphia. His projected starting role alongside Acuff is encouraging for his fantasy outlook, particularly given his playmaking and rebounding ability, though his durability remains a…

3907497.h: Murray (toe) said Monday he'll be fine to play in Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Pacers, per Jim Eichenhofer of the Pelicans' official site.
3907497.s: Murray battled a bruised toe to close out the preseason, but all signs point toward him being good to go for the start of the regular season. The star guard should be able to handle a normal workload Wednesday, and Murray is looking to build on last year's successful comeback from an Achilles injury.

3907497.h: Murray (toe) won't play in Friday's preseason finale against the Wizards, Jim Eichenhofer of the Pelicans' official site reports.
3907497.s: Murray looked good in the preseason opener on Oct. 7, but he then sat out the final three exhibition games due to a toe issue. He'll have another four days to rest up before the Pelicans' regular-season opener against the Pacers on Oct. 21, and for now, he can be considered questionable for that one. If he's not ready by Opening Night, Jeremiah Fears and Jordan Poole would get a bump in opportunity.

3907497.h: Murray (toe) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game versus the Mavericks, Ron Harrod of DLLS Mavs reports.
3907497.s: Murray has appeared in just one preseason game due to a toe injury. The Pelicans play their final exhibition Friday versus Washington, though it's unknown if Murray will suit up for that contest.

3907497.h: Murray (toe) has been ruled out for Thursday's preseason game against the Heat, Andrew Lopez of Gulf Coast Sports & Entertainment Network reports.
3907497.s: Murray is dealing with a right toe contusion, though head coach Jamahl Mosley said his absence Thursday is precautionary. The veteran point guard's next chance to play in the preseason will come Wednesday against Dallas.

3907497.h: Murray (hand) remains a cornerstone of New Orleans' backcourt despite missing the first half of last season due to a torn Achilles tendon.
3907497.s: Murray's playing time was monitored closely after his delayed 2025-26 debut, and he missed the final games of the regular season due to a bruised hand. Assuming he's fully healthy entering training camp, Murray should reclaim a starting role and provide veteran leadership alongside the Pelicans' young guards. His ability to contribute across the board as a scorer, facilitator and defender gives him a chance to…

3907498.h: Thybulle will start Tuesday's preseason matchup against Golden State, Ryan Ward of SI.com reports.
3907498.s: Thybulle will get an opportunity with Los Angeles' first unit against the Warriors. The defensive-minded wing will look to make an impact with his steals and perimeter defense, though his offensive contributions have historically been limited. His starting assignment Tuesday doesn't necessarily indicate that he'll hold a first-unit role when the regular season begins.

3907498.h: Thybulle (rest) is available for Thursday's preseason game against the Kings, Sean Cunningham of Fox 40 Sacramento reports.
3907498.s: Thybulle sat out Tuesday's loss to Golden State but will return to action against Sacramento. He'll come off the bench Thursday after starting Monday's preseason-opening win over the Kings, during which he logged six points, two steals and one assist in 18 minutes.

3907498.h: Thybulle (rest) will skip Tuesday's exhibition against the Warriors, Luca Evans of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.
3907498.s: The Lakers are on the second leg of a back-to-back set, so they will rest their entire starting lineup and some key reserves. Jaden Hardy and Bronny James could see major minutes in Tuesday's preseason game.

3907498.h: Thybulle will start Monday's preseason game against the Kings, Khobi Price of The California Post reports.
3907498.s: The Lakers will be without Austin Reaves (ankle) and Walker Kessler (finger) in their preseason opener, so the club will start Luka Doncic, Quentin Grimes, Ziaire Williams, Kevon Looney and Thybulle. The defensive-minded swingman is competing for a starting spot ahead of the regular season.

3907498.h: Thybulle has made an immediate impact defensively during his first training camp with the Lakers, recording at least seven steals through the team's first two practices, according to Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com.
3907498.s: Head coach JJ Redick specifically highlighted Thybulle's ability to disrupt passing lanes, joking that his teammates need to learn not to throw the ball when the veteran wing is positioned to make a play. Thybulle's defensive ability should give him a strong opportunity to earn consistent minutes as Los Angeles sorts through a crowded competition on the wing.

3907823.h: Mann (coach's decision) did not play in Wednesday's 110-103 loss to Charlotte.
3907823.s: The veteran wing was left out of Brooklyn's rotation as the team prioritized other perimeter options. Mann's experience could earn him opportunities later in the campaign, but his immediate fantasy outlook is limited.

3907823.h: Mann (knee) is unlikely to begin the 2026-27 season as a starter and appears to be buried on the depth chart.
3907823.s: Mann started 51 of his 63 regular-season appearances during his first year with the Nets in 2025-26, but he's all but certain to begin the new campaign as a reserve instead. Brooklyn drafted Mikel Brown in the first round this summer and is also set to get Egor Demin back in the mix, potentially leaving Mann behind Drake Powell, Ben Saraf and Nolan Traore (foot) in a position to fight for scraps with Keon Ellis off…

3908809.h: Cavaliers guard Sam Merrill reported that Mitchell is "100 percent committed" to the organization, Daniel Chavkin of The Sporting News reports.
3908809.s: Mitchell agreed to a four-year, $275 million extension during the offseason after leading the Cavaliers to the Eastern Conference Finals in 2025-26. While the new contract should have extinguished any doubt regarding Mitchell's desire to remain with the organization moving forward, Merrill recalled how things went during the last extension. "Donovan's 100 percent committed here," Merrill stated. "I remember when he…

3908809.h: Mitchell will be sharing the backcourt with James Harden again this season after the latter re-signed with Cleveland.
3908809.s: Harden may soak up more usage than Mitchell's previous backcourt partner, Darius Garland, but Mitchell didn't see a notable drop-off in fantasy value with Harden in the fray following last year's trade deadline. Mitchell averaged 26.0 points, 5.2 assists, 4.2 rebounds and 1.4 steals per game in 22 regular-season appearances with Harden in 2025-26, keeping the former squarely in conversations as an elite fantasy…

3908809.h: Mitchell agreed to a four-year, $273 million max contract extension with the Cavaliers on Tuesday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
3908809.s: The deal includes a player option for 2030-31 and a full trade kicker. Along with trade-deadline acquisition James Harden, Mitchell led the Cavaliers to the Eastern Conference Finals last season before fizzling out against the Knicks, averaging 26.0 points, 4.8 rebounds, 3.1 assists and 1.2 steals across 18 postseason contests. He could've waited until next summer to sign an even larger extension, but the veteran…

3908845.h: Collins plans to use his versatility to complement Cade Cunningham after joining the Pistons during the offseason, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.
3908845.s: The veteran forward highlighted Cunningham's playmaking ability and said he wants to generate easy baskets by playing off the star guard. Collins shot 40.6 percent from three-point range during the 2025-26 regular season, and his combination of perimeter shooting and finishing ability should give Cunningham another versatile offensive option.

3908845.h: Collins could be the most significant offseason addition for the Pistons, per Coty M. Davis of The Detroit News.
3908845.s: Collins is replacing Tobias Harris, who left for San Antonio this summer, in the starting lineup this year. The veteran power forward is a strong lob threat and pick-and-roll big man, which could play well with Cade Cunningham running the show at point guard. Collins got off to a rough start last season but experienced a second-half turnaround from Jan. 1 onward, averaging 14.4 points, 5.8 rebounds and 1.5…

3908845.h: Collins agreed to a three-year, $51 million contract with the Pistons on Wednesday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
3908845.s: With Tobias Harris expected to leave this offseason, the Pistons found a new starting power forward in Collins, who's coming off a down year but has been steady throughout his career. Across nine seasons and three different teams, Collins has averaged 16.2 points, 7.9 rebounds, 1.5 assists, 1.0 blocks and 0.7 steals while posting 55/37/79 shooting splits.

3912848.h: Wade (ankle) is available and starting Saturday's game against the Bucks, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.
3912848.s: Wade will return from a two-game absence due to a sprained ankle and enter the starting lineup in LeBron James' (back) stead. Wade will be joined in the first unit by Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe, Jaylen Brown and Joel Embiid in the front end of this back-to-back set.

3912848.h: Wade is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Bucks due to a left ankle sprain.
3912848.s: Wade is in jeopardy of missing a third straight game to begin the regular season. If the veteran forward is unable to suit up, Kentavious Caldwell-Pope and Jabari Walker would be candidates to see a bump in minutes.

3912848.h: Wade (ankle) is out for Thursday's game against the Cavaliers.
3912848.s: After sitting out Philadelphia's 106-100 victory over the Knicks on Opening Night, Wade will have to watch from the sidelines once again. In his absence, Kentavious Caldwell-Pope and Jabari Walker could see a slight uptick in playing time.

3912848.h: Wade (ankle) participated in Thursday's morning shootaround, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.
3912848.s: Wade remains day-to-day with his ankle sprain after missing the season opener. The 76ers have listed him as questionable, but his availability Thursday morning bodes well for his chances.

3912848.h: Wade (ankle) is questionable for Thursday's game against Cleveland.
3912848.s: Wade is aiming to make his 76ers debut Thursday. His eventual return from an ankle sprain could slightly cut into Kentavious Caldwell-Pope's minutes on the wing.

3913174.h: Kennard (knee) is available for Saturday's game against the Warriors, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.
3913174.s: Kennard will shed his questionable tag and return to action after missing Wednesday's season-opening loss to Portland. The sharpshooter figures to see meaningful burn off the bench behind Jalen Green.

3913174.h: Kennard (knee) is questionable to play Saturday against the Warriors.
3913174.s: A decision on Kennard's status will be made closer to Saturday's contest. If he ends up being ruled out for a second straight game, then Jordan Goodwin should be more involved off the bench.

3913174.h: Kennard (knee) practiced Friday, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.
3913174.s: Kennard is trending positively ahead of Saturday's game against the Warriors. The veteran sharpshooter can be tentatively deemed questionable before the Suns release an official injury report later Friday.

3913174.h: Kennard (knee) won't play Wednesday versus Portland, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.
3913174.s: Kennard is seemingly making progress after experiencing soreness in his knee near the end of the preseason. His next opportunity to suit up will come Saturday in Golden State. Without Kennard on the floor, Jordan Goodwin should be more involved.

3913174.h: Kennard (knee) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against Portland.
3913174.s: Kennard began experiencing knee soreness near the end of the preseason. While the sharpshooter has been increasing his activity level in recent practices, he may need to miss a game or two to begin the 2026-27 campaign. If that's the case, Jordan Goodwin could see more minutes.

3913176.h: Ingram won't be ready for the start of the season due to a partially torn Achilles, per Joey Linn of SI.com.
3913176.s: The Clippers learned about the injury this summer, though it's unclear exactly how far along Ingram is in his recovery. The star forward's timeline for a return is unclear, clouding his fantasy outlook in the meantime. Darius Garland should take on all the usage he can handle in Ingram's stead, while Kris Dunn and Max Strus could have additional streaming appeal early in the year.

3913176.h: Ingram had surgery on his foot/heel during the offseason, ESPN's Brian Windhorst reported Tuesday.
3913176.s: "We're going to hear at Media Day where he's at with his heel," Windhorst added. This update is certainly ominous, and there's been no mention of this by the Clippers. Fantasy managers will want to monitor this closely in case it impacts Ingram's availability for Opening Night.

3913176.h: The Clippers and Raptors both agreed Monday to finalize the trade sending Kawhi Leonard to Toronto for Ingram (heel), Gradey Dick, two unprotected first-round picks, one first-round pick swap and two second-rounders, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
3913176.s: The deal, which was agreed to in principle June 30, was held up over two months due to the league's investigation involving salary-cap circumvention by Leonard and the Clippers. Ingram underwent surgery in early May to address ongoing right heel pain, so his health will be worth monitoring when he reports to Los Angeles' training camp later in September.

3913176.h: The NBA has concluded its investigation into salary cap circumvention involving Kawhi Leonard and the Clippers, and the trade sending Ingram (heel) to Los Angeles is expected to be finalized in the coming days, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
3913176.s: Among other punishments, the Clippers were stripped of five first-round picks Wednesday. Additionally, Leonard was fined $700,000 in restitution for improper benefits. However, now that the findings and penalties have been announced, Ingram is expected to officially be traded to the Clippers after averaging 21.5 points, 5.6 rebounds, 3.7 assists and 1.5 combined steals-plus-blocks in 33.8 minutes per game across 77…

3913176.h: The Clippers are nearing a deal that would send Kawhi Leonard to the Raptors for Ingram (heel), Gradey Dick, two future first-round picks, one pick swap and two future second-rounders, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
3913176.s: Although the trade isn't yet finalized, it sounds like Ingram is heading to Los Angeles for the 2026-27 season. The star forward is recovering from heel surgery, but the expectation is that he'll be able to fully participate in training camp this fall. If the deal is indeed consummated, Ingram would set up as the Clippers' top scoring option while sharing the primary playmaking duties with Darius Garland.

3914044.h: Shamet (rest) didn't play in Tuesday's 148-98 preseason loss to the Raptors.
3914044.s: New York presumably gave the veteran swingman Tuesday night off along with the rest of its routine starters. It's possible Shamet will be available for Thursday's meeting with Toronto for a final tune-up appearance.

3914044.h: Shamet intends to sign a four-year, $24 million deal to return to the Knicks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports Monday.
3914044.s: Shamet played for five different teams before landing in New York and finding a long-term home. He played a minor role during his first season but worked his way into being a key contributor in 2025-26, culminating in a few memorable playoff moments for the NBA champions. While a feel-good story, Shamet's on-court production will be modest and sporadic when everyone is healthy. He averaged 9.3 points in 23.0 minutes…

3917376.h: Brown (rest) will play in Friday's preseason finale against the Celtics, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globereports.
3917376.s: Brown was rested Saturday against Boston but is all set for the rematch against his former team. More usage is likely to come his way with VJ Edgecombe resting Friday.

3917376.h: Brown (rest) won't suit up for Saturday's preseason game in Boston, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.
3917376.s: Brown will skip his first meeting against his former team in Boston, but he should be able to get back out there for Friday's rematch with the Celtics. Justin Edwards and Dean Wade will help pick up the slack Saturday with Brown unavailable.

3934672.h: Head coach Mike Brown said Brunson (rest) and the rest of New York's starters will see increased playing time in Thursday's preseason game versus the Raptors, James L. Edwards III of The Athletic reports.
3934672.s: Brunson sat out Tuesday's exhibition loss to the Raptors, though he's set to play in New York's preseason finale. The star point guard's return figures to push Jose Alvarado to the second unit.

3934672.h: Brunson (rest) won't suit up for Tuesday's preseason game in Toronto, Stefan Bondy of The New York Post reports.
3934672.s: It's the second night of a back-to-back set in the preseason, so the Knicks will sit out their entire starting unit. Expect more minutes for Miles McBride and Tyler Kolek. Brunson registered 20 points (6-13 FG, 1-4 3Pt, 7-8 FT), five rebounds, three assists and three steals over 22 minutes in Monday's 122-104 preseason loss to the Timberwolves.

3934672.h: Brunson announced Thursday that he's been fully cleared after undergoing surgery on his left wrist over the offseason, New York Basketball reports.
3934672.s: Brunson has been trending in this direction all along and was expected to open training camp without any restrictions. However, it's reassuring that he feels comfortable enough to announce a full recovery before camp gets underway.

3934672.h: Brunson (wrist) is expected to be ready for training camp, ESPN's Vincent Goodwill reports.
3934672.s: "Brunson is at about 80 to 85 percent after the wrist surgery that he had in July," Goodwill said. "He'll have no restrictions when training camp begins in a couple of weeks." Brunson had surgery back in early July following New York's championship run, but his status for Opening Night was never in any real doubt.

3934672.h: Brunson is set to undergo surgery on his left wrist/forearm area Tuesday and is expected to require at least two months of rehab, Ian Begley of SportsNet New York reports.
3934672.s: Brunson reportedly played through discomfort in this area during the Knicks' Finals run, and he'll undergo surgery before training camp begins in the fall. The superstar point guard is coming off an impressive postseason that culminated in a championship and Finals MVP honors. Over five Finals appearances against the Spurs, he averaged 32.6 points, 4.6 assists, 4.2 rebounds and 2.0 steals in 39.0 minutes per showing.

3934673.h: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.
3934673.s: DiVincenzo is approaching six months since tearing his right Achilles during the first round of the playoffs and has been rehabbing with the expectation that he'll play at some point this season. The veteran guard has sought advice from Jayson Tatum, Tyrese Haliburton and Damian Lillard during his recovery, though Minnesota has yet to establish a timetable for his return.

3934673.h: Team president Tim Connelly believes DiVincenzo (Achilles) will return at some point this season, Jack Borman of the Locked On Wolves Podcast reports.
3934673.s: DiVincenzo underwent surgery to repair a ruptured Achilles in late April, but there's optimism he'll be able to contribute for the Timberwolves later this year. Although the door is open for the sharpshooter to make a late-season return, he's highly unlikely to be a factor in fantasy leagues in 2026-27.

3934719.h: Anunoby (rest) is set to play in Thursday's preseason game against the Raptors, James L. Edwards III of The Athletic reports.
3934719.s: Thursday's exhibition represents a tune-up opportunity for the Knicks' starters. Anunoby could see close to a normal workload as a result.

3934723.h: Bryant (coach's decision) did not play in Thursday's 114-106 loss to Philadelphia.
3934723.s: Bryant was left out of Cleveland's rotation despite the Cavaliers entering the season with some frontcourt injury concerns. With Jarrett Allen and Evan Mobley handling the primary frontcourt responsibilities, Bryant could struggle to see consistent playing time when the team is healthy.

3934723.h: Bryant intends to re-sign with the Cavaliers on a one-year deal, per Shams Charania of ESPN on Monday.
3934723.s: The journeyman center is set for his second season with Cleveland in 2026-27. Bryant averaged just 6.2 points, 3.4 rebounds and 0.5 blocks in 12.2 minutes per game over 60 regular-season appearances a year ago, offering the Cavs depth at the center position behind Jarrett Allen and Evan Mobley.

3936099.h: Jones will only suit up for the first half of Sunday's preseason game against the Warriors, Joey Linn of SI.com reports.
3936099.s: Jones will join Darius Garland, Max Strus, Rui Hachimura and Isaiah Jackson in the first unit, though none of them will play in the second half. Jones started 45 of his 50 regular-season appearances in 2025-26, averaging 10.1 points, 3.5 rebounds, 1.4 assists, 1.0 blocks and 0.9 steals across 27.0 minutes per contest on the campaign.

3936099.h: Max Strus gives the Clippers another veteran wing capable of occupying many of the same lineup slots as Jones.
3936099.s: While Jones offers considerably more defensive versatility and athleticism, Strus provides superior floor spacing and could be preferred in lineups that need additional shooting. The added competition makes Jones' minutes somewhat less secure and reinforces his status as a low-usage contributor whose fantasy value will generally come from defensive statistics rather than offensive volume.

3936299.h: Murray (personal) is in the starting lineup for Tuesday's preseason contest against the Jazz.
3936299.s: Murray didn't play in Sunday's preseason opener against Utah, but he gets the nod and is in the starting lineup for this rematch Tuesday. It remains to be seen whether the star guard will have a limited workload in this preseason contest, though that wouldn't be surprising. He's the No. 2 option on offense behind Nikola Jokic and isn't expected to play heavy minutes in the preseason with the start of the 2026-27…

3936299.h: Murray is out for Sunday's preseason opener against the Jazz due to personal reasons, Katy Winge of Altitude Sports reports.
3936299.s: Murray is dealing with a personal matter, but at this point, there's no indication it will affect his status for the regular-season opener. His next chance to play in the preseason will come Tuesday in Utah. Tyus Jones should see an expanded role with Murray unavailable.

3936299.h: Murray did not participate in Canada's latest FIBA World Cup qualifying window as he turns his attention toward the upcoming NBA season.
3936299.s: Murray is coming off a standout 2025-26 campaign with Denver in which he earned his first All-Star and All-NBA selections of his career. The veteran guard remains firmly entrenched as the Nuggets' No. 2 offensive option alongside Nikola Jokic and should continue carrying a substantial scoring and playmaking workload in 2026-27.

3936299.h: The Nuggets signed DeMar DeRozan on Friday, giving Murray another competitor for usage in 2026-27.
3936299.s: There could be a tighter squeeze for usage in Denver this season, as DeRozan is effectively replacing the more defensive-minded Peyton Watson on the roster. Murray should remain the team's clear-cut No. 2 scoring option behind Nikola Jokic, but it remains to be seen if the addition of DeRozan, who should compete for a starting job during training camp, will adversely impact Murray's productivity.

3945274.h: Doncic (rest) will start in Friday's preseason finale against the Nuggets, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.
3945274.s: Doncic received a rest day during Tuesday's exhibition loss to the Warriors, but he'll get back out there for Friday's preseason finale. With Doncic active, Quentin Grimes will shift back to the second unit.

3945274.h: Doncic will be rested for Tuesday's preseason game against the Warriors, Khobi Price of The California Post reports.
3945274.s: There is no injury to report, and this is reported to be a planned night off for Doncic. He will have one more chance to get some exhibition reps in Friday against Denver.

4017837.h: Zubac (ankle) is out for Monday's game against the Bucks.
4017837.s: No surprises here after coach Rick Carlisle hinted at Zubac's absence following his injury Sunday night. The center is dealing with some swelling, but it's currently unclear how long this will sideline him for. Look for Jay Huff and possibly Larry Nance to pick up some minutes in the meantime.

4017837.h: Head coach Rick Carlisle said that X-rays on Zubac's sprained left ankle came back negative, but he's got some swelling and is unlikely to play Monday in Milwaukee, Scott Agness of FieldhouseFiles.com reports.
4017837.s: Zubac rolled his ankle during Sunday's game, and with a quick turnaround, it seems unlikely he'll be ready to roll by Monday. Jay Huff started the second half of Sunday's game and finished with 14 points (5-6 FG, 2-3 3Pt, 2-2 FT), two rebounds, three assists and three swats over 21 minutes, so he could make for an attractive streamer Monday. According to Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com, Zubac was spotted leaving the…

4017837.h: Zubac (ankle) will not return to Sunday's game against the Nets.
4017837.s: Zubac left the game in the first quarter after rolling his left ankle and will not be able to return. Indiana plays the second half of the back-to-back set Monday against the Bucks, making it likely Zubac will be forced to miss at least one additional game. Jay Huff is expected to see an expanded role if Zubac is out.

4017837.h: Zubac is questionable to return to Sunday's game in Brooklyn due to a left ankle sprain, Pat Boylan of FanDuel Sports Network Indiana reports.
4017837.s: Zubac rolled his ankle stepping on Kelly Oubre's foot, and while he tried to play through it for a few possessions, he eventually requested out and limped back to the locker room. Larry Nance, Jay Huff and Obi Toppin would help pick up the slack if Zubac needs to miss time.

4017837.h: Zubac said he's already making progress developing chemistry with Tyrese Haliburton and Pascal Siakam after getting his first extended work with the duo during the Pacers' players-only minicamp, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.
4017837.s: The big man said playing with Haliburton felt "really natural" and doesn't expect it to take long for the two to gel due to the point guard's high basketball IQ. Zubac also focused on improving his conditioning during the offseason to better handle Indiana's pace and revealed that he's been working on expanding his shooting range, though his primary focus remains playing to his established strengths.

4065648.h: Tatum (rest) is expected to play in Tuesday's opener against the Pistons.
4065648.s: Tatum didn't play in the 125-120 preseason overtime win over the 76ers on Friday. However, since he sat out that contest to rest, he is in line to play Tuesday in Detroit. The six-time All-Star appeared in 16 regular-season games in 2025-26 after working his way back from an Achilles injury, averaging 21.8 points, 10.0 rebounds, 5.3 assists and 1.4 steals across 32.6 minutes per contest. With Jaylen Brown now in…

4065648.h: Tatum (rest) won't play in Friday's preseason finale against the 76ers, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports.
4065648.s: Tatum and the rest of Boston's regulars will sit out the final exhibition. He's expected to be full go for the regular-season opener against Detroit on Tuesday.

4065648.h: Tatum (rest) is in the starting lineup for Saturday's preseason game against the 76ers, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports.
4065648.s: The Celtics will be starting most of their regulars in this preseason contest, meaning Tatum will return to the hardwood after missing the previous game. It wouldn't be surprising if Boston monitors his workload with the regular season right around the corner.

4065648.h: Tatum (rest) isn't in line to play Thursday against Cleveland, Zack Cox of the Boston Herald reports.
4065648.s: Boston looks to be resting its starters for this exhibition. Hugo Gonzalez is starting at small forward Thursday.

4065648.h: Tatum said he "feels great" as he continues his recovery, noting that he's now 16 and a half months removed from surgery, Zack Cox of the Boston Herald reports.
4065648.s: The extended offseason has allowed him to focus on getting stronger and becoming more explosive while working on his body as a whole. These are encouraging comments from a fantasy perspective as Tatum enters the 2026-27 season with a clean bill of health.

4065654.h: Isaac (knee) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Knicks.
4065654.s: Isaac continues to be sidelined by a left knee injury that caused him to miss the final two months of the 2025-26 season. He has yet to make his 2026-27 debut, and his next chance to do so is Wednesday against the Raptors.

4065654.h: Isaac (knee) is out for Friday's game against Minnesota.
4065654.s: The oft-injured forward isn't ready to make his season debut. His next chance to do so arrives Sunday in New York, when Orlando takes on the defending-champion Knicks. Isaac has progressed to 2-on-2 scrimmages during practice, but the team will presumably proceed with caution.

4065654.h: Isaac (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Hawks.
4065654.s: Isaac didn't play in the preseason and will sit out Wednesday's contest due to left knee injury management. His next chance to suit up will come Friday against Minnesota.

4065654.h: Isaac (knee) is out for Friday's preseason game against Miami.
4065654.s: Isaac has been a limited participant at training camp and did not make any appearances in the preseason. He's questionable at best ahead of the Magic's Opening Night matchup against the Hawks on Wednesday.

4065654.h: Isaac (personal, knee) participated in Thursday's practice but is still ramping up his activity, according to Orlando Magic Daily.
4065654.s: Isaac previously missed time during the preseason due to personal reasons but has since rejoined the team. Although his participation in practice is a positive development, his status for Friday's exhibition against Miami has yet to be determined. The Magic now have their full roster participating in on-court activities.

4065663.h: Okogie agreed to a two-year, $12 million deal with the Jazz on Friday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4065663.s: Okogie played in a career-high 78 regular-season games for the Rockets during the 2025-26 campaign, averaging 4.5 points and 2.6 rebounds in 17.4 minutes per game. He'll provide depth on the wing for Utah and should serve as a veteran presence in a young locker room.

4065731.h: Huff will start Monday's game against the Bucks, Scott Agness of FieldhouseFiles.com reports.
4065731.s: Ivica Zubac (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's clash, opening the door for Huff to start at center. He started the second half of Sunday's matchup after Zubac went down and put together a strong final line, finishing with 14 points, two rebounds, three assists and three blocks in 21 minutes.

4065731.h: Huff (coach's decision) did not play in Wednesday's 123-120 win over New Orleans.
4065731.s: Indiana opted not to use Huff despite the tightly contested matchup. The veteran center appears to be behind other frontcourt options in the Pacers' rotation, limiting his immediate fantasy appeal unless his workload increases.

4065732.h: Hunter will start Wednesday's game against the Clippers, Tomer Azarly of ClutchPoints.com reports.
4065732.s: Ben Simmons is out for the season with a torn Achilles, opening the door for Hunter to step into the starting five. The 28-year-old appeared in only two games after being traded to Sacramento last season, and he averaged 13.7 points, 4.1 rebounds, 2.0 assists and 0.7 steals across 26.1 minutes per contest in 45 regular-season games (25 starts) between the Kings and Cavaliers.

4065732.h: Hunter (rest) is available to play in Friday's exhibition against the Spurs, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.
4065732.s: Hunter missed Tuesday's preseason loss to Portland for maintenance, but he's been cleared for Sacramento's preseason finale. Hunter is averaging 3.3 points, 2.3 rebounds and 2.3 turnovers per game this preseason.

4065732.h: Hunter (rest) has been ruled out for Tuesday's preseason game against the Trail Blazers, Matt George of ABC 10 Sacramento reports.
4065732.s: Hunter will join several other regulars on the inactive list. His final chance to play in the preseason will come Friday against the Spurs.

4065732.h: Hunter is not in the Kings' starting lineup against the Warriors on Saturday, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.
4065732.s: Hunter has started in each of the Kings' first two preseason games, but he'll come off the bench Saturday while Keegan Murray, Ben Simmons and Precious Achiuwa make up Sacramento's starting frontcourt. Hunter logged only three points over 13 minutes during Monday's preseason loss to the Lakers.

4065732.h: Hunter finished with three points (3-3 FT) in 13 minutes during Monday's 127-103 preseason loss to Los Angeles.
4065732.s: Hunter started at small forward but didn't attempt a field goal during his limited action. The 28-year-old joined Sacramento late last season and appears positioned to open the 2026-27 campaign in the starting lineup.

4065733.h: Jerome is emerging as a potential option at point guard for the Grizzlies, Damichael Cole of The Commercial Appeal reports.
4065733.s: With Memphis still sorting through its point guard depth chart, it's possible that Jerome is in pole position to begin the season as Memphis' top point guard in favor of Scotty Pippen. Health has long been a major obstacle for Jerome, but he's certainly shined in his starting opportunities over the past several years. Dating back to 2020-21, the 29-year-old has averaged 18.6 points, 5.3 assists, 3.0 rebounds and 1.0…

4065778.h: Strus has been diagnosed with a partially torn plantar fascia in his right foot and he will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.
4065778.s: Plantar fascia injuries can be challenging to recovery from, with the only remedy typically being prolonged rest; therefore, it wouldn't be surprising if Strus' absence extends well beyond this initial four-week window. With Strus now set to miss at least the first few weeks of the season and Bradley Beal (knee) uncertain for Opening Night, Keaton Wagler could be thrust into the first unit sooner than expected.

4065778.h: Strus will not return to Sunday's preseason game against the Warriors due to a right foot injury, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.
4065778.s: Strus appeared to tweak his foot while making a cut in the first quarter. Keaton Wagler figures to see more playing time with Strus out.

4065778.h: Strus exited Sunday's preseason game against the Warriors due to an apparent right ankle injury, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.
4065778.s: Strus exited in the first quarter straight to the locker room, seemingly favoring his right foot or ankle. Keaton Wagler could see some extra run if Strus is unable to return.

4065778.h: Strus is in the starting lineup for Sunday's preseason opener against the Warriors, but he will only be available for the first half of play, Joey Linn of SI.com reports.
4065778.s: Strus has the edge to start over Keaton Wagler to begin the season, as he has chemistry with Darius Garland from their time together in Cleveland. With Brandon Ingram (Achilles) and Bradley Beal (knee) banged up, Strus should see an expanded role to begin his Clippers tenure.

4065778.h: Strus could be in line for an expanded role to begin the season with Brandon Ingram sidelined while recovering from a partially torn Achilles and right heel surgery.
4065778.s: The Clippers haven't established a timetable for Ingram's return, opening additional minutes on the wing for Strus. The veteran's perimeter shooting makes him one of the more logical options to absorb some of Ingram's playing time while Los Angeles waits for its new forward to return.

4065804.h: Hauser (rest) is expected to play in Tuesday's game against Detroit.
4065804.s: Hauser didn't play in Friday's 125-120 preseason overtime win over Philadelphia, though that was the case with most of the team's core performers. The 28-year-old averaged 9.2 points, 3.8 rebounds and 1.5 assists, all career highs, in 78 regular-season games, including 49 starts, during the 2025-26 campaign. Hauser could be in line for an even better season, especially if Paul George, Jayson Tatum, Derrick White and…

4065804.h: Hauser (rest) is not suiting up for Friday's preseason game against the 76ers, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports.
4065804.s: Hauser and other prominent Celtics players, like Jayson Tatum, Paul George and Derrick White, will rest for Friday's preseason finale. The Celtics will open their regular season Tuesday against the Pistons, and Hauser is once again expected to operate in a rotational role off the bench, though he'll be competing against the likes of Jordan Walsh, Baylor Scheierman (rest), Hugo Gonzalez and Ron Harper for playing…

4065804.h: Hauser (rest) is available for Saturday's preseason contest against the 76ers, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports.
4065804.s: Hauser didn't play in the preseason win over the Cavaliers on Thursday, but he'll be able to log minutes off the bench in this contest. Hauser has a strong grip on a rotation spot, and a good showing in the preseason could boost his chances to earn consistent playing time once the regular season starts. He's projected to open the campaign as the backup small forward behind Paul George.

4065804.h: Hauser (rest) is out for Thursday's preseason game against the Cavaliers, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports.
4065804.s: The Celtics are resting several players ahead of this preseason game, and that includes Hauser, who's expected to have a sizable role in the rotation this season. His next chance to play will come against the 76ers on Saturday.

4065804.h: Hauser's role could become more secure following Boston's offseason shakeup with the team swapping Jaylen Brown for Paul George and other assets, John Schuhmann of NBA.com reports.
4065804.s: While George is expected to absorb most of Brown's minutes, George's recent durability concerns may create additional opportunities for Hauser on the wing throughout the season. Hauser should continue to provide elite three-point shooting, with his fantasy value receiving a boost whenever George requires maintenance days or misses time.

4065813.h: Diallo (wrist) is out for Monday's game against the Warriors.
4065813.s: Diallo was initially listed as doubtful for this contest, and the Nuggets will err on the side of caution. The defensive specialist will have a chance to return Wednesday against the Pelicans.

4065813.h: Diallo (wrist) is doubtful for Monday's game against the Warriors.
4065813.s: Diallo logged 22 minutes in the season opener against the Thunder on Thursday, but now he's at risk of missing a second consecutive contest due to a right wrist sprain. If that's the case, Bryce Hopkins and Cam Whitmore would continue to see extra minutes off the bench.

4065813.h: Diallo (wrist) won't play Saturday against the Pelicans.
4065813.s: Diallo will hit the sidelines after hurting his wrist in Denver's season opener, which should open up minutes for Bryce Hopkins and Cam Whitmore. Diallo's next chance to play will come Monday against the Warriors.

4065813.h: Diallo is questionable for Saturday's game versus the Pelicans due to a right wrist sprain.
4065813.s: Diallo tweaked his wrist in the season opener and is now listed as questionable to face the Pelicans on Saturday. If he can't give it a go, Bryce Hopkins and Cam Whitmore could be more involved in the rotation.

4065813.h: Diallo has impressed head coach David Adelman on both ends of the floor during training camp, according to DNVR Nuggets.
4065813.s: Adelman praised Diallo's ability to navigate screens and described his defense as a "special skill," while noting that the 29-year-old has been impressive offensively with his positioning and movement. The reigning EuroLeague Best Defender has already received work with Denver's second unit during camp, and Adelman indicated that Diallo's combination of defense, cutting and off-ball movement could give him a chance…

4066211.h: Williams (rest) is expected to play in Wednesday's regular-season opener against Phoenix.
4066211.s: Williams got the night off Friday but figures to return for Portland's regular-season opener. The big man is expected compete for minutes with Micah Potter (illness) and Yang Hansen behind Donovan Clingan.

4066211.h: Williams (rest) won't play in Friday's preseason game against the Warriors.
4066211.s: Williams will take the night off before presumably being available for Opening Night against Phoenix. The veteran big man is a capable statistical contributor, though he has battled injuries over the years. If Williams remains healthy, he should see steady minutes behind Donovan Clingan throughout the 2026-27 campaign.

4066211.h: Williams (rest) is available for Tuesday's preseason game against the Kings.
4066211.s: The veteran big man is off the injury report after resting Monday against London. Williams is in line to be the primary backup center behind Donovan Clingan, though 2025 first-rounder Yang Hansen poses a threat to that role.

4066211.h: Williams (rest) is out for Monday's exhibition against the London Lions.
4066211.s: The Trail Blazers are giving the veteran big man a maintenance day Monday. Williams' next chance to play comes Tuesday against Sacramento.

4066211.h: Williams will sign a three-year, $44 million contract with the Trail Blazers, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4066211.s: Williams likely would've had a big market in free agency, so the Trail Blazers quickly moved to lock him up. He'll be penciled in as the backup center behind Donovan Clingan for 2026-27. During the 2025-26 regular season, Williams averaged 6.7 points, 7.0 rebounds, 1.0 assists and 1.5 blocks in 17.1 minutes per contest.

4066218.h: Williams (hamstring) will be re-evaluated following Charlotte's upcoming two-game road trip, Rod Boone of The Charlotte Observer reports.
4066218.s: Williams' earliest possible return date now looks to be Saturday at home against the 76ers. Royce O'Neale should continue to play meaningful minutes off the bench for the Hornets in the interim.

4066218.h: Williams (hamstring) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Heat.
4066218.s: Williams will miss a third straight game to begin the regular season due to a right hamstring strain that popped up during training camp in late September. Sion James will likely continue to operate in an elevated role in the absence of Williams, who can be considered week-to-week until the Hornets provide an update on his progress.

4066218.h: Williams (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Hawks.
4066218.s: A hamstring strain continues to leave Williams on the shelf. Sion James played 27 minutes during an Opening Night start in Brooklyn and carries some deep-league streaming appeal.

4066218.h: Williams (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's season opener versus the Nets.
4066218.s: Williams is not yet able to practice fully as he works back from a hamstring injury. The Hornets should turn to Royce O'Neale for some extra playing time until Williams is ready to suit up.

4066218.h: Williams will miss the preseason after suffering a right hamstring injury, the Hornets announced Friday.
4066218.s: Williams will be re-evaluated the first week of the regular season, putting his status for Opening Night in the air. Williams will have a difficult path to minutes this season as he competes with the likes of Naz Reid, Royce O'Neale and Tidjane Salaun.

4066259.h: Fox (wrist) is available for Friday's game against the Rockets, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
4066259.s: Fox will power through the wrist issue and get out there for the second game of the season. He logged 32 minutes as a starter in the season opener and finished with 14 points, seven rebounds, seven assists, one steal and two turnovers in a 116-104 loss to the Thunder.

4066259.h: Fox (wrist) participated in Friday's morning shootaround, Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News reports.
4066259.s: Fox appeared to get some extra shots up following practice as well. The point guard is officially listed as questionable and could end up being a game-time call.

4066259.h: Fox (wrist) is questionable to play in Friday's game against the Rockets.
4066259.s: Fox appears to have picked up a wrist injury that will leave his status for Friday's contest up in the air. He was efficient in the season-opening defeat Tuesday, tallying 14 points (6-9 FG, 0-2 3Pt, 2-3 FT), seven rebounds, seven assists and one steal across 32 minutes. If Fox is sidelined, Dylan Harper and Stephon Castle will handle more of the playmaking duties, while Julian Champagnie would likely slide into the…

4066259.h: Fox (undisclosed) is in the starting lineup for Wednesday's preseason game against Phoenix, Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News reports.
4066259.s: Fox will make his preseason debut after missing the first three games with an undisclosed issue. While the guard is in the starting lineup, his workload may be limited in the exhibition.

4066259.h: Fox (undisclosed) has been ruled out for Monday's preseason game against the Jazz, Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News reports.
4066259.s: Fox was listed in the starting lineup for Thursday's game against the Hawks but was a late scratch and will miss a third straight exhibition Monday. The extent of his injury remains unclear, but the Spurs have given no indication the veteran point guard is in danger of missing Opening Night. For what it's worth, the Spurs are resting most of their regulars, including their expected starting lineup, for Monday's game.

4066261.h: Adebayo (groin) isn't listed on the injury report for Wednesday's game against Minnesota.
4066261.s: Adebayo missed the Heat's final three preseason games with right groin tightness, though the star big man is set to play in the team's regular-season opener. Over 73 regular-season appearances in 2025-26, he averaged 20.1 points, 10.0 rebounds, 3.2 assists and 1.9 combined steals-plus-blocks in 32.4 minutes per contest. He's finished with regular-season averages of at least 18 points and nine rebounds per game in…

4066261.h: Adebayo (groin) participated in Monday's practice, Anthony Chiang of the Miami Herald reports.
4066261.s: Adebayo is battling a right groin issue, though it's a good sign that he's been able to practice on back-to-back days. His availability for Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Timberwolves should become more clear once the team releases its first injury report Tuesday evening.

4066261.h: Adebayo (groin) participated in Sunday's practice, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
4066261.s: Adebayo missed Miami's final three preseason games due to right groin tightness, though he returned to practice Sunday. The star big man can be considered questionable for Wednesday's regular-season opener against Minnesota until the Heat offer an update on his status. If Adebayo needs to miss time, Bobby Portis and Nick Richards would likely see increased minutes.

4066261.h: Adebayo (groin) has been ruled out for Friday's preseason game against the Magic, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
4066261.s: Adebayo won't suit up for Friday's preseason finale due to right groin tightness. The star big man's next chance to suit up will come in Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Timberwolves.

4066261.h: Adebayo (groin) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Nets, Eric Nehm of The Athletic reports.
4066261.s: The star big man is dealing with minor right groin tightness. Friday's game against the Magic is his next chance to play.

4066262.h: Monk (ankle) is available for Friday's game against Portland.
4066262.s: Monk is ready to make his season debut Friday. The veteran guard figures to cut into Emanuel Sharp's playing time off the bench in the Sacramento backcourt.

4066262.h: Monk (ankle) is probable for Friday's game against Portland.
4066262.s: Monk was downgraded to out for Sacramento's regular-season opener Wednesday against the Clippers due to an ankle issue. However, he appears on track to make his 2026-27 debut Friday. Expect confirmation on Monk's availability as tipoff nears.
