4066262.s: Monk is not expected to suit up for Sacramento's regular-season opener due to left ankle soreness. If the veteran guard is ultimately ruled out, Nique Clifford, Emanuel Sharp and Daeqwon Plowden could all see a bump in minutes.

4066262.h: Monk (ankle) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.
4066262.s: Monk is in danger of missing Wednesday's regular-season opener due to left ankle soreness. His absence would leave additional minutes available for the likes of Nique Clifford and Emanuel Sharp.

4066320.h: Bane (rest) is available for Tuesday's preseason game against the Cavaliers.
4066320.s: Bane sat out Sunday's loss to Cleveland but is set to return to action in Orlando's penultimate exhibition game. The veteran swingman's return will likely send Tristan da Silva back to the second unit.

4066320.s: Bane will sit out Orlando's second exhibition game for rest purposes. The 28-year-old swingman's next opportunity to suit up in the preseason will come in Tuesday's rematch against the Cavaliers.

4066320.h: Bane feels confident entering his second year with the Magic, Philip Rossman-Reish of Orlando Magic Daily reports.
4066320.s: Bane navigated an entirely new team and coach a season ago after being traded from Memphis to Orlando in June of 2025. However, that won't be the case entering the 2026-27 campaign. Bane has voiced his confidence in the team and staff around him, and he's also been impressed with one of his new teammates, Nikola Vucevic, stating that Vucevic has a serious approach and makes it clear that he's in Orlando to win, per…

4066328.h: Allen (knee) is active for Thursday's game against the 76ers.
4066328.s: Despite carrying a questionable tag leading up to Cleveland's regular-season opener in Philadelphia, Allen was always expected to suit up. The Cavaliers' starting center could be on a soft minutes restriction given his history with the lingering knee issue. Evan Mobley, Thomas Bryant, Peyton Watson and Jaylon Tyson would likely benefit from any vacated minutes.

4066328.h: Allen (knee) said he expects to play Thursday against the 76ers, Chris Fedor of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.
4066328.s: Allen is listed as questionable on the latest injury report. He was able to get some shots up Thursday morning, however, and it sounds like he intends to push through the minor injury. The Cavaliers may keep a close eye on his minutes if he's cleared to suit up.

4066328.h: Allen (knee) is questionable for Thursday's game against the 76ers.
4066328.s: Allen is in danger of missing the Cavaliers' first game of the 2026-27 campaign. If Allen can't suit up, Evan Mobley would presumably slide to the five, with Jaylon Tyson the favorite to move into the starting lineup.

4066336.h: Markkanen (neck) is not listed on the injury report for Monday's preseason meeting with the Spurs.
4066336.s: It looks like Markkanen will be back after a one-game absence, which should shift Jaxson Hayes or Ace Bailey back to the second unit. If Markkanen can manage to stay healthy this season, he could be in for a career year as an integral component of the Jazz's attack.

4066336.h: Markkanen won't play in Tuesday's preseason game against the Nuggets due to neck soreness.
4066336.s: Markkanen is sitting out the exhibition game with some minor neck soreness, but he should be able to get back out there for Monday's preseason game against the Spurs. Ace Bailey will have a chance to start sans Markkanen, and there will be more minutes available for Svi Mykhailiuk.

4066354.h: Pritchard (rest) is expected to play in Tuesday's game versus Detroit.
4066354.s: Pritchard didn't play in Friday's 125-120 preseason overtime win over Philadelphia but is on track to be on the floor when the Celtics begin the 2026-27 campaign versus the Pistons. The 2020 No. 26 overall pick is coming off his best season in 2025-26, averaging 17.0 points, 3.9 rebounds and 5.2 assists across 32.4 minutes per contest in 79 regular-season games, including 50 starts. With Jaylen Brown now in…

4066354.h: Pritchard (rest) won't play in Friday's preseason finale against the 76ers, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports.
4066354.s: Pritchard and the rest of Boston's regulars won't be available for the final exhibition but should be good to go for the regular-season opener against the Pistons on Tuesday. Pritchard provided seven points (3-11 FG, 1-4 3Pt), 11 assists and three rebounds over 29 minutes off the bench during Wednesday's 114-93 preseason win over Charlotte.

4066354.s: Pritchard's extension includes a mutual option for the 2029-30 campaign. The 28-year-old guard is coming off the best statistical year of his career, averaging 17.0 points, 5.2 assists, 3.9 rebounds and 0.7 steals across 32.4 minutes per game in 79 regular-season appearances (50 starts). Regardless of whether the 2024-25 Sixth Man of the Year starts, he figures to play a sizable role for the Jaylen Brown-less…

4066354.h: Pritchard (rest) said he'll play in Saturday's preseason game against the 76ers, Jay King of The Athletic reports.
4066354.s: Most of Boston's regular players rested during the preseason opener, including Pritchard, but the veteran point guard will make his debut Saturday. He's coming off a career-best season during which he averaged 17.0 points, 5.2 assists and 3.9 rebounds across 79 regular-season games (50 starts).

4066354.h: Pritchard (undisclosed) has been ruled out for Thursday's preseason game against the Cavaliers, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports.
4066354.s: This appears to be a scheduled rest day for Pritchard, as the Celtics are sitting a number of their regular rotation players. He'll have an opportunity to suit up for Saturday's exhibition against the 76ers.

4066372.h: Huerter said Monday that he's healthy entering training camp after undergoing surgery during the offseason to address a groin injury, Omari Sankofa II of the Detroit Free Press reports.
4066372.s: Huerter said the injury initially occurred during his time with Chicago before he aggravated it during Detroit's first-round playoff series against Orlando. He underwent a cleanup procedure after the Pistons' postseason run ended and has since returned to full health, putting him on track to participate in training camp without limitations.

4066372.h: Huerter intends to sign a three-year, $27 million contract with the Pistons, Shams Charania of ESPN reports Monday.
4066372.s: Huerter was traded from Chicago to Detroit before last season's deadline. He appeared in 25 regular-season games (three starts) with the Pistons, during which he averaged 8.6 points, 2.8 rebounds, 2.5 assists and 1.1 steals in 20.5 minutes per game. However, the Pistons added Isaiah Joe via trade this offseason, so Huerter will likely have to compete for minutes with Joe, Daniss Jenkins, Caris LeVert and Marcus…

4066383.h: Bridges (ankle) will play in Friday's preseason game against the Jazz, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.
4066383.s: Bridges will return to the lineup in Friday's preseason finale after missing two games with an ankle injury. The 28-year-old forward is gearing up for his first regular season with the Suns after averaging 17.1 points, 5.8 rebounds and 3.2 assists per game across 77 regular-season starts with Charlotte in 2025-26.

4066383.h: Bridges (rest) won't play Wednesday against the Spurs, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
4066383.s: Bridges and the other veterans on the roster will sit this one out. His final opportunity to get on the floor before the start of the regular season will come Friday versus the Jazz.

4066383.h: Bridges isn't expected to play Wednesday against the Spurs after missing Phoenix's full morning shootaround, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.
4066383.s: Bridges appears headed for a night off alongside several other Suns regulars. Phoenix has one exhibition game remaining Friday against Utah, giving the forward another chance to get minutes before the regular season.

4066383.h: Bridges (ankle) won't play in Saturday's preseason game against the Spurs, Hayden Cilley of ClutchPoints.com reports.
4066383.s: While Bridges won't play Saturday, he was able to practice Friday, so he's trending in the right direction. His next chance to suit up will come Wednesday in a preseason rematch with the Spurs.

4066383.h: Head coach Jordan Ott said Friday that Bridges' (ankle) X-rays came back negative, and he participated in Friday's practice, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.
4066383.s: Bridges exited Wednesday's preseason loss to the Bulls with a right ankle injury and did not return, though this news bodes well for his status ahead of the regular season. Ott added that the team will "be smart" with Bridges moving forward, so it wouldn't be surprising if he missed time during the preseason. The 28-year-old forward can be considered questionable for Saturday's exhibition against San Antonio until…

4066399.h: Potter (illness) is available for Wednesday's game against Phoenix.
4066399.s: Potter was in danger of missing this contest, though after recently being upgraded to probable, he is now officially good to go Wednesday night. However, even though the 28-year-old is cleared to suit up, that doesn't mean he'll be on the floor often on Opening Night.

4066399.h: Potter (illness) has been upgraded to probable for Wednesday's game against the Suns.
4066399.s: Potter was initially listed as questionable but is trending in the right direction ahead of Wednesday's regular-season opener. However, even if he's cleared to play, he isn't likely to see meaningful burn.

4066399.h: Potter (illness) is questionable for Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Suns.
4066399.s: Potter missed Portland's preseason finale due to this illness and now he's in danger of missing Opening Night. However, Potter is not expected to have a significant role in the rotation, so his playing status won't impact fantasy leagues.

4066399.h: Potter has been ruled out for Friday's preseason finale against the Warriors due to an illness.
4066399.s: Potter isn't feeling well and will miss Portland's final exhibition match, but he should be good to go for Wednesday's regular-season opener versus Phoenix. Potter will conclude his preseason run with averages of 6.7 points and 3.0 rebounds in 10.8 minutes per game.

4066399.h: Potter was claimed off waivers by Portland on Friday.
4066399.s: Potter bounced around the league before spending most of the 2025-26 campaign in Indiana. In 47 regular-season appearances with the Pacers, he averaged 9.7 points, 5.0 rebounds, 1.5 assists, 0.3 blocks and 0.5 steals across 19.3 minutes. It's unknown what kind of role Potter will have in Portland, though it's reasonable to assume the Trail Blazers acquired him for depth purposes.

4066436.h: Melton will come off the bench in Friday's matchup with Memphis, Danny Emerman of SFStandard.com reports.
4066436.s: Brandin Podziemski (back) is active and starting, so Melton will retreat to the second unit. As a reserve last season, Melton averaged 11.8 points, 2.3 assists, 1.4 triples and 1.5 steals per game.

4066436.h: Melton will start Wednesday's game against the Lakers, Trevor Lane of LakersNation.com reports.
4066436.s: Brandin Podziemski won't suit up due to lower-back soreness, opening the door for Melton to enter the starting five. The 28-year-old guard started 24 games in the 2025-26 regular season, averaging 12.8 points, 3.5 rebounds, 2.8 assists and 1.7 steals across 24.5 minutes per game in those outings.

4066436.h: Melton (rest) won't travel with the Warriors for Wednesday's preseason game against the Trail Blazers, Dalton Johnson of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.
4066436.s: Melton is among several rotation players Golden State is holding out for the second half of a preseason back-to-back. The veteran guard has been working with the Warriors' second unit during training camp and should have another opportunity to suit up Saturday against Sacramento.

4066436.h: Melton revealed this offseason that he underwent surgery on each of his thumbs, per Danny Emerman of SFStandard.com.
4066436.s: Melton is fully recovered now, but playing through the discomfort resulted in him shooting just 29.4 percent from deep during the regular season, his lowest mark since 2019-20 with Memphis. The swingman is competing at training camp with Gui Santos and Yaxel Lendeborg for a starting role, and Melton has shown he is capable of being an effective nine-category fantasy player when healthy after averaging at least 10.0…

4066436.h: Melton will sign a two-year, $11 million deal with the Warriors, Shams Charania of ESPN reports Wednesday.
4066436.s: Melton previously declined his $3.45 million player option after rebuilding his market value with a strong 2025-26 campaign. He averaged a career-high 12.3 points along with 3.2 rebounds, 2.6 assists and 1.6 steals in 23.0 minutes per contest across 49 regular-season games (24 starts). Look for him to play a similar role moving forward, though the Warriors are expected to be very busy this offseason.

4066457.h: Reaves (ankle) is available for Thursday's preseason game against the Kings, Benjamin Royer of The Orange County Register reports.
4066457.s: Head coach JJ Redick confirmed Reaves' availability, meaning the Lakers will have one of their go-to offensive options on the hardwood for this preseason contest. As a result, the 28-year-old will get some much-needed reps as the regular season approaches.

4066457.h: Reaves (ankle) won't play in Tuesday's preseason game against the Warriors, Luca Evans of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.
4066457.s: Reaves missed Monday's game against the Kings after tweaking his ankle, and the Lakers won't risk his health, so he'll also sit the second half of this back-to-back set. Reaves' next chance to make his preseason debut will come against the Kings on Thursday.

4066457.h: Reaves won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Kings after tweaking his ankle, Dan Woike of The Athletic reports.
4066457.s: The Lakers don't appear to be overly concerned about the injury at this point. Reaves will have another chance to make his preseason debut Tuesday against Golden State.

4066457.h: Lakers president Rob Pelinka referred to Reaves, Luka Doncic and Walker Kessler as the team's "Big 3" while discussing the continuity of the roster, Ryan Ward of SI.com reports.
4066457.s: The comments reinforce Reaves' prominent role in Los Angeles' offense and suggest he should remain a major part of the team's plans alongside Doncic and Kessler this season. Fantasy managers can expect a mild bump in offensive usage with LeBron James out of the mix.

4066648.h: Hachimura will start in Sunday's preseason game against the Warriors, but he will be limited to the first half of play, Joey Linn of SI.com reports.
4066648.s: Joining Hachimura in the first unit for Sunday's exhibition will be Darius Garland, Max Strus, Derrick Jones and Isaiah Jackson. Brandon Ingram (Achilles) won't be ready for Opening Night, so Hachimura could begin the season as a starter.

4066648.h: The arrival of Max Strus creates another source of competition for Hachimura in Los Angeles.
4066648.s: Strus' ability to space the floor and function without the ball should make him an easy fit around the Clippers' primary creators, potentially costing Hachimura some opportunities depending on how the rotation shakes out. Hachimura can still carve out a significant role with his size and scoring ability, but the Clippers' depth makes a major fantasy breakout less likely.

4066648.h: Hachimura signed a two-year, $28 million contract with the Clippers on Monday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4066648.s: After spending the past three-plus seasons with the Lakers, Hachimura will remain in Los Angeles on a two-year pact with the Clippers. The 28-year-old forward figures to see meaningful playing time but isn't guaranteed a starting role with his new club. Over 68 regular-season appearances (41 starts) in 2025-26, he averaged 11.5 points and 3.3 rebounds across 28.3 minutes per showing.

4066650.h: Head coach Tiago Splitter said he expects Collins to play Saturday against the Wizards, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.
4066650.s: Collins was available for Friday's game, but he did not leave the bench. However, Splitter said he will need Collins' size to compete with the Wizards' frontcourt, so he expects to have the big man in the rotation Saturday.

4066650.h: Collins (quadriceps) is available for Friday's game against the Bucks.
4066650.s: Collins will play through a right quadriceps strain after previously carrying a probable designation. The veteran big man was limited to 16 minutes in Wednesday's season opener against Toronto, and he could remain on a restricted workload Friday. With Nic Claxton (hamstring) sidelined, Collins should have opportunities in Chicago's frontcourt if his minutes increase.

4066650.h: Collins (quadriceps) is probable for Friday's game against the Bucks.
4066650.s: Collins is likely to play through a right quadriceps strain Friday. The veteran center had a minutes cap of 16 minutes in the season opener Wednesday in Toronto, and he'll likely carry a similar restriction.

4066650.h: Collins (quadriceps) will be limited to 12-16 minutes in Wednesday's game against the Raptors, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.
4066650.s: Collins will return to game action after missing the preseason, though he'll be heavily limited. The big man is coming off an injury-plagued 2025-26 season in which he appeared in only 10 regular-season games, averaging 9.7 points, 5.6 rebounds and 1.5 assists in 18.4 minutes per contest.

4066650.h: Collins (quadriceps) is available for Wednesday's game against Toronto.
4066650.s: As expected, Collins will ditch his probable tag for Wednesday's regular-season opener after sitting out the team's entire preseason schedule. The big man figures to operate as Jalen Smith's primary backup until Nic Claxton (hamstring) returns to the lineup.

4066757.h: Merrill (elbow) is not listed on the injury report ahead of Thursday's regular-season opener in Philadelphia.
4066757.s: Merrill skipped Cleveland's preseason finale due to some soreness in his shooting elbow, but he's been fully cleared for Opening Night. Merrill will be battling Jaylon Tyson and Mario Hezonja for reserve minutes on the wings this season.

4066757.h: Head coach Kenny Atkinson said Tuesday that Merrill (elbow) went through a full practice, per Danny Cunningham of Sports Radio 92.3 The Fan Cleveland.
4066757.s: It sounds like Merrill is progressing well from an elbow injury. The Cavaliers will release their first injury report Wednesday, and Merrill can be tentatively deemed questionable for Thursday's regular-season opener against the 76ers in the meantime.

4066757.h: Merrill (elbow) isn't participating in Saturday's scrimmage, Danny Cunningham of Sports Radio 92.3 The Fan Cleveland reports.
4066757.s: Merrill was held out of Tuesday's preseason finale due to right elbow soreness and won't scrimmage Saturday. He can be considered questionable for Thursday's regular-season opener against the 76ers until the Cavaliers provide an update on his status.

4066757.h: Merrill (elbow) has been ruled out for Tuesday's preseason game against the Magic, Serena Winters of FanDuel Sports Network Ohio reports.
4066757.s: Merrill will be held out of Cleveland's preseason finale due to right elbow soreness. The 30-year-old sharpshooter's next opportunity to play will come in the Cavaliers' regular-season opener against Philadelphia on Thursday, Oct. 22.

4066757.h: Peyton Watson's arrival gives Cleveland another option on the wing, though Merrill's elite perimeter shooting provides him with a skill that remains particularly valuable alongside Donovan Mitchell, James Harden, Evan Mobley and Jarrett Allen.
4066757.s: Watson shot 41.1 percent from three last season over 54 regular-season games, but he's historically been a relatively low-volume shooter, so Merrill could continue to have a role when the Cavaliers need additional floor spacing. Even so, Cleveland's increasingly crowded wing rotation leaves Merrill with a relatively narrow path to consistent fantasy relevance.

4066993.h: Smith (calf) is available for Wednesday's season opener versus Minnesota.
4066993.s: Smith has made good progress with a right calf strain and is ready to roll for Opening Night. He's set to be the No. 2 point guard off the bench behind Davion Mitchell on Wednesday.

4066993.h: Smith (calf) participated in practice Monday, Anthony Chiang of the Miami Herald reports.
4066993.s: Smith was also able to suit up for Sunday's practice, so he appears to be trending in the right direction despite dealing with a right calf strain. More clarity on his status for Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Timberwolves should come once the team releases an injury report Tuesday evening.

4066993.h: Smith (calf) participated in Sunday's practice, Anthony Chiang of the Miami Herald reports.
4066993.s: Smith didn't play in the preseason due to a strained right calf. While his level of participation in Sunday's session is unclear, it's encouraging to see Smith practicing. He can be considered questionable for Wednesday's regular-season opener against Minnesota.

4066993.h: Smith (calf) has been ruled out for Friday's preseason game against the Magic, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
4066993.s: Smith strained his right calf in the beginning of training camp and will end up missing the entire preseason. His next chance to play will come in Wednesday's regular-season opener against Minnesota.

4066993.h: Smith will miss a couple of weeks with a strained right calf, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
4066993.s: This is a tough blow for the point guard who was penciled in as the top backup behind Davion Mitchell. If he misses only a couple of weeks, Smith could be back in time for their final preseason contest Oct. 16.

4222252.h: Hartenstein (ankle) is good to suit up in Tuesday's preseason game against the Pacers, Justin Martinez of The Oklahoman reports.
4222252.s: Hartenstein is in line to make his 2026 preseason debut after dealing with an ankle injury. The big man is coming off an injury-plagued 2025-26 season in which he appeared in 47 regular-season games (46 starts), averaging 9.2 points, 9.4 rebounds, 3.5 assists and 1.8 combined steals-plus-blocks in 24.2 minutes per contest.

4222252.h: Hartenstein (ankle) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Hawks, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
4222252.s: Hartenstein and the rest of Oklahoma City's regulars won't travel to Atlanta for the first half of a back-to-back set. The veteran center has yet to suit up during the preseason due to an ankle injury, and his status for Tuesday's home game against Indiana remains unclear.

4222252.h: Hartenstein (ankle) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Bucks, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
4222252.s: Hartenstein is sitting out once again with ankle soreness after missing the Thunder's preseason opener. His next chance for exhibition action is Monday against the Hawks.

4222252.h: Hartenstein (rest) will not play in Tuesday's preseason opener against the Pelicans, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
4222252.s: Hartenstein will travel to Tulsa despite sitting out the contest. The veteran center is among several key rotation players whom Oklahoma City will hold out Tuesday as the club manages workloads during the preseason.

4222252.h: Hartenstein dropped nearly 10 pounds ahead of the 2026-27 season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
4222252.s: Hartenstein has been a full go for several weeks after tweaking his ankle while playing for Germany during the offseason. He's expected to play a similar role in 2026-27 and is fresh off a three-year, $75 million extension.

4277811.h: Sexton (calf) isn't listed on the injury report for Friday's game against the Clippers.
4277811.s: Sexton took a seat for Wednesday's 2026-27 season opener against the Warriors as a precaution, but he'll be ready to make his team debut Friday evening. He's expected to be utilized off the bench behind Luka Doncic and will be on a minutes restriction, Thuc Nhi Nguyen of the Los Angeles Times reports.

4277811.s: It sounds like Sexton is day-to-day, so for now, he should be considered questionable for Friday's meeting with the Clippers. Quentin Grimes, Jake LaRavia and Sandro Mamukelashvili will help pick up the slack in Sexton's absence.

4277811.h: Sexton (calf) won't play in Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Warriors, per Khobi Price of The California Post.
4277811.s: Sexton isn't ready to make his Lakers debut Wednesday due to a calf strain. The veteran guard's absence should open the door to more playing time for Quentin Grimes, Jake LaRavia and Sandro Mamukelashvili.

4277811.h: Sexton (calf) is questionable for Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Warriors.
4277811.s: Sexton did not play during the preseason due to a right soleus strain, but he was able to get through the Lakers' past two practices, so he's trending in the right direction. He'll likely have some minutes restrictions if he's cleared to play.

4277811.h: Sexton (lower leg) fully practiced Monday, per Dan Woike of The Athletic.
4277811.s: Sexton missed the end of the preseason with a lower right leg injury, but he's trending in the right direction. His status remains uncertain for Wednesday's season opener against the Warriors.

4277813.h: Jones is not in the starting lineup for Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Pacers.
4277813.s: The Pelicans will go small for Wednesday's season opener, starting Dejounte Murray and Jeremiah Fears in the backcourt. Jones still should see quality minutes in the reserve role, but his upside will be limited.

4277813.h: Jones won't start Thursday's preseason game against the Heat.
4277813.s: Jones got the starting nod in the Pelicans' preseason-opening win over the Thunder on Tuesday, though he'll slide to the second unit Thursday. Bennedict Mathurin will enter the first unit in Jones' place.

4277813.h: Jones is in the starting lineup for Tuesday's preseason game against the Thunder, Andrew Lopez of Gulf Coast Sports & Entertainment Network reports.
4277813.s: Jones will start on the wing, with Zion Williamson and Yves Missi as the frontcourt pairing. The former Alabama standout was limited to just 56 regular-season appearances in 2025-26 and averaged 8.9 points, 3.4 rebounds and 2.8 assists while logging 28.4 minutes per game. If he stays healthy, he should be a lock in the starting unit.

4277813.h: Jones continues to provide New Orleans with elite perimeter defense and positional versatility, making him one of the NBA's premier role players.
4277813.s: While Jones' offensive responsibilities remain modest, his ability to contribute steals, blocks and efficient complementary production keeps him fantasy relevant. His role as the Pelicans' top defensive wing should remain unchanged heading into 2026-27.

4277843.h: Trent (coach's decision) did not play in Wednesday's 128-116 loss to Washington.
4277843.s: The veteran sharpshooter was unable to crack Milwaukee's rotation despite the team's Opening Night defeat. Trent has the perimeter shooting ability to contribute when called upon, but his uncertain workload makes him difficult to trust in fantasy formats.

4277843.h: Trent was active for Friday's 128-127 preseason win over the Pacers in overtime but didn't play due to a coach's decision.
4277843.s: Trent sat out Wednesday's loss to Chicago and didn't see the floor in Milwaukee's preseason finale. He's expected to provide wing depth for the Bucks in 2026-27 and faces competition for minutes from Brayden Burries and AJ Green.

4277843.h: Trent (rest) won't play Wednesday against the Bulls, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.
4277843.s: The Bucks are giving the veteran swingman Wednesday night off. His next chance for preseason action is Friday against the Pacers.

4277843.h: Trent (coach's decision) was inactive for Wednesday's 128-126 preseason win over Oklahoma City.
4277843.s: Trent's absence wasn't listed as injury-related, and Milwaukee may simply be evaluating other backcourt options during the preseason. His next opportunity to play will come Sunday against Charlotte.

4277843.h: The NBA's investigation into Trent's four-year, $64 million contract with the Bucks remains ongoing, Joe Vardon of The Athletic reports.
4277843.s: The league has reportedly hired national investigations law firm Hecker Fink to examine the fully guaranteed deal, while both Milwaukee and Trent's agency, Klutch Sports Group, are cooperating with the investigation. The NBA is looking into whether Trent's previous team-friendly contracts with the Bucks were connected to an understanding that he would receive a more lucrative deal once Milwaukee acquired his Early…

4277847.h: Carter's outlook becomes more uncertain following Orlando's acquisition of Nikola Vucevic.
4277847.s: While Carter has served as the Magic's starting center in recent seasons, Vucevic's return could cut into his playing time and potentially shift him into a reduced role depending on how Orlando structures its frontcourt rotation. Carter is likely to remain with the first unit, but his fantasy value may take a hit if the two centers split minutes consistently.

4277848.h: Bagley (shoulder) agreed to a one-year deal with the Nuggets on Wednesday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4277848.s: After playing for three teams over the past two seasons, Bagley will join the Nuggets for the 2026-27 campaign. The big man appeared in 60 regular-season games (12 starts) between the Wizards and Mavericks last season, averaging 10.5 points, 6.1 rebounds, 1.4 assists and 1.2 combined steals-plus-blocks while shooting 61.8 percent from the field across 20.0 minutes per contest. He figures to operate as Denver's top…

4277869.h: Alvarado (ankle) is out for Tuesday's game against the Pistons.
4277869.s: Alvarado will miss a second consecutive game with a sprained ankle. Tyler Kolek entered the New York rotation in Sunday's loss to the Magic and should continue to play a bench role while Alvarado is sidelined.

4277869.h: Alvarado (ankle) is out for Sunday's game against the Magic, James L. Edwards III of The Athletic reports.
4277869.s: Alvarado was deemed questionable Saturday due to a left ankle sprain, and the veteran guard won't suit up as a result of the injury. Jordan Clarkson and Tyler Kolek should be in line for more playing time. As for Alvarado, his next chance to play will come against the Pistons on Tuesday.

4277869.h: Alvarado is questionable for Sunday's game against Orlando due to a left ankle sprain.
4277869.s: Alvarado may have tweaked his ankle during the Knicks' 107-103 loss to the Celtics on Friday, when he played 11 minutes and finished with two points, two rebounds, two assists and one steal. Miles McBride, Jordan Clarkson and Tyler Kolek would all be in line for an uptick in minutes off the bench if Alvarado cannot play Sunday.

4277869.h: Alvarado isn't in the starting lineup for Thursday's preseason game against the Raptors.
4277869.s: Alvarado drew a spot start Tuesday but will revert back to the bench for the preseason finale. Jalen Brunson will draw the start at point guard and get a chance for a final tune-up before the regular season begins Tuesday against Philly.

4277869.h: Alvarado is starting Tuesday against the Raptors, Jared Schwartz of the New York Post reports.
4277869.s: The Knicks are resting their usual starting lineup Tuesday. Alvarado could play big minutes in this exhibition.

4277905.h: Young (quadriceps) has been cleared for training camp and was spotted participating in on-court work during Wednesday's practice, according to Wizards reporter Greg Finberg.
4277905.s: Young's 2025-26 campaign ended with him sidelined by a right quadriceps contusion and lower-back irritation after appearing in just five games for Washington following his midseason arrival. His participation during the second day of camp indicates he's moved past those issues and enters the preseason healthy.

4277905.h: Young (quadriceps) has been doing sand-dune workouts during the offseason, and his trainer discussed the guard's outlook Monday, Mark Medina of RG reports.
4277905.s: With Young limited to 15 regular-season appearances in 2025-26 due to injuries, any sign of offseason rehab progress is notable. This report points to active conditioning work after his quadriceps issue, though it does not provide a return timeline or formal clearance update ahead of Washington's training camp. However, a previous report from ESPN indicated that he would be ready to roll.

4277919.h: Bamba (coach's decision) did not play in Wednesday's 123-103 loss to Memphis.
4277919.s: Utah leaned on Jaxson Hayes and Jaren Jackson in the frontcourt, leaving Bamba without an opportunity in the season opener. The veteran center appears to be a depth option and could struggle to find consistent minutes without injuries ahead of him.

4277919.h: Bamba agreed to a two-year contract with the Jazz on Wednesday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4277919.s: Bamba spent the first four-plus seasons of his career in Orlando before suiting up for the Lakers, 76ers, Clippers, Pelicans, Jazz and Raptors. The 2018 No. 6 overall pick has appeared in 368 regular-season contests, averaging 6.7 points, 5.4 rebounds, 0.8 assists, 1.3 blocks and 0.4 steals over 16.7 minutes. Bamba isn't the most talented scorer in the NBA, but his defensive acumen gives him value for a Utah squad…

4277922.h: Sims (undisclosed) is not listed on the injury report for Wednesday's game against the Wizards.
4277922.s: The high-flying big man is ready to suit up in Milwaukee's 2026-27 regular-season opener in Washington after missing the preseason finale. With the addition of Kel'el Ware during the offseason and Myles Turner entering his second season with the franchise, Sims is set to be the third center on any given night as the Bucks begin to rebuild following their trade of franchise pillar Giannis Antetokounmpo to the Heat.

4277922.h: Sims (undisclosed) didn't play in Friday's 128-127 preseason win over the Pacers in overtime.
4277922.s: Sims was held out of Friday's preseason finale for undisclosed reasons. The big man's next opportunity to play will come in Wednesday's regular-season opener against Washington, though his absence wouldn't significantly impact the rotation.

4277922.h: Sims is in the starting lineup for Wednesday's preseason game against Chicago.
4277922.s: Sims will enter the starting lineup for the first time this preseason with several Milwaukee regulars resting. In 67 regular-season appearances (19 starts) last season, the big man averaged 5.0 points, 5.5 rebounds and 1.6 assists in 19.7 minutes per contest.

4277951.h: Garza (nose) went to the locker room late in the fourth quarter of Saturday's preseason game against the 76ers, Bobby Manning of CLNS Media Network reports.
4277951.s: Garza took an inadvertent elbow to the nose from teammate Chris Cenac, and the former was taken to the locker room shortly thereafter. He didn't return to the hardwood, ending his night with eight points (4-9 FG), seven rebounds and one assist over 11 minutes.

4277951.h: Garza is not in the starting lineup for Saturday's preseason game against the 76ers, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports.
4277951.s: Garza returns to the bench with Mitchell Robinson (undisclosed) getting the start at center. Garza provided 22 points (6-17 FG, 3-10 3Pt, 7-8 FT), 10 rebounds, three blocks and two assists across 27 minutes in Thursday's 124-113 preseason win over Cleveland, and he's making a strong case to earn a spot in the rotation even if he'll compete with Neemias Queta and Robinson for playing time.

4277951.h: Garza will start Thursday's preseason game against Cleveland, Bobby Krivitsky of Forbes.com reports.
4277951.s: The Celtics are expected to rest several rotation players Thursday, opening the door for Garza to step into the first unit. The 27-year-old center will face an uphill battle for steady minutes during the regular season.

4277956.h: The Pelicans gave Poole another competitor for playing time with the signing of Bennedict Mathurin on Wednesday.
4277956.s: Poole was a massive disappointment from a fantasy perspective in 2025-26, averaging 13.4 points, 3.1 assists and 2.0 rebounds per game over 39 regular-season appearances while falling out of the rotation at times. He'll be battling with Jeremiah Fears for the backup point guard role behind Dejounte Murray at training camp, while the addition of Mathurin could make it difficult for Poole to see steady minutes at…

4277956.h: Poole provided New Orleans with an additional scoring threat initially during the 2025-26 campaign, but he would eventually fall out favor with the coaching staff.
4277956.s: Poole ended up making 39 regular-season appearances, shooting 37.2 percent from the field with 13.4 points, 3.1 assists and 2.0 rebounds. With Dejounte Murray (hand) expected to be back at full strength, Poole will face an uphill battle for playing time in 2026-27.

4277961.h: Jackson is still developing chemistry with Utah's core after having limited time alongside his teammates following his arrival last season, according to Jazz reporter Eric Spyropoulos.
4277961.s: Head coach Will Hardy said Tuesday that Jackson's familiarity with the roster doesn't change the fact that he's still early in the learning process after appearing in only three games for Utah last season. Hardy was encouraged by Jackson's communication during the Jazz's opening practice and highlighted the big man's versatility as something that gives the team several options. Developing chemistry with Lauri…

4277961.h: With Walker Kessler now in Los Angeles, Jackson (knee) figures to be an even more essential piece for the Jazz in 2026-27, per ESPN's Tim MacMahon.
4277961.s: Jackson was traded from Memphis to Utah in February, though he appeared in only three regular-season games for the Jazz before undergoing surgery due to a growth in his left knee. The 2022-23 Defensive Player of the Year will look to make his presence felt on that end of the floor and anchor a now Kessler-less Jazz frontcourt. Jackson's two-way production will be crucial for a Utah team that's looking to return to…

4278039.h: Alexander-Walker (rest) is available for Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.
4278039.s: Alexander-Walker is off the injury report for this exhibition. He'll likely see some run in the first half before handing things off to Atlanta's younger players in the second half.

4278039.h: Alexander-Walker (rest) won't suit up for Saturday's preseason game in Indiana, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
4278039.s: Alexander-Walker will skip Saturday's exhibition, but he should be back for Monday's preseason matchup with Oklahoma City. Kingston Flemings should see a boost in minutes with Alexander-Walker unavailable.

4278039.h: Alexander-Walker could face increased competition for minutes after Atlanta added Luguentz Dort, Rylan Stiles of SI.com reports.
4278039.s: Additionally, the Hawks added rookie Kingston Flemings while previously acquiring Aaron Wiggins. Alexander-Walker's defensive versatility and three-point shooting should still earn him a big role in the rotation, but the Hawks suddenly have much greater depth on the wing, making it more difficult for him to secure consistent touches. As a result, Alexander-Walker's upside may not be as appealing as it was in 2025-26.

4278049.h: Gafford went to the locker room during the third quarter of Monday's game against the Heat due to an undisclosed injury, but he returned with 8:52 remaining in the quarter, Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com reports.
4278049.s: Gafford looked to take a knee to the body on a Giannis Antetokounmpo dunk, and the big man was spotted going into the locker room right after. However, Gafford was able to return later in the quarter after getting checked out.

4278049.h: Gafford (rest) is not listed on the injury report ahead of Friday's preseason finale with the Hawks.
4278049.s: Gafford sat out Wednesday's exhibition for rest, but he'll be back in action for Friday's final exhibition before the regular season. Over 55 regular-season games (44 starts) in 2025-26, Gafford averaged 9.5 points, 6.9 rebounds, 1.1 assists and 1.3 blocks per contest.

4278049.h: Gafford (rest) won't play Wednesday against the Pelicans, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.
4278049.s: The big man is receiving a maintenance day Wednesday. His next chance to play comes Friday against the Hawks.

4278049.h: Gafford could have the green light to attempt occasional three-pointers this season, with head coach Dusty May encouraging the center to expand his offensive game, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.
4278049.s: May said the Mavericks want Gafford to become more of a playmaking decision-maker on the perimeter and indicated that he'll be allowed to take rhythm threes as long as he earns those opportunities. Gafford has attempted just one three-pointer across his seven NBA regular seasons and has yet to make one, so any development of a perimeter shot would represent a significant change to his offensive profile. He averaged…

4278053.h: Mitchell (rest) is in line to play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Nets, Will Manso of Local 10 Miami reports.
4278053.s: The Heat plan to get most of their regular players some minutes Wednesday. Mitchell should get some burn in the first half of this exhibition.

4278053.h: Mitchell (rest) won't suit up for Saturday's exhibition against the Timberwolves, Eric Nehm of The Athletic reports.
4278053.s: The Heat will be resting their entire starting lineup for Saturday's preseason game, so expect ample minutes for guys like Ryan Conwell and Bez Mbeng. Mitchell should return for Wednesday's exhibition against the Nets.

4278053.h: Mitchell could be in line for a larger role after Miami traded Tyler Herro in the deal for Giannis Antetokounmpo, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sentinel reports.
4278053.s: With the Heat expected to lean on Mitchell as a primary backcourt facilitator, he'll have the opportunity to capitalize on the attention Antetokounmpo commands offensively. However, Mitchell's fantasy value will likely hinge on whether he can provide enough scoring to complement his defensive impact. Over 70 regular-season appearances in 2025-26, he averaged 9.3 points, 6.5 assists, 2.7 rebounds and 1.0 steals while…

4278067.h: Claxton (hamstring) participated in individual drills Monday morning and hopes to join the team for practice next week, Joe Cowley of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.
4278067.s: The Bulls reported one week ago that the big man would be re-evaluated in two weeks, so he appears to be right on track with his recovery from a hamstring injury. He'll presumably need to take part in 5-on-5 drills before getting the green light to return to game action.

4278067.h: Claxton (hamstring) will be re-evaluated in two weeks, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.
4278067.s: This is a tough blow for the Bulls, as they will be without their starting center for at least the first seven regular-season games. Meanwhile, Zach Collins' (toe) status remains in the air. This could set up Jalen Smith for a solid workload to open the season.

4278067.h: Claxton tweaked his hamstring and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Chuck Swirsky of the Bulls Radio Network of the Bulls Radio Network reports.
4278067.s: This is a huge blow for Claxton, and it rules him out for the entire preseason. For now, fantasy managers can consider him questionable for Opening Night on Oct. 21 against the Raptors. Jalen Smith is the next man up on the depth chart for Chicago, followed by Zach Collins (toe).

4278067.h: Claxton is projected to start at center for the Bulls in the 2026-27 campaign, according to Law Murray of The Athletic.
4278067.s: The Bulls were left with a big void at the center position after dealing Nikola Vucevic to the Celtics for Anfernee Simons at last year's trade deadline, and they're looking for Claxton to help plug the hole in 2026-27 after coming over from Brooklyn. Claxton, who was a full-time starter with the Nets for the better part of the last four seasons, has generally been a strong source of boards and swats for fantasy…

4278073.h: Gilgeous-Alexander (rest) is available for Tuesday's preseason game versus Indiana, Justin Martinez of The Oklahoman reports.
4278073.s: As expected, Gilgeous-Alexander will return to action in the second leg of this back-to-back set after missing Monday's loss to Atlanta for rest purposes. The superstar point guard's return will leave fewer minutes available for Josh Dix and Bennett Stirtz, who combined for 42 points and 12 assists Monday.

4278073.h: Gilgeous-Alexander (rest) won't play in Monday's preseason game against Atlanta, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
4278073.s: Gilgeous-Alexander and the rest of the Thunder's regulars won't travel to Atlanta for Monday's game, but they are expected to suit up during the second half of their back-to-back set Tuesday, when they host Indiana. Gilgeous-Alexander produced 17 points (5-5 FG, 3-3 3Pt, 4-4 FT), three rebounds, five assists and a block across 18 minutes in Wednesday's 128-126 preseason loss to the Bucks.

4278073.h: Gilgeous-Alexander (not injury related) is set to play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Bucks, Justin Martinez of The Oklahoman reports.
4278073.s: Gilgeous-Alexander isn't included on the list of Thunder players who'll be held out of Wednesday's contest. Chet Holmgren (quadriceps) and Isaiah Hartenstein (ankle) will remain on the inactive list, though the rest of Oklahoma City's projected starters for 2026-27 are expected to suit up.

4278073.h: Gilgeous-Alexander will not play in Tuesday's preseason opener against the Pelicans, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
4278073.s: Gilgeous-Alexander will travel with the team to Tulsa but won't see game action. The absence appears to be part of Oklahoma City's plan to manage its primary rotation players throughout a five-game preseason slate, and there's no injury to report.

4278073.h: Gilgeous-Alexander could play off the ball more this season, per Kevin O'Connor of Yahoo Sports.
4278073.s: Running mate Jalen Williams was limited to a career-low 33 regular-season appearances in 2025-26, but his presence on the floor could help Gilgeous-Alexander spend more time off the ball in 2026-27. Gilgeous-Alexander remains a cinch pick early in the first rounds of fantasy drafts regardless of his role, having averaged at least 30 points, four rebounds, five assists, one steal and nearly one block while shooting…

4278076.h: Richards won't start Friday's preseason game against the Magic, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
4278076.s: Richards will slide to the second unit after starting Miami's past two games. The Heat will go with a starting five of Davion Mitchell, Klay Thompson, Andrew Wiggins, Bobby Portis and Nikola Jovic in the absences of Giannis Antetokounmpo (rest) and Bam Adebayo (groin).

4278076.h: Richards will start in Saturday's preseason game against the Timberwolves, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
4278076.s: Richards will get the start with Bam Adebayo (rest) and Giannis Antetokounmpo (rest) taking the night off. There should also be additional minutes available for Bobby Portis.

4278076.h: Richards agreed to a one-year deal with the Heat on Thursday, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
4278076.s: Miami fortifies its center depth with the move. Over 20 regular-season appearances for the Bulls in 2025-26, Richards averaged 9.3 points, 7.6 rebounds and 0.9 blocks in 22.4 minutes per game while shooting 52.3 percent from the field following a trade from Phoenix. The big man is likely to settle for a lesser role in his new digs, but he has a chance to serve as the No. 2 center behind Bam Adebayo.

4278077.h: Vanderbilt (undisclosed) is not listed on the injury report ahead of Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Warriors.
4278077.s: Vanderbilt skipped the Lakers' preseason finale, but he'll be available for Opening Night. However, he's not guaranteed a spot in the rotation.

4278077.h: Vanderbilt (undisclosed) isn't expected to play in Friday's preseason game against the Nuggets, Thuc Nhi Nguyen of the Los Angeles Times reports.
4278077.s: Vanderbilt was spotted in street clothes, though it's unknown why he isn't playing in the Lakers' preseason finale. His next chance to suit up will come in Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Warriors.

4278077.h: Vanderbilt is among the candidates for the Lakers' final starting position, according to Jovan Buha of Buha's Block.
4278077.s: Vanderbilt's defensive versatility, size and rebounding make him a theoretical fit for what Los Angeles wants from the role, but Buha is skeptical that he'll win the competition after playing a modest role last season. Jake LaRavia and Ziaire Williams appear to have the inside track entering camp, so Vanderbilt may need a strong preseason to move up the pecking order.

4278077.h: Vanderbilt should continue to provide defensive value after LeBron James' exit from the Lakers, Broderick Turner of the Los Angeles Times reports.
4278077.s: Despite James' absence, the arrivals of Matisse Thybulle, Ziaire Williams and Sandro Mamukelashvili give the Lakers additional options on the wing and in the frontcourt. While Vanderbilt's rebounding and defensive versatility remain valuable, increased competition for minutes could make it difficult for him to carve out a reliable fantasy role.

4278078.h: Washington (ankle) will play in Sunday's preseason game against the Rockets, Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com reports.
4278078.s: Washington missed Friday's preseason opener due to a left ankle sprain but will return to action Sunday, sliding into the starting lineup next to Cooper Flagg, Zaccharie Risacher, Kyrie Irving and Daniel Gafford. As a starter last season (53 games), Washington averaged 14.5 points, 7.2 rebounds, 1.7 assists, 1.1 blocks and 1.0 steals per game.

4278078.h: Washington won't play in Friday's preseason game against the Rockets due to a left ankle sprain.
4278078.s: The severity of Washington's ankle injury is unclear, but his next chance to suit up will come during Sunday's rematch against the Rockets in China. The veteran forward is expected to have a key role for the Mavs heading into the 2026-27 season, though head coach Dusty May isn't ready to commit to the Kentucky product as a mainstay in the starting five. Washington has come off the bench only four times across 113…

4278078.h: Washington is being considered for a spot in the Mavericks' starting lineup, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.
4278078.s: Washington is expected to have a key role for the Mavs heading into the 2026-27 season, though coach Dusty May is not yet ready to commit to the Kentucky product being a mainstay in the starting five. It's worth noting that Washington has come off the bench only four times in 113 regular-season appearances for Dallas over the last two years. However, the addition of rookie Morez Johnson could complicate the…

4278104.h: Porter (wrist) is good to go for Monday's preseason game against the Wizards, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.
4278104.s: As expected, Porter is back after missing Thursday's preseason game due to wrist soreness. Presumably, the Nets were simply being cautious for the exhibition.

4278104.h: Porter will not play in Thursday's preseason game against Philadelphia due to left wrist soreness, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.
4278104.s: Porter's absence comes after he scored 16 points in Tuesday's preseason win over Charlotte. The Nets haven't indicated whether the wrist issue will affect his availability beyond Thursday, though his next opportunity to play will come Monday against Washington.

4278104.h: Porter said his goal this season is to become the best off-ball player in the NBA, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports.
4278104.s: The forward believes his cutting and catch-and-shoot ability give him the tools to reach that level, though he emphasized that conditioning will be an important factor. Porter should have plenty of opportunities to showcase those skills as he looks to have another significant role with Brooklyn.

4278104.h: Porter (hamstring) could see his offensive role shift after the Nets acquired Julius Randle, who figures to become one of the focal points of Brooklyn's half-court offense, Sameer Kumar of SI.com reports.
4278104.s: While Porter should continue to benefit from Randle's ability to draw defensive attention, Randle's high-usage style may reduce Porter's shot volume after he emerged as the team's top-scoring option last season. Porter should still have plenty of fantasy appeal due to his elite shooting and rebounding, but his scoring upside may take a slight hit if Randle dominates possessions as expected.

4278129.h: Ayton is starting Monday's preseason game against the Nets.
4278129.s: The Wizards are resting Anthony Davis on Monday, opening a spot in the first unit. Ayton is positioned to play the backup center role for Washington in 2026-27.

4278129.h: Ayton is not in the starting lineup for Saturday's preseason game against the Pistons, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.
4278129.s: The Wizards will tweak their frontcourt and will have Alex Sarr next to Anthony Davis, meaning Ayton will move to the bench. Ayton is likely to see most of his regular-season minutes off the bench, with Sarr and Davis expected to start when healthy.

4278129.h: Ayton will start Thursday's preseason game against the Knicks, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.
4278129.s: Ayton will get a look with the first unit while Alex Sarr continues to recover from offseason foot surgery. He'll start alongside Trae Young, Kyshawn George, AJ Dybantsa and Anthony Davis.

4278129.h: Ayton won't play for the Bahamas during upcoming FIBA action, NBA reporter Marc Stein reports.
4278129.s: There's no report of an injury to Ayton, who appears to be sitting out for maintenance purposes. After being shipped to the Wizards this offseason, the 28-year-old big man is lined up as the primary backup big behind Alex Sarr and Anthony Davis ahead of training camp.

4278129.h: The Lakers are trading Ayton to the Wizards in exchange for Jaden Hardy and two second-round picks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4278129.s: Ayton's departure was imminent following the addition of Walker Kessler. In Washington, Ayton figures to be the primary backup to Alex Sarr, filling the void left by the departure of Marvin Bagley. Ayton doesn't seem like an appealing fantasy option on his new team, as he needs a lot of volume and minutes to be worthwhile in standard formats.

4278562.h: Reed will start Sunday's game against the 76ers, Omari Sankofa II of the Detroit Free Press reports.
4278562.s: Reed will enter the starting five due to Jalen Duren (hamstring) being out. Reed performed well during Friday's win over the Heat, logging 19 points and 11 rebounds in 26 minutes off the bench.

4278562.h: Reed will start Monday's preseason game against the Suns, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.
4278562.s: With Jalen Duren (rest) out, Reed will enter the starting lineup in Detroit's preseason opener. The 27-year-old is expected to operate as the Pistons' primary backup behind Duren in 2026-27.

4278562.h: Reed will be in line for increased playing time and is expected to operate as the Pistons' backup center in 2026-27, per Hunter Patterson of The Athletic.
4278562.s: The Pistons remain in contract talks with Jalen Duren, but assuming the restricted free agent returns for at least one more season, Reed should operate as Detroit's primary backup center. The club traded Isaiah Stewart to the Grizzlies in June, and all signs point toward Reed taking on an increased role. The 27-year-old center played double-digit minutes in 42 of his regular-season appearances (11 starts) in…

4278562.h: The Pistons fully guaranteed Reed's $5.6 million contract for the 2026-27 season, Jake Fischer of BleacherReport.com reports.
4278562.s: This was essentially a formality for the Pistons after Reed put together a solid 2025-26 campaign. Across 65 regular-season contests, he shot 61.7 percent from the field for averages of 7.8 points, 4.5 rebounds, 1.2 assists, 0.9 blocks and 0.9 steals in 13.9 minutes per contest. He's penciled in as the backup center ahead of the new campaign, assuming Jalen Duren ultimately re-signs.

4278572.h: The Magic exercised their 2026-27 team option for Cain on Monday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
4278572.s: This was a formality after Cain carved out a key role down the stretch of 2025-26, averaging 17.6 minutes during Orlando's playoff run. Look for him to compete for a rotation spot entering 2026-27 with momentum on his side.

4278580.h: Mamukelsahvili isn't starting Thursday's preseason game against the Kings, Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com reports.
4278580.s: Mamukelashvili drew the start in Tuesday's exhibition against Golden State, and he made the most of his opportunity by finishing with 15 points in 18 minutes. However, the big man will head back to a bench role Thursday as Kevon Looney gets a chance to start at center.

4278580.h: Mamukelashvili will start in Tuesday's preseason game against the Warriors, Jovan Buha of The Athletic reports.
4278580.s: The Lakers have seven players inactive for Tuesday's exhibition, so Mamukelashvili could see reasonable minutes. Joining him in the first unit will be Bronny James, Quentin Grimes, Jake LaRavia and Adou Thiero.

4278580.h: Mamukelashvili is among the options for the Lakers' final starting spot, though Jovan Buha of Buha's Block has reservations about his defensive fit.
4278580.s: Buha questioned whether a lineup featuring Luka Doncic, Mamukelashvili and Walker Kessler would have sufficient quickness and athleticism defensively. Mamukelashvili should nevertheless get an opportunity to compete for the job during camp and the preseason, though Jake LaRavia and Ziaire Williams appear to be the more likely candidates entering the competition.

4278580.h: Mamukelashvili signed a four-year, $52 million deal with the Lakers on Wednesday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4278580.s: The Lakers make another huge splash after just acquiring Walker Kessler. Mamukelashvili likely had a considerable market after a career-best season in Toronto. Across 80 regular-season games, Mamukelashvili averaged 11.2 points, 4.9 rebounds and 1.9 assists in 21.9 minutes per game. In Los Angeles, he's poised for a consistent role in a frontcourt that lost LeBron James and Rui Hachimura this offseason.

4278580.h: Mamukelashvili declined his $2.8 million player option for 2026-27, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4278580.s: This was a widely expected transaction, with Mamukelashvili putting together a career season in 2025-26. Across 80 regular-season contests, he produced averages of 11.2 points, 4.9 rebounds and 1.9 assists on 52.3 percent shooting from the field. He's expected to have a strong market heading into free agency.

4278585.h: Gillespie (rest) is not listed on the injury report for Friday's preseason finale against the Jazz, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.
4278585.s: Gillespie sat out Wednesday's preseason loss to the Spurs for maintenance purposes, but he'll be back in action for Friday's final exhibition game. Gillespie is averaging 7.3 points, 1.7 triples and 1.3 steals in 16.9 minutes per contest this preseason.

4278585.h: Gillespie (rest) won't play in Wednesday's game against the Spurs, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
4278585.s: Gillespie has appeared in three preseason games for the Suns in 2026, averaging 16.9 minutes per contest. However, as expected, the 27-year-old will rest Wednesday, with his final chance to see more preseason action coming Friday versus Utah.

4278585.h: Gillespie did not take part in Wednesday's full morning shootaround and isn't expected to play against San Antonio, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.
4278585.s: The guard's anticipated absence further thins Phoenix's backcourt, with Devin Booker and Jalen Green also expected to sit. Gillespie's next opportunity to play will be Friday's preseason finale against Utah, assuming he's available.

4278594.h: Marshall (illness) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Heat.
4278594.s: Marshall is under the weather and will be held out of Monday's road game, and his next chance to suit up will come when the Mavericks host the Thunder on Wednesday. With the 28-year-old forward unavailable, Zaccharie Risacher and Marcus Sasser could see increased burn.

4278594.h: Marshall will start Saturday's game against the Spurs.
4278594.s: With Kyrie Irving (knee/rest) and Cooper Flagg (shoulder) sidelined in the second leg of this back-to-back set, Marshall will enter the starting five and figures to see increased playmaking duties. He's posted at least 15 points and six assists in back-to-back games to begin the regular season.

4278594.h: Marshall will come off the bench in Friday's preseason finale against the Hawks.
4278594.s: Marshall started in Wednesday's exhibition loss to the Pelicans with Kyrie Irving (rest) unavailable, but Irving is back from his maintenance day. Marshall will be operating in a reserve role for the Mavs this season, so it'll be tough for him to find enough minutes to make an impact in fantasy leagues.

4278594.h: Marshall will start in Wednesday's preseason game against New Orleans, Christian Clark of The Athletic reports.
4278594.s: Marshall will start for the second time this preseason. The 28-year-old started in 47 regular-season games during the 2025-26 campaign, averaging 17.3 points, 5.0 rebounds, 3.7 assists and 1.2 steals over 31.6 minutes per contest in those appearances.

4278594.h: Marshall said during Media Day that improving his three-point shooting was a major focus during the offseason, Austin Veazey of SI.com reports.
4278594.s: The 28-year-old expressed confidence that the work will translate this season, saying that becoming a more consistent perimeter threat would make him "unstoppable." Marshall averaged a career-high 15.2 points, 4.7 rebounds, 3.3 assists and 1.1 steals across 74 regular-season appearances in 2025-26 despite shooting just 29.1 percent from three. A significant improvement from beyond the arc would add another dimension…

4279318.h: Plowden agreed to a two-year, $5.1 million contract with the Kings on Thursday, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.
4279318.s: Plowden has managed to land a standard NBA deal after previously playing on two-way contracts while with Sacramento, Atlanta and Golden State over the last few seasons. He averaged 10.8 points, 3.0 rebounds, 1.3 assists and 1.9 made threes in 26.4 minutes over 32 regular-season appearances a year ago with the Kings.

The good news for Haliburton is that his ankle issue is not related to the Achilles injury that caused him to miss the entire 2025-26 season. His next chance to play is Tuesday against…

4396993.s: The star point guard sustained a torn Achilles in Game 7 of the 2025 NBA Finals and missed the entire 2025-26 campaign, though he has been fully cleared to participate in training camp and should be available for the start of the regular season. Carlisle added that Haliburton has gotten stronger, but it wouldn't be surprising to see the Pacers manage his workload to start the campaign, especially during back-to-back…

4396993.s: With Haliburton working his way back from the torn Achilles he suffered in Game 7 of the 2025 NBA Finals, this is a notable checkpoint ahead of the 2026-27 season. He should play a sizable role for the club in 2026-27.

4397002.s: Dosunmu won't travel with the Timberwolves but is expected to be ready to go for their regular-season opener against the Heat on Wednesday. With the 26-year-old sidelined, Terrence Shannon, Isaiah Evans and Bones Hyland could see increased playing time.

4397002.h: Dosunmu (rest) is available for Monday's preseason game against the Knicks.
4397002.s: After resting Saturday, Dosunmu will be available off the bench at Madison Square Garden. Through two preseason games, he's averaging 7.5 points, 2.0 rebounds and 1.5 assists in 15.0 minutes per contest.

4397002.s: Dosunmu will get a breather for Saturday's contest, as will other prominent Timberwolves players like Anthony Edwards (rest) and LaMelo Ball (rest). Dosunmu's next chance to play is Monday against the Knicks.

4397002.h: Dosunmu reiterated Monday that he views Minnesota as his long-term home after re-signing with the Timberwolves during the offseason, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.
4397002.s: "I felt at home. That was the most important part," Dosunmu said, adding that he can envision starting a family in Minnesota and pointing to the area's public schools as another factor in his desire to stay. The 26-year-old signed a five-year, $112 million deal this summer after averaging 14.4 points, 4.2 rebounds and 3.5 assists across 24 regular-season appearances for Minnesota following his midseason arrival from…

4397014.h: Grimes will come off the bench in Friday's game against Denver, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.
4397014.s: Grimes is projected to start at small forward to open the season. He will come off the bench Friday in the final preseason game before the Opening Night meeting with the Warriors on Wednesday.

4397014.h: Grimes wants to establish himself as a starter during training camp, Jovan Buha of The Athletic reports.
4397014.s: According to Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com, Grimes also said that he takes pride in his defense and will be ready to guard the opposing team's best player on a nightly basis, which should help him secure a regular starting role. Luka Doncic, Austin Reaves and Walker Kessler are all essentially locked in as starters to begin the season, though head coach JJ Redick will have training camp and the preseason to…

4397014.h: Grimes is viewed as a lock to occupy one of the Lakers' starting spots entering training camp, according to Jovan Buha of Buha's Block.
4397014.s: Grimes is expected to join Luka Doncic, Austin Reaves and Walker Kessler as four established members of the starting five, leaving only one position unsettled. The offseason addition should complement Doncic and Reaves with his perimeter defense and ability to operate away from the ball, putting Grimes in line for a substantial role in his first season with Los Angeles.

4397014.h: Grimes figures to have an opportunity to fill the two-way role the Lakers need on the perimeter, with his defensive ability potentially being just as important as his production on the offensive end, Jovan Buha of The Athletic reports.
4397014.s: Grimes is an athletic, aggressive guard capable of applying pressure at the point of attack, while his physicality and activity should give Los Angeles another option against opposing perimeter scorers. Grimes' willingness to attack offensively also adds another dimension beyond his spot-up shooting, though his overall impact could depend heavily on the makeup of the starting five.

4397014.h: Grimes agreed to a four-year, $60 million deal with the Lakers on Wednesday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4397014.s: The Lakers continue to add some firepower to their roster after acquiring Walker Kessler, Sandro Mamukelashvili and Collin Sexton. Grimes will likely be a key part of the second unit in Los Angeles with his ability to play multiple positions. During the 2025-26 regular season, Grimes averaged 13.4 points, 3.6 rebounds, 3.3 assists and 0.9 steals in 29.4 minutes per contest.

4397020.h: Dort (rest) will play in Friday's preseason finale against the Mavericks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
4397020.s: Dort and most of Atlanta's regulars rested Monday against the Thunder but will return to action for the final exhibition. It'd be surprising if the veteran played major minutes Friday.

4397020.h: Dort (rest) is out for Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.
4397020.s: Dort is sitting out Monday for maintenance purposes, along with most of the Hawks' regulars. The veteran swingman's next chance to play is Friday against Dallas.

4397020.h: Dort is in the starting lineup for Saturday's preseason contest against the Pacers, Kevin Chouinard of the Hawks' official site reports.
4397020.s: The Hawks are tweaking their lineup for this preseason contest, and Dort will get the nod in the starting lineup due to the absence of Nickeil Alexander-Walker (rest). Dort averaged 8.3 points, 3.6 rebounds and 1.9 three-pointers per contest with the Thunder in 69 regular-season appearances in 2025-26.

4397020.s: It appears Dort will make his Hawks preseason debut Saturday, but the 27-year-old veteran will likely have his minutes monitored. Over 69 games with the Thunder last season, Dort averaged 8.3 points, 3.6 rebounds and 1.9 triples per contest.

4397040.h: Williams (back) is available for Monday's game against the Nuggets.
4397040.s: Williams was deemed probable Sunday due to left lower-back soreness, but he's been cleared to play and should see minutes off the bench in the Warriors' backcourt. He started against Phoenix on Saturday in a game where the Warriors rested several starters and posted 20 points with five assists, so he's likely to see a relatively voluminous role with the second unit.

4397040.h: Williams is probable for Monday's game against the Nuggets due to left lower back soreness.
4397040.s: The back issue seems to be new for Williams, but he is expected to play through it Monday. Williams got a spot start Saturday against the Suns due to Golden State resting many players, and he made the most of the opportunity, recording 20 points (5-10 FG, 2-3 3Pt, 8-11 FT), five assists, three rebounds and two steals in 24 minutes.

4397040.h: Williams will start Saturday's game against Phoenix, Dalton Johnson of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.
4397040.s: With Stephen Curry (rest) out, Williams will draw his first regular-season start with the Warriors. Through two regular-season games, he's averaging 9.0 points, 3.0 rebounds, 2.0 assists and 2.0 steals in 13.5 minutes per tilt.

4397040.h: Williams will come off the bench in Saturday's preseason game against the Kings.
4397040.s: Stephen Curry is back and starting after skipping Wednesday's exhibition, so Williams will return to a reserve role. However, with Curry set to play just the first half of Saturday's exhibition, Williams should still see quality minutes.

4397040.h: Williams will start in Wednesday's exhibition against the Trail Blazers, Jason Quick of The Athletic reports.
4397040.s: The Warriors are resting nine players for Wednesday's exhibition, so Williams could see major minutes in a starting role. Joining him in the first unit for Wednesday's game will be Will Richard, Malevy Leons, Dalen Terry and Charles Bassey.

4397077.h: Hayes (shoulder) is out for Monday's game against the Grizzlies.
4397077.s: Hayes will miss the second leg of this back-to-back due to right shoulder soreness after posting nine points, five rebounds, a steal and an assist in 19 minutes during Sunday's loss to the Lakers. That means Kyle Filipowski and Mo Bamba are likely to handle a bigger role off the bench. Hayes' next chance to play will come against the Spurs on Wednesday.

4397077.h: Hayes is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Grizzlies due to right shoulder soreness, Shreyas Laddha of The Salt Lake Tribune reports.
4397077.s: Hayes could be held out of the second leg of this back-to-back set after posting nine points, five rebounds, a steal and an assist in 19 minutes during Sunday's loss to the Lakers. If the big man joins Jusuf Nurkic (foot) on the inactive list, Kyle Filipowski and Mo Bamba would be candidates to see increased minutes off the bench.

4397077.h: Hayes won't start Friday's game against New Orleans.
4397077.s: Hayes got the starting nod in Wednesday's season-opening loss to Memphis, posting five points, six blocks, five rebounds, three assists and two steals in 26 minutes of action. However, the big man will come off the bench behind Jaren Jackson on Friday, with Ace Bailey entering the first unit.

4397077.h: Hayes will start in Tuesday's game against Denver.
4397077.s: Jusuf Nurkic (foot) is sidelined, so Hayes will start in the rematch with the Nuggets. The 26-year-old started nine times with the Lakers in 2025-26, averaging 12.4 points, 5.1 rebounds, 1.9 assists and 1.1 steals over 27.4 minutes in those appearances.

4397077.h: The Jazz are signing Hayes to a two-year, $12 million deal Wednesday, per Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com.
4397077.s: The second season on the contract has a team option as well. Hayes spent his last three years with the Lakers, but now he's lined up to compete for the backup center role behind Jusuf Nurkic with Kyle Filipowski next year. Hayes averaged 7.5 points, 4.1 rebounds, 0.9 assists and 0.8 blocks in 18.3 minutes over 66 regular-season contests in 2025-26.

4397136.h: Bey is not listed in the starting lineup for Friday's preseason game against Washington.
4397136.s: Bey will come off the bench in the final preseason game for the Pelicans before the team kicks off the 2026-27 campaign versus the Pacers on Opening Night.

4397136.s: Bey will come off the bench in the Pelicans' first preseason game. The veteran wing signed a three-year extension in September after averaging 17.7 points, 5.6 rebounds and 2.5 assists over 31.2 minutes per contest in 72 regular-season games in 2025-26.

4397136.h: Bey agreed to a three-year, $55.5 million contract extension with New Orleans on Thursday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4397136.s: Bey, who sat out the 2024-25 season after suffering a torn ACL, proved to the Pelicans that he's deserving of a raise. He averaged 17.7 points, 5.6 rebounds, 2.5 assists and 2.1 made threes in 72 appearances during the 2025-26 season, and following this healthy extension, he'll presumably play a key role in the frontcourt heading into the new campaign, even with Bennedict Mathurin entering the mix.

4397136.h: Bey tentatively projects as the Pelicans' starting small forward, but the addition of Bennedict Mathurin gives him a formidable threat for a starting job.
4397136.s: Mathurin was effectively a full-time starter for the Pacers before becoming the first man off the bench following his trade to the Clippers. Bey is coming off a career year, averaging a career-high 17.7 points per game while shooting 45.1 percent from the field in his first season with New Orleans (72 regular-season games), so the camp battle between Bey and Mathurin for a spot in the first unit should be one to…

4397183.h: Wiggins (rest) is available for Friday's preseason game against Dallas, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

4397183.s: Wiggins' preseason debut was cut short after he suffered a lip laceration and was downgraded to out, but he's in line for a larger role Thursday evening. The 27-year-old will draw the start at power forward with Jalen Johnson set for a night off.

4397183.h: Wiggins (lip) is off the injury report for Thursday's preseason game against the Spurs.
4397183.s: Wiggins left the preseason opener with a lip laceration but is set to play Thursday. He's expected to occupy a key role off the bench in his debut season with the Hawks.

4397189.h: Smith (foot) is available and starting in Sunday's preseason game versus Denver.
4397189.s: Smith has been battling a foot injury but will be on the floor for the preseason meeting with the Nuggets after missing Friday's 104-100 loss to Memphis. 4397189.s: Smith got a chance to start for the Bulls at times in 2025-26 as they searched for Nikola Vucevic's replacement, averaging 12.1 points, 7.1 rebounds, 1.0 assists and 0.8 blocks in 24.6 minutes per tilt across 21 regular-season games as a starter. Now that Nic Claxton is in the picture, Smith appears primed to revert to the No. 2 center role in 2026-27, which could cap his upside from a fantasy perspective.…

4397204.h: Castleton (rest) has been ruled out for Saturday's Summer League game against the Celtics, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

4397204.s: Castleton will return to Orlando after operating as a two-way player for the club last season. 4397204.s: Castleton is now a two-way restricted free agent and can look for a better deal elsewhere. In 23 appearances with the G League's Osceola Magic in 2025-26, he averaged 18.7 points, 10.8 rebounds, 2.1 assists and 2.0 combined steals-plus-blocks in 27.5 minutes per…

4397251.s: Harper is working through right shoulder soreness, which has prevented him from playing in each of the Celtics' first two preseason games. His next opportunity to play is Wednesday against the Hornets.

4397251.s: Harper won't suit up for Boston's preseason opener due to a shoulder injury. His next opportunity to play will come in Saturday's preseason game against Philadelphia.

4397424.h: Queta will come off the bench for Tuesday's season opener against Detroit, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports.
4397424.s: Mitchell Robinson has officially won the starting job at center, though this position battle will be one to watch. Given Robinson's durability concerns, this could become a timeshare at the center spot.

4397424.h: Queta (rest) is expected to play in Tuesday's game against the Pistons.
