4397424.s: Queta didn't play against the Cavaliers on Thursday, but there's no indication that he won't be available for Saturday's game. Mitchell Robinson (rest) is starting at center, so Queta will come off the bench against Philadelphia.

4397424.h: Queta (rest) isn't in line to play Thursday against Cleveland, Zack Cox of the Boston Herald reports.
4397424.s: Boston seems to be holding out its expected starters for this exhibition. Luka Garza is getting a chance to start at center for the Celtics on Thursday.

4397475.h: Green (rest) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against Chicago, Cameron Ezeir of CBS58 reports.
4397475.s: Green has played in two of Milwaukee's preseason contests. His final opportunity to get on the floor before the start of the 2026-27 campaign will come Friday in Indiana.

4397475.h: Green (coach's decision) was inactive for Wednesday's 128-126 preseason victory over Oklahoma City.
4397475.s: Green joined several Milwaukee rotation players on the inactive list Wednesday. His absence was not attributed to an injury, and his next opportunity to take the floor will come Sunday against Charlotte.

4397688.h: Murphy has been working alongside Zion Williamson during three-point shooting drills at training camp, offering advice as his teammate attempts to expand his offensive game, Jim Eichenhofer of the Pelicans' official site reports.
4397688.s: Murphy said he's been giving Williamson pointers during the drills and praised the forward for being willing to listen and put in the work. This highlights Murphy's growing leadership role in New Orleans as he enters his sixth NBA season, while his established perimeter shooting makes him a natural resource for Williamson as the latter works to become a more consistent threat from outside. Murphy is poised to have a…

4397688.h: Murphy (ankle) continued his emergence as one of New Orleans' top offensive weapons before injuries interrupted another strong campaign.
4397688.s: Murphy's combination of three-point shooting, athleticism and secondary shot creation should once again make him a featured option alongside Zion Williamson. Murphy has averaged at least 21 points, five rebounds, three assists and one steal in back-to-back seasons, but he's made more than 66 regular-season appearances only once in his past five years.

4397886.h: Bassey (knee) is available for Monday's game against the Nuggets.
4397886.s: Bassey will play in his second consecutive contest after sitting out the first two outings of the season for Golden State. He posted 10 points (4-4 FG, 2-3 FT), seven rebounds and two blocks in just 13 minutes during Saturday's loss to Phoenix, and he should see limited minutes again with Draymond Green (back) returning to the lineup.

4397886.h: Bassey is probable for Monday's game against the Nuggets due to right patellar tendinopathy.

4397886.h: Bassey (knee) is available for Saturday's game against the Suns.
4397886.s: Bassey will return to action after missing the first two games of the regular season due to right patellar tendinopathy. The Warriors will be shorthanded in the second leg of this back-to-back set, so the big man will likely see significant minutes.

4397886.h: Bassey (knee) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Suns.
4397886.s: If Bassey is cleared to play, he would likely see meaningful playing time for the shorthanded Warriors. However, if Bassey and Draymond Green (back/rest), who is listed as doubtful, join Al Horford (back) on the inactive list, Graham Ike and Georges Niang would likely see increased burn.

4397886.h: Bassey (knee) is out for Friday's game versus the Grizzlies.
4397886.s: The big man is dealing with right patellar tendinopathy and can be considered day-to-day. Even with Kristaps Porzingis (illness) out of action, Bassey is unlikely to play a significant role once healthy.

4398207.h: Slawson signed a two-way contract with the Pacers on Tuesday, per Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com.
4398207.s: Indiana extended Slawson a qualifying offer in June, and the two sides have officially reached an agreement on a new deal. Preparing for his second season with the Pacers, the 2023 second-rounder figures to spend most of his time with the G League's Noblesville Boom in 2026-27.

4398207.h: The Pacers extended a qualifying offer to Slawson on Monday, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

4398390.h: Pickett and the Clippers agreed to a two-way contract Wednesday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
4398390.s: The Nuggets declined their team option for Pickett on June 29, but he lands in a pretty good spot with the Clippers in the early stages of a rebuild. Pickett figures to get plenty of G League reps to open the 2026-27 campaign.

4398390.h: The Nuggets declined Pickett's team option Monday, Bennett Durando of The Denver Post reports.
4398390.s: This one is a bit of a surprise, with Pickett now heading for free agency. As Denver's backup point guard during the 2025-26 regular season, he averaged 5.2 points, 2.3 assists and 2.3 rebounds in 16.1 minutes per contest.

4411057.h: The Knicks plan to waive McCullar on Friday, per Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com.
4411057.s: Previously a two-way player for New York, McCullar is now searching for another opportunity ahead of the upcoming G League season. Dalton Knecht is taking McCullar's place on the roster.

4411057.h: McCullar agreed to a two-way contract with the Knicks on Sunday.
4411057.s: McCullar has seen most of his action in the G League since being drafted in 2024. However, the 24-year-old has some experience at the NBA level, averaging 2.2 points and 1.4 rebounds over 7.4 minutes per contest in 25 regular-season games for the Knicks.

4431671.h: McDaniels agreed to a one-year, $40 million extension with the Timberwolves on Monday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4431671.s: McDaniels will now be under contract with Minnesota through the 2029-30 season, earning $124 million over the life of his deal. The 26-year-old forward could see an uptick in usage this season with Julius Randle no longer around, and he'll be a reliable source of stocks, making him an attractive draft-day target.

4431671.h: McDaniels (rest) is expected to play in Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Heat.
4431671.s: McDaniels and most of the Timberwolves' projected regular-season rotation sat out Friday's preseason finale, though he should be back in the lineup Wednesday. The 26-year-old forward is coming off the best year of his career in 2025-26, averaging 14.8 points, 4.2 rebounds, 2.7 assists, 1.1 steals and 1.0 blocks across 31.7 minutes per contest in 73 regular-season appearances.

4431671.h: McDaniels (rest) won't play in Friday's preseason game against the Bulls, Alan Horton of the Timberwolves Radio Network reports.
4431671.s: McDaniels will join several other key Timberwolves players on the inactive list Friday. However, he should be good to go by Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Heat.

4431671.h: McDaniels (rest) will start against the Knicks in Monday's preseason game.
4431671.s: McDaniels skipped Saturday's exhibition against the Heat for maintenance purposes, but he'll be back in action Monday evening. It'll be interesting to see if McDaniels can take a leap as a scorer this season with Julius Randle no longer around.

4431671.s: McDaniels and several other Timberwolves players -- including LaMelo Ball (rest) and Anthony Edwards (rest) -- will be idle for Saturday's preseason contest. McDaniels' next opportunity to play is Monday against New York.

4431675.h: Watford agreed to a one-year deal with the Pelicans on Monday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4431675.s: The 76ers declined Watford's team option in June, but he's found a new home ahead of training camp. In New Orleans, Watford will likely provide some emergency depth in the frontcourt, and he may have a tough time carving out a consistent role.

4431675.h: The 76ers declined Watford's team option for 2026-27 on Monday, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.
4431675.s: Watford is now set to become an unrestricted free agent. He's coming off a down campaign in 2025-26, as he posted regular-season averages of 6.5 points, 3.3 rebounds and 2.5 assists in 16.3 minutes per tilt over 53 games.

4431678.h: Maxey (rest) is in line to play in Thursday's preseason game against the Nets, per ESPN.com.
4431678.s: The 76ers are getting their first look at their new star-studded starting lineup Thursday. Maxey, Joel Embiid, LeBron James and Jaylen Brown are all set to take the floor together for the first time.

4431678.h: Maxey (rest) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Knicks, Chris Hine of The Philadelphia Inquirer reports.
4431678.s: With Maxey, LeBron James, Joel Embiid and Anfernee Simons all resting during the preseason opener, more usage will be available for second-year guard VJ Edgecombe and rookie Labaron Philon. It's unclear if Maxey will be available for Thursday's preseason game in Brooklyn.

4431678.h: LeBron James said Monday that his relationship with Maxey played a significant role in his decision to sign with the 76ers, Dave McMenamin of ESPN reports.
4431678.s: James said he narrowed his free-agent choices to five teams before ultimately choosing Philadelphia. The 41-year-old described his relationship with Maxey as "really, really great" and said their extensive conversations were a "main deciding factor" in his decision. James previously revealed that Maxey was among the first players to contact him after he informed the Lakers he wouldn't return, with the two sharing a…

4431679.h: Achiuwa is in the starting lineup for Sunday's game against the Grizzlies, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
4431679.s: With Keegan Murray (ankle) out, Achiuwa will start at power forward alongside Domantas Sabonis in the frontcourt. Achiuwa has enjoyed an excellent start to the season, averaging 14.5 points, 5.5 rebounds and 2.0 steals per game in two appearances off the bench.

4431679.h: Achiuwa is not in the starting lineup for Friday's preseason game against the Spurs, Tristi Rodriguez of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.
4431679.s: Achiuwa was deemed available for Friday's preseason finale after tweaking his ankle in Tuesday's 110-98 preseason loss to Portland. However, he won't be starting, as Sacramento will deploy Keegan Murray and Domantas Sabonis in the frontcourt.

4431679.h: Achiuwa (ankle) is available for Friday's preseason game against San Antonio, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.
4431679.s: Achiuwa tweaked his ankle in Tuesday's 110-98 preseason loss to Portland. However, he is good to suit up for the Kings' final exhibition before facing the Clippers on Opening Night.

4431679.h: Achiuwa exited Tuesday's game with a right ankle injury and did not return, per Jason Anderson of the Sacramento Bee.
4431679.s: Achiuwa started at center and posted a double-double before leaving late with a right ankle injury and being ruled out for the remainder of the contest. With Maxime Raynaud (knee) and Dylan Cardwell (calf) each expected to miss at least two weeks, the severity of the ankle injury matters a lot for Sacramento's frontcourt depth.

4431679.h: Achiuwa will start Monday's preseason game against the Lakers, Khobi Price of The California Post reports.
4431679.s: With Keegan Murray (undisclosed) sitting out the Kings' preseason opener, Achiuwa will get the starting nod. The big man started 57 of his 73 regular-season appearances in 2025-26, though he's expected to come off the bench when the first unit is at full strength this year.

4431680.h: Okongwu (rest) will play in Friday's preseason finale against the Mavericks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
4431680.s: Okongwu and most of Atlanta's regulars rested Monday against the Thunder but will return to action for the final exhibition. It's unclear how many minutes Okongwu will play Friday, but he should be a full go for the regular-season opener.

4431680.h: Okongwu (rest) is out for Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.
4431680.s: Okongwu is getting the night off Monday, with Atlanta resting a number of starters. His next chance to play arrives Friday against Dallas.

4431684.h: Jackson-Davis won't start Wednesday's meeting with the Bulls.
4431684.s: Jackson-Davis will come off the bench after getting the spot start in Friday's preseason finale. The big man is expected to begin the regular season as Toronto's third-string center and isn't guaranteed to see meaningful playing time.

4431684.h: Jackson-Davis will start in Friday's preseason game against Detroit, Josh Lewenberg of TSN.ca reports.
4431684.s: Jackson-Davis will start to close out the preseason. The 26-year-old most recently appeared in Tuesday's 148-98 preseason victory over New York, amassing nine points, three rebounds, one steal and two blocks over nine minutes of action.

4431684.h: Jackson-Davis (dental) is available Tuesday against the Knicks, Vivek Jacob of the Raptors' official site reports.
4431684.s: Jackson-Davis looks to be recovered from a dental procedure he underwent prior to Tuesday's exhibition. He's set to serve as frontcourt depth for the Raptors in 2026-27.

4431684.h: Jackson-Davis (dental) practiced Monday, per Zulfi Sheikh of Sportsnet.
4431684.s: Jackson-Davis has yet to make his preseason debut while working his way back from a dental procedure. His status remains up in the air for Tuesday's preseason game against the Knicks.

4431684.h: Jackson-Davis (dental) will not play against the Clippers in Saturday's preseason game, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.
4431684.s: Jackson-Davis will miss another preseason game, this time due to dental work rather than a migraine. His next opportunity to play is Tuesday against New York.

4431687.h: Williams (groin) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Celtics.
4431687.s: Williams is in line for a second straight absence due to right groin/adductor soreness. He's yet to appear in a game this season for Chicago even when healthy.

4431687.h: Williams (groin) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against Boston.
4431687.s: Williams is in jeopardy of missing a second consecutive contest due to right groin/adductor soreness. However, his potential absence wouldn't cause any significant waves in the rotation.

4431687.h: Williams (groin) is out for Saturday's game versus the Wizards, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.
4431687.s: This will be Williams' first missed game this season due to injury. However, he hasn't been in the rotation, so Williams' absence from the active roster won't impact fantasy leagues.

4431687.h: Williams (groin) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Wizards.
4431687.s: Williams is a late addition to the injury report due to right groin soreness, so his status will be worth monitoring leading up to the 8:00 p.m. ET tipoff. He has yet to appear in a regular-season game, so his absence wouldn't have much of an impact on the Bulls' bench rotation.

4431687.h: Williams (coach's decision) did not play in Wednesday's 135-92 loss to Toronto.
4431687.s: Williams remained on Chicago's bench despite the Bulls suffering a 43-point defeat. His absence from the rotation is a concerning development for his early-season fantasy value, and he'll need to regain the coaching staff's trust to secure meaningful minutes.

4431690.h: Nnaji (coach's decision) did not play in Thursday's 96-84 loss to Oklahoma City.
4431690.s: Nnaji was left out of Denver's rotation, with the team using Marvin Bagley and Trevon Brazile off the bench. With both players ahead of him in the frontcourt pecking order, Nnaji appears unlikely to provide consistent fantasy production without a change in his role.

4431695.h: The Suns claimed Timme off waivers Monday, per Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com.
4431695.s: After being let go by Minnesota on Saturday, Timme didn't go through waivers unclaimed. With Mark Williams (shoulder) likely out through the All-Star break, Timme helps reinforce Phoenix's depth at center.

4431695.h: Timme was waived by the Timberwolves on Saturday.
4431695.s: Timme had 18 points, seven rebounds, three assists and one steal over 27 minutes in Friday's 133-116 preseason loss to the Bulls. Despite the strong showing, he couldn't land a spot with the Timberwolves. The 23-year-old has appeared in 36 regular-season games for the Nets and Lakers throughout his career, averaging 5.6 points, 2.7 rebounds and 1.2 assists over 13.6 minutes per contest. Timme could find work in the…

4431695.h: Timme signed a training camp contract with the Timberwolves on Friday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
4431695.s: Timme was a two-way player for the Lakers in 2025-26, though Los Angeles declined to tender him a qualifying offer this offseason. He'll now compete for a spot on Minnesota's regular-season roster. The big man appeared in 27 regular-season games (one start) last season, averaging 3.4 points, 1.2 rebounds and 0.9 assists in 8.7 minutes per tilt.

4431714.h: Wilson agreed to a two-way deal with the Hawks on Monday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
4431714.s: A second-round pick of the Nets in 2023, Wilson will move on to a new organization after three seasons in Brooklyn. He was an occasional member of the Brooklyn rotation in 2025-26, averaging 6.4 points, 2.1 rebounds and 1.0 three-pointers in 15.9 minutes per game over 54 appearances. As one of Atlanta's three two-way players, Wilson will be little more than a depth option at forward and could end up seeing most of…

4431714.h: Wilson will head to free agency after Brooklyn declined to tender him a qualifying offer, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports Monday.
4431714.s: Wilson, who averaged 6.4 points, 2.1 rebounds and 1.0 made threes in 15.9 minutes over 54 regular-season appearances during the 2025-26 season, will now become an unrestricted free agent. He's primarily served in a bench role during the first three seasons of his NBA career, all with the Nets.

4431734.h: Enaruna enters his second NBA season after averaging 4.1 points, 1.6 rebounds and 0.8 assists during his first regular-season campaign with Cleveland.
4431734.s: The 6-foot-7 forward remains a developmental option for the Cavaliers and participated with the club's Summer League team again this offseason. Enaruna will likely need injuries ahead of him to obtain enough playing time for meaningful fantasy production in 2026-27.

4431734.h: Enaruna (illness) didn't play in Friday's 100-91 Summer League win over the Bulls.
4431734.s: Enaruna missed the Cavaliers' Summer League finale, marking his third consecutive absence due to an illness. However, he is expected to be available for the start of training camp.

4431734.h: Enaruna (illness) won't play in Wednesday's Summer League game against the Pelicans, per Danny Cunningham of Sports Radio 92.3 The Fan Cleveland.
4431734.s: Enaruna is out for a second straight contest with an illness. Friday's matchup with the Bulls marks his next chance to take the court.

4431734.h: Enaruna (illness) didn't play in Sunday's 103-94 Summer League loss to the Pistons, per Chris Fedor of The Cleveland Plain Dealer.
4431734.s: Enaruna is also unlikely to play Monday, when the Cavaliers face the Heat on the second leg of a back-to-back set. His next chance to play would appear to come Wednesday versus the Suns.

4431736.h: Camara should continue to play a major role following Portland's trade for Ja Morant, according to Robert Ohman of Willamette Week.
4431736.s: The Trail Blazers have been reluctant to include Camara in trade discussions because of his defensive value, and he'll remain an important complementary piece alongside Ja Morant, Damian Lillard and Deni Avdija. Camara's fantasy value should continue to be driven primarily by steals, rebounds and hustle stats in general.

4431752.h: The Pacers signed Brown to a two-way contract Thursday, per Tony East of Forbes.com.
4431752.s: Indiana acquired the forward as part of the Ivica Zubac trade this past season, and the team is bringing Brown back for the 2026-27 campaign. Brown, a 2023 first-rounder, averaged 9.4 points, 4.9 rebounds and 2.0 assists per game over 27 regular-season appearances for the Pacers last year, but he figures to be a featured member of the G League's Noblesville Boom in 2026-27.

4431767.h: Braun said Monday that increasing both his three-point volume and efficiency was his biggest developmental focus during the offseason, Ryan Blackburn of MileHighSports.com reports.
4431767.s: "Shoot more. Make more. Don't hesitate to shoot, just let it go," Braun said. The 25-year-old connected on just 30.1 percent of his three-pointers across 44 regular-season appearances in 2025-26 after shooting 39.7 percent from deep the previous season. A return to form from beyond the arc would help Braun provide more reliable floor spacing alongside Nikola Jokic and Jamal Murray.

4431767.h: Braun appears cemented as a starter for the Nuggets in 2026-27 after Peyton Watson was traded to Cleveland.
4431767.s: Despite playing a career-low 44 regular-season games, Braun was a full-time starter last year and should be locked into a similar role this season. The swingman is searching for a bounce-back campaign, closing last regular season with averages of 12.0 points, 4.8 rebounds and 2.7 assists in 31.8 minutes per game.

4431772.h: Gardner said Monday that he's "back now" and "ready to get going" after missing the Las Vegas Summer League with an ankle injury, Ricardo Urrusuno of Lemon City Live reports.
4431772.s: Gardner also said that he spent time in Miami recovering this offseason, and he appears to be at full strength ahead of Saturday's preseason opener against Toronto. The 25-year-old is set to compete for a spot in Miami's rotation this season.

4431772.h: Gardner (ankle) won't participate in the Las Vegas Summer League, per Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel.
4431772.s: Gardner's Summer League is over because of an ankle sprain he suffered in Friday's California Classic opener in San Francisco against the Spurs. The swingman is missing out on valuable reps as he competes for a rotation spot with the Heat, but he does have plenty of time to recuperate for training camp in the fall.

4431772.h: Gardner (ankle) won't play Monday against the Warriors Gold, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
4431772.s: Gardner tweaked his ankle in Miami's California Classic opener and proceeded to miss the rest of the tournament. For now, he should be considered questionable for Friday's Summer League game against the Bucks in Las Vegas.

4431772.h: Gardner (ankle) won't play in Sunday's California Classic Summer League game against the Lakers, Anthony Chiang of the Miami Herald reports.
4431772.s: Gardner sustained a sprained left ankle in Friday's Summer League win over the Spurs and will be held out of the front end of this back-to-back set. His next chance to play will come against Warriors Gold on Monday.

4431785.h: Pippen is viewed as the biggest challenger to Ty Jerome for the starting point guard job, Damichael Cole of The Memphis Commercial Appeal reports.
4431785.s: With Ja Morant out of the picture, Jerome has emerged as the most likely candidate to fill his shoes, though Pippen is also in the mix. Head coach Tuomas Iisalo called the 25-year-old guard an "easy fit" alongside other players thanks to his ballhandling, defense and ability to hit perimeter shots, and he figures to take on a sizable role regardless of whether he starts. Pippen appeared in just 10 regular-season…

4431785.h: Pippen is a full participant to begin training camp, Grizzlies president of basketball operations Zach Kleiman said, according to Memphis reporter Landon Speck.
4431785.s: Pippen continues to go through camp without any health-related restrictions, clearing the way for him to compete normally throughout the preseason. The guard's full participation is encouraging after he underwent a toe procedure back in March. As Memphis begins sorting out its backcourt rotation ahead of the regular season, Pippen's battle with Ty Jerome will be one to watch.

4431785.h: Pippen (toe) has a chance to begin the new year as Memphis' starting point guard after Portland acquired Ja Morant in a trade with the Grizzlies earlier this offseason.
4431785.s: Pippen will have to gain clearance ahead of training camp after undergoing a toe procedure in March, but he certainly appears to be a winner of the team's offseason moves. Ty Jerome (ankle) poses a significant risk to Pippen's role, however, and the two guards figure to engage in a battle for the top role at the point this fall. Pippen is looking to bounce back following an injury-ruined 2025-26 campaign, during…

4431786.h: Johnson (hamstring) is available for Wednesday's game against the Nets, Eric Nehm of The Athletic reports.
4431786.s: Johnson has made swift progress in his recovery from a hamstring injury. A two-way player, Johnson will likely be shuttled to the G League's Sioux Falls Skyforce later this fall.

4431786.h: Johnson (hamstring) is practicing in a limited fashion, per Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel.
4431786.s: Johnson doesn't sound like a candidate for preseason reps, but it's encouraging to hear he's progressing in his hamstring recovery. A two-way player, Johnson will likely be shuttled to the G League's Sioux Falls Skyforce once healthy later this fall.

4431786.h: Johnson will be sidelined for a few weeks with a right hamstring strain, Anthony Chiang of the Miami Herald reports.
4431786.s: This is a tough blow for Johnson as it rules him out for the entire preseason. The forward is on a two-way contract and is expected to feature for Miami's G League affiliate.

4431786.h: Johnson agreed to a two-way contract with the Heat on Thursday, per Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel.
4431786.s: Miami didn't extend Johnson a qualifying offer ahead of the Las Vegas Summer League, but the two sides ultimately renegotiated a new deal. Johnson joins Vladislav Goldin and Tre Donaldson as the squad's trio of two-way players and should see ample playing time for the G League's Sioux Falls Skyforce this season.

4431786.h: Johnson will not receive a qualifying offer from Miami, per Kelly Iko of Yahoo Sports.
4431786.s: Johnson is now an unrestricted free agent. He averaged 8.8 minutes per game over 32 appearances for the Heat last regular season, so Johnson may have to settle for an Exhibit 10 deal this summer.

4431823.h: McBride isn't listed in the starting five for Thursday's preseason matchup with Toronto.
4431823.s: New York will have four of its usual starting five in the first unit Thursday, pushing McBride to the bench. Mohamed Diawara will get the starting nod alongside Jalen Brunson, Mikal Bridges, OG Anunoby and Karl-Anthony Towns.

4431823.h: McBride is starting Tuesday's preseason game against the Raptors, Jared Schwartz of the New York Post reports.
4431823.s: Typically the Knicks' sixth man, McBride is getting a chance to start Tuesday's exhibition. He could see significant run in the first unit.

4431823.h: McBride once again expressed his desire to remain in New York moving forward, James L. Edwards III of The Athletic reports.
4431823.s: McBride is entering the final season of a three-year, $13 million contract. While the 25-year-old stated Wednesday that he would like to end his career with the organization, that may not be possible, considering Knicks' owner James Dolan is not willing to go into the second apron. McBride has appeared in 277 regular-season games since being drafted in the second round of the 2021 NBA Draft, averaging 7.1 points,…

4431893.h: Battle (back) is expected to make his preseason debut Thursday against the Knicks, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.
4431893.s: Battle has yet to suit up this preseason while dealing with a back issue, but he appears to be nearing a return. Thursday's contest should give the Raptors an opportunity to evaluate the forward before the regular season, though it's unclear whether he'll face any minutes restrictions in his first appearance.

4431893.h: Battle (undisclosed) has been ruled out for Tuesday's preseason matchup with the Knicks, Vivek Jacob of the Raptors' official site reports.
4431893.s: It's unclear exactly why Battle isn't playing Tuesday, though it's worth noting he previously dealt with a lower-back issue this preseason. His penultimate chance to play before the regular season will come Thursday against New York.

4431893.h: Battle (lower back) isn't listed on the injury report for Saturday's preseason game against the Clippers, Esfandiar Baraheni of The Athletic reports.
4431893.s: Battle missed the preseason opener last weekend but returned to practice this past week and is slated to suit up Saturday. He's made 120 regular-season appearances over the past two seasons, but his path to playing time this year is muddled after the additions of Kawhi Leonard and Allen Graves.

4431893.h: Battle (lower back) was a limited participant in Monday's practice, Esfandiar Baraheni of The Athletic reports.
4431893.s: The severity of the lower-back issue is unclear, though it kept Battle out of last Saturday's preseason-opening loss to the Heat. He'll look to continue making progress in practices ahead of Saturday's preseason matchup with the Clippers.

4431893.h: Battle (back) has been ruled out for Saturday's preseason game against the Heat, Josh Lewenberg of TSN.ca reports.
4431893.s: Battle was held out of Thursday's scrimmage due to a lower-back injury, and he'll remain sidelined for Toronto's preseason opener. His next chance to play in the preseason will come next Saturday against the Clippers.

4432107.h: Sasser (hip) is not listed on the injury report for Friday's exhibition versus the Hawks.
4432107.s: Sasser missed Dallas' first three preseason games, but he'll be out there for the Mavericks' final exhibition. He had been generating some buzz at training camp before going down with the hip injury, so it'll be interesting to see what his role looks like Friday evening.

4432107.h: Sasser (groin) is expected to play in Friday's preseason finale against Atlanta, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.
4432107.s: Coach Dusty May indicated Thursday that he anticipates Sasser returning after dealing with left adductor tightness. The guard's expected availability should give Dallas another backcourt option for its final exhibition, though it's unclear whether he'll face any minutes restrictions.

4432107.h: Sasser (adductor) has been ruled out for Wednesday's preseason game against New Orleans, Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com reports.
4432107.s: Sasser has yet to appear in a preseason game due to left adductor tightness. His next chance to play will come Friday against Atlanta.

4432107.h: Sasser (adductor) won't play in Sunday's preseason game against the Rockets, Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com reports.
4432107.s: Sasser will miss a second straight exhibition game due to left adductor soreness. It's unclear when he'll be cleared to play again, but Sasser has three more chances to suit up during the preseason beginning with Wednesday's game against the Pelicans.

4432107.h: Sasser won't play in Friday's preseason game against the Rockets due to left adductor soreness.
4432107.s: Sasser is competing for a bench role ahead of the 2026-27 season, and he's showing early on why he deserves a spot in the rotation, though missing time won't help his cause. Sasser averaged 5.2 points, 1.0 rebounds and 2.0 assists in 38 regular-season appearances a season ago in Detroit before joining Dallas in June as part of a six-team trade.

4432158.h: The addition of Peyton Watson could be beneficial for Mobley if Watson's improved outside shooting carries over to Cleveland.
4432158.s: Watson connected on 41.1 percent of his three-pointers last season over 54 regular-season games, and having a credible floor spacer at forward will make it easier for the Cavaliers to continue playing Mobley alongside Jarrett Allen without compromising spacing around Donovan Mitchell and James Harden. Watson's defensive versatility also gives Cleveland another option for switch-heavy lineups alongside Mobley,…

4432165.h: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4432165.s: Suggs suffered the injury during Sunday's win over the Knicks when his right knee buckled following a layup attempt. Fortunately, further testing revealed no major structural damage, though the 25-year-old will miss at least two weeks before being re-evaluated. Anthony Black and Jase Richardson could see increased opportunities in Orlando's backcourt during Suggs' absence.

4432165.h: Suggs (knee) did not return to Sunday's game against the Knicks.
4432165.s: Suggs exited the game late in the fourth quarter due to a non-contact right knee injury and was unable to return. He concluded the contest with four points (2-8 FG, 0-3 3Pt), six rebounds, six assists and three steals in 33 minutes. Initial reports postgame suggest that Suggs will undergo an MRI in the coming days to determine the extent of the injury.

4432165.h: Suggs went down with an apparent right knee injury during Sunday's game against the Knicks and needed to be helped to the locker room, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
4432165.s: Suggs couldn't put much pressure at all on his right leg as he was helped back to the locker room, so for now, he should be considered doubtful to return. Anthony Black will likely be elevated to a starting role if Suggs needs to miss time, and there will be more minutes available for Jase Richardson.

4432165.h: Suggs (illness) is available for Tuesday's preseason game against the Cavaliers, Dan Savage of the Magic's official site reports.
4432165.s: Suggs missed the Magic's first two preseason games while under the weather, though he'll return to action Tuesday. With the 25-year-old floor general back in action, Jase Richardson will likely shift to the second unit.

4432165.h: Magic coach Sean Sweeney said Suggs is no longer under the weather, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
4432165.s: Sweeney added that Suggs is doing well, but there was no mention of his status for Tuesday's preseason game against the Cavaliers. Suggs' status for Opening Night is not a concern, however.

4432166.h: Cunningham (rest) is in the starting lineup for Wednesday's preseason game against Minnesota, Coty M. Davis of The Detroit News reports.
4432166.s: Cunningham rested Saturday against Washington, but the star guard is back in the starting five for Wednesday's matchup in Minnesota. He should see a fair amount of playing time in the first half but isn't expected to shoulder a heavy workload throughout the exhibition.

4432166.h: Cunningham (rest) didn't play in Saturday's 114-108 preseason loss to the Wizards in overtime.
4432166.s: The star guard wasn't announced in the starting lineup for this contest, with Daniss Jenkins taking his place, but Cunningham didn't even step on the hardwood. This was likely a precautionary move to manage his workload before the start of the regular season, so fantasy managers shouldn't worry too much about his absence. His next chance to play in the preseason will come Wednesday against the Timberwolves.

4432166.h: Cunningham is not in the starting lineup for Saturday's preseason game against the Wizards, Coty M. Davis of The Detroit News reports.
4432166.s: Cunningham isn't in the starting lineup for the Pistons ahead of this preseason contest, and it remains to be seen whether he'll be playing at all. Daniss Jenkins will get the nod at point guard over the MVP candidate.

4432166.h: Cunningham is getting ready for his sixth season in the league, per Coty M. Davis of The Detroit News.
4432166.s: Cunningham, 24, finds himself now being the longest-tenured player on the Pistons after the team traded veteran big man Isaiah Stewart to Memphis this offseason. The move puts more of an emphasis on Cunningham as a leader, and the star guard remains worthy of a first-round pick in most fantasy drafts this fall after averaging 23.9 points, 9.9 assists, 5.5 rebounds, 1.4 steals and 0.8 blocks per game last regular…

4432170.h: Head coach Ty Lue said Saturday that Jackson will open the 2026-27 regular season as the Clippers' starting center, Joey Linn of SI.com reports.
4432170.s: The big man will get the starting nod in Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Kings, with Brook Lopez operating as Jackson's primary backup. The 24-year-old averaged 7.5 points, 4.6 rebounds, 1.2 assists and 1.2 blocks across 15.8 minutes per game in 17 regular-season appearances off the bench with the Clippers in 2025-26.

4432170.h: Jackson will start in Wednesday's preseason game against the Nuggets, Joey Linn of SI.com reports.
4432170.s: Jackson will make his second start of the preseason. The 24-year-old started in 14 regular-season games in 2025-26, averaging 8.1 points, 5.6 rebounds and 1.1 assists over 19.7 minutes per contest.

4432170.h: Jackson is not in the Clippers' starting lineup against the Raptors for Saturday's preseason game.
4432170.s: Brook Lopez will instead get the start Saturday, with Jackson coming off the bench. Jackson logged four points, four rebounds, three assists, two blocks and a steal over 16 minutes in the Clippers' 104-101 win over the Warriors during this past Sunday's preseason opener.

4432170.h: Jackson will start Sunday's preseason game against the Warriors, though he'll only play the first half, Joey Linn of SI.com reports.
4432170.s: Jackson will get the starting nod over Brook Lopez, with the former joining Darius Garland, Max Strus, Rui Hachimura and Derrick Jones in the first unit. Over 17 regular-season appearances off the bench with the Clippers last season, Jackson averaged 7.5 points, 4.6 rebounds, 1.2 assists and 1.2 blocks across 15.8 minutes per contest.

4432170.h: Jackson has been working with the first team in training camp and said, "I think I'm going to be in the starting role," Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.
4432170.s: Jackson was traded from Indiana to Los Angeles last February and averaged 7.5 points, 4.6 rebounds, 1.2 assists and 1.2 blocks across 15.8 minutes per game in 17 regular-season appearances off the bench with the Clippers last season. Head coach Ty Lue may still opt to start veteran big man Brook Lopez to begin the regular season, so Jackson will look to impress during the preseason. He'll face competition for…

4432171.h: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
4432171.s: Moody has been limited to individual court work, but team sources indicate he's ahead of Jimmy Butler (knee) in the rehabilitation process and is expected to return before the veteran forward. The 24-year-old still has several recovery checkpoints to complete, and Golden State has not established an official timetable. His eventual return would help replenish a Warriors wing rotation that will open the season…

4432171.h: Moody has progressed to light on-court activities as he continues his recovery from a ruptured left patellar tendon, Evan Webeck of The Mercury News reports.
4432171.s: Moody suffered the injury March 23 and underwent season-ending surgery four days later. The 24-year-old had been targeting September to resume running and on-court work, so his latest progress appears to keep his rehabilitation on track, though he remains without a firm timetable for his return to game action.

4432181.h: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.
4432181.s: Strawther suffered the injury in Wednesday's preseason game against the Clippers. The 24-year-old has appeared in 172 regular-season games for the Nuggets since entering the league in 2023, averaging 7.1 points, 2.0 rebounds and 1.1 assists over 16.2 minutes per contest. He was in line to compete for an expanded role during the 2026-27 campaign. While that may be the case once Strawther is cleared to suit up, Tyus…

4432181.h: Strawther (knee) will undergo an MRI on Thursday morning, Katy Winge of Altitude Sports reports.
4432181.s: Strawther exited to the locker room in the third quarter of Wednesday's preseason loss to the Clippers after his left knee bent awkwardly following contact while handling the ball. "All you can do is hope for the best," said Nuggets head coach David Adelman. An extended absence for Strawther would test Denver's depth on the wing, with Spencer Jones (hamstring) not yet cleared for contact. Strawther finished…

4432181.h: Strawther (knee) exited to the locker room in the third quarter of Wednesday's preseason game against the Clippers and will not return, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.
4432181.s: Strawther's left knee bent awkwardly, leaving him in considerable pain and forcing an early exit to the locker room. An update on the 24-year-old's status could come after the game or in the coming days, but an extended absence would test the Nuggets' depth on the wing with Spencer Jones (hamstring) not yet cleared for contact.

4432181.h: Strawther could play an expanded role for the Nuggets in 2026-27 after Peyton Watson was traded to the Cavaliers.
4432181.s: Strawther is still ticketed for a bench role this season, even with Watson now out of the picture, but his playing time could be more consistent after finishing last postseason outside the rotation. The sharpshooter averaged 7.2 points, 2.0 rebounds, 1.1 assists and 1.0 three-pointers in 15.1 minutes per game over 57 regular-season appearances in 2025-26.

4432194.h: Sharpe (shoulder) will play in Monday's preseason game against the Wizards, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.
4432194.s: Sharpe will return to action after sitting out Thursday's exhibition. With two more preseason contests, Sharpe continues to sit atop the center depth chart.

4432194.h: Sharpe has been ruled out for Thursday's preseason matchup against Philadelphia due to left shoulder soreness, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.
4432194.s: The severity of Sharpe's shoulder issue remains unclear, though the team is likely being cautious for this exhibition. His absence could create additional frontcourt opportunities for Brooklyn's other big men during Thursday's contest.

4432194.h: Sharpe intends to pace himself entering the 2026-27 season as he slots into a starting role, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.
4432194.s: Sharpe ended the 2025-26 campaign as the team's starting center, and he's entering his first full NBA season with the expectation of tackling a larger workload. The big man acknowledges that while he may need to pace himself over the course of a long season, he has no intention of letting his foot off the gas. "I feel like I played against starters last year as well. Sometimes, when I would come in the game, they…

4432194.h: Sharpe (thumb) will sign a two-year, $20 million deal with the Nets, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4432194.s: The Nets will quickly lock up their new starting center after previously trading away Nic Claxton. Sharpe is coming off a career-best season in 2025-26, posting regular-season averages of 8.7 points, 6.7 rebounds, 2.3 assists and 1.1 steals. He could offer a lot of appeal in fantasy formats depending on how the rest of the offseason shapes up.

4432241.h: Shead (rest) is expected to play in Wednesday's regular-season opener versus Chicago.
4432241.s: Shead sat out Friday's preseason finale but isn't dealing with an injury ahead of the regular-season opener. He's expected to operate as Immanuel Quickley's primary backup in 2026-27.

4432241.h: Shead will not play in Friday's preseason finale against the Pistons, Josh Lewenberg of TSN.ca reports.
4432241.s: Toronto's regulars are getting the night off to rest up before Wednesday's season opener against the Bulls. Shead is expected to play a backup point guard role to begin the campaign.

4432241.h: Shead and the Raptors agreed to a three-year, $24 million extension Thursday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4432241.s: The Raptors have now secured their backup point guard through the 2029-30 season. Last regular season, Shead averaged 6.6 points, 5.4 assists and 1.7 rebounds in 22.6 minutes per game across 82 outings (12 starts). He's poised for a similar role in 2026-27.

4432247.h: Clark will come off the bench in Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Heat.
4432247.s: Clark started in the Timberwolves preseason finale with Anthony Edwards (rest) taking the night off, but Edwards is back and starting on Opening Night. As a reserve last season, Clark averaged 4.0 points in 12.8 minutes per game.

4432247.h: Clark will start Friday's preseason finale against the Bulls.
4432247.s: Clark will draw his second preseason start with all of Minnesota's regulars resting. He'll be joined by Zyon Pullin, Terrence Shannon, Cody Williams and Joan Beringer.

4432247.h: Clark will start in Saturday's exhibition against the Heat.
4432247.s: Jaden McDaniels (rest) and Jonathan Kuminga (rest) are out, so Clark will be thrust into the starting unit for Saturday's exhibition. Clark earned one start last season and finished with eight points, three rebounds, two assists, two triples and one block over 30 minutes.

4432247.h: Clark faces a more difficult path to consistent minutes following Minnesota's addition of Jonathan Kuminga.
4432247.s: Clark currently provides depth at shooting guard and small forward, but Kuminga's expected starting role might push Ayo Dosunmu into a more prominent reserve role while occupying substantial minutes at the forward spots. Clark's defensive ability should keep him in consideration for situational minutes, though he's unlikely to enter the season with a significant fantasy role.

4432446.h: Walker has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Pistons due to left knee soreness.
4432446.s: It was reported after Saturday's win over the Bucks that Walker exited the contest early due to a right knee injury, though he's now listed on the injury report with left knee soreness. With the 24-year-old sidelined, Dean Wade and Kentavious Caldwell-Pope may see increased minutes, while Justin Edwards could enter the rotation.

4432446.h: Walker exited to the locker room in the third quarter of Saturday's game against the Bucks due to an apparent ankle injury, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.
4432446.s: Walker appeared to turn his ankle before limping to the locker room. He can be considered questionable to return until further notice.

4432446.h: Walker will come off the bench in Friday's preseason finale against the Celtics, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports.
4432446.s: Walker started in Saturday's preseason loss to the Celtics with Philly resting Joel Embiid, but Embiid is back and starting for the preseason finale. Walker is not expected to be a major factor in the rotation for the 76ers this season as long as the starters are healthy.

4432446.h: Walker is in the starting lineup for Saturday's game against the Celtics.
4432446.s: Walker is one of the players who will benefit from the Sixers resting several projected starters in this contest. The former second-round pick is expected to be a frontcourt backup in the regular season but will have the chance to show what he can do with an expanded role.

4432573.h: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4432573.s: Banchero left during Friday's loss against the Timberwolves due to an ankle injury, and follow-up tests have confirmed a high-ankle sprain for the fifth-year forward. With an extended absence expected, the Magic will have to rely more heavily on Franz Wagner and Desmond Bane offensively, and Tristan da Silva figures to be the top candidate to enter the Magic's starting lineup for as long as Banchero is sidelined.

4432573.h: Banchero is doubtful to return to Friday's game against the Timberwolves due to a sore right ankle, NBA reporter Marc Stein reports.
4432573.s: The Magic are currently down by 20-plus points with four minutes to go in the fourth quarter, so that may be impacting Orlando's decision to hold Banchero out of the remainder of the game. For now, Banchero should be considered questionable for Sunday's game in New York.

4432573.h: Banchero (ankle) has checked back into Friday's game against the Timberwolves, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
4432573.s: Banchero tweaked his ankle coming down from a rebound, but after getting checked up in the locker room, he's been cleared to return. He's off to a hot start, scoring 14 points on eight shots in his first 23 minutes of play.

4432573.h: Banchero exited Friday's game against the Timberwolves and went to the locker room after appearing to have tweaked his ankle, Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com reports.
4432573.s: Banchero appeared to tweak his ankle when he and Jalen Suggs went crashing in for a rebound early in the third quarter, and the former departed straight to the locker room. Losing Banchero would be huge for Orlando, as he scored 14 points on 6-for-7 shooting before leaving. If he doesn't return, Tristan da Silva could be in line for a bigger role in the frontcourt.

4432573.h: Banchero drew praise from teammate Wendell Carter on Monday for the work he put in during the offseason, with Carter saying the star forward is "looking like young Paolo," Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
4432573.s: Carter described Banchero as "very springy" and "very bouncy" after seeing him work out this summer, an encouraging assessment of his conditioning and athleticism heading into training camp. Banchero also said Monday that new head coach Sean Sweeney made an immediate effort to build a relationship with him after being hired, including traveling to Seattle to spend time with the 23-year-old during the offseason.

4432582.h: Christie (shin) is available for Saturday's game against the Spurs.
4432582.s: Christie is dealing with a bruised shin, but he'll play through it. With Kyrie Irving (rest) and Cooper Flagg (shoulder) unavailable for Saturday's game, Christie could see a nice bump in usage.

4432582.h: Christie (shin) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Spurs.
4432582.s: Christie may have picked up the injury during the Mavericks' 121-105 win over the Pacers on Friday, when he played 38 minutes and finished with 16 points, four rebounds, four assists and one steal. If he cannot play in the second leg of the Mavericks' back-to-back set, then Marcus Sasser and Zaccharie Risacher would be the top candidates to enter the starting five.

4432582.h: Christie will start Wednesday's game against the Rockets.
4432582.s: Christie will return to the starting lineup after being held out of Friday's preseason finale. As a result, Zaccharie Risacher will retreat to the second unit. In 68 regular-season starts last year, Christie averaged 12.6 points, 3.3 rebounds, 2.4 triples, 2.0 assists and 0.6 steals in 29.5 minutes per contest.

4432582.h: Christie (foot) will play in Wednesday's regular-season opener against Houston, Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com reports.
4432582.s: Christie is dealing with a sore foot, but he practiced Tuesday and is expected to be a full go for Wednesday. Christie is projected to open the season as the No. 2 shooting guard on the depth chart.

4432582.h: Christie (rest) is expected to play in Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Rockets.
4432582.s: Christie sat out Friday's preseason finale but should suit up when the Mavericks head to Houston on Wednesday. Over 77 regular-season games (68 starts) with Dallas in 2025-26, he averaged 12.3 points, 3.2 rebounds and 2.0 assists in 29.1 minutes per tilt.

4432639.h: Smith remained a key contributor for Houston, providing frontcourt size, floor spacing and defensive versatility throughout the 2025-26 season.
4432639.s: Smith's ability to complement both Kevin Durant and Alperen Sengun gives him an important role on a team with championship aspirations. After an otherwise quiet offseason, Smith is expected to retain a prominent place in Houston's starting lineup entering 2026-27.

4432737.h: Bradley won't start Wednesday's game against the Bulls.
4432737.s: Bradley started Friday's preseason finale, though he'll slide to the second unit Wednesday. The rookie guard faces plenty of competition for minutes and isn't expected to see meaningful playing time to begin the regular season.

4432737.h: Bradley will start in Friday's preseason game against the Pistons, Josh Lewenberg of TSN.ca reports.
4432737.s: Bradley will get the start in his second appearance of the preseason. He most recently logged 12 minutes in Tuesday's 148-98 preseason win over the Knicks, finishing with three points, three rebounds and two assists.

4432737.h: Bradley signed a multi-year contract with the Raptors on Monday, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.
4432737.s: With Bradley on the official roster, the Raptors will now have a two-way slot open for several players on Exhibit 10 deals to compete for. Bradley, a 2026 second-round pick, is facing an uphill battle to crack the rotation ahead of Opening Night.

4432737.h: Bradley signed a two-way contract with Toronto on Saturday.
4432737.s: Bradley began his college career at Alabama before transferring to Arizona, where he spent the last three seasons. The 22-year-old most recently logged 39 regular-season and postseason games for the Wildcats in 2025-26 and averaged 13.3 points, 3.4 rebounds, 4.4 assists, 0.1 blocks and 1.4 steals over 30.6 minutes. He also shot 39.4 percent from deep and was named the Big 12 Player of the Year. Bradley was selected…

4432808.h: Wiseman isn't listed in the starting lineup for Thursday's preseason meeting with the Raptors.
4432808.s: With Karl-Anthony Towns (rest) back in the lineup, Wiseman will slide to the second unit. The big man turned in an 18-point, 10-rebound double-double in Tuesday's loss to the Raptors.

4432808.h: Wiseman is starting Tuesday against the Raptors, Jared Schwartz of the New York Post reports.
4432808.s: The Knicks are resting a number of starters Tuesday. Wiseman is auditioning for a roster spot with New York.

4432808.h: Wiseman signed an Exhibit 9 contract with the Knicks on Wednesday.
4432808.s: Wiseman will now compete for a roster spot in training camp. New York currently has two spots available, and Wiseman will compete with Ochai Agbaji, Bruce Brown, John Konchar and Drew Eubanks for one of the spots.

4432810.h: Stewart won't start Monday's game against the Jazz.
4432810.s: The big man will play in the second leg of this back-to-back set, though Zach Edey (ankle) will return to action and push Stewart to the bench. The 25-year-old is averaging 8.5 points, 3.5 rebounds, 1.0 assists, 1.0 steals and 1.0 blocks across 19.5 minutes per contest in two regular-season appearances (one start) on the campaign.

4432810.h: Stewart (ankle) is available for Monday's game at Utah.
4432810.s: Stewart will shed his questionable tag and suit up for the second leg of this back-to-back set. Through two regular-season games (one start), he's averaging 8.5 points, 3.5 rebounds, 1.0 assists, 1.0 steals and 1.0 blocks across 19.5 minutes per contest.

4432810.h: Stewart is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Jazz due to left ankle injury management.
4432810.s: Stewart may be held out of the second leg of this back-to-back set after posting 13 points, five rebounds, two assists, two blocks and a steal across 22 minutes while starting in the absence of Zach Edey (injury management) during Sunday's win over Sacramento. If Stewart is ultimately ruled out, Quinten Post would likely see increased playing time behind Edey.

4432810.h: Stewart (ankle) is available for Friday's game against the Warriors.
4432810.s: Stewart is set to make his regular-season debut for the Grizzlies, and he should help back up Zach Edey and Cameron Boozer. With Stewart active, Quinten Post's minutes could dip.

4432810.h: Stewart (ankle) is questionable for Friday's game against the Warriors.
4432810.s: Stewart wasn't able to go for Wednesday's opener against the Jazz due to an ankle injury suffered during the preseason, but he's been upgraded to questionable ahead of Friday's clash. The Grizzlies will likely monitor him closely in shootaround and warmups to determine whether he can suit up Friday night.

4432811.h: Green (knee) totaled two rebounds, two assists and two steals over 11 minutes in Tuesday's 93-79 preseason loss to the Nuggets.
4432811.s: Green sat out Utah's preseason opener with a minor knee issue, but he looked fine in Tuesday's exhibition. He'll provide some emergency depth on the wings for the Jazz this season, but Green is not expected to be a significant part of the rotation.

4432811.h: Green (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's preseason game against the Nuggets, Shreyas Laddha of The Salt Lake Tribune reports.
4432811.s: The severity of the left knee issue is unknown, though Green will sit out Utah's preseason opener. His next chance to play in the preseason will come in Tuesday's rematch against Denver.

4432811.h: The Timberwolves traded Green and cash considerations to the Jazz on Friday in exchange for Cody Williams and John Konchar, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4432811.s: After being traded from Charlotte to Minnesota as part of the LaMelo Ball trade in June, Green is now set to begin the season with the Jazz. The 25-year-old swingman appeared in 58 regular-season games for the Hornets in 2025-26, averaging 4.3 points, 1.8 rebounds, 0.8 assists and 0.6 steals in 15.7 minutes per contest. He figures to provide wing depth for Utah and will likely compete with Brice Sensabaugh, Josh…

4432811.h: Green's future with Minnesota is uncertain following the team's agreement with Jonathan Kuminga.
4432811.s: Green currently sits near the bottom of the depth chart at both forward positions, and the Timberwolves reportedly need to create additional room below the second-apron hard cap before finalizing Kuminga's contract. Minnesota is expected to explore trades involving Green and could waive and stretch his expiring contract if it can't find a deal, making his eventual landing spot more important than his current place…

4432816.h: Ball (rest) is expected to suit up for Wednesday's regular-season opener against Miami.
4432816.s: Ball was one of many Timberwolves regulars who sat out Friday's preseason finale, though he should make his regular-season debut with the team Wednesday. The star point guard averaged 9.5 points, 5.8 assists and 3.3 rebounds in 19.4 minutes per game across four appearances this preseason.

4432816.h: Ball (rest) won't play in Friday's preseason finale against the Bulls, Chuck Swirsky of the Bulls Radio Network reports.
4432816.s: Ball, Anthony Edwards, Rudy Gobert and Ayo Dosunmu will all sit for the final exhibition. Ball should be good to go for Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Heat.

4432816.h: Ball (rest) is in the starting lineup for Monday's preseason game against the Knicks.
4432816.s: After resting Saturday, Ball is slated to return to action for Monday's road contest. The standout guard is averaging 12.5 points, 5.0 assists and 4.0 rebounds in 18.6 minutes per contest across two preseason appearances.

4432816.h: Ball (rest) has been ruled out for Saturday's preseason game against the Heat.
4432816.s: Ball will get a breather Saturday, with Bones Hyland and Terrence Shannon get the start in the backcourt. Ball's next chance to take the floor is Monday against the Knicks, though his playing time will likely be limited until the Timberwolves' regular-season opener against the Heat on Wednesday, Oct. 21.

4432819.h: Mann is out for Saturday's game against the Pistons due to general soreness, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.
4432819.s: Mann is a bit sore after logging 16 minutes in Thursday's preseason opening win over the Knicks, so he'll sit out Saturday's exhibition. His next chance to play will come Monday against the Nets.

4432819.h: The Cavs traded Mann and a 2027 second-round pick to the Wizards on Wednesday in exchange for Cam Whitmore, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4432819.s: Mann will add some depth to the Wizards backcourt, where he'll compete for minutes with Bub Carrington and Tre Johnson. Mann averaged 5.5 points and 1.6 assists on 36/32/85 shooting splits with the Hornets last regular season.

4432819.h: The Hornets traded Mann to the Cavaliers on Friday in exchange for Dennis Schroder and cash considerations, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
4432819.s: Mann was expected to serve as backcourt depth for Charlotte before the move, and now he'll assume a similar role with his new team. He'll likely be competing in training camp with Craig Porter and Tyrese Proctor for the backup role at point guard behind James Harden, and Mann has an opportunity for a fresh start after playing a career-low 12.6 minutes per game for the Hornets last regular season.

4432822.h: Okoro (knee) is available for Wednesday's season opener against the Raptors.
4432822.s: The Bulls are giving Okoro the green light to play through a knee issue and make his season debut. With a couple of players sidelined for Opening Night, Chicago's rotation, particularly in the second unit, will be one for fantasy managers to monitor.

4432822.h: Okoro (knee) is probable for Wednesday's regular-season opener against Toronto.
4432822.s: Okoro had his reps managed in the preseason but is expected to play Wednesday. He could see a couple of extra minutes in Dailyn Swain's (illness) expected absence.

4432822.h: Okoro (undisclosed) is out for Friday's preseason finale versus the Timberwolves, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.
4432822.s: The Bulls have not yet revealed exactly what Okoro is dealing with, but he didn't practice Tuesday, and this will be his second straight game on the sidelines. For now, he should be considered questionable for Wednesday's regular-season opener in Toronto.

4432822.h: Okoro (undisclosed) was unavailable for Wednesday's 125-104 preseason win over Milwaukee, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.
4432822.s: Okoro missed practice Tuesday and was ultimately sidelined Wednesday due to an undisclosed issue. The wing's next chance to suit up will come Friday against Minnesota.

4432822.h: Okoro (undisclosed) didn't participate in Tuesday's practice, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.
4432822.s: It's unclear why Okoro didn't practice, though he can be considered questionable for Wednesday's exhibition against Milwaukee. If the 25-year-old wing is unable to suit up, Leonard Miller, Jordan Hawkins and Buddy Hield could see a bump in playing time.

4432823.h: Williams (wrist) is available for Monday's game against the Suns.
4432823.s: Williams left Sunday's game early with wrist soreness, but he's not listed on the injury report for the second leg of this back-to-back set. He's likely to reprise his role as the backup center.

4432823.h: Williams won't return to Sunday's game against the Clippers due to right wrist soreness, Nick Crain of SLAM reports.
4432823.s: The Thunder will be shorthanded in the frontcourt for the rest of the game, as Williams plays a regular role as Isaiah Hartenstein's backup at center. Williams went scoreless (0-1 FG, 0-1 3Pt) and didn't record any other stats in five minutes. His status should be considered questionable for the second half of the back-to-back set Monday against the Suns.

4432823.h: Williams (heel) isn't listed on the injury report ahead of Tuesday's game against the Spurs, Justin Martinez of The Oklahoman reports.
4432823.s: Williams was unable to take the court during the preseason due to a heel injury, but he'll be available for Tuesday's 2026-27 regular-season opener. He's expected to open the year in a backup role behind Isaiah Hartenstein.

4432823.h: Williams (heel) won't play in Thursday's preseason game against Houston, Justin Martinez of The Oklahoman reports.
4432823.s: Williams will miss all five of Oklahoma City's preseason matchups while dealing with a heel issue. He'll be considered day-to-day leading up to Tuesday's regular-season opener against San Antonio.

4432823.h: Williams (heel) has been ruled out for Tuesday's preseason game against the Pacers, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
4432823.s: Williams is still dealing with a heel injury and won't play in the second half of this back-to-back set. The big man's final chance to see game action ahead of the regular season will come Thursday against Houston.

4432827.h: Tshiebwe signed to a contract with the Rockets on Friday.
4432827.s: The exact details of the deal aren't known, but the big man could be joining Houston on an Exhibit 10 or partially guaranteed contract after spending his first three seasons in the professional ranks on two-way pacts. The 26-year-old appeared in 27 games (six starts) for the injury-riddled Jazz in 2025-26, averaging 7.8 points, 6.6 rebounds and 1.2 assists in 16.6 minutes per contest.

4432827.h: The Jazz will not tender a qualifying offer to Tshiebwe, per Tony Jones of The Athletic.
4432827.s: Tshiebwe will now become an unrestricted free agent, and Utah is not extending an invitation for Summer League action. The Kentucky product flashed a bit down the stretch a year ago, averaging 14.0 points, 11.2 rebounds, 1.5 assists and 1.0 steals per game over his last five contests, so Tshiebwe could draw some attention this offseason.

4432847.h: Shannon will come off the bench in Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Heat.
4432847.s: Shannon started in Minnesota's preseason finale with the main guys resting, but he'll shift to a reserve role Wednesday with the regular starters healthy. As a reserve last season, Shannon averaged 5.0 points in 11.7 minutes per game.

4432847.h: Shannon will start Friday's preseason meeting with the Bulls.
4432847.s: The Timberwolves will rest their usual starting five, opening the door for Shannon to enter the first unit. He'll be joined in the starting lineup by Zyon Pullin, Jaylen Clark, Cody Williams and Joan Beringer.

4432847.h: Shannon (undisclosed) has been ruled out for Monday's preseason game against the Knicks.
4432847.s: Shannon will be unavailable at Madison Square Garden after starting Saturday against the Heat. Across three preseason games, the wing is averaging 11.3 points, 3.3 assists and 2.7 rebounds in 18.5 minutes per contest. His next chance to suit up will come Wednesday against the Pistons.

4432847.h: Shannon will start in Saturday's preseason game against the Heat.
4432847.s: Shannon is getting the start with Anthony Edwards (rest) taking the night off. In two starts last season, Shannon averaged 17.0 points and 4.0 assists per contest.

4432847.h: Shannon faces additional competition for playing time following Minnesota's agreement with Jonathan Kuminga.
4432847.s: Shannon currently sits second behind Anthony Edwards at shooting guard while providing depth at both forward spots, but Kuminga's expected place in the starting five further crowds Minnesota's wing rotation. Shannon should still have an opportunity to earn a reserve role, though he'll be competing with Ayo Dosunmu, Jaylen Clark and others for minutes behind the starters.

4432848.h: Jaquez (rest) is available for Friday's preseason game against the Pacers.
4432848.s: Jaquez will return to action after sitting out Wednesday's loss to Chicago. The 25-year-old swingman finished second in Sixth Man of the Year voting last season, though he's expected to start after being traded from Miami to Milwaukee in the Giannis Antetokounmpo (rest) deal this past offseason.

4432848.h: Jaquez (rest) won't play Wednesday against the Bulls, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.
4432848.s: The Bucks are set to rest a number of key players for this exhibition. Jaquez's last chance for preseason reps comes Friday against the Pacers.

4432907.h: Champagnie went to the locker room during the first quarter of Monday's game against the Hornets with an apparent ankle injury, Greg Finberg of Wizards Central reports.
4432907.s: Champagnie can be considered questionable to return until the team has more information to share. Khris Middleton and Will Riley could see more run if Champagnie is downgraded to out.

4433076.h: Sheppard is scheduled for surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee Wednesday, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.
4433076.s: Sheppard was diagnosed with a torn left meniscus Friday, and the team has since determined that he'll require surgery. A timetable for the guard's return should start to come into focus after the procedure.

4433076.h: Sheppard has been diagnosed with a torn meniscus in his left knee and is without a timetable for a return to game action, Scott Agness of FieldhouseFiles.com reports.
4433076.s: Sheppard can be considered out indefinitely until the Pacers offer an update on his timeline to return. In the meantime, Jarace Walker and Quenton Jackson will likely see increased playing time.

4433076.h: Head coach Rick Carlisle said Friday that Sheppard is without a timetable to return due to a left meniscus injury, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.
4433076.s: Sheppard sustained the knee injury in Wednesday's season-opening win over New Orleans and can be considered week-to-week until the Pacers provide an update on his progress. Quenton Jackson and Jarace Walker are candidates for increased playing time with Sheppard on the sidelines.

4433076.h: Sheppard (knee) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against the Mavericks.
4433076.s: Sheppard is in jeopardy of missing Friday's contest due to left knee soreness. If he's ultimately ruled out, Quenton Jackson and Jarace Walker would likely see increased burn, especially if Aaron Nesmith (hamstring) remains sidelined.

4433076.h: Sheppard will come off the bench in Friday's preseason finale against the Bucks, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.
4433076.s: Sheppard started in Tuesday's exhibition with Andrew Nembhard (undisclosed) unavailable, but Nembhard is back and starting, so Sheppard will retreat to a reserve role. As a member of the second unit this preseason, Sheppard is averaging 7.5 points, 3.0 rebounds and 1.5 triples in 19.2 minutes per game.

4433083.h: Spencer is in the mix for a spot in the Grizzlies' starting five to begin the 2026-27 season, Damichael Cole of The Memphis Commercial Appeal reports.
4433083.s: Ty Jerome and Scotty Pippen are competing for the starting point guard job with Ja Morant now in Portland, though there's also a battle for starting spots on the wings in Memphis. Cedric Coward, Jerami Grant and Jaylen Wells are all competing with Spencer for a role in the first unit. The 26-year-old shot an impressive 44.8 percent from beyond the arc in 2025-26, averaging 11.1 points and 2.0 triples per game across…

4433083.h: Spencer (back) should have a significant role next season after the Grizzlies traded Ja Morant to the Trail Blazers this offseason.
4433083.s: Memphis has a three-way competition brewing for No. 1 point guard duties ahead of training camp, featuring Scotty Pippen (toe), Ty Jerome (ankle) and Spencer. Even if he fails to seize a starting position to open the year, Spencer is far more likely than D'Angelo Russell to play meaningful minutes in the backcourt off the bench for the rebuilding Grizzlies. Kentavious Caldwell-Pope (finger) also agreed to a buyout…

4433134.h: Barnes (rest) is expected to play in Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Bulls.
4433134.s: Barnes and several other regulars got the night off Friday, though he's expected to be back in action when the Raptors host the Bulls. The star forward averaged 16.3 points, 5.3 rebounds, 3.3 assists, 1.3 steals and 1.3 blocks in 21.2 minutes per tilt across four outings this preseason.

4433134.h: Barnes will be rested for Friday's preseason finale against the Pistons, Omari Sankofa II of the Detroit Free Press reports.
4433134.s: Barnes, along with the rest of the Raptors' starting lineup, will get the night off. However, there is no indication Barnes' availability for Opening Night is in any doubt.

4433134.h: Barnes (knee) practiced Tuesday and remains fine after experiencing some soreness following Saturday's preseason loss to Miami, Josh Lewenberg of TSN.ca reports.
4433134.s: Barnes bumped his knee during the opening minute of Saturday's contest but played through the remainder of the first half before being held out after halftime as a precaution. His participation in Tuesday's practice is another indication that the issue isn't expected to be a concern moving forward.

4433134.h: Barnes said he injured his knee during the opening minute of Saturday's preseason loss to Miami and is still experiencing some soreness, Josh Lewenberg of TSN.ca reports.
4433134.s: Barnes was able to play through the injury for the remainder of the first half before being held out after halftime as a precaution. He recorded 11 points (5-11 FG, 0-1 3Pt, 1-2 FT), three steals, two rebounds and two assists across 12 minutes in Saturday's 129-105 preseason loss to the Heat. Barnes is receiving treatment and doesn't expect the issue to be a concern, while Toronto won't play again until Saturday…

4433134.h: Barnes expects to spend more time on the ball this season, per Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca.
4433134.s: Barnes is an exceptionally well-rounded player and makes for a very intriguing early-round choice this fall. He shot a career-high 50.7 percent from the floor on a talented Toronto team last regular season and has also averaged at least 18.1 points, 7.5 rebounds, 5.8 assists, 1.3 steals and 1.0 blocks per game in three straight years.

4433136.h: Kessler (finger) is available for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.
4433136.s: Kessler suffered a finger injury during training camp but was cleared to suit up in the preseason. The 25-year-old averaged a career-high 14.4 points along with 10.8 rebounds, 3.0 assists, 1.8 blocks and 1.4 steals over 30.8 minutes per contest in 2025-26. However, he was limited to five regular-season games due to a shoulder injury.

4433136.h: Kessler (finger) will play in Tuesday's preseason game against the Warriors, Jovan Buha of The Athletic reports.
4433136.s: Kessler jammed his finger during training camp but has been cleared to make his 2026 preseason debut Tuesday. The big man appeared in just five regular-season games with Utah in 2025-26 due to a shoulder injury and will look to bounce back in his first year with the Lakers.

4433136.h: Kessler (finger) was a full participant in Sunday's practice, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.
4433136.s: Kessler has yet to suit up in the preseason after jamming his finger during training camp, though the injury isn't viewed as a long-term concern. The big man can be considered questionable for Tuesday's exhibition against the Warriors until the Lakers provide an update on his status.

4433136.h: Lakers head coach JJ Redick said Kessler participated in Saturday's practice but didn't do live work, though the center might scrimmage Sunday, Jovan Buha of The Athletic reports.
4433136.s: If Kessler scrimmages Sunday and everything goes according to plan, the big man could make his Lakers debut Tuesday against Golden State. Kessler jammed his finger early in training camp and has missed three straight games, but by all accounts, it's not a long-term issue.

4433136.h: Kessler (finger) won't play in Thursday's preseason game against the Kings, Benjamin Royer of The Orange County Register reports.
4433136.s: Kessler will miss a third consecutive contest due to a finger injury, though head coach JJ Redick isn't concerned that it's a long-term issue, per Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com. The big man's next opportunity to play in the preseason will come Tuesday against the Warriors.

4433137.h: Williams (foot) is available and will start in Friday's preseason game versus the Nuggets, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.
4433137.s: Williams has been bothered by a foot contusion. However, he will get the green light to suit up and start in the preseason finale. The 25-year-old, who agreed to a deal with the Lakers in the offseason, averaged a career-high 10.2 points along with 2.4 rebounds, 1.1 assists and 1.4 steals over 22.9 minutes per contest in 56 regular-season games with the Nets in 2025-26. Williams should see some minutes throughout…

4433137.h: Williams (foot) was a full participant in Thursday's practice, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.
4433137.s: Williams has been dealing with a foot contusion recently, though he's trending in the right direction ahead of Friday's preseason finale against Denver. The 25-year-old swingman can be considered questionable for that contest until the Lakers provide an update on his status.

4433137.h: Williams (foot) will not play in Tuesday's preseason matchup against Golden State, Khobi Price of The California Post reports.
4433137.s: Williams continues to deal with a foot contusion that has kept him out of recent preseason action. Coach JJ Redick indicated that the forward remains day-to-day, suggesting the injury isn't considered a long-term concern. Williams' next opportunity to suit up will come Friday against Denver in the Lakers' preseason finale.

4433137.h: Lakers head coach JJ Redick said Saturday that Williams is dealing with a foot contusion, Benjamin Royer of The Orange County Register reports.
4433137.s: Williams has missed two straight preseason games due to the injury, which was previously labeled as general soreness. It's unclear when he'll be cleared to play, but it doesn't sound like he's practicing at full capacity yet.

4433137.h: Williams won't play in Thursday's preseason game against the Kings due to general soreness, Benjamin Royer of The Orange County Register reports.
4433137.s: Williams was also held out for the second half of a preseason back-to-back Tuesday, and he'll take a seat again Thursday with coach JJ Redick indicating a number of Lakers are dealing with minor injuries, per Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com. Williams' next opportunity to return will arrive Tuesday against Golden State.

4433144.h: Love agreed to a two-way contract with the 76ers on Friday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4433144.s: Love was on a two-way contract with Portland in 2025-26. He made 49 regular-season appearances, posting averages of 10.4 points, 2.5 assists and 2.3 rebounds in 20.7 minutes per contest. He'll likely spend a lot of time with Philadelphia's G League affiliate during the 2026-27 campaign.

4433174.h: Cardwell (calf) will be re-evaluated in one week, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
4433174.s: Cardwell is progressing well in his recovery from a calf strain. Precious Achiuwa should remain worth streaming in all fantasy leagues for the banged-up Kings in the meantime.

4433174.h: Cardwell (calf) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, with a longer absence possible, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
4433174.s: Cardwell appeared in 44 games last season, providing frontcourt depth while Domantas Sabonis dealt with injuries.
