Sacramento will also be without Maxime Raynaud (knee) to begin the campaign, leaving the team thin at center behind Sabonis. Cardwell's return timetable remains uncertain, but his absence could create additional opportunities for the Kings' remaining frontcourt reserves.

4433174.h: Cardwell will miss at least two weeks with a left calf strain, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.
4433174.s: Sacramento's frontcourt takes another blow after losing Maxime Raynaud (knee) for several weeks over the weekend. The Kings figure to depend heavily upon Domantas Sabonis at center to open the season, while Precious Achiuwa should play a featured role off the bench to help pick up the slack.

4433174.h: Cardwell (calf) didn't practice Monday, per James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento.
4433174.s: Cardwell is nursing left calf soreness and missed Saturday's preseason game against the Warriors. His status is uncertain for Tuesday's preseason game versus Portland.

4433174.h: Cardwell (rest) has been ruled out for Saturday's exhibition game against Golden State, Jason Anderson of The Sacramento Bee reports.
4433174.s: Cardwell will get a breather Saturday, and his absence opens the door to more playing time for Alex Karaban, Precious Achiuwa and Daeqwon Plowden. Cardwell's next opportunity to play is Tuesday against Portland.

4433188.h: Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.
4433188.s: Carter missed Boston's final three preseason games with the illness and is now expected to miss time to begin the regular season. He can be considered week-to-week until Boston provides an update on his progress. The 2024 first-rounder signed a two-way pact with the Celtics on Saturday and will provide backcourt depth for the club.

4433188.h: Carter (illness) agreed to a two-way deal with the Celtics on Saturday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
4433188.s: Carter was the No. 13 overall pick in the 2024 NBA Draft. Since then, he appeared in 74 regular-season games with the Kings, including 12 starts, averaging 6.4 points, 2.7 rebounds and 1.9 assists over 14.8 minutes per contest. Carter might have some untapped potential left, though he has a way to go before earning a meaningful role with the Celtics.

4433188.h: Carter (illness) has been ruled out for Friday's preseason game versus the 76ers, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports
4433188.s: Carter will miss a third consecutive contest due to an illness. The 2024 first-rounder is signed to a non-guaranteed deal and could be let go before the Celtics' regular-season opener against the Pistons on Tuesday.

4433188.h: Carter (illness) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against Charlotte, Bobby Krivitsky of Forbes.com reports.
4433188.s: Carter will miss a second consecutive game due to an illness. His next chance to suit up could come Friday against Philadelphia.

4433188.h: Carter (illness) has been ruled out for Saturday's exhibition game against the 76ers, Jack Simone of BostonSportsJournal.com reports.
4433188.s: Carter played 25 minutes during Boston's preseason opener against Cleveland on Thursday, but the third-year pro is under the weather and will not be available for Saturday's contest. His next chance to play is Wednesday against Charlotte.

4433192.h: Eason (undisclosed) returned to Thursday's preseason game against the Thunder with 5:48 remaining in the third quarter, per the broadcast.
4433192.s: Eason jogged back to the locker room early in the third quarter. However, he returned to the bench and checked back in shortly thereafter.

4433192.h: Eason (undisclosed) exited to the locker room in the third quarter of Thursday's preseason game against the Thunder, Will Guillory of The Athletic reports.
4433192.s: Eason jogged back to the locker room but has since returned to the bench, per Guillory. Still, it's unclear if he'll return to Thursday's preseason finale.

4433192.h: Eason agreed Thursday to a five-year, $81.5 million deal (fully guaranteed) to remain in Houston, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4433192.s: Eason was selected by the Rockets with the No. 17 overall pick in the 2022 NBA Draft. Since then, the 25-year-old has appeared in 221 regular-season games for Houston, averaging 10.4 points, 6.3 rebounds, 1.3 assists, 0.7 blocks and 1.3 steals over 23.6 minutes. Eason was on the radar of a few teams around the NBA, especially the Lakers. However, he will remain in Houston, where he will likely see most of his…

4433247.h: Kuminga (rest) is expected to play in Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Heat.
4433247.s: Kuminga joined several other regulars on the inactive list for Friday's preseason finale, but he should play Wednesday. The 24-year-old forward is ready to prove himself in a starting role with Minnesota after signing a two-year, $13 million deal in August.

4433247.h: Kuminga (rest) won't play in Friday's preseason game against the Bulls, Alan Horton of the Timberwolves Radio Network reports.
4433247.s: Kuminga will join several other key contributors on the inactive list in Minnesota's preseason finale. He should be able to play in Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Heat.

4433247.h: Kuminga (soreness) is in the starting lineup for Wednesday's preseason game against Detroit.
4433247.s: Kuminga missed the previous two games due to general soreness but will return to the starting lineup Wednesday. The forward should see a fair amount of playing time in the first half, though his workload may be limited given the exhibition setting.

4433247.h: Kuminga (general soreness) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Knicks, Alan Horton of the Timberwolves Radio Network reports.
4433247.s: "[Kuminga] is dealing with a little bit of bumps and bruises that we're just being overly cautious with," said head coach Chris Finch when asked why Kuminga would miss Monday's exhibition. It sounds like there's a decent chance Kuminga will be able to get back out there for Wednesday's preseason meeting with the Pistons.

4433247.h: Kuminga (rest) is not available against the Heat on Saturday.
4433247.s: Kuminga played in each of the Timberwolves' first two preseason games but will observe Saturday's game from the bench in street clothes. His next chance to play is against the Knicks on Monday.

4433249.h: Diabate (elbow) isn't listed on the injury report for Wednesday's game against the Nets.
4433249.s: Diabate missed the preseason finale due to a right elbow injury but is good to go for Opening Night. The 2022 second-round pick is expected to start at center but will face competition from second-year big man Ryan Kalkbrenner and rookie Hannes Steinbach.

4433249.h: Diabate has been ruled out for Friday's preseason finale against the Grizzlies due to a right elbow injury.
4433249.s: Diabate can be considered day-to-day moving forward, and his status for Wednesday's regular-season opener in Brooklyn remains unclear. If he's sidelined, Ryan Kalkbrenner and rookie Hannes Steinbach would be candidates for increased roles.

4433249.h: Diabate was spotted working with the first unit in Friday's practice.
4433249.s: Although he began the 2025-26 season in a reserve role, Diabate started 47 of his 73 regular-season appearances, averaging 7.9 points, 8.7 rebounds, 1.9 assists, 1.0 blocks and 0.8 steals across 26.0 minutes per contest. He faces added competition for playing time this year with Hannes Steinbach and Naz Reid now in the mix. However, it appears likely Reid will start at power forward, while Diabate battles for center…

4433255.h: Holmgren (knee) is out for Monday's game versus the Suns.
4433255.s: The star big man is sitting out the second part of this back-to-back set. Jaylin Williams and Kenrich Williams should help pick up the slack at power forward for the Thunder on Monday, with Shai Gilgeous-Alexander likely soaking up all the usage he can handle.

4433255.h: Holmgren (quadriceps) is available for Tuesday's regular-season opener against the Spurs, Justin Martinez of The Oklahoman reports.
4433255.s: Holmgren did not play during the preseason due to the quad issue, but he'll be out there for Opening Night. Holmgren was a top-20 player last season with averages of 17.1 points, 8.9 rebounds, 1.7 assists, 1.3 triples and 1.9 blocks per regular-season contest, and he should provide similar production in his age-24 season.

4433255.h: Holmgren (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Thursday's preseason game against the Rockets, Justin Martinez of The Oklahoman reports.
4433255.s: Holmgren will miss the entire preseason due to a bruised quad. The team has yet to express any concern about the big man missing the regular-season opener Tuesday against San Antonio, but his status should come into focus as Opening Night approaches.

4433255.h: Holmgren (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Tuesday's preseason game against the Pacers, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
4433255.s: Holmgren has yet to play in the preseason due to a quad contusion and will remain on the inactive list in the second leg of this back-to-back set. The big man's final chance to suit up before the regular season will come Thursday versus Houston.

4433255.h: Holmgren (quadriceps) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Hawks, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
4433255.s: Holmgren and the rest of the Thunder's regulars won't travel to Atlanta for the first half of a back-to-back set. The talented center has yet to play during the preseason due to a quadriceps contusion, and his status for Tuesday's home game against the Pacers remains unclear.

4433287.h: Miller agreed to a five-year, $209 million rookie-scale contract extension with Charlotte on Monday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4433287.s: The Hornets have already elected to exercise a $15.1 million team option for the 2026-27 season, but this deal will keep Miller in Charlotte for years to come. The 23-year-old has averaged 20-plus points in each of his last two seasons and will serve in a key scoring role heading into the upcoming campaign.

4433287.h: Miller will start in Sunday's preseason game against Milwaukee.
4433287.s: Miller didn't play in Tuesday's loss to Brooklyn due to a shin injury, but he will be on the floor Sunday versus the Bucks. The 23-year-old is coming off a productive 2025-26 campaign, averaging 20.2 points, 4.9 rebounds, 3.3 assists and 1.0 steals over 30.3 minutes per contest in 65 regular-season games.

4433287.h: Miller (shin) will play in Sunday's preseason game against the Bucks.
4433287.s: Miller missed Tuesday's preseason-opening loss to the Nets due to a shin contusion, though he'll suit up for Sunday's contest. With the 23-year-old swingman back in action, Liam McNeeley could slide to the second unit, though Grayson Allen's (knee) spot in the first unit is up for grabs.

4433287.h: Miller (leg) is listed as out for Tuesday's preseason game versus the Nets.
4433287.s: Miller suffered a shin contusion during Tuesday's practice. Although there haven't been further details, his absence against the Nets is likely precautionary. The 23-year-old ended the 2025-26 campaign by averaging 20.2 points, 4.9 rebounds, 3.3 assists and 1.0 steals while shooting a career-high 38.3 percent from deep over 30.3 minutes per contest in 65 regular-season games.

4433287.h: Hornets general manager Jeff Peterson said Monday that Miller (shoulder) is expected to participate in training camp and be ready for the start of the regular season, Hunter Bailey of the HWY 49 Podcast reports.
4433287.s: Miller's availability for training camp is an encouraging sign after his injury issues last season. Peterson expects the forward to be "ready to roll" for Opening Night, which would be a significant boost for a Charlotte squad that could be without Kon Knueppel (hamstring) to begin the season.

4433621.h: Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.
4433621.s: Duren suffered the hamstring injury in Friday's win over Miami and is set to miss an extended period. Paul Reed is expected to join the starting five and carries significant fantasy value until Duren returns. John Collins and Tolu Smith are also candidates to see a bump in minutes in Duren's stead.

4433621.h: Duren has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 76ers due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.
4433621.s: Duren exited Friday's win over Miami early and did not return, and he's since been diagnosed with a hamstring strain. With the star big man sidelined, Paul Reed is expected to start and figures to see a significant increase in minutes.

4433621.h: Duren is questionable to return to Friday's game in Miami due to a right thigh injury.
4433621.s: Duren tweaked his thigh and immediately departed to the locker room. If he's not able to get back out there, John Collins and Paul Reed will benefit.

4433621.h: Duren exited to the locker room in the second quarter of Friday's game against the Heat due to an apparent right knee injury, Omari Sankofa II of the Detroit Free Press reports.
4433621.s: Duren appeared to tweak his knee before walking back to the locker room. The big man can be considered questionable to return until more information comes to light.

4433621.h: Duren (reconditioning) is in the starting lineup for Wednesday's preseason game against Minnesota, Coty M. Davis of The Detroit News reports.
4433621.s: Duren has completed his reconditioning process and is ready to make his preseason debut. The young center inked a five-year, $200 million extension at the beginning of October after averaging 19.5 points, 10.5 rebounds and 2.0 assists across 70 regular-season appearances last season.

4433627.h: George and the Jazz agreed to a five-year, $157.5 million contract extension Friday, ESPN's Shams Charania reports.
4433627.s: The writing was on the wall for this move a long time ago, as there was a lot of mutual interest to get this done quickly. George averaged 23.6 points, 6.1 assists, 3.7 rebounds and 1.1 steals in 33.1 minutes per contest during the 2025-26 regular season, and moving forward he'll get to play alongside No. 2 overall pick Darryn Peterson in a new-look backcourt.

4437244.h: Green (rest) is available for Friday's preseason game against the Jazz, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.
4437244.s: Green was given the night off during Wednesday's loss to San Antonio. However, the 24-year-old guard will return to the lineup for the Suns' preseason finale.

4437244.h: Green (rest) won't play Wednesday versus the Spurs, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
4437244.s: Green was expected to sit this one out, so the latest update isn't surprising. His final chance to suit up before the start of the regular season will come Friday against Utah.

4437244.h: Green did not participate in Wednesday's full morning shootaround and isn't expected to face San Antonio, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.
4437244.s: Green is among six Suns players expected to miss Wednesday's exhibition contest. The reason for his anticipated absence is likely maintenance-related, leaving Friday's preseason finale against Utah as his next potential opportunity to take the floor.

4437244.h: Green said Monday that improving his playmaking and pace were major focuses during the offseason, with the guard working with Hall of Famer Steve Nash to develop those areas of his game, according to Suns reporter Ethan Kinney.
4437244.s: Green said Nash has helped him better understand how to read the floor and control the pace of a game, which could prove particularly useful with Phoenix looking to emphasize transition opportunities this season. Green averaged 17.8 points, 3.6 rebounds and 2.8 assists across 32 regular-season appearances in 2025-26, and growth as a facilitator would add another dimension to his offensive profile.

4437244.h: Green could experience a downtick in usage next season after the Suns acquired Miles Bridges from the Hornets this offseason.
4437244.s: Phoenix is welcoming in a new member of its starting lineup in 2026-27, with Bridges set to replace Royce O'Neale in that role. The Suns effectively replaced Grayson Allen with Luke Kennard, as both players profile similarly as three-point shooters, but Bridges poses a far greater risk to Green's usage than Kennard. Green still figures to slot in as the team's No. 2 scoring option behind Devin Booker, and the former…

4565698.h: Hopkins will start Saturday's game against the Pelicans.
4565698.s: With Cameron Johnson (ankle) sidelined, Hopkins will draw his first career start. The rookie second-rounder has logged just two minutes over one appearance so far this season.

4565698.h: Hopkins signed a two-way contract with Denver on Wednesday.
4565698.s: Hopkins was the No. 49 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft. With this transaction, he will be allowed to develop at his own pace with a lot of reps in the G League.

4565698.h: Hopkins (rest) won't play in Sunday's Summer League game against the Raptors, Ryan Blackburn of MileHighSports.com reports.
4565698.s: Hopkins will sit out the Nuggets' Summer League finale. Over four Las Vegas Summer League appearances, he averaged 18.0 points, 6.5 rebounds, 1.5 assists, 1.5 steals and 0.8 blocks in 25.9 minutes per contest.

4566434.h: Wagner (shoulder) is off the injury report for Wednesday's season opener against the Hawks.
4566434.s: Wagner dealt with a brief bout of shoulder soreness to end the preseason, but the issue proved to be of minimal concern. The star forward should be able to handle a normal workload in his season debut.

4566434.h: Wagner (shoulder) practiced in full Tuesday and is planning to play in Wednesday's game against the Hawks, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
4566434.s: Orlando will release its injury report Tuesday evening ahead of Opening Night, and this update suggests Wagner may not be listed. For now, fantasy managers can pencil him into lineups.

4566434.h: Head coach Sean Sweeney said the team will continue to evaluate Wagner's right shoulder, and he was limited to "light work" in Sunday's practice, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
4566434.s: Wagner exited Friday's preseason finale due to right shoulder soreness and did not return. The severity of the issue is unclear, though the 25-year-old forward can be considered questionable for Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Hawks. If he's forced to miss time, Anthony Black (ankle), Jamal Cain and Tristan da Silva would all be candidates for increased playing time.

4566434.h: Wagner exited Friday's 136-115 preseason win over the Heat with right shoulder soreness and did not return, Cody Taylor of USA Today reports.
4566434.s: Per Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel, head coach Sean Sweeney did not provide an update after the game, simply saying that Wagner would be "re-evaluated." For what it's worth, Wagner did return to the bench after getting ruled out for the remainder of the game, but for now, he should be considered questionable for Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Hawks.

4566434.h: Wagner (calf) is eager for the new season to begin, per Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel.
4566434.s: After sitting out for Germany during FIBA World Cup action over the summer, Wagner appears to have a clean bill of health this fall. Ankle and calf injuries held Wagner to just 34 regular-season appearances last year, but the star forward was highly effective when healthy, averaging 20.6 points, 5.2 rebounds, 3.3 assists and 0.9 steals per game.

4576060.h: Kalkbrenner is in the Hornets' starting lineup for Friday's preseason game against the Grizzlies.
4576060.s: Kalkbrenner will draw the start for Friday's preseason finale while Moussa Diabate (elbow) is sidelined. Across three preseason games, Kalkbrenner has averaged 4.3 points and 3.3 rebounds over 15.4 minutes per game. It's unclear what his role will look like for the 2026-27 season given the presence of both Diabate and rookie first-rounder Hannes Steinbach.

4576060.h: Kalkbrenner said Monday that improving his physicality was his biggest developmental focus during the offseason, Owen O'Connor of SI.com reports.
4576060.s: Physicality was already an area in which Kalkbrenner made noticeable strides during his rookie campaign, particularly absorbing contact defensively and setting screens. The 7-foot-1 center averaged 7.6 points, 5.5 rebounds and 1.5 blocks in 21.4 minutes across 69 regular-season appearances last campaign, and further improvement in that area could help him earn additional playing time in Charlotte's frontcourt. His…

4576087.h: Watson (hamstring) will start Thursday's preseason game against the Celtics, Serena Winters of FanDuel Sports Network Ohio reports.
4576087.s: Watson is likely to begin the regular season in a starting role, and he will get the starting nod in Cleveland's preseason opener. He'll be joined in the first unit by Donovan Mitchell, Jaylon Tyson, Evan Mobley and Jarrett Allen.

4576087.h: Although head coach Kenny Atkinson said Friday that the starting lineup for the beginning of the 2026-27 season is not yet set, he praised Watson's (hamstring) fit in Cleveland and added that "there's a lot of room for growth in his offensive game," Chris Fedor of Cleveland.com reports.
4576087.s: Watson isn't guaranteed a spot in the starting five immediately but will have the chance to compete for it during training camp. The 24-year-old forward figures to play a sizable role for Cleveland after being acquired from the Nuggets in August in a multi-team deal. Watson was limited to just 54 regular-season appearances (40 starts) in 2025-26 due in large part to a strained hamstring, though he impressed when…

4576087.h: Watson (hamstring) was traded to Cleveland on Wednesday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports. As parts of the deal, the Clippers will receive Max Strus, and the Nuggets will receive an unprotected first-round pick in 2031 and a second-round pick in 2032.
4576087.s: The Nuggets extended a qualifying offer at the end of July, but the team will now move on from Watson, who averaged a career-high 14.6 points, 2.1 assists, 4.9 rebounds and 1.1 blocks across 29.6 minutes in 54 regular-season games in 2026.  The 23-year-old, who also agreed to a four-year, $88 million contract with Cleveland, could make an immediate impact for a team looking to compete in a loaded Eastern Conference.…

4576087.h: The Nuggets offered Watson (hamstring) $70 million over five seasons, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.
4576087.s: This offer comes in well below the $25 million annually that Watson was seeking. Christian Braun previously received a five-year, $125 million deal from the Nuggets and was clearly outplayed by Watson in 2025-26, but Denver holds the leverage. Watson is a restricted free agent, and his top suitors currently don't have the cap space to sign him.

4576087.h: The Nuggets tendered a qualifying offer to Watson (hamstring) on Monday, Keith Smith of Spotrac.com reports.
4576087.s: With tons of injuries in Denver last season, Watson broke out, averaging 14.6 points, 4.9 rebounds, 2.1 assists, 1.1 blocks and 0.9 steals per game on 49/41/73 shooting splits. However, the injury bug also hit Watson, who missed 31 of the Nuggets' final 36 games, including every postseason contest. Given his strong performance, Watson is set for a major raise, assuming he's fully healthy during free agency.

4591725.h: Rollins (rest) is available for Friday's preseason game against the Pacers.
4591725.s: Rollins will return from a one-game absence due to rest purposes. The 24-year-old guard is coming off a career year in 2025-26 and is expected to remain a key piece for the Bucks as they navigate life without Giannis Antetokounmpo (rest).

4591725.h: Rollins (rest) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against Chicago, Cameron Ezeir of CBS58 reports.
4591725.s: Rollins will take the night off before possibly suiting up for Friday's preseason meeting with the Pacers. The 24-year-old has played relatively well during the preseason (three games), averaging 13.0 points, 3.7 rebounds, 3.3 assists, 1.7 blocks and 1.3 steals over 19.4 minutes per contest.

4591725.h: Rollins (eye) returned to Monday's preseason game against the Timberwolves with 1:37 remaining in the first quarter, per the broadcast.
4591725.s: Rollins exited the Bucks' preseason opener in the opening quarter due to a right eye laceration. The 24-year-old was deemed likely to return shortly after leaving the court and has since checked back in.

4591725.h: Rollins (right eye laceration) is expected to return to Monday's exhibition versus Minnesota.

4606840.s: Watkins, a two-way player for the Wizards, suffered the injury during the Summer League. Although Washington has yet to offer a timetable for a return, a typical recovery time for the procedure is approximately 9-to-12 months. 4683021.h: Avdija (ankle) is available for Wednesday's game against the Suns, Jason Quick of The Athletic reports.
4683021.s: Avdija will shed his questionable tag due to right ankle soreness and suit up for Portland's regular-season opener. The star forward is coming off a career year in 2025-26, when he averaged 24.2 points, 6.9 rebounds, 6.7 assists and 1.4 combined steals-plus-blocks in 33.3 minutes per game across 66 regular-season outings.

4683021.h: Avdija is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Suns due to right ankle soreness.
4683021.s: It would be surprising if Avdija missed Wednesday's season opener at home due to ankle soreness, but we'll have a better idea on his status based on Avdija's activity level at shootaround. If he can't give it a go on Opening Night, Sidy Cissoko could start, and Ja Morant would likely see an uptick in usage.

4683021.s: Avdija explained that he wanted to represent Israel but that Portland wasn't willing to risk his health while he recovered from what he described as a complex back injury. The 25-year-old dealt with the issue beginning in January but still put together a breakout 2025-26 campaign, averaging 24.2 points, 6.9 rebounds and 6.7 assists across 66 regular-season appearances while earning his first All-Star selection.

4683021.h: Avdija's outlook remains bright despite Portland's acquisition of Ja Morant, according to Robert Ohman of Willamette Week.
4683021.s: Morant's arrival could reduce Avdija's on-ball responsibilities after his breakout campaign, but the Trail Blazers continue to view him as a foundational piece. Even if his usage declines slightly, Avdija's ability to contribute across every category should keep him among Portland's top fantasy options.

4683634.s: Mathurin will come off the bench for the last exhibition before the start of the 2026-27 campaign. However, Los Angeles remained below the first apron following the trade, so the addition of Strus doesn't necessarily prevent Mathurin from returning. His fantasy outlook will depend heavily on where he ultimately signs and what role is available there.

4683634.h: The Clippers tendered Mathurin a qualifying offer Monday, per Michael Scotto of USA Today.
4683634.s: The move will make Mathurin a restricted free agent. The Clippers can match any offer sheet he receives from other teams, and they'll likely make every effort to retain him following last season's Ivica Zubac trade.

4684806.s: Memphis cruised to an Opening Night victory without needing Hendricks in its rotation. The forward faces competition for frontcourt minutes and will need to establish a more consistent role before generating meaningful fantasy appeal.

4684806.h: Hendricks (undisclosed) is available for Tuesday's Summer League game against the Hawks, Michael Wallace of the Grizzlies' official site reports.
4684806.s: The Grizzlies held Hendricks out of Monday's Salt Lake City Summer League game against the Jazz, but the forward is good to go Tuesday. He should be heavily involved on both ends of the floor for a Grizzlies squad that will be without several key producers.

4684806.h: Hendricks (undisclosed) won't play in Monday's Salt Lake City Summer League game against the Jazz, Damichael Cole of The Memphis Commercial Appeal reports.
4684806.s: Hendricks will be held out of Monday's contest but can be considered day-to-day moving forward. His final opportunity to suit up in Salt Lake City this summer will come Tuesday against the Hawks.

4687718.h: Minott (ankle) will sign a two-year, $9 million deal to stay with the Nets, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4687718.s: The deal will include a team option for the second season. Prior to this transaction, Minott had his 2026-27 team option declined to clear the way for this new contract. Minott is likely to compete for rotation minutes at forward next season after a career-best campaign.

4697268.h: Jones signed a two-way contract with the Bucks on Saturday, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.
4697268.s: Jones was a second-round pick of the Pacers in the 2025 NBA Draft and averaged 4.4 points, 3.2 assists and 1.6 rebounds over 16.6 minutes per game across 37 regular-season contests (seven starts) in 2025-26. He was traded to the Bulls in June before being waived, but he'll now get a fresh start with a Bucks team that is also in a reset after trading Giannis Antetokounmpo to the Heat in June.

4697268.h: The Bulls plan to waive Jones, Marc J. Spears of ESPN.com reports Tuesday.
4697268.s: Jones was traded along with pick swaps and cash from the Pacers to the Bulls in exchange for Braden Smith during the 2026 NBA Draft, though Jones is set to hit the open market if he clears waivers. The No. 38 overall pick in 2025, Jones appeared in 37 regular-season games (seven starts) for Indiana in 2025-26, averaging 4.4 points, 3.2 assists and 1.6 rebounds in 16.6 minutes per contest.

4698719.h: Brazile won't start Thursday's game against the Thunder.
4698719.s: Brazile got the starting nod in Friday's preseason finale but will slide to the second unit in Denver's regular-season opener. The rookie forward is a candidate to enter the rotation Thursday due to Spencer Jones (hamstring) being sidelined.

4698719.h: Brazile will start in Friday's preseason game against the Lakers, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.
4698719.s: Aaron Gordon (rest) will get the night off, so Brazile will move into the starting lineup for the Nuggets' final exhibition. The 23-year-old is coming off a big showing, amassing 22 points, two rebounds, one steal and one block over 25 minutes in Wednesday's 122-110 preseason loss to the Clippers.

4698719.h: Brazile is out for Sunday's Summer League finale against the Raptors for undisclosed reasons, Ryan Blackburn of MileHighSports.com reports.
4698719.s: Brazile is likely just getting a rest day for the team's final Summer League game. The No. 35 pick showed clear upside during his time in Las Vegas, averaging 25.5 points, 7.0 rebounds, 2.0 blocks and 1.0 assists in 28.0 minutes per contest across two appearances.

4698719.h: Brazile (shoulder) won't play in Saturday's Summer League game against Minnesota, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.
4698719.s: Brazile is managing a right shoulder strain that will keep him sidelined Saturday. It remains to be seen whether the injury will sideline him beyond the weekend, though the rookie's next chance to suit up will come Tuesday against Oklahoma City.

4701208.h: Cisse will come off the bench in Friday's preseason finale versus the Hawks.
4701208.s: Daniel Gafford (rest) is back and starting after sitting out Wednesday's preseason loss to the Pelicans, so Cisse will return to a reserve role. As a member of the second unit this preseason, Cisse is averaging 1.5 points and 3.5 rebounds in 10.5 minutes per game.

4701208.h: Cisse (ankle) is available for Friday's preseason game versus Atlanta.
4701208.s: Cisse is nursing a sprained left ankle, though it won't keep him off the court for the Mavericks' final exhibition. The 24-year-old has averaged 3.7 points, 4.3 rebounds, 1.7 assists, 1.0 steals and 1.3 blocks across 12.5 minutes per outing in three preseason appearances.

4701208.h: Head coach Dusty May said Cisse (ankle) didn't practice Thursday as a precaution but added that the big man "would've been able to play" if there was a game, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.
4701208.s: Cisse sprained his left ankle in Wednesday's loss to the Pelicans and could sit out Friday's preseason finale against the Hawks as a precautionary measure. Even if he doesn't play Friday, it appears Cisse is trending toward being available for Wednesday's regular-season opener against Houston.

4701208.h: Cisse exited Wednesday's 101-97 preseason loss to New Orleans due to a left ankle sprain.
4701208.s: Cisse exited early, though Dallas head coach Dusty May downplayed the severity of the injury. "They said he tweaked an ankle and I don't think preseason is a reason to push it," May said, per Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News. As such, the Mavericks could opt to hold Cisse out of Friday's preseason finale against Atlanta.

4701208.h: Cisse will start in Wednesday's preseason game against New Orleans, Christian Clark of The Athletic reports.
4701208.s: Cisse will make his first start of the preseason. The 24-year-old hasn't had a productive preseason thus far, averaging 1.5 points, 3.5 rebounds, 2.0 assists and 1.0 steals over 10.5 minutes per contest in two appearances.

4701230.h: Johnson (rest) will play in Friday's preseason finale against the Mavericks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
4701230.s: Johnson and most of Atlanta's regulars rested Monday against the Thunder but will return to action for the final exhibition. It's unclear how many minutes the star forward will play Friday, but he should be full go for the regular-season opener.

4701230.h: Johnson (rest) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
4701230.s: Johnson and most of Atlanta's regulars won't suit up for the penultimate preseason contest. Johnson tallied 20 points (8-12 FG, 2-2 3Pt, 2-3 FT), seven rebounds and three assists over 25 minutes in Saturday's 119-117 preseason win over the Pacers.

4701230.h: Johnson (rest) will start in Saturday's exhibition against the Pacers, Kevin Chouinard of the Hawks' official site reports.
4701230.s: Johnson skipped Thursday's 123-116 preseason loss to the Spurs for maintenance purposes, but he'll be back in action Saturday night. Aaron Wiggins will shift back to the second unit with Johnson active.

4701230.h: Johnson (rest) has been ruled out for Thursday's preseason game against San Antonio, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
4701230.s: Johnson will sit out Atlanta's second preseason game after posting eight points (1-7 FG, 0-3 3Pt, 6-6 FT), five rebounds, three assists and one steal in 18 minutes during Monday's loss to Memphis. His next chance to play in the preseason will come against Indiana on Saturday.

4701230.h: Hawks president of basketball operations Onsi Saleh said Johnson has "multiple levels he can raise his game to" as the forward continues his development, Malik Brown of ClutchPoints.com reports.
4701230.s: "Jalen's really hard on himself, and we're hard on Jalen because we think he has multiple levels he can raise his game to," Saleh said. The comments suggest Atlanta will continue pushing Johnson to expand his game, and he's up for the challenge. Look for Atlanta's franchise player to be heavily involved on both ends of the court this season.

4701232.h: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4701232.s: This is a tough blow for the center with training camp right around the corner. With Williams on the inactive list, Oso Ighodaro and Khaman Maluach figure to see increased playing time, with the latter already drawing buzz during Summer League play. More clarity on Williams' timeline should be known in the coming weeks, and while nothing official has come from the Suns, Phoenix radio host John Gambadoro reports that…

4701233.h: Porter is lined up as Cleveland's top backup point guard after the franchise re-signed James Harden.
4701233.s: Porter did benefit from the departure of Dennis Schroder, who previously served as the team's No. 2 point guard following last year's trade deadline. Tre Mann, who was originally acquired for Schroder, has since been rerouted to Washington, so Porter seems to have only Tyrese Proctor to beat out for the role during training camp.

4702177.h: Ellis is starting Tuesday's preseason opener against the Hornets, C.J. Holmes of the New York Daily News reports.
4702177.s: The veteran swingman is getting the nod in the absence of rookie Mikel Brown (ankle) on Tuesday. Ellis could be ticketed for a bench role once Brooklyn is healthy, though.

4702177.h: Ellis agreed to a two-year, $18 million deal with Brooklyn on Tuesday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4702177.s: Ellis will head to Brooklyn after spending the 2025-26 season with Sacramento and Cleveland. Across 72 regular-season appearances (11 starts) last season, the Alabama product averaged 6.7 points, 1.9 rebounds, 1.2 steals and 1.0 assists while shooting 44.0 percent from the field and 36.3 percent from beyond the arc in 20.5 minutes per contest. The 26-year-old may not operate as a full-time starter, but Ellis should…

4702352.h: Sanders (hip) was a full participant in Saturday's practice and is expected to play in Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Kings, Joey Linn of SI.com reports.
4702352.s: Sanders didn't suit up during the preseason due to a hip injury, though he's expected to play when the Clippers host the Kings on Wednesday. The 24-year-old swingman could see increased playing time to begin the regular season, as Brandon Ingram (Achilles), Bradley Beal (knee) and Max Strus (foot) are all expected to miss an extended period.

4702352.h: Sanders (hip) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Nuggets, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
4702352.s: While Sanders isn't available for the Clippers' final preseason game, the team is optimistic he will be cleared to suit up for Opening Night against the Kings. With Max Strus (foot), Bradley Beal (knee) and Brandon Ingram (Achilles) all sidelined to begin the 2026-27 campaign, Sanders might be in line for a more prominent role. The 24-year-old appeared in 68 regular-season games as a rookie in 2024-25, starting 16…

4702352.h: Sanders (hip) was limited to individual player development work and did not take part in five-on-five activity Wednesday, Tomer Azarly of ClutchPoints.com reports. Azarly adds that the Clippers said Sanders is day-to-day.
4702352.s: With Sanders having already missed the Clippers' preseason opener due to a left hip impingement, his continued limitations in practice suggest he still isn't back to full activity. The day-to-day designation keeps him in play to suit up at some point this preseason, but his availability for upcoming exhibition action remains uncertain until he resumes five-on-five work.

4702352.h: Sanders won't play in Sunday's preseason game against the Warriors due to a left hip impingement, Joey Linn of SI.com reports.
4702352.s: It's unclear when Sanders began dealing with the hip issue, though it'll keep him out of the Clippers' preseason opener. He will also be limited to individual work during Saturday's practice, per Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com. Sanders' next opportunity to suit up during the preseason will come next Saturday against the Raptors.

4702352.h: Sanders could have a clearer path to playing time early in the season with Brandon Ingram unavailable for the opener while recovering from a partially torn Achilles and right heel surgery.
4702352.s: Los Angeles is already dealing with several injuries on the wing, and Sanders is expected to compete for meaningful minutes off the bench. Ingram's absence should give Sanders an opportunity to establish himself in the Clippers' rotation during the opening portion of the campaign. During the 2025-26 regular season, Sanders averaged 7.3 points, 2.3 rebounds and 1.6 assists.

4702382.h: The Magic have exercised da Silva's fourth-year rookie-scale team option, keeping him under contract through the 2027-28 season, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
4702382.s: The decision gives Orlando another year of control over the 2024 first-round pick, who has established himself as a versatile forward capable of spacing the floor. Da Silva will continue competing for minutes in a crowded Magic frontcourt, with his fantasy upside largely dependent on securing a consistent rotation role and increasing his offensive involvement.

4702382.h: Da Silva won't start Tuesday's preseason meeting with Cleveland.
4702382.s: Desmond Bane is back from his rest day, forcing da Silva back to the second unit. The 25-year-old forward is expected to play a meaningful role off the bench behind Paolo Banchero this season.

4702382.h: Da Silva will start Sunday's preseason game against the Cavaliers, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
4702382.s: With Desmond Bane getting the night off for rest purposes, da Silva will join the first unit. Over 25 minutes in Wednesday's preseason-opening win over the Grizzlies, he provided 19 points, five rebounds, two assists and one steal.

4702384.h: The Kings exercised their third-year team option on Clifford's contract Monday, Sean Cunningham of Fox 40 Sacramento reports.
4702384.s: Clifford is officially under contract for the 2027-28 campaign. The 24-year-old has totaled just 19 minutes over two regular-season appearances so far this season, averaging 3.0 points while shooting 42.9 percent from the field. He also didn't see the floor in Sunday's loss to Memphis.

4702384.h: Clifford is not listed in the starting lineup for Friday's preseason game against San Antonio, Tristi Rodriguez of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.
4702384.s: Clifford got the start in Tuesday's 110-98 preseason loss to Portland, finishing with two points, two rebounds, five assists and one block. However, he will come off the bench Friday in the last exhibition before the Kings begin the 2026-27 campaign versus the Clippers on Wednesday.

4702384.h: Clifford will start Tuesday's preseason matchup against the Trail Blazers, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
4702384.s: Clifford will get an opportunity to work with Sacramento's first unit as the Kings continue evaluating their rotation ahead of the regular season. With several regulars unavailable, the young wing could see an expanded workload and additional opportunities to contribute offensively.

4702384.h: Clifford enters his second NBA season after showing flashes as a versatile two-way wing during his rookie campaign.
4702384.s: His ability to defend multiple positions and contribute as a rebounder should keep him in the mix for rotation minutes, though Sacramento's wing depth could make consistent playing time difficult to secure. Continued improvement as a perimeter shooter would go a long way toward expanding his role in 2026-27 after he hit 33.3 percent from beyond the arc over 75 regular-season games as a rookie.

4702384.h: Clifford (rest) is out for Friday's Summer League game against Charlotte, per Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140.
4702384.s: Clifford is getting Friday night off for the Las Vegas Summer League finale. With DeMar DeRozan (hamstring) out of the picture ahead of 2026-27, Clifford could be looking at an expanded role with the Kings next season.

4709138.h: Podziemski (back) is no longer listed on the injury report ahead of Monday's game against the Nuggets.
4709138.s: Podziemski didn't play Saturday against the Suns because of a back issue, but since the shooting guard isn't on the injury report, he should return to the starting lineup Monday. Stephen Curry (rest) is also expected back, so the Warriors could have their starting backcourt against Denver. Podziemski has made just one appearance this season. He finished with 18 points (7-17 FG, 2-8 3Pt, 2-2 FT), three assists, two…

4709138.h: Podziemski (back) told reporters Friday that he will not play in the second leg of the Warriors' back-to-back set Saturday against the Suns, Nick Friedell of The Athletic reports.
4709138.s: Podziemski missed the Warriors' regular-season opener against the Lakers on Wednesday due to back soreness, but he was cleared to play against the Grizzlies on Friday, when he played 33 minutes and finished with 18 points (7-17 FG, 2-8 3Pt, 2-2 FT), three assists, two rebounds, three steals and one block in a 111-108 loss. Stephen Curry (rest) is unlikely to play Saturday, so the Warriors' starting backcourt figures…

4709138.h: Podziemski (back) is good to go for Friday's game against the Grizzlies, Nick Friedell of The Athletic reports.
4709138.s: Podziemski is set to make his regular-season debut after sitting out Opening Night, which will shift De'Anthony Melton back to the second unit. Podziemski is expected to have a significant role in the Warriors' offense this season.

4709138.h: Podziemski (back) is probable for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.
4709138.s: The 23-year-old guard was previously listed as questionable, so he's trending in the right direction after missing Opening Night. If Podziemski is cleared to play, De'Anthony Melton would likely see fewer minutes.

4709138.h: Podziemski (back) is questionable for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.
4709138.s: Podziemski missed the regular-season opener against the Lakers on Wednesday and is at risk of missing a second consecutive game, but a final call on his availability is expected to be made at some point Friday. If Podziemski isn't able to play, De'Anthony Melton, Gary Payton and Will Richard are all candidates to log more time on the court.

4711272.h: Sheppard will come off the bench for Monday's game against the Hawks, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.
4711272.s: Sheppard drew the start Saturday in Fred VanVleet's absence, but the 22-year-old will retreat to the bench Monday with VanVleet back in action. Sheppard logged 16 minutes off the bench in the season opener, though he could see more minutes Monday with Marcus Smart (arm) ruled out.

4711272.h: Sheppard is in the starting lineup for Saturday's game against the Hawks, Will Guillory of The Athletic reports.
4711272.s: Sheppard is back after a one-game absence and is being moved straight into the first unit with Fred VanVleet (knee) out. Sheppard was limited to 16 minutes in the season opener against the Mavericks on Wednesday, tallying three points, two rebounds, four assists and two steals. He should be in line for expanded playing time Saturday.

4711272.h: Sheppard (knee) is good to go for Saturday's game in Atlanta, Varun Shankar of the Houston Chronicle reports.
4711272.s: Sheppard is back after a one-game absence, and with Fred VanVleet (knee) sitting out Saturday's game, Sheppard will have an opportunity to start. If he gets the starting nod, he would make for an intriguing  option in daily fantasy leagues.

4711272.h: Sheppard (knee) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Hawks.
4711272.s: Sheppard is in danger of missing a second straight game with a left knee bone bruise. If he joins Fred VanVleet (knee) on the inactive list, Marcus Smart and Bruce Thornton would likely see increased minutes.

4711272.h: Sheppard (knee) is out for Friday's game in San Antonio.
4711272.s: Sheppard was listed as doubtful and now we have official confirmation that he'll be inactive. With Sheppard unavailable, Marcus Smart and Bogdan Bogdanovic will have the chance for some extra minutes.

4711294.h: The Bulls picked up Buzelis' team option Tuesday.
4711294.s: This is a procedural move as the 2024 first-rounder rides out his rookie contract. Expectations are high for Buzelis as he enters his third NBA season, and the forward is primed for a key role with the rebuilding Bulls this year.

4711294.h: Buzelis (ankle) will start Sunday's preseason game against the Nuggets.
4711294.s: Buzelis left Friday's preseason game against the Grizzlies early due to a right ankle injury, but he will return to the lineup Sunday. Buzelis recorded six points and a block in 12 minutes before exiting Friday's game.

4711294.h: Buzelis expects to have more offensive freedom this season and said he focused on becoming more physical and attacking the rim during the offseason, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.
4711294.s: The 21-year-old felt he attempted too many three-pointers last season, when 51.4 percent of his field-goal attempts came from beyond the arc, and he wants to incorporate more mid-range opportunities into his game. Buzelis also prioritized adding weight and strength, which could help him play through contact as he looks to build upon his 16.3 points, 5.8 rebounds, 2.1 assists and 1.5 blocks per game from the 2025-26…

4711297.h: Edwards will come off the bench in Friday's preseason finale against the Celtics, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports.
4711297.s: Edwards will return to the second unit with Jaylen Brown back from his rest day. As a reserve this preseason, Edwards is averaging 6.5 points, 3.0 rebounds and 1.5 blocks per contest.

4711297.h: Edwards is in the starting lineup for Saturday's game against the Celtics.
4711297.s: Edwards is getting a spot start Saturday since the 76ers are resting projected starters Jaylen Brown and LeBron James. He had a down year in 2025-26, averaging 6.0 points per game in 64 regular-season outings (12 starts), and he's expected to be limited to a bench role in 2026-27 when all the rotation members are healthy.

4711297.h: Edwards is competing for a bench role with the 76ers this season, per Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com.
4711297.s: Philadelphia made obvious waves for the signing of LeBron James and acquisition of Jaylen Brown this summer, but the team made several other moves to fortify the second unit. They drafted Labaron Philon in the first round of the draft, while also signing Anfernee Simons, Kentavious Caldwell-Pope and Dean Wade. That likely leaves Edwards in need of an impressive training camp in order to stitch up an Opening Night…

4712849.h: Black (ankle) is available for Sunday's game at New York, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
4712849.s: Black didn't suit up in the preseason and missed Orlando's first two regular-season games with a right ankle sprain, but he'll shed his questionable tag and return to action Sunday. His return to the lineup will leave fewer minutes available for guys like Jase Richardson and Jevon Carter, though it wouldn't be surprising to see Black operate under a minutes restriction in his first game back.

4712849.h: Black (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Knicks.
4712849.s: Black has a chance to return to action Sunday after missing Orlando's first two regular-season games. If the 22-year-old guard is cleared to play, Jase Richardson and Jevon Carter would likely see fewer minutes.

4712849.h: Black (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Minnesota but participated in shootaround and has experienced no setbacks in his recovery, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
4712849.s: "He's doing a good job, still ramping up and looked good," coach Sean Sweeney said. Black continues to make encouraging progress from a right ankle sprain that sidelined him throughout the preseason. His participation in shootaround is a positive sign, though the Magic have yet to establish a timetable for his return. He'll look to carve out a role in Orlando's backcourt once cleared to play.

4712849.h: Black (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Timberwolves.
4712849.s: Despite being a full participant during Thursday's practice, Black will miss a second consecutive regular-season contest after missing the entire preseason with a right ankle sprain. His next opportunity to suit up will come Sunday against New York. With the 22-year-old guard unavailable, Jase Richardson and Tristan da Silva will likely continue seeing increased burn.

4712849.h: Black (ankle) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Hawks, Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com reports.
4712849.s: Black didn't suit up in the preseason due to a sprained right ankle. He's still in the process of ramping up and will miss the team's regular-season opener, though head coach Sean Sweeney said he was moving well in Sunday's practice. The 22-year-old's next chance to play will come in Friday's game against Minnesota. In the meantime, Tristan da Silva, Jamal Cain and Jevon Carter are candidates to see increased…

4712863.h: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
4712863.s: Gueye will be re-evaluated by medical staff in 3-to-4 months, which means he'll miss all of training camp and preseason and likely the start of the 2026-27 regular season. It's a brutal blow for the fourth-year big man, given that the Hawks used the No. 23 overall pick of the 2026 NBA Draft to select St. John's product Zuby Ejiofor. Gueye's absence means Ejiofor will have more opportunities in the preseason, and the…

4712896.h: Clowney is not in the starting lineup for Monday's preseason game against Washington.
4712896.s: Clowney will retreat to the bench after finishing with 11 points (3-4 FG, 2-3 3Pt, 3-4 FT) across 20 minutes as a starter Thursday against Philadelphia. The young forward will cede his starting role to Michael Porter, who missed the previous contest due to wrist soreness.

4712896.h: Clowney is in the starting lineup for Thursday's preseason game against the 76ers, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.
4712896.s: Clowney is expected to be a bench option in the regular season, but he'll get the starting nod Thursday because Michael Porter (wrist) won't start. Clowney is coming off a career-best 2025-26 season, averaging 12.3 points per game in 66 regular-season appearances, including 60 starts.

4712896.h: Clowney acknowledged Monday that his offensive role will shrink following the Nets' acquisition of Julius Randle, adding that he's focused on improving defensively in order to earn playing time, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.
4712896.s: Clowney started 60 of his 66 regular-season appearances last campaign, averaging 12.3 points, 4.1 rebounds and 1.6 assists in 27.0 minutes per game. Randle's arrival is expected to push the 22-year-old into a reserve role and reduce his shot volume, making Clowney's ability to contribute defensively and on the glass increasingly important to securing consistent minutes in Brooklyn's frontcourt.

4713010.h: Jones Garcia (ankle) is good to go for Thursday's preseason game against the Hawks, Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News reports.
4713010.s: After undergoing ankle surgery in February, Jones Garcia apparently has a clean bill of health ahead of the 2026-27 campaign. He's on a two-way contract with the Spurs and is likely to see a lot of G League reps.

4713010.h: Jones Garcia (ankle) agreed to a two-way contract with the Spurs on Wednesday, per Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com.
4713010.s: Jones Garcia is set for his second season with San Antonio in 2026-27, though most of his action is likely to come with the G League's Austin Spurs. He underwent ankle surgery in February, so it's unclear if Jones Garcia will be ready for full participation in training camp this fall.

4713010.h: The Spurs tendered a two-way qualifying offer to Jones Garcia (ankle) on Monday, Keith Smith of Spotrac.com reports.
4713010.s: Jones Garcia appeared in only 11 regular-season games for the Spurs in 2025-26 before having his season cut short, averaging 2.9 points, 1.6 assists and 1.2 rebounds in 6.2 minutes per contest. The 24-year-old underwent surgery on his right ankle in February, and it's unclear whether he'll be available by training camp. He's a restricted free agent and can still seek a better deal elsewhere.

4781746.h: Small (rest) is out for Tuesday's Summer League game against the Hawks, Michael Wallace of the Grizzlies' official site reports.
4781746.s: Small joins a number of starters on the sidelines for the Grizzlies on Tuesday. His next opportunity to play comes Friday in Las Vegas against the Bulls.

4838721.h: Nickel agreed to a two-way contract with the Knicks on Sunday.
4838721.s: Nickel played at North Carolina, Virginia Tech and Vanderbilt throughout his collegiate career before being selected in the second round of the 2026 NBA Draft. The 23-year-old most recently appeared in five games for New York during the 2026 Las Vegas Summer League, averaging 12.2 points, 3.6 rebounds, 1.6 assists and 1.0 steals while shooting 41.3 percent from deep over 28.5 minutes per contest.

4845367.h: The Spurs exercised the team option on Castle for the 2027-28 season Saturday, Jared Weiss of The Athletic reports.
4845367.s: In an unsurprising move, San Antonio picked up Castle's team option for the 2027-28 season. After that time, he will be a restricted free agent. However, there's a good chance both sides will agree on an extension before it gets to that point, though it can't happen until next offseason. The 2024 No. 4 overall pick has appeared in 149 regular-season games for the Spurs since entering the NBA, averaging 15.6 points,…

4845367.h: Castle (rest) will play Wednesday against the Suns, Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News reports.
4845367.s: Castle is returning to the starting lineup after missing the Spurs' last preseason tilt for rest purposes. He's in line for some first-half action Wednesday.

4845367.h: Castle (rest) will not play in Monday's preseason matchup against Utah, Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News reports.
4845367.s: The Spurs planned to rest several regulars for Monday's contest before the preseason began, so Castle's absence is not believed to be injury-related. Victor Wembanyama, De'Aaron Fox, Dylan Harper and Devin Vassell are also among the players sitting out. Castle's next opportunity to suit up will come Wednesday against the Suns.

4845367.h: Castle appears to be locked into a starting role at shooting guard, per Jared Weiss of the New York Times.
4845367.s: There's some discourse surrounding whether or not Dylan Harper should start over veteran De'Aaron Fox in 2026-27, but Castle seems to be safe from that debate. Castle was instrumental to the Spurs' deep playoff run last year, averaging 18.2 points, 6.1 assists, 5.0 rebounds, 0.9 steals and 1.5 three-pointers per game across 23 postseason appearances.

4848625.h: Swain (illness) is available for Friday's game against the Bucks.
4848625.s: Swain is moving past an illness and is ready to make his NBA debut. The rookie first-rounder may not be part of Chicago's rotation in the early going, but Swain could eventually push Isaac Okoro for playing time off the bench with the rebuilding Bulls.

4848625.h: Swain (illness) is now probable for Friday against the Bucks.
4848625.s: Swain was previously listed as questionable after missing Opening Night. The Bulls have a lot of question marks in their rotation right now, making this an interesting situation to monitor in deeper fantasy formats.

4848625.h: Swain (illness) is questionable for Friday's game against the Bucks.
4848625.s: Swain is aiming to make his NBA debut Friday. The rookie forward could eventually push Isaac Okoro for playing time off the bench with the rebuilding Bulls.

4848625.h: Swain is out for Wednesday's season opener against Toronto with an illness.
4848625.s: Swain wasn't expected to travel with the Bulls, and it appears unlikely he'll play in Milwaukee on Friday as well. Once healthy, the rookie forward should push for a reserve role at forward.

4848625.h: Swain (illness) is officially doubtful for Wednesday's regular-season opener in Toronto.
4848625.s: Swain wasn't expected to travel with the team, but the Bulls are at least leaving the door slightly open for Wednesday. Isaac Okoro (knee) and Patrick Williams should ultimately pick up a few extra minutes off the bench.

4868423.h: The Wizards traded Hardy and two second-round picks to the Lakers in exchange for Deandre Ayton on Friday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4868423.s: Hardy will get yet another fresh start, this time in Los Angeles. In 57 regular-season games, split between the Mavericks and Wizards in 2025-26, Hardy averaged 9.2 points and 1.0 assists in 15.8 minutes per contest.

4869342.h: Daniels (rest) will play in Friday's preseason finale against the Mavericks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
4869342.s: Daniels and most of Atlanta's regulars rested Monday against the Thunder but will return to action for the final exhibition. It's unclear how many minutes Daniels will play Friday, but he should be a full go for the regular-season opener.

4869342.h: Daniels (rest) has been ruled out for Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
4869342.s: Daniels and most of Atlanta's regulars will rest during the Hawks' penultimate preseason contest. Daniels tallied 13 points (6-16 FG, 1-3 3Pt), 11 rebounds, an assist and a steal across 21 minutes in Thursday's 123-116 preseason win over the Spurs but struggled with his shot against the Pacers on Saturday.

4869342.h: Hawks president of basketball operations Onsi Saleh called Daniels "one of the most impactful players in the NBA" and an "all-world defender" while expressing confidence that his shooting will improve, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
4869342.s: Daniels remained highly productive across the board in 2025-26, averaging 11.9 points, 6.8 rebounds, 5.9 assists and 2.0 steals in 33.2 minutes across 76 regular-season appearances, but he connected on just 18.8 percent of his 1.5 three-point attempts per game. Despite the lack of perimeter shooting, Daniels shot 51.7 percent overall and earned a spot on the All-Defensive Second Team. Atlanta's continued confidence…

4869780.h: The Pelicans exercised their third-year team option on Queen's contract Tuesday, Terry Kimble of SI.com reports.
4869780.s: The No. 13 overall pick in the 2025 NBA Draft is now officially under contract for the 2027-28 season. The big man averaged 11.7 points, 7.1 rebounds, 3.7 assists and 1.9 combined steals-plus-blocks across 25.0 minutes per tilt in 81 regular-season appearances (48 starts) in his rookie season. Queen is expected to compete for minutes with Yves Missi and Karlo Matkovic in 2026-27.

4869780.h: Queen impressed during his rookie campaign despite missing time early in the season due to a wrist injury, flashing the versatile offensive skills that made him a lottery pick.
4869780.s: Queen posted several standout performances, including the first 30-point triple-double by a rookie center in NBA history. Queen should compete for an even larger frontcourt role in 2026-27 as one of New Orleans' top young building blocks.

4870562.h: Barlow will miss at least the next two weeks due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.
4870562.s: The back issue cost Barlow the entire preseason, and now he'll begin the regular season on the sidelines. The earliest we could see Barlow back on the court would be Nov. 2, but it wouldn't be shocking to see his absence extend beyond that two-week window.

4870562.h: Barlow (back) did not participate in Monday's practice, according to 76ers reporter Paul Hudrick.
4870562.s: Barlow wasn't able to make any appearances during the preseason and remains without a timetable to return. The 76ers will release an injury report Monday evening ahead of Opening Night against the Knicks on Tuesday.

4870562.h: Barlow (back) didn't participate in Sunday's practice, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.
4870562.s: Barlow didn't play in the preseason and is in danger of missing time in the regular season. If the 23-year-old is ultimately ruled out for Tuesday's regular-season opener against the Knicks, Adem Bona (foot), Jabari Walker and Justin Edwards could see increased burn.

4870562.h: Barlow (back) didn't play in Friday's 125-120 preseason loss to Boston in overtime.
4870562.s: Barlow missed the entire preseason with a back injury. He can be considered questionable for Tuesday's regular-season opener against the Knicks until further notice.

4870562.h: Barlow (back) was unable to practice Tuesday, Noah Levick of NBC Sports Philadelphia reports.
4870562.s: Barlow has missed the entire preseason so far and remains without a timetable to return. He can be considered questionable at best for Friday's preseason finale against Boston.

4870564.h: The Nets assigned Jefferson to the G League's Long Island Nets on Monday.
4870564.s: Jefferson will head to Brooklyn's G League affiliate to receive additional developmental opportunities after seeing limited action at the NBA level. The rookie forward could move between Brooklyn and Long Island throughout the season but remains off the fantasy radar in standard leagues.

4870564.h: Jefferson (back) is available for Wednesday's game against Charlotte, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports.
4870564.s: After missing the entire preseason, Jefferson practiced in full Monday and has the green light to return. He projects as an emergency depth option to open the season.

4870564.h: Jefferson (back) has yet to fully participate in team activities and remains without a timetable for his return, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.
4870564.s: Coach Jordi Fernandez confirmed Friday that the rookie is still dealing with back stiffness and isn't ready to return, although Jefferson has participated in portions of team activities and has been doing conditioning work. Fernandez was also unable to confirm whether Jefferson has undergone imaging. With Brooklyn's regular-season opener against Charlotte scheduled for Wednesday, it's safe to rule him out.

4870564.h: Jefferson (back) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game versus the Heat, per Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com.
4870564.s: The rookie first-rounder will now have been sidelined for the entire preseason with a back injury, costing him valuable reps this fall. His status is up in the air for Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Hornets.

4870564.h: Jefferson (back) is out for Monday's preseason game against the Wizards, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.
4870564.s: Jefferson will be sidelined for his third straight exhibition. The rookie forward will have one more chance to return during the preseason, which comes against the Heat on Oct. 14.

4871141.h: Hukporti has been diagnosed with a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
4871141.s: Hukporti went down with an Achilles injury in Monday's preseason opener against the Knicks, and an MRI has since revealed a rupture. He signed a one-year deal with the 76ers over the summer, so Hukporti will be an unrestricted free agent come season's end. With Hukporti's year already finished, Adem Bona (foot) should assume the backup center role behind Joel Embiid.

4871141.h: Hukporti was helped to the locker room during the first quarter of Monday's preseason game against the Knicks after suffering an apparent right lower leg injury, Kristian Winfield of the New York Daily News reports.
4871141.s: Hukporti appeared to grab at his lower leg or ankle after taking a tumble, and he needed the assistance of his teammates to make it down the tunnel. It seems unlikely that he'll return to Monday's exhibition after he was unable to put much weight on his injured leg.

4871141.h: Hukporti will start in Monday's preseason game against the Knicks.
4871141.s: Hukporti is getting the start with Joel Embiid (rest) sitting this one out, but he'll return to a reserve role once the regular season gets underway. Hukporti is not expected to be a consistent part of the 76ers' rotation.

4871141.h: Hukporti agreed to a one-year, $3.4 million deal with the 76ers on Wednesday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4871141.s: The 76ers will add some athletic frontcourt depth behind Joel Embiid and Adem Bona, with Andre Drummond set for unrestricted free agency. Hukporti was used sparingly by the Knicks during the 2025-26 regular season, appearing in 54 games with 2.2 points, 2.9 rebounds and 0.5 blocks in 9.2 minutes per contest.

4871141.h: The Knicks will not extend a qualifying offer to Hukporti, Vincent Goodwill of ESPN.com reports Monday.
4871141.s: Hukporti is set to enter unrestricted free agency after spending the first two years of his career with the Knicks. Over 54 regular-season appearances (five starts) in 2025-26, the big man averaged 2.2 points and 2.9 rebounds while shooting 56.3 percent from the field in 9.2 minutes per showing.

4871144.h: Sengun (rest) is set to play in Thursday's preseason finale against the Thunder, Will Guillory of The Athletic reports.
4871144.s: Sengun appears to be active for a dress rehearsal for the Rockets. Houston's starters are expected to see about a half of action Thursday.

4871144.h: Sengun (rest) isn't expected to play in Sunday's preseason game against the Mavericks, Will Guillory of The Athletic reports.
4871144.s: Sengun recorded 16 points (6-9 FG, 0-2 3Pt, 4-5 FT), 10 rebounds, 10 assists, one steal and three blocks in 22 minutes during Friday's 135-117 preseason win over Dallas but will take a seat Sunday. Sengun is coming off another impressive season, averaging 20.4 points, 8.9 rebounds, 6.2 assists, 1.2 steals and 1.1 blocks in 33.3 minutes per game across 72 regular-season appearances in 2025-26. However, the star…

4871144.h: Sengun has been working with shooting coach Chip Engelland on his free throws and three-point shot, and the big man wants to make corner threes a bigger part of his game, Varun Shankar of the Houston Chronicle reports.
4871144.s: Sengun is coming off another impressive year, averaging 20.4 points, 8.9 rebounds, 6.2 assists, 1.2 steals and 1.1 blocks in 33.3 minutes per game across 72 regular-season appearances in 2025-26. However, the star center shot just 69.1 percent from the charity stripe and 30.5 percent from downtown. He's been focused on improving in those areas this offseason, and an uptick in efficiency would be a significant step…

4871144.h: Sengun continued his ascent as one of the league's premier offensive centers during the 2025-26 campaign, serving as Houston's primary facilitator in the frontcourt while forming an elite partnership with Kevin Durant.
4871144.s: Sengun's combination of interior scoring, rebounding and passing remained the foundation of the Rockets' halfcourt offense throughout the regular season. With Houston returning most of its rotation, Sengun's role should remain virtually unchanged entering 2026-27.

4871145.h: Giddey (wrist) is available for Friday's game against the Bucks.
4871145.s: Giddey was previously listed as probable due to a left wrist sprain, but he'll be able to suit up for the first half of Chicago's back-to-back set. The injury reportedly affected his shooting during Wednesday's season opener against Toronto, when he managed just two points on 1-for-10 shooting. His availability is encouraging, though the wrist issue could continue to affect his offensive efficiency.

4871145.h: Giddey (wrist) is probable for Friday's game against the Bucks.
4871145.s: Giddey is expected to suit up for the first half of this back-to-back set. The star guard will be looking to right the ship after scoring just two points during Wednesday's blowout loss in Toronto. Giddey is coming off a career year in 2025-26 and should be able to get back on track. However, the veteran point guard is dealing with a lingering left wrist injury that happened in the first preseason game, per K.C.…

4871145.h: Giddey (ankle) will be a full participant at training camp, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.
4871145.s: After undergoing ankle surgery in the spring, Giddey will have no restrictions at camp this fall. The star guard is primed for another big season as the Bulls' go-to playmaker, fresh off recording a career-high 17.0 points, 9.1 assists and 8.3 rebounds per game for Chicago in 2025-26.

4873090.h: Philon (coach's decision) didn't play during Tuesday's 106-100 victory over the Knicks.
4873090.s: There was some hope the rookie first-rounder would open the season as Tyrese Maxey's backup at point guard, but Anfernee Simons took on that role in the opener. Philon's fantasy value appears to be more pronounced in dynasty leagues.

4873090.h: Philon faces plenty of competition for minutes and an uncertain role heading into his rookie campaign, per Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com.
4873090.s: Selected with the No. 22 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, Philon will likely have to impress to take on a steady role after the 76ers added Jaylen Brown, LeBron James, Anfernee Simons, Dean Wade and Kentavious Caldwell-Pope (finger) this offseason. Philon will need to prove he can be effective off the ball to see meaningful burn on a nightly basis during his rookie season, as the 76ers have plenty of…

4873090.h: Philon (rest) won't play in Saturday's Summer League game against the Bucks, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.
4873090.s: Philon will take a seat for the 76ers' Summer League finale. The rookie first-rounder scored at least 15 points in all four of his Las Vegas Summer League appearances, during which he averaged 18.5 points, 5.8 assists, 3.5 rebounds and 1.5 steals in 32.0 minutes per contest.

4873138.h: Bailey is in the starting lineup for Friday's game against the Pelicans.
4873138.s: Bailey was productive coming off the bench in Wednesday's loss to the Grizzlies, posting 12 points (5-11 FG, 2-5 3Pt), five rebounds, three assists and three blocks in 24 minutes. He's moving to a first-unit role, sending Jaxson Hayes to the bench. In 61 starts in the 2025-26 season, Bailey averaged 15.3 points, 4.4 rebounds and 1.9 assists per contest.

4873138.h: Bailey will come off the bench in Monday's exhibition against the Spurs, Jazz digital reporter Eric Spyropoulos reports.
4873138.s: Lauri Markkanen (neck) is back after a one-game stint on the sidelines, so Bailey will return to a reserve role. In his previous game off the bench this preseason, Bailey finished with 10 points, four rebounds, one steal and one block over 16 minutes.

4873138.h: Bailey will start in Tuesday's preseason game against the Nuggets.
4873138.s: Bailey will get the start with Lauri Markkanen (neck) unavailable, and he'll be joined in the first unit by Keyonte George, Darryn Peterson, Jaren Jackson and Jaxson Hayes. It'll be interesting to see what Bailey's usage rate looks like in the first unit.

4873138.h: Bailey's (back) role is undetermined heading into the 2026-27 campaign.
4873138.s: The addition of No. 2 overall pick Darryn Peterson may leave Bailey without a spot in Utah's starting lineup to begin the new year. The Jazz are also getting Keyonte George and Lauri Markkanen back in the lineup after the two stars sat out the final stretch of a losing season in 2025-26. Bailey began to blossom late last year, averaging 18.3 points, 4.9 rebounds, 2.0 assists and 1.1 blocks per game in 23…

4873138.h: Bailey (back) won't play in Friday's Summer League game against Portland, per Ben Anderson of KSL News Salt Lake City.
4873138.s: The Jazz are giving Bailey Friday night off while he tends to right back spasms. Given the nature of the injury, the 2025 first-rounder should be fully recovered in time for training camp this fall.

4873153.h: Johnson (lower leg) is available for Saturday's game against the Spurs but will play on a minutes restriction, Ron Harrod Jr. of DLLS Sports reports.
4873153.s: Johnson will be available to play Saturday, and while he's recovered from his lower-leg injury, his minutes restriction means the Mavericks are being cautious with the rookie. Johnson has played in Dallas' first two games this season, logging 14 minutes against Houston and 17 against the Pacers while averaging 7.0 points and 4.5 rebounds per contest.

4873153.h: Johnson (shin) is listed as probable for Saturday's game against the Spurs.
4873153.s: Johnson was initially listed as questionable but is now trending in the right direction ahead of tipoff. If he's cleared to suit up, the rookie would likely see increased playing time due to the Mavericks being extremely shorthanded in the second leg of this back-to-back set.

4873153.h: Johnson (shin) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Spurs.
4873153.s: Johnson is in jeopardy of missing the second leg of this back-to-back set due to right shin splints. If the rookie forward is unable to suit up, Naji Marshall, P.J. Washington and Tobi Lawal would be candidates to see a bump in minutes.

4873153.h: Johnson (rest) is not on the injury report for Friday's exhibition against the Hawks.
4873153.s: Johnson received a maintenance day and sat out Wednesday's exhibition, but he'll be back in action for the Mavs' final preseason game. This will be his second preseason appearance, and it will be interesting to see how much playing time he earns after logging just 12 minutes in his first preseason contest.

4873153.h: Johnson (rest) won't play Wednesday against the Pelicans, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.
4873153.s: The rookie first-rounder missed the start of training camp with leg soreness, so Dallas is taking a cautious approach. Johnson could return for Friday's preseason finale against the Hawks.

4873201.h: Newell won't start Friday's preseason finale against the Mavericks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
4873201.s: With most of Atlanta's regulars resting, Newell drew a spot start against the Thunder on Monday. However, the Hawks are at full strength Friday, so the second-year forward will come off the bench.

4873201.h: Newell is starting Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
4873201.s: The majority of the Hawks' usual starters are sitting out Monday. Newell is auditioning for a spot in the Opening Night rotation for Atlanta and has already posted a couple of solid preseason performances.

4873201.h: Newell will look to build upon his rookie campaign after averaging just 11.4 minutes across 44 regular-season appearances.
4873201.s: The young big remains an intriguing developmental piece due to his athleticism, rebounding and ability to finish around the basket, though Atlanta's frontcourt depth could continue to limit his opportunities. Newell is unlikely to warrant much attention in standard fantasy formats unless he secures a substantially larger role in his second season.

4873201.h: Newell (rest) has been ruled out for Saturday's Summer League game against the Wizards, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
4873201.s: Newell will end up playing in four Summer League games in Las Vegas, averaging 11.8 points, 5.0 rebounds, 2.2 assists, 1.0 steals and 0.8 blocks over 25.9 minutes per game while going 6-for-12 from three-point range. He split his time between the Hawks and the G League during the 2025-26 season but averaged just 11.4 minutes per game across 44 regular-season contests (two starts). Newell figures to compete with…

4873201.h: Newell (rest) won't play in Thursday's Summer League game against Memphis, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
