4873201.s: Newell will get another night off Thursday. The 20-year-old appeared in two games during his time in Las Vegas, combining for 19 points, eight rebounds, three assists, two steals and two blocks.

4888725.h: Dunn will come off the bench in Friday's preseason finale versus Utah, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.
4888725.s: Miles Bridges (ankle) is back and starting following a two-game layoff, so Dunn will head back to the second unit. As a reserve this preseason, Dunn is averaging 3.0 points, 3.5 rebounds and 1.5 steals in 19.6 minutes per game.

4888725.h: Dunn will start in Saturday's preseason game against the Spurs, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.
4888725.s: Dunn is getting the start with Miles Bridges (ankle) unavailable for Saturday's exhibition. As a starter last season, Dunn averaged 9.3 points, 5.4 rebounds, 2.1 assists, 1.3 triples and 1.3 steals per game.

4888725.h: The Suns exercised Dunn's fourth-year option for 2027-28 on his rookie contract Thursday.
4888725.s: This was the expectation as Dunn plays out the final year of his rookie deal in 2027-28 ahead of restricted free agency the following year. He figures to be contending for a bench role with the likes of Jordan Goodwin, Haywood Highsmith, Rasheer Fleming and perhaps even rookie first-rounder Koa Peat at training camp this fall.

4888725.h: Dunn could be restricted to a reserve role next year after Phoenix acquired Miles Bridges from Charlotte this summer.
4888725.s: The Suns may have lost Grayson Allen and Royce O'Neale this offseason, but they signed sharpshooter Luke Kennard in addition to receiving Bridges in a trade with the Hornets. Dunn opened 2025-26 as a starter before being phased out of Phoenix's rotation entirely during the playoffs, ultimately averaging a pedestrian 5.8 points, 4.2 rebounds and 1.5 assists in 19.4 minutes per game over 70 appearances (16 starts)…

4895758.h: Williams will come off the bench in Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Heat.
4895758.s: Williams started for the resting Jaden McDaniels in Minnesota's preseason finale, but he'll shift to a reserve role with the main guys healthy for Opening Night. Williams could have trouble finding meaningful minutes this season while McDaniels and Jonathan Kuminga are active.

4895758.h: Williams will start Friday's preseason finale against the Bulls.
4895758.s: Williams will draw his second preseason start with all of Minnesota's regulars resting again. He'll be joined by Zyon Pullin, Terrence Shannon, Jaylen Clark and Joan Beringer.

4895758.h: Williams will start in Monday's preseason matchup with the Knicks.
4895758.s: Williams turned some heads at training camp and was singled out for praise by Anthony Edwards, so it'll be interesting to see what he can do in a starting role in Monday's exhibition. Joining him in the first unit will be LaMelo Ball, Anthony Edwards, Jaden McDaniels and Rudy Gobert.

4895758.h: The Jazz traded Williams and John Konchar to the Timberwolves on Friday in exchange for Josh Green and cash considerations, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4895758.s: Williams will get a fresh start in Minnesota after taking a bit of a leap in his sophomore season. The 21-year-old wing played in 67 regular-season games (41 starts) last season, averaging 8.8 points, 3.0 rebounds, 2.0 assists and 0.8 steals while shooting 46.8 percent from the field in 24.3 minutes per showing. However, the Colorado product faces plenty of competition for minutes in Minnesota and isn't guaranteed…

4895758.h: Williams (illness) is in line to compete for a reserve role during training camp this fall.
4895758.s: Williams closed last season as a starter for a Jazz team that was looking ahead to 2026-27, but they should have most of their key players healthy for Opening Night and added Darryn Peterson with the No. 2 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft. Williams, who started a career-high 41 regular-season games a year ago, failed to stand out in any one particular area, averaging 8.8 points, 3.0 rebounds, 2.0 assists and 0.8…

4896372.h: Clayton signed a two-way contract with the Mavericks on Wednesday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4896372.s: Clayton will join the Mavericks on a two-way deal after being waived by the Grizzlies on Monday. The No. 18 overall pick in the 2025 NBA Draft appeared in 69 regular-season games (six starts) between the Jazz and Grizzlies in his rookie campaign, averaging 7.8 points, 4.0 assists, 2.0 rebounds and 0.6 steals while shooting 38.4 percent from the field in 20.4 minutes per contest.

4896372.h: Memphis waived Clayton on Monday, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
4896372.s: The Grizzlies were unable to find a trade suitor for Clayton's services prior to Monday's roster deadline. The Florida product was a first-round pick last year and may not pass through waivers unclaimed.

4896372.h: Memphis is actively shopping Clayton ahead of Monday's roster deadline, with Sacramento emerging as a possible destination, NBA reporter Marc Stein reports.
4896372.s: The Grizzlies are attempting to clear roster space before the regular season, and Clayton has become a prominent trade candidate. Although the Kings have surfaced as a potential landing spot, no agreement has been reported. A move could give the second-year guard a fresh opportunity to compete for backcourt minutes, but his role would depend on his destination.

4896372.h: Clayton (knee) has been a full go at training camp, according to Grizzlies reporter Matt Infield.
4896372.s: Clayton missed the entire Summer League due to a sprained right knee, but he made no mention of it during Media Day. Clayton is competing for a roster spot in Memphis and is looking to make an impact in the preseason.

4896372.h: Clayton (knee) won't play in Sunday's Summer League title game against the Warriors, Drew Hill of The Daily Memphian reports.
4896372.s: Clayton is still dealing with a sprained right knee and will end up missing the entirety of Summer League play. The 23-year-old guard will now turn his attention to the 2026-27 campaign, and he's expected to provide backcourt depth during his second season in the Association.

4897262.h: Richard is in the starting lineup for Saturday's matchup with the Suns, Dalton Johnson of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.
4897262.s: Stephen Curry (rest), Brandin Podziemski (back) and Draymond Green (back) are all inactive for Saturday's game, so Richard will start, and he'll be joined in the first unit by Brandon Williams, Gui Santos, Yaxel Lendeborg and Graham Ike. Across 21 starts last season, Richard averaged 8.3 points, 3.4 rebounds, 1.9 assists, 1.3 triples and 1.3 steals per game.

4897262.h: Richard will come off the bench in Saturday's preseason game against the Kings.
4897262.s: Gui Santos will replace Richard in the first unit for Saturday's exhibition. As a reserve this preseason, Richard is averaging 3.5 points and 1.5 rebounds per game.

4897262.h: Richard will start in Wednesday's preseason game against the Trail Blazers, Jason Quick of The Athletic reports.
4897262.s: With the Warriors missing Stephen Curry, Draymond Green and Yaxel Lendeborg, among others, Richard will start in the preseason meeting with Portland. The 23-year-old started in 21 regular-season games in 2025-26, averaging 8.3 points, 3.4 rebounds, 1.9 assists and 1.3 steals over 24.4 minutes per contest in those appearances.

4897262.h: Richard took part in 5-on-5 work with the third team at Warriors camp Thursday, Luca Evans of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.
4897262.s: This update doesn't come as much of a shock, as Richard could find himself near the back end of the team's rotation if the Warriors can stay healthy this season. He put together a decent rookie campaign a year ago, averaging 6.5 points, 2.5 assists, 1.3 assists and 1.2 steals over 69 appearances while Golden State was forced to navigate without Stephen Curry, Brandin Podziemski and De'Anthony Melton down the stretch.

4897262.h: Richard (undisclosed) is starting Thursday's Summer League game against Dallas.
4897262.s: Richard was out for Monday's California Classic Summer League game against Miami for undisclosed reasons, but he's set to return Thursday. The 2025 second-rounder should play a significant role for the Warriors in the Summer League.

4897943.h: Knecht has agreed to a two-way contract with the Knicks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4897943.s: Knecht lands in New York after being waived by the Lakers ahead of the regular season. The 25-year-old averaged 4.2 points and 1.4 rebounds across 10.2 minutes per game during the 2025-26 regular season, but the move gives him an opportunity to rebuild his value. He'll likely spend time developing in the G League and face an uphill battle for consistent NBA minutes, limiting his immediate fantasy appeal.

4897943.h: The Lakers waived Knecht on Monday, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
4897943.s: The writing appeared to be on the wall once head coach JJ Redick told reporters Monday that Knecht was excused from practice with an illness. A first-round pick just two years ago, Knecht shouldn't take long to catch on with another NBA club.

4897943.h: Knecht (illness) was excused from Monday's practice, per Jovan Buha of The Athletic.
4897943.s: Knecht is under the weather Monday. The 2024 first-rounder can be viewed as questionable for Wednesday's season opener against the Warriors, but he's not likely to be part of the rotation anyway.

4897943.h: Knecht won't play in Thursday's preseason game against the Kings due to a contusion, Mike Trudell of Spectrum SportsNet reports.
4897943.s: Knecht is dealing with an undisclosed contusion. His next opportunity to take the floor will come in Tuesday's preseason meeting with the Warriors.

4897943.h: Sam Amico of Hoops Wire believes Knecht is on the Lakers' roster bubble.
4897943.s: Despite LeBron James' offseason exit, Knecht still likely finds himself behind newcomers Quentin Grimes, Collin Sexton, Cameron Carr, Matisse Thybulle and Ziaire Williams on the depth chart. A different situation may be needed for Knecht to attain fantasy relevance in 2026-27.

4898371.h: Raynaud (knee) is progressing in his rehabilitation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
4898371.s: Raynaud's absence is expected to extend into mid-November due to a right patellar subluxation. With Dylan Cardwell (calf) set to miss at least one more week, Precious Achiuwa, Jonathan Mogbo and De'Andre Hunter are candidates for increased minutes in the frontcourt.

4898371.h: Raynaud (knee) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, and potentially longer, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
4898371.s: Raynaud is recovering from a right patellar subluxation and appears set to begin the campaign on the sidelines. The young center appeared in 74 games last season, helping anchor Sacramento's frontcourt while Domantas Sabonis battled injuries. With Dylan Cardwell (calf) also sidelined, the Kings will be especially dependent on Sabonis until their reserve centers return.

4898371.h: Raynaud has been diagnosed with a right patellar subluxation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
4898371.s: Raynaud was taken back to the locker room in a wheelchair during Saturday's preseason loss to the Warriors, though he has seemingly avoided a serious injury. The big man will still begin the regular season on the inactive list, leaving additional minutes available for the likes of Precious Achiuwa and Dylan Cardwell (rest).

4898371.h: Raynaud suffered a right knee injury during the second quarter of Saturday's preseason game against the Warriors and will not return, Marc J. Spears of ESPN.com reports.
4898371.s: Raynaud appeared to tweak his knee after bumping into Stephen Curry, per Luca Evans of the San Francisco Chronicle. The injury was severe enough for Raynaud that he had to be taken off the floor and into the locker room in a wheelchair, and the Kings should have an update on the second-year center once he undergoes more tests on his knee. An extended absence would mean more minutes at center would be available for…

4898371.h: Raynaud is not in the starting lineup for Saturday's preseason game against the Warriors, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.
4898371.s: Even though Domantas Sabonis (undisclosed) is out Saturday, Raynaud won't start, as Precious Achiuwa will get the nod at center. Raynaud has posted solid numbers in the preseason, tallying 25 points and 18 rebounds across two appearances, and he's expected to see steady minutes in the frontcourt, though he'll mainly operate as Sabonis' backup when the former is healthy.

4900671.h: Mitchell is in the starting lineup for Monday's game against the Suns, Brandon Rahbar of DailyThunder.com reports.
4900671.s: Mitchell will move to the starting lineup and could be in line for a larger role for the foreseeable future since both Jalen Williams (leg) and Cason Wallace (shoulder) are expected to miss most, if not all, of the remainder of the season. Mitchell recorded 18 points (8-14 FG, 1-2 3Pt, 1-1 FT), six rebounds, four assists and three steals in 27 minutes during Sunday's 108-101 win over the Clippers.

4900671.h: Mitchell won't start Tuesday's game against the Spurs, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
4900671.s: Mitchell got the starting nod in Thursday's preseason finale, though Cason Wallace is back in action and starting Tuesday's regular-season opener. Mitchell should play a sizable role for Oklahoma City this season after averaging 13.6 points, 3.6 assists, 3.3 rebounds and 1.2 steals in 25.8 minutes per game across 57 regular-season appearances (16 starts) in the 2025-26 campaign.

4900671.h: Mitchell (rest) is available and starting Thursday's preseason finale against Houston, Jackson Gatlin of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
4900671.s: Mitchell will return from a two-game absence due to rest purposes, resulting in Cason Wallace sliding to the second unit. Mitchell will be joined in the starting five by Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Alex Caruso, Jalen Williams and Isaiah Hartenstein.

4900671.h: Mitchell (rest) won't play in Tuesday's preseason game against the Pacers, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
4900671.s: Mitchell is out for both ends of this back-to-back set. His next chance to play is Thursday against the Rockets.

4900671.h: Mitchell (rest) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Hawks, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
4900671.s: Mitchell and the rest of the Thunder's regulars won't travel to Atlanta for the first half of a back-to-back set, but they're expected to suit up Tuesday, when they host the Pacers. After a breakout 2025-26 campaign, Mitchell is one of the preseason favorites for Sixth Man of the Year.

4903027.h: Coward (wrist) is available for Sunday's game against the Kings.
4903027.s: Coward sat out Friday's 111-108 win over the Warriors with a left wrist sprain, but he's back in the starting lineup after a one-game absence. He started his lone appearance this season, tallying seven points, seven rebounds, two assists and a block in 28 minutes.

4903027.h: Coward (wrist) is questionable for Sunday's game in Sacramento.
4903027.s: Coward sat out Friday's 111-108 win over the Warriors due to the wrist issue, which resulted in GG Jackson drawing the start, and Jerami Grant saw a minor bump in minutes. It will likely be more of the same if Coward gets ruled out again.

4903027.h: Coward (wrist) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Warriors.
4903027.s: Coward will miss Friday's contest due to a left wrist sprain, and his next chance to suit up will come Sunday against Sacramento. With the 23-year-old swingman sidelined, Jerami Grant, Scotty Pippen, Cam Spencer and GG Jackson are all candidates for a bump in minutes.

4903027.h: Coward is doubtful for Friday's game against the Warriors due to a left wrist sprain.
4903027.s: Coward is expected to miss Friday's contest after posting seven points, seven rebounds, two assists and one block across 28 minutes in Wednesday's season-opening win over Utah. If he's ultimately ruled out, Jerami Grant, Cam Spencer and Scotty Pippen would all be candidates to see increased playing time.

4903027.h: The Grizzlies exercised their third-year team option on Coward's contract Tuesday.
4903027.s: Coward is now officially under contract for the 2027-28 campaign after averaging 13.6 points, 5.9 rebounds and 2.8 assists in 25.8 minutes per game across 62 regular-season appearances (47 starts) in his rookie season. The 23-year-old swingman will likely begin the 2026-27 season in the Grizzlies' starting five when they host the Jazz on Wednesday.

4914336.h: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his right knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
4914336.s: It's a tough blow to the Trail Blazers' depth on the wing ahead of training camp. Sharpe, who is now likely to be sidelined until after the All-Star break, had been ticketed for a reserve role behind Toumani Camara following an injury-plagued 2025-26 campaign, which saw Sharpe average a career-high 20.8 points, 1.4 steals and 2.1 three-pointers per game over 50 regular-season appearances. The door is now open for…

4914336.h: Sharpe could face increased competition for offensive opportunities after Portland acquired Ja Morant, according to Robert Ohman of Willamette Week.
4914336.s: Sharpe has been mentioned as a potential trade candidate as the Trail Blazers reshape their roster, though he can provide a scoring punch if he stays in Portland. His long-term upside remains intriguing, but Morant's arrival may cap his usage entering 2026-27.

4917149.h: The Kings signed Ben Simmons to a one-year deal Friday, adding another bench option who will challenge Karaban for playing time.
4917149.s: Simmons will return to The Association after sitting out the 2025-26 campaign. With the three-time All-Star in the mix, Karaban faces increased competition for playing time off the bench. Karaban, the No. 29 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, could see increasingly steady minutes as the season progresses, though the UConn product isn't guaranteed a meaningful role early on, especially if Keegan Murray (ankle) is…

4917149.h: Karaban (ankle) is available for Thursday's Summer League game against the Clippers, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
4917149.s: Karaban was initially expected to miss this game, but he progressed quicker than anticipated. The No. 29 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft could be heavily featured during the Summer League.

4917149.h: Karaban sustained a sprained right ankle in Thursday's practice and will be re-evaluated in one week, Kayla Anderson of Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
4917149.s: Karaban won't play in the California Classic Summer League due to the ankle injury. His next chance to suit up will come in the NBA Summer League game against the Wizards on July 12.

4917149.h: Karaban left Thursday's practice after suffering an ankle injury, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
4917149.s: Karaban appeared to roll his ankle near the end of Thursday's practice, per Nunes, and he was unable to return. He can be considered day-to-day leading up to Sacramento's first Summer League game against Brooklyn on Saturday.

4997526.h: Dieng is in the starting lineup for Wednesday's preseason game against Chicago.
4997526.s: With several Milwaukee regulars resting, Dieng will move into the starting lineup Wednesday. In 30 regular-season appearances (20 starts) with the Bucks last season, the young forward averaged 11.0 points, 4.6 rebounds and 3.6 assists in 26.8 minutes per contest.

4997526.h: Dieng was a DNP-CD during Monday's 116-97 preseason loss to Minnesota.
4997526.s: Dieng was available but didn't see the floor in Milwaukee's first preseason contest. The 23-year-old will look to earn a role in a crowded Bucks frontcourt during the remainder of the preseason.

4997526.h: Dieng signed a three-year, $17.5 million contract with the Bucks on Tuesday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4997526.s: After landing with the Bucks ahead of last season's trade deadline, Dieng will return to Milwaukee on a multi-year pact. The versatile forward averaged 11.0 points, 4.6 rebounds, 3.6 assists, 1.5 triples and 0.8 steals in 26.9 minutes per contest across 30 regular-season games (20 starts) with the Bucks last season, and he should continue seeing significant playing time with the rebuilding club.

4997526.h: The Bucks declined to extend a qualifying offer to Dieng, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports Monday.
4997526.s: Dieng will enter unrestricted free agency, though Scotto added that the Bucks still have significant interest in re-signing the versatile forward. After spending three-plus seasons with the Thunder to begin his career, the 23-year-old was traded multiple times ahead of last season's deadline. He ended up on the Bucks, with whom he averaged 11.0 points, 4.6 rebounds, 3.6 assists and 0.8 steals in 26.9 minutes per…

4997528.h: Jovic will come off the bench in Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Timberwolves, Zachary Weinberger of ClutchPoints.com reports.
4997528.s: Jovic started in Miami's preseason finale with Giannis Antetokounmpo (rest) taking a night off, but Antetokounmpo is back and starting on Opening Night. As a reserve last season, Jovic averaged 7.3 points, 3.3 rebounds and 2.2 assists per game.

4997528.h: Jovic will start in Friday's preseason finale in Orlando, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
4997528.s: Bam Adebayo (rest) and Giannis Antetokounmpo (rest) are sitting out the preseason finale, so Jovic will draw the start and he'll be joined in the first unit by Davion Mitchell, Klay Thompson, Andrew Wiggins and Bobby Portis. In his previous start this preseason, Jovic finished with 14 points, six rebounds, three assists, two triples, two steals and one turnover across 21 minutes.

4997528.h: Jovic is not listed in the starting lineup for Wednesday's preseason game against the Nets.
4997528.s: Jovic got the start in Saturday's preseason loss to Minnesota, finishing with 16 points, six rebounds, three assists and three steals over 25 minutes. He will come off the bench once again Wednesday, though it's not known what his role will be versus Orlando on Friday.

4997528.h: Jovic is in the starting lineup for Saturday's preseason matchup with the Timberwolves, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
4997528.s: Simone Fontecchio, Tre Donaldson, Nikola Jovic, Pelle Larsson and Nick Richards will join Jovic in the first unit for Saturday's exhibition with the regular starters all resting. In Jovic's lone start last season, he produced nine points, three rebounds, two triples, one steal and three turnovers in 23 minutes.

4997536.h: Santos (knee) is available for Monday's game at Denver.
4997536.s: Santos will shed his questionable tag due to left knee tendinitis. He's expected to come off the bench after starting Saturday's loss to the Suns, per Luca Evans of the San Francisco Chronicle.

4997536.h: Santos is questionable for Monday's game against the Nuggets due to left knee tendinitis.
4997536.s: Santos exited Saturday's 131-122 loss to the Suns with an undisclosed injury and did not return, and the questionable tag ahead of Monday's game is an issue for a Warriors team that doesn't have a lot of depth at forward at the moment. If Santos can't play Monday, and knowing that Jimmy Butler (knee) and Moses Moody (knee) remain out, Georges Niang and Gary Payton could be in line to see expanded roles versus Denver.

4997536.h: Santos exited Saturday's 131-122 loss to the Suns with an undisclosed injury and did not return, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.
4997536.s: Santos limped to the locker room during the third quarter, ending his evening with seven points (1-4 FG, 1-2 3Pt, 4-8 FT), four rebounds, three assists and one turnover across 23 minutes. For now, Santos should be considered questionable for Monday's game in Denver.

4997536.h: Santos will start Saturday's game against the Suns, Dalton Johnson of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.
4997536.s: Draymond Green (back) won't play in the second leg of this back-to-back set, opening the door for Santos to rejoin the first unit. He started Wednesday's season-opening loss to the Lakers, posting 12 points, five rebounds and one steal in 25 minutes.

4997536.h: Santos won't start Friday's game against the Grizzlies, Dalton Johnson of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.
4997536.s: Graham Ike will draw his first career start, pushing Santos to the second unit. The 24-year-old forward logged 25 minutes in Wednesday's season-opening loss to the Lakers, posting 12 points, five rebounds and one steal.

4997537.h: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.
4997537.s: Although the big man will remain a limited participant in training camp as he continues his rehab from a hip impingement, it sounds like his absence from game action will extend into the regular season. Deandre Ayton should have the backup center role all to himself until Vukcevic is cleared to return to the floor.

4997537.h: Vukcevic (knee) is unlikely to have a significant role to begin the 2026-27 season.
4997537.s: The Wizards didn't have Anthony Davis (finger) or Alex Sarr (foot) available late last year, allowing Vukcevic to make a career-high 12 starts. This time around, however, Washington boasts a revamped frontcourt that is not only set to feature Davis and Sarr, but it also includes Deandre Ayton as a new face down low. As a result, Vukcevic is likely to be hard-pressed to squeeze into the Opening Night rotation.

4997538.h: Matkovic is not listed in the starting lineup for Friday's preseason game against the Wizards.
4997538.s: Matkovic started in Wednesday's 101-97 preseason victory over the Mavericks. However, he will return to the bench for the Pelicans' final exhibition before they face the Pacers on Opening Night.

5037871.h: The Spurs exercised the team option on Harper for the 2027-28 season, Jared Weiss of The Athletic reports.
5037871.s: Harper had a quality 2025-26 campaign, averaging 11.8 points, 3.4 rebounds and 3.9 assists over 22.6 minutes per contest in 69 regular-season games, including four starts. The 2025 No. 2 overall pick has All-Star upside, though it may take him another year or two before he gets to that point. Harper will presumably continue to come off the bench behind De'Aaron Fox and Stephon Castle in 2026-27, but he should…

5037871.h: Harper (rest) is in the starting lineup for Wednesday's preseason game against Phoenix, Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News reports.
5037871.s: Harper is back in the starting lineup after missing Monday's game for rest purposes. The young guard should see a fair amount of playing time but may have his workload limited in the exhibition.

5037871.h: Harper (rest) won't play in Monday's preseason game against Utah, per Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News.
5037871.s: Harper is joining the rest of the Spurs' regular starters on the sidelines Monday. His next chance to play comes Wednesday against the Suns.

5037871.h: Harper is starting Thursday's game against the Hawks, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
5037871.s: The Spurs are getting a look at a three-guard lineup with De'Aaron Fox and Stephon Castle. It looks like Harper has a chance to start Opening Night with Tobias Harris (calf) injured.

5037871.h: Jared Weiss of the New York Times believes coach Mitch Johnson needs to find ways to increase Harper's minutes this year.
5037871.s: Weiss thinks the optimal way to boost Harper's playing time would be to close games with all three of Harper, De'Aaron Fox and Stephon Castle on the floor. It remains to be seen how willing the Spurs will be to deploy more frequent small-ball looks, as they would then have to squeeze either Devin Vassell or Tobias Harris from the lineup more often. Harper remains one of the favorites for the Sixth Man of the Year…

5037873.h: The Nets assigned Powell to the G League's Long Island Nets on Monday.
5037873.s: Powell will continue his development with Long Island after struggling to carve out a consistent role in Brooklyn's rotation. The second-year wing could return to the NBA roster as needed, but he isn't currently positioned to provide meaningful fantasy production.

5037873.h: Powell (coach's decision) did not play in Wednesday's 110-103 loss to Charlotte.
5037873.s: The second-year wing was excluded from Brooklyn's rotation to begin the campaign. Powell faces competition for perimeter minutes and will need to capitalize on future opportunities to establish a larger role.

5037873.h: Powell (rest) is looking to improve this season following a poor rookie campaign in 2025-26.
5037873.s: Powell struggled to make an impression on either end of the floor during his rookie year, averaging 6.5 points, 1.8 rebounds, 1.4 assists and 0.6 steals per game while shooting just 40.2 percent from the floor over 63 regular-season appearances (24 starts) in 2025-26. While it appears unlikely he'll start the new year in the first unit, Powell should at least have a leg up on veterans Keon Ellis and Terance Mann for…

5037873.h: Powell (rest) won't play in Sunday's Summer League game against the Thunder, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.
5037873.s: Powell will sit out the Nets' Summer League finale. The 2025 first-rounder struggled mightily with efficiency over four Las Vegas Summer League appearances, averaging 7.2 points, 1.8 rebounds, 1.2 steals and 1.0 assists while shooting 25.9 percent from the field in 22.8 minutes per tilt.

5037873.h: Powell will be available for Monday's California Classic Summer League game against the Warriors Blue, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.
5037873.s: Powell skipped Sunday's win over the Bucks, but he'll be back in action for Monday's exhibition. John Ukomadu will likely return to the second unit with Powell active.

5037878.h: Onyenso agreed to a two-way contract with the Pistons on Thursday.
5037878.s: The No. 53 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, Onyenso appears poised to see run in the G League after putting pen to paper on a two-way deal. He'll likely face an uphill battle to carve out a role in the rotation, so Detroit will presumably allow him to continue his development with Motor City.

5041939.h: Flagg (shoulder) is active for Monday's game against the Heat.
5041939.s: Despite being diagnosed with a mild left shoulder sprain that forced him to miss Saturday's loss to the Spurs and being considered a true game-time call by coach Dusty May, Flagg will play versus Miami. It doesn't sound like he'll have any restrictions following the one-game absence, and his return will likely send Zaccharie Risacher back to the bench.

5041939.h: Head coach Dusty May said Flagg is a game-time decision for Monday's matchup against the Heat, though May expects the second-year forward to play, Eddie Sefko of the Mavericks' official site reports.
5041939.s: Flagg suffered a left shoulder sprain in Friday's win over Indiana, though he's trending in the right direction after being held out of Saturday's loss to the Spurs. If the star forward is cleared to return to action, there would be fewer minutes available for guys like Sergio de Larrea, Jett Howard and Zaccharie Risacher.

5041939.h: Flagg (shoulder) has been upgraded to probable for Monday against the Heat, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.
5041939.s: Flagg was carrying a questionable tag prior to this update with his mild shoulder sprain. He made it through the morning shootaround with no setbacks, however, and the Mavericks are now preparing for their star forward to suit up. For now, there's no word of potential restrictions.

5041939.h: Flagg (shoulder) was spotted going through Monday's morning shootaround, Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com reports.
5041939.s: Given the circumstances of the injury, it's quite remarkable to see Flagg doing so well. He was diagnosed with a sprain Saturday, but the injury seems to be progressing, and it's being described as a mild issue. He remains listed as questionable on the injury report.

5041939.h: Flagg (shoulder) is questionable to play Monday against the Heat.
5041939.s: The Mavericks diagnosed Flagg with a mild left shoulder sprain Saturday, and the questionable tag suggests a final call on his availability will be made closer to Monday's 7:30 p.m. ET tipoff. With Naji Marshall (illness) already ruled out, Marcus Sasser and Zaccharie Risacher would be the top candidates to start if Flagg is ruled out for Monday's road game.

5041951.h: Thomas (coach's decision) did not play in Thursday's 114-106 loss to Philadelphia.
5041951.s: The rookie guard was left out of Cleveland's initial rotation, with Craig Porter and Tyrese Proctor both receiving playing time off the bench. Thomas showed scoring potential during the preseason, but he'll need to work his way into coach Kenny Atkinson's rotation before becoming a viable fantasy option.

5041951.h: Thomas (rest) won't play in Wednesday's Summer League game against the Pelicans, per Danny Cunningham of Sports Radio 92.3 The Fan Cleveland.
5041951.s: The Cavaliers are monitoring the rookie second-rounder's reps Wednesday after he exploded for 35 points (14-23 FG, 5-9 3Pt, 1-1 FT) during Monday's 90-73 Summer League win over the Heat. His next chance to play comes during Friday's matchup with the Bulls.

5041953.h: The Suns are shutting down Peat (rest) for the remainder of the Las Vegas Summer League, per John Gambadoro of Arizona Sports 98.7 FM.
5041953.s: Peat wraps up a promising Las Vegas Summer League run, producing at least 12 points, six rebounds and two steals in each of his three appearances. The rookie first-rounder is set to compete with the likes of Haywood Highsmith and Ryan Dunn for a reserve role with the Suns during training camp.

5041955.h: Peterson has impressed veteran teammate Jusuf Nurkic with his maturity and work ethic during training camp, according to Jazz reporter Chandler Holt.
5041955.s: Nurkic said that in 13 NBA seasons he hasn't seen a player enter the league with Peterson's level of maturity, adding that the rookie spends so much time working that Utah has nearly had to tell him to stay out of the gym. Peterson is preparing for his first NBA season after being selected No. 2 overall in the 2026 NBA Draft and should have an opportunity to take on a substantial role immediately.

5041955.h: Peterson (rest) is set to compete for a starting role during training camp in the fall.
5041955.s: The rookie No. 2 overall pick has Ace Bailey to overcome for the top spot at shooting guard with the Jazz. Whether he starts or comes off the bench right off the bat, Peterson is certainly primed for a significant role for Utah in 2026-27. Over five Summer League appearances, the 19-year-old stood out with averages of 23.0 points, 5.2 assists, 3.2 rebounds, 1.2 blocks and 1.0 steals per game.

5041955.h: Peterson (rest) is out for Friday's Summer League game against Portland, per Ben Anderson of KSL News Salt Lake City.
5041955.s: Peterson is sitting out Utah's Summer League finale Friday. The rookie first-rounder is primed for a significant role with the Jazz in 2026-27.

5041955.h: Peterson (rest) is available to play in Wednesday's Summer League game against the Spurs, Ben Anderson of KSL News Salt Lake City reports.
5041955.s: After getting a maintenance day Monday, Peterson will be back in action. The rookie is averaging 22.3 points and 5.5 assists through four exhibitions.

5044385.h: Miller (groin) is available for Wednesday's regular-season opener in Toronto.
5044385.s: Miller made some noise in December last season, averaging 16.1 points, 7.9 rebounds, 1.6 triples and 0.9 blocks per contest on 58/41/67 shooting splits through the final seven games of the year. It'll be interesting to see what his role looks like in the rotation while Nic Claxton (hamstring) is out.

5044385.h: Miller is probable for Wednesday's game against the Raptors with a right adductor strain.
5044385.s: This is a new injury for Miller, though it sounds minor. The Bulls have quite a few injuries, so Miller could be in the mix for a rotation spot after a strong showing in the preseason.

5060701.h: Anderson (ankle) is available for Saturday's game against the Heat.
5060701.s: As expected, Anderson will ditch his probable tag due to a left ankle sprain. He's averaging 1.0 points, 2.0 assists and 1.5 combined steals-plus-blocks while shooting 12.5 percent from the field in 14.5 minutes per game across two regular-season outings, and he'll likely continue to back up Dennis Schroder until Coby White (calf) returns.

5060701.h: Anderson (ankle) is probable for Saturday's game against the Heat.
5060701.s: The rookie first-rounder was dealing with an ankle injury during the preseason, and he may have slightly aggravated the issue during the Hornets' 128-81 loss to the Hawks on Friday, when he played 16 minutes and finished with two points, two assists and one block. The injury doesn't appear to be a long-term concern for Anderson, and he's expected to be available for Saturday's contest.

5060701.h: Anderson (ankle) is available for Wednesday's preseason game against the Celtics.
5060701.s: Anderson has recovered from a left ankle injury. The rookie first-rounder is making his preseason debut as he battles for an Opening Night role.

5060701.h: Anderson (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's preseason game against Milwaukee.
5060701.s: Anderson will miss a second straight game due to a left ankle sprain. His next chance to suit up will come in Wednesday's exhibition against the Celtics.

5060701.h: Anderson (ankle) won't play in Tuesday's preseason game against the Nets.
5060701.s: The Hornets are taking a cautious approach with the rookie first-rounder, who suffered an ankle sprain in practice. His next chance to play comes Sunday against the Bucks.

5061568.h: The Spurs exercised the team option on Bryant for the 2027-28 season, Jared Weiss of The Athletic reports.
5061568.s: Bryant, the 2025 No. 14 overall pick, appeared in 71 regular-season games as a rookie in 2025-26. He got off to a slow start but demonstrated signs of growth by ending the year averaging 7.0 points and 1.9 assists in seven regular-season appearances in April. Bryant should be more productive in 2026-27, though the verdict is still out regarding just how high his ceiling can be at the professional level. The Spurs…

5061568.h: Carter (ankle) is available for Wednesday's preseason game against Phoenix, Paul Garcia of ProjectSpurs.com reports.
5061568.s: Bryant didn't play in Monday's preseason meeting with the Jazz. However, he is cleared to return Wednesday versus the Suns.

5061568.h: Bryant (ankle) won't play in Monday's preseason game against Utah, per Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News.
5061568.s: Bryant exited Saturday's preseason loss to Phoenix after rolling his right ankle in the first half and did not return, so the Spurs are giving him a day to recover Monday. His next chance to play comes Wednesday against the Suns.

5061568.h: Bryant exited Saturday's 102-98 preseason loss to Phoenix after rolling his right ankle in the first half and did not return, Jeff McDonald of the San Antonio Express-News reports.
5061568.s: Bryant suffered the injury after stepping on teammate Devin Vassell's foot and was subsequently ruled out for the remainder of the contest. However, McDonald suggested the decision was precautionary rather than indicative of a serious injury, while coach Mitch Johnson also characterized the early exit as precautionary. The second-year forward's status for Monday's preseason matchup against Utah remains uncertain,…

5061568.h: Bryant (rest) won't play in Sunday's Summer League game against the Bucks, Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News reports.
5061568.s: Bryant will sit out the second leg of this back-to-back set, and it's possible the Spurs have seen enough from him this summer after he appeared in the team's first two Las Vegas Summer League games. His next opportunity to play will come Wednesday against the Jazz.

5061575.h: Knueppel (hamstring) is without a timetable for a return, Rod Boone of The Charlotte Observer reports.
5061575.s: Knueppel has yet to take the floor this season while on the mend from a left hamstring strain, and at this point in time, the team isn't ready to commit to a return date. Coach Charles Lee stated before Monday's game against Washington that he could have more clarity on the plan for Knueppel following the two-game road trip, which wraps up Friday in Washington.

5061575.h: Knueppel (hamstring) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Wizards.
5061575.s: Knueppel will miss a fourth straight outing due to a left hamstring strain, with his next chance to play coming Wednesday at Detroit. The second-year swingman's continued absence will leave additional playing time available for the likes of Sion James and Grayson Allen.

5061575.h: Knueppel (hamstring) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Heat.
5061575.s: Knueppel will miss a third consecutive contest due to a left hamstring strain. The second-year swingman has been ramping up toward a return, and his next opportunity to play will come Monday against the Wizards.

5061575.h: Knueppel (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Hawks.
5061575.s: Knueppel can be treated as day-to-day while he recovers from a preseason hamstring strain. He'll miss a second regular-season game Friday, but the sharpshooter has been ramping up and taking more contact at recent practices. With Knueppel sidelined, Grayson Allen should be rostered in the majority of fantasy formats as a high-end streaming option.

5061575.h: Knueppel (hamstring) has returned to individual on-court activity but won't play in Wednesday's game against the Nets.
5061575.s: Knueppel didn't play in the preseason and will miss Wednesday's regular-season opener due to a left hamstring injury. However, he's trending in the right direction and can be considered questionable for Friday's game against Atlanta. With the 21-year-old swingman sidelined, Sion James, Grayson Allen (knee) and Royce O'Neale are candidates to see an uptick in minutes.

5061585.h: Evans agreed to a four-year, $9.3 million deal with Minnesota on Sunday, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.
5061585.s: Evans, the No. 33 overall pick in the 2026 NBA draft, is coming off his best collegiate season. In 38 appearances with the Blue Devils in 2025-26, which includes four NCAA Tournament games, the 20-year-old averaged 15.0 points, 3.2 rebounds, 1.3 assists, 0.7 blocks and 0.7 steals across 28.2 minutes. Evans was projected to be selected earlier in the draft, potentially somewhere in the first round. However, he is now…

5061589.h: Missi has been diagnosed with a left knee bone bruise and will miss an extended period of time, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
5061589.s: Missi currently has no official timetable for his return, but he appears likely to miss significant time. Derik Queen could be elevated into a starting role while Missi is sidelined, so make sure the former is not floating around on your waiver wire. Missi doesn't offer enough upside to warrant holding onto in redraft fantasy leagues.

5061589.h: Missi (knee) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Nuggets.
5061589.s: Missi exited Friday's loss to the Jazz with what the Pelicans are now calling a left knee bone bruise. His next chance to suit up will come in Wednesday's rematch against Denver. In the meantime, Derik Queen and Karlo Matkovic are candidates to see increased playing time.

5061589.h: Missi won't return to Friday's game against the Jazz due to a left knee injury.
5061589.s: Missi needed to be helped to the locker room after colliding with Zion Williamson, and while we don't know the extent of this knee injury, getting ruled out so quickly is not encouraging. If he needs to miss time, Derik Queen and Herbert Jones would benefit.

5061589.h: Missi was helped to the locker room in the second quarter of Friday's game against the Jazz due to an apparent left leg injury, Shreyas Laddha of The Salt Lake Tribune reports.
5061589.s: Zion Williamson appeared to collide with Missi's leg, and the 22-year-old center required assistance getting back to the locker room. If he's unable to return, Derik Queen figures to see increased playing time the rest of the way.

5061589.h: The Pelicans exercised their fourth-year team option on Missi's contract Tuesday, Terry Kimble of SI.com reports.
5061589.s: Missi is now under contract for the 2027-28 campaign. He's expected to open the 2026-27 campaign as the Pelicans' starting center after averaging 5.7 points, 5.8 rebounds, 1.5 blocks and 1.3 assists in 19.7 minutes per game across 66 regular-season appearances (14 starts) last season.

5061603.h: Sorber (knee) is out for Monday's game versus the Suns, per Andrew Schlecht of The Athletic.
5061603.s: It appeared earlier Monday on the Thunder's injury report that Sorber was ready to make his season debut, but it was a clerical error. Sorber's return timeline remains in the dark due to offseason knee surgery.

5061603.h: Sorber (knee) is available for Monday's game against the Suns.
5061603.s: Sorber is no longer on the injury report for the Thunder. With how impressive Aday Mara has been in limited run, Sorber is unlikely to crack the rotation right away.

5061603.h: Sorber (knee) is listed as out for Thursday's game against Denver.
5061603.s: Sorber is still working his way back from offseason knee surgery and remains without a firm return date. He should be considered week-to-week until there is a more definitive update.

5061603.h: Sorber (knee) won't play in Tuesday's season opener against the Spurs, Justin Martinez of The Oklahoman reports.
5061603.s: Sorber remains without a definitive timeline for his season debut following offseason knee surgery. Once cleared to play, he's expected to operate as frontcourt depth for Oklahoma City.

5061603.h: Sorber (knee) has been ruled out for Thursday's preseason game against the Rockets, Justin Martinez of The Oklahoman reports.
5061603.s: Sorber will end up missing the entire preseason while recovering from arthroscopic knee surgery he underwent July 1. His next chance to play will come in Tuesday's regular-season opener against San Antonio, though he isn't expected to be a part of the rotation.

5082206.h: Burries (coach's decision) is in the starting lineup for Wednesday's preseason game against Chicago.
5082206.s: Burries was unavailable Sunday but will move into the starting lineup Wednesday with several Milwaukee regulars resting. The guard figures to open the regular season in a reserve role but should compete for significant playing time after being selected No. 10 overall in the 2026 NBA Draft.

5082206.h: Burries will not play in Sunday's preseason game against the Hornets due to a coach's decision, Justin Garcia of the Milwaukee Bucks Radio Network reports.
5082206.s: Burries played well in Milwaukee's preseason game Wednesday, logging 16 points, five rebounds, two steals and an assist in 21 minutes, but he will sit out of Sunday's matchup with the Hornets. His next opportunity to play comes Wednesday against the Bulls.

5082206.h: Burries (rest) is not playing in Wednesday's Summer League game against the Hornets, Eric Nehm of The Athletic reports.
5082206.s: Burries, Kasparas Jakucionis and Cormac Ryan are all sidelined for Wednesday's contest. The rest of the Summer League schedule has yet to be finalized, but Burries and the Bucks figure to play their next game Saturday against a team to be announced.

5093267.h: The Raptors exercised their third-year team option on Murray-Boyles' contract Tuesday, Vivek Jacob of the Raptors' official site reports.
5093267.s: Murray-Boyles is coming off a productive rookie campaign, averaging 8.5 points, 5.0 rebounds, 1.9 assists and 1.8 combined steals-plus-blocks in 21.9 minutes per game across 57 regular-season appearances (22 starts). The 2025 No. 9 overall pick is set to play a sizable role as one of the first men off Toronto's bench in 2026-27, and he'll likely step into the starting lineup if Kawhi Leonard or Jakob Poeltl miss…

5093267.h: Murray-Boyles (rest) is expected to play in Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Bulls.
5093267.s: Murray-Boyles got the night off Friday, though he should be back in action when the Raptors host the Bulls. The 21-year-old averaged 8.5 points, 5.0 rebounds, 1.9 assists and 1.8 combined steals-plus-blocks in 21.9 minutes per game across 57 regular-season appearances (22 starts) in his rookie campaign, and he figures to see increased burn in 2026-27.

5093267.h: Murray-Boyles is sitting out Friday's preseason game against the Pistons for rest, Josh Lewenberg of TSN.ca reports.
5093267.s: Toronto is sitting regulars for the preseason finale, giving the main pieces of the rotation time to rest up for Wednesday's season opener against the Bulls.

5093267.h: Raptors head coach Darko Rajakovic said Monday that Murray-Boyles will see time at both power forward and center this season, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.
5093267.s: Rajakovic added that Murray-Boyles could play alongside Jakob Poeltl at times, giving Toronto the option of using a bigger frontcourt. The second-year forward's ability to handle minutes at multiple positions could help him carve out a significant role in the Raptors' rotation, and he's likely to generate some buzz in fantasy drafts this year. There was also no mention of Murray-Boyles' sprained finger from Summer…

5093267.h: Murray-Boyles (finger) won't play in Sunday's Summer League game against the Nuggets, Zulfi Sheikh of sportsnet reports.
5093267.s: Murray-Boyles will miss all the Raptors' Las Vegas Summer League games due to a sprained finger. The 21-year-old big man was productive on both ends of the floor in his rookie campaign, and he figures to continue seeing meaningful playing time in 2026-27.

5099752.h: Rupert and the 76ers agreed to a two-way contract Friday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
5099752.s: A 2023 second-round pick, Rupert split his time between Portland and Memphis last season. Across 64 regular-season games, he averaged 5.2 points, 2.9 rebounds and 1.1 assists.

5101761.h: Head coach Jordi Fernandez said Brown (rest) will be held out of Sunday's game against the Pacers, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.
5101761.s: Brown missed time in the preseason with an ankle injury and will sit out the second leg of this back-to-back set after posting eight points (3-10 FG, 2-6 3Pt), five assists, two rebounds and two steals across 20 minutes in Saturday's 125-121 loss to Cleveland. The rookie guard's next chance to play will come Tuesday at Boston, though he's expected to continue facing restrictions for the time being.

5101761.h: Nets coach Jordi Fernandez said Brown will continue to have restrictions going forward, C.J. Holmes of the New York Daily News reports.
5101761.s: "At some point he'll be able to play more minutes, he'll be able to play back-to-backs, but it's not right now," Fernandez said. Brown had six points (2-8 FG, 1-3 3Pt, 1-1 FT), three rebounds and three assists across 20 minutes during Wednesday's 110-103 loss to Charlotte, but his fantasy managers will need to exercise a lot of patience in the early going.

5101761.h: Brown will remain on a minutes restriction for Wednesday's regular-season opener against Charlotte, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.
5101761.s: Coach Jordi Fernandez indicated that he wouldn't be comfortable starting a player until cleared to exceed 24 minutes, a threshold Brown has yet to reach. The rookie guard made his preseason debut Wednesday against Miami after missing Brooklyn's first three exhibition games with an ankle injury, recording 15 points, three rebounds, two assists and two steals in 18 minutes. Brown is expected to begin the season in a…

5101761.h: Brown (ankle) is available for Wednesday's preseason game against the Heat, per Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com.
5101761.s: This was the expectation after Brown missed the start of the preseason with an ankle injury. The rookie first-rounder is set to make his first appearance at the professional level Thursday as he aims to begin the year as a starter for the Nets.

5101761.h: Brown (ankle) is out for Monday's preseason game against the Wizards, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.
5101761.s: Brown has yet to suit up during the preseason as he continues to work his way back from a left ankle issue. His final chance to get in an exhibition is Wednesday against the Heat, a game he's targeting for his return after going through a scrimmage Monday morning.

5101845.h: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
5101845.s: The Spurs are expected to exercise extreme caution with the big man, as Quaintance suffered a torn ACL and meniscus with Arizona State in February 2025 before appearing in only four games with Kentucky last season due to severe complications and persistent swelling. The 19-year-old underwent a cleanup procedure on his meniscus in mid-July, and the Spurs will likely want him at 100 percent before ramping him up to…

5101845.h: Quaintance underwent right knee surgery Wednesday and has no timetable for a return, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
5101845.s: The rookie center faced severe complications and persistent knee swelling last season following February 2025 ACL surgery, and a follow-up procedure was required. It remains to be seen how long he will be sidelined, but this certainly puts his status for training camp in doubt.

5101845.h: Quaintance (knee) won't play in Summer League action, per NBA reporter Matthew Tynan.
5101845.s: Quaintance is traveling with the Spurs, but it appears that the team is taking a cautious approach with the rookie first-rounder. The 18-year-old big man faced severe complications and persistent knee swelling last season following February 2025 ACL surgery, and it remains uncertain if he'll be a full participant for training camp this fall.

5104155.h: Coulibaly is in the starting lineup for Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Bucks.
5104155.s: Fantasy managers will have to wait at least one more game for rookie No. 1 overall pick AJ Dybantsa (ankle) to make his highly anticipated NBA debut, with Coulibaly getting the nod in the first unit for Opening Night. The third-year forward can struggle with his shooting efficiency at times, but Coulibaly is capable of contributing across the board and makes sense as a plug-and-play fantasy option Wednesday.

5104157.h: Wembanyama (rest) will play Wednesday against the Suns, Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News reports.
5104157.s: Wembanyama is back in the lineup after missing the Spurs' last preseason game for rest purposes. He should see some action in the first half.

5104157.h: Wembanyama (rest) will not play in Monday's preseason matchup against the Jazz, Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News reports.
5104157.s: The Spurs planned to rest several regulars against Utah before the preseason began, so Wembanyama's absence appears to be a routine precaution rather than an injury-related concern. San Antonio will also sit Stephon Castle, De'Aaron Fox, Dylan Harper and Devin Vassell, among others. Wembanyama's next opportunity to play will come Wednesday against the Suns.

5105337.h: Brown (back) is out for Thursday's preseason game against the Hawks, Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News reports.
5105337.s: Brown is dealing with some tightness, so this sounds like a precaution. The No. 44 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft is not expected to crack the rotation on Opening Night.

5105462.h: Saunders' (knee) role with Memphis remains unclear as the Grizzlies work through a roster crunch ahead of the regular season, according to Jonah Dylan of The Memphis Commercial Appeal.
5105462.s: President of basketball operations Zach Kleiman characterized the situation as "wait and see" Wednesday. Saunders was selected by Memphis in the second round of the 2026 NBA Draft but remains unsigned, leaving his immediate future uncertain as the Grizzlies sort through a logjam at the back end of their roster.

5105550.h: Jackson will come off the bench during Sunday's game against the Kings, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
5105550.s: Jackson got the start Friday due to Cedric Coward (wrist) being out, but the former will return to a reserve role Sunday, with the latter back in action. In two appearances, Jackson is averaging 7.0 points, 6.0 rebounds and 1.0 blocks in 17.0 minutes per contest.

5105550.h: Jackson will start Friday against the Warriors, Damichael Cole of The Memphis Commercial Appeal reports.
5105550.s: Jackson is getting the start with Cedric Coward (wrist) unavailable, and he'll be joined in the first unit by Ty Jerome, Jaylen Wells, Cameron Boozer and Zach Edey. As a starter last season, Jackson averaged 16.0 points, 5.4 rebounds, 1.8 assists, 1.6 triples and 1.0 blocks per game on 50/39/77 shooting splits.

5105550.h: Jackson (ankle) is off the injury report for Wednesday's season opener against the Jazz.
5105550.s: Jackson is good to go for the start of the season after dealing with a tweaked ankle. He's battling with Taylor Hendricks and Olivier-Maxence Prosper for playing time in the frontcourt in the early going.

5105550.h: Jackson has been ruled out for Friday's exhibition against the Hornets due to an ankle injury, Chris Herrington of The Daily Memphian reports.
5105550.s: Head coach Tuomas Iisalo said that Jackson tweaked his ankle during Friday's preseason win over the Bulls, so he'll miss Friday's preseason finale and will be listed as "day-to-day." For now, he should be considered questionable for Wednesday's regular season opener against the Jazz.

5105550.h: With Cameron Boozer, Karim Lopez (undisclosed) and Jerami Grant now in the mix, Jackson faces increased competition for playing time in the 2026-27 campaign.
5105550.s: The Grizzlies are expected to focus on developing their young talent this season, though Jackson still faces plenty of competition for minutes. Memphis drafted Boozer and Lopez in June before acquiring Grant in the Ja Morant deal later that month. Jackson has flashed potential throughout his time in the NBA, which the Grizzlies rewarded this summer by exercising his $2.4 million team option. The 21-year-old's…

5105553.h: Phillips (illness) is available for Wednesday's game against Dallas.
5105553.s: Phillips will shake off his questionable tag for Wednesday's regular-season opener. However, the two-way player isn't likely to be part of the Rockets' rotation.

5105553.h: The Rockets converted Phillips' deal to a two-way contract Monday, per Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com.
5105553.s: Phillips is set to begin the season with Houston after working with a training camp pact. Most of his playing time should come with the G League's Rio Grande Valley Vipers.

5105553.h: Phillips signed a training camp contract with the Rockets on Friday, Paul Garcia of The Spot Up Shot reports.
5105553.s: Phillips will join the Rockets for training camp and compete for a spot on the club's regular-season roster. The 22-year-old forward was traded from the Bulls to the Timberwolves ahead of last season's trade deadline, though Minnesota declined its $2.41 million team option on his contract for 2026-27. Over 48 regular-season appearances (two starts) in 2025-26, he averaged 2.9 points in 8.9 minutes per showing.

5105553.h: The Timberwolves are declining Phillips' $2.41 million team option for the 2026-27 season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.
5105553.s: Phillips spent the first two-and-a-half years of his NBA career with the Bulls before being traded to the Timberwolves in February. He served in a minor role off the bench for both teams and was limited to garbage-time minutes during Minnesota's playoff run. Once free agency officially begins, Phillips will have the opportunity to catch on with a team looking for depth on the wing.

5105555.h: Awaka (knee) is available for Friday's game versus the Bucks.
5105555.s: The rookie big man is good to go for the front end of this back-to-back set. With Nic Claxton (hamstring) still sidelined, Awaka should share the backup center minutes with Zach Collins.

5105555.h: Awaka (knee) is probable for Friday's game against the Bucks.
5105555.s: Awaka is likely to be available off the bench for the first leg of this back-to-back set. The rookie big man played 14 minutes in Wednesday's blowout loss to Toronto, so it remains to be seen if he'll handle a similar workload in more competitive games.

5105555.h: Awaka (knee) is available to play Wednesday against the Raptors.
5105555.s: Awaka was listed as probable, and now we have official confirmation that he'll be out there. With Nic Claxton (hamstring) out to begin the year, Awaka will have a chance to get into the rotation for Chicago.

5105555.h: Awaka (knee) is probable for Wednesday's game against the Raptors.
5105555.s: Awaka remains day-to-day with his knee sprain. With Nic Claxton (hamstring) sidelined to open the season, Awaka could be in the mix at the edge of the rotation.

5105555.h: Awaka (knee) is out for Friday's preseason finale versus Minnesota, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.
5105555.s: Awaka will miss Chicago's final two preseason games due to the knee injury, but for what it's worth, head coach Tiago Splitter said he's "close" to a return. The Bulls open their season Tuesday in Toronto, and for now, Awaka should be considered questionable for that game.

5105571.h: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.
5105571.s: Veesaar suffered the injury during a Sept. 15 workout, and an MRI confirmed the diagnosis. The No. 52 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, Veesaar was expected to spend a lot of time with Atlanta's G League affiliate this season.

5105592.h: Whitmore made a strong impression on head coach David Adelman during the Nuggets' first day of training camp, standing out alongside Aaron Gordon, Ryan Blackburn of MileHighSports.com reports.
5105592.s: The 22-year-old has received plenty of praise since joining Denver on a two-way contract, and a strong camp could help him push for a spot in the rotation. Whitmore averaged 9.2 points and 2.8 rebounds in 16.9 minutes across 21 regular-season appearances for Washington last season and is looking to take advantage of a fresh start in Denver.

5105592.h: Whitmore agreed to a two-way contract with the Nuggets on Friday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
5105592.s: Whitmore, who is entering his fourth NBA season, holds career averages of 10.5 points and 3.3 rebounds across 119 games. He figures to spend a lot of team with Denver's G League affiliate, but the 2023 first-round pick does have the talent to break into the Nuggets' rotation if he finds his footing.

5105592.h: Whitmore (shoulder) was waived by the Cavaliers on Friday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
5105592.s: Whitmore was traded to Cleveland on Aug. 19 as part of the multi-team deal that sent Peyton Watson (hamstring) to the Cavaliers. However, Whitmore will now have to explore other opportunities if he clears waivers. The 22-year-old forward's 2025-26 campaign with the Wizards was cut short due to deep vein thrombosis in his right shoulder, and he finished the season with averages of 9.2 points and 2.8 rebounds in 16.9…

5105592.h: Whitmore (shoulder) was dealt to Cleveland on Wednesday as a part of a multi-team trade between the Cavaliers, Wizards, Nuggets and Clippers involving Peyton Watson (hamstring), Max Strus, Tre Mann and picks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
5105592.s: After being drafted by the Rockets in the first round of the 2023 NBA Draft, Whitmore will now suit up for his third NBA team. The 22-year-old had his best campaign as a rookie, when he averaged a career-high 12.3 points and 3.8 rebounds across 18.7 minutes in 47 regular-season games. Since then, his production has decreased. Whitmore will have a fresh start in Cleveland, though he is likely not close to securing a…

5105623.h: Ware is not listed in the starting lineup for Sunday's preseason game against the Hornets, Sam Perley of the Hornets' official site reports.
5105623.s: Ware started in Wednesday's 128-126 preseason win over the Thunder, finishing with an 18-point, 12-rebound double-double. He will come off the bench Sunday, with Kyle Kuzma moving into the starting lineup for Milwaukee's preseason meeting with Charlotte.

5105623.h: Ware will start Wednesday's preseason game against the Thunder.
5105623.s: Ware came off the bench and posted a double-double during his Bucks debut, and he'll now supplant Kyle Kuzma in the starting lineup for Milwaukee's second exhibition game. Ware started 35 regular-season games for the Heat last year, averaging 12.8 points, 11.0 rebounds, 0.9 assists, 1.3 blocks and 0.8 steals per game.

5105623.h: Ware has a clearer path to playing time on the Bucks and should have a better opportunity to find firmer footing than he had with Miami, per Zach Kram of ESPN.
5105623.s: Ware flashed potential in his first two years in the Association with Miami, and he averaged 11.1 points, 9.0 rebounds, 1.9 combined steals-plus-blocks and 0.7 assists in 22.1 minutes per game across 77 regular-season appearances (34 starts) in 2025-26. The big man also shot an impressive 39.5 percent from downtown on 3.0 three-point tries per contest last season. He was dealt to Milwaukee as part of the Giannis…

5105626.h: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Indiana.
5105626.s: Bilodeau will miss a third straight game to begin the regular season due to a right shoulder sprain. The two-way player's absence shouldn't affect the rotation.

5105626.h: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Saturday's game in Cleveland.
5105626.s: This will be Bilodeau's second straight game off the court. His next chance to play will come Sunday against the Pacers.

5105626.h: Bilodeau will miss the regular-season opener against the Hornets on Wednesday due to a shoulder sprain, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports.
5105626.s: Bilodeau is on a two-way contract and was unlikely to crack the rotation right away. He'll likely get plenty of G League reps once he's healthy.

5105626.h: Bliodeau's (rest) first NBA season is set to come as a two-way player in 2026-27.
5105626.s: The Nets grabbed Bliodeau in the second round of the draft earlier this summer and quickly signed the rookie to a two-way contract thereafter. That said, the 22-year-old figures to spend most his time developing with the G League's Long Island Nets and is likely to have a hard time mustering much fantasy relevance in 2026-27.

5105626.h: Bilodeau (rest) won't play in Sunday's Summer League game against the Thunder, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.
5105626.s: Bilodeau will be held out of the Nets' Summer League finale. In four Las Vegas Summer League games, the two-way player averaged 4.2 points and 2.8 rebounds in 19.6 minutes per showing.

5105637.h: Bona produced three rebounds, one assist and one block across 10 minutes during Tuesday's 106-100 victory over the Knicks.
5105637.s: Bona was available after dealing with a left foot sprain during the preseason, but his role was minimal behind Joel Embiid, who logged 33 minutes. The reserve center made his presence felt defensively with a block, though he didn't receive any offensive opportunities. Bona's fantasy value remains heavily dependent on additional playing time, particularly when Embiid is unavailable.

5105637.h: Bona (foot) is available for Tuesday's game against the Knicks.
5105637.s: Across 71 regular-season games (18 starts) in 2025-26, Bona averaged 4.8 points, 4.3 rebounds and 1.2 blocks, providing solid rim protection and defense behind Joel Embiid and the departed Andre Drummond. With Drummond now in New York and Ariel Hukporti (Achilles) already out for the season, Bona is primed to earn the backup center spot and has the opportunity to see a career high in minutes in 2026-27, especially…

5105637.h: Bona (foot) is questionable for Tuesday's game against the Knicks, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.
5105637.s: Bona missed the preseason due to the foot issue, but he was able to get in a full practice Sunday, so he appears to be trending in the right direction. If Bona is cleared for Tuesday's season opener, he'll play limited minutes behind Joel Embiid.

5105637.h: Bona (foot) was a full participant in Sunday's practice, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.
5105637.s: Bona didn't suit up in the preseason due to a foot injury, though this update bodes well for his status ahead of Tuesday's regular-season opener versus the Knicks. The big man will likely have a chance to carve out a meaningful role behind Joel Embiid to begin the season, especially if Dominick Barlow (back) misses time.

5105637.h: Bona (foot) remains out for Friday's preseason finale against the Celtics, but he's getting closer to a return, Kyle Neubeck of AllPHLY.com reports.
5105637.s: Bona has yet to appear in the preseason and will now miss the final exhibition. He did go through practice Thursday, however, giving him a chance to suit up for Opening Night as the backup center.

5105806.h: Howard (calf) is available for Saturday's game against the Spurs.
5105806.s: Howard had been listed as probable in the latest update, so it's not surprising to see him available for this contest. He was ruled out for the first two games of the season, and it remains to be seen whether he'll get any meaningful minutes Saturday.

5105806.h: Howard (calf) has been upgraded to probable ahead of Saturday's meeting with the Spurs.
5105806.s: Howard was listed as doubtful, but shootaround must have gone well with the upgrade to probable. He's not guaranteed minutes in the rotation, though.

5105806.h: Howard (calf) is listed as doubtful against the Spurs on Saturday.
5105806.s: Howard is tracking toward missing each of the first three games of the regular season while tending to a right calf injury. Assuming he's ruled out, the fourth year pro's next opportunity to make his 2026-27 regular-season debut would be Monday against the Heat.

5105806.h: Howard (calf) is out for Friday's game in Indiana.
5105806.s: This will be Howard's second straight game on the sidelines. His next chance to play will come Saturday against the Spurs.

5105806.h: Howard (calf) is listed as doubtful for Friday's game against the Pacers.
5105806.s: Howard is expected to miss a second consecutive contest due to right calf tightness. His potential absence wouldn't cause any significant waves in the rotation.

5105809.h: Reed could have a hard time cracking San Antonio's Opening Night rotation.
5105809.s: Reed lines up as the Spurs' third-string center behind Victor Wembanyama and Luke Kornet in 2026-27. Jayden Quaintance's status for the start of his rookie season appears to be in serious doubt due to offseason knee surgery, but Reed is still likely to need an injury to either Wembanyama or Kornet in order to come into legitimate fantasy relevance.

5105809.h: Reed (rest) won't play in Saturday's Summer League game against the Suns, Paul Garcia of ProjectSpurs.com reports.
5105809.s: Reed will hit the inactive list for the Spurs' Summer League finale. The rookie first-rounder will finish the Las Vegas Summer League with averages of 7.7 points, 8.7 rebounds, 2.3 assists and 0.7 steals in 23.1 minutes per game across three outings.

5105809.h: Reed (rest) won't suit up for Sunday's Las Vegas Summer League game against the Bucks, Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News reports.
5105809.s: It's the second night of a back-to-back set, so Reed will get hit with a maintenance day. He should return for Wednesday's meeting with the Jazz.

5105809.h: Reed will play in Monday's California Classic Summer League game against the Lakers, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
5105809.s: Reed did not play in Sunday's California Classic Summer League game for rest purposes, but he will return to action Monday. Reed logged 10 points (3-10 FG, 0-1 3Pt, 3-3 FT), seven rebounds and one block in his Summer League debut against the Heat.

5105809.h: Reed did not play in Sunday's California Classic Summer League game against the Warriors for rest purposes, according to Spurs reporter Matt Guzman of SI.com.
5105809.s: The No. 26 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, Reed won't be playing in back-to-backs early on as a precaution. However, he will likely play Monday against the Lakers. During his Summer League debut on July 3 against Miami, Reed had 10 points (3-10 FG, 0-1 3Pt, 3-3 FT), seven rebounds and one block.

5105839.h: Sensabaugh (hip) is not listed on the injury report for Monday's preseason game against San Antonio.
5105839.s: Sensabaugh sat out Utah's first two preseason games due to a left hip injury, but his omission from the injury report paves the way for the Ohio State product to return to action Monday. In 75 games (22 starts) last season, he averaged 14.9 points, 3.1 rebounds and 1.9 assists in 23.5 minutes per contest.

5105839.h: Sensabaugh (hip) won't play in Tuesday's preseason game against the Nuggets.
5105839.s: A left hip injury will keep Sensabaugh off the floor for the rematch with Denver. The Jazz will likely be cautious with the 22-year-old, so it's reasonable to believe he could also miss Monday's exhibition versus the Spurs.

5105839.h: Sensabaugh won't play in Sunday's preseason opener against the Nuggets due to a left hip injury, Shreyas Laddha of The Salt Lake Tribune reports.
5105839.s: Sensabaugh's absence from Sunday's exhibition seems largely precautionary. His next chance to play will come Tuesday in a rematch with the Nuggets.

5105841.h: Okpara (illness) is available for Friday's game against Toronto.
5105841.s: Okpara will shed his questionable tag due to an illness and suit up Friday. However, the two-way player isn't guaranteed to see the floor.

5105841.h: Okpara (illness) is questionable for Friday's game against Toronto.
5105841.s: The Wizards figure to check back in with Okpara closer to tipoff. The rookie big man may not see the floor even if he's available, though.

5105841.h: Okpara (not injury related) has been ruled out for Wednesday's Summer League game against the Clippers, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.
5105841.s: Okpara is healthy, though he'll be held out Wednesday as the Wizards provide other players on the roster with opportunities. The remainder of Washington's Summer League schedule has yet to be finalized, though the club is expected to play its next game Saturday against an opponent yet to be announced.

5105977.h: Fleming will likely have to navigate through a crowded Suns frontcourt for an Opening Night role.
5105977.s: Phoenix is stocked with plenty of options at the forward spots, including new additions Miles Bridges and Koa Peat, who was selected in the first round of the 2026 NBA Draft. Jordan Goodwin, Haywood Highsmith and Ryan Dunn are also vying to be part of the squad's rotation, so Fleming has plenty of hurdles to overcome in order to attain fantasy relevance in 2026-27.

5105977.h: The Suns will shut down Fleming for the remainder of the Summer League, John Gambadoro of Arizona Sports 98.7 FM reports.
5105977.s: The Suns will also shut down Khaman Maluach and Koa Peat, though there are no injuries to report. Across four exhibitions, he put up averages of 11.5 points, 6.5 rebounds and 1.0 assists.

5106058.h: Sharp faces increased competition for playing time after the Kings signed Ben Simmons to a one-year deal Friday.
5106058.s: Although Russell Westbrook is out of the picture now, Ben Simmons will return to The Association and figures to see a steady role in the Kings' rotation thanks to his defensive versatility and playmaking. Along with fellow rookie Alex Karaban, Sharp isn't guaranteed a meaningful role to begin his professional career. However, the No. 45 overall pick out of Houston could see increasingly steady minutes as the season…

5106058.h: Sharp (undisclosed) won't play in Monday's California Classic Summer League game against the Bucks, Sean Cunningham of Fox 40 Sacramento reports.
5106058.s: After playing in Saturday's win over the Nets and Sunday's win over Warriors Blue, Sharp will be held out of the Kings' final California Classic contest. His next chance to play will come in Sacramento's Las Vegas Summer League opener against the Clippers on Thursday.

5106060.h: Walker won't start Sunday's game against Brooklyn.
5106060.s: Aaron Nesmith will return to the starting lineup, pushing Walker to the bench. The 23-year-old forward is averaging 2.5 points, 3.5 rebounds and 1.5 assists in 17.5 minutes per tilt across two regular-season appearances (one start).

5106060.h: Walker will start Friday's game against the Mavericks, Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com reports.
5106060.s: Aaron Nesmith will come off the bench in his return from a hamstring injury, opening the door for Walker to enter the first unit. He logged 19 minutes in Wednesday's season-opening win over New Orleans, recording three points, six rebounds, two assists, one block and four turnovers while shooting 1-for-6 from the field.

5106060.h: Walker (rest) is off the injury report for Wednesday's season opener against the Pelicans.
5106060.s: Walker missed the end of the preseason, likely for maintenance reasons. With Aaron Nesmith sidelined with a hamstring injury, Walker and Kelly Oubre stand out as the most likely candidates to enter the Pacers' Opening Night starting lineup.

5106060.h: Walker (undisclosed) is out for Friday's preseason game against the Bucks, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.
5106060.s: This will be Walker's second straight game on the shelf for unspecified reasons. Walker can be considered questionable ahead of Opening Night.

5106060.h: Walker (undisclosed) won't play in Tuesday's preseason game against the Thunder, Scott Agness of FieldhouseFiles.com reports.
5106060.s: It's unclear why Walker will be held out of the Pacers' penultimate preseason game. His final chance to play before the regular season will come against the Bucks on Friday.

5106258.h: Dick could see increased opportunities to begin the season while Brandon Ingram recovers from a partially torn Achilles and right heel surgery.
5106258.s: Dick arrived in Los Angeles alongside Ingram in the Kawhi Leonard trade and will compete for minutes on a Clippers team currently thin on the wing. Ingram's absence gives Dick an opportunity to earn a consistent rotation role, though he'll still face competition for playing time.

5106258.h: The Clippers and Raptors mutually agreed Monday to complete the trade sending Leonard to Toronto in exchange for Brandon Ingram (heel), Gradey Dick, two unprotected first-round picks, one first-round pick swap and two second-rounders, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
5106258.s: The trade hit a snag in July when the league investigated Leonard and the Clippers for salary cap circumvention, but the deal is now official ahead of training camp.
