The 2023 first-rounder is searching for a fresh start in Los Angeles after averaging 6.0 points and 1.9 rebounds in 14.0 minutes per game across 76 regular-season appearances (one start) for the Raptors last year.

5106258.h: The NBA has concluded its investigation into salary cap circumvention involving Kawhi Leonard and the Clippers, and the trade sending Dick to Los Angeles is expected to be finalized in the coming days, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
5106258.s: Among other punishments, the Clippers were stripped of five first-round picks Wednesday. Furthermore, Leonard was fined $700,000 in restitution for improper benefits. With the findings and penalities being announced, Dick is now expected to officially join the Clippers after spending his first three seasons in the Association with Toronto. The 2023 No. 13 overall pick's production took a hit in 2025-26, during which…

5106258.h: The Raptors are expected to send Dick, Brandon Ingram, two first-round picks, a first-round pick swap and two second-round picks to the Clippers on Tuesday in exchange for Kawhi Leonard, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
5106258.s: After a promising sophomore campaign, Dick took a major step back in Year 3 and will look for a fresh start with a change of scenery. The sharpshooter shot over 35 percent from three in each of his first two seasons but hit rock bottom in 2025-26, shooting 30.3 percent on 2.4 three-point attempts per game while playing only 14 minutes a night over 76 regular-season games. Dick will likely be competing with Kobe…

5106262.h: Ejiofor enters his rookie campaign after the Hawks selected him 23rd overall in the 2026 NBA Draft.
5106262.s: The 6-foot-9 forward flashed his two-way potential during Summer League, including a performance in which he recorded 13 points, six rebounds, three blocks and two steals. Atlanta's veteran depth could prevent Ejiofor from immediately seeing heavy minutes, but his rebounding and defensive ability give him a path toward becoming a useful rotation piece.

5106262.h: Ejiofor (rest) won't play in Saturday's Summer League game against the Wizards, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
5106262.s: Ejiofor will be held out of Atlanta's Summer League finale for rest purposes, marking his third straight absence. The rookie big man averaged 12.5 points, 5.0 rebounds, 2.5 assists, 1.5 steals and 1.5 blocks in 25.5 minutes per game across two Las Vegas Summer League outings.

5106262.h: Ejiofor (rest) won't play in Thursday's Summer League game against Memphis, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
5106262.s: This looks to be a scheduled maintenance day for Ejiofor, who also took a seat for Monday's game against Boston. He'll have another chance to play over the weekend as Summer League draws to a close.

5106262.h: Ejiofor (rest) is out for Monday's Summer League game against Boston, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
5106262.s: The Hawks are giving several key players the day off Monday. Ejiofor's next chance to play comes Thursday against Memphis.

5106262.h: Ejiofor (rest) is in the starting lineup for Thursday's Summer League game against the Spurs, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.
5106262.s: Ejiofor sat out Tuesday's Salt Lake City Summer League contest against the Grizzlies for maintenance purposes, but he's set to return to action in Las Vegas on Thursday. The St. John's product is looking to leave a strong impression this summer as he makes a case for a rotation spot with Atlanta ahead of the 2026-27 campaign, though Jock Landale (ankle) and Mouhamed Gueye appear to be the early favorites for the…

5106268.h: Tomlin is set to miss several weeks with a lower back stress reaction, Chris Fedor of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.
5106268.s: This is a tough blow for the forward, and there's no guarantee he's cleared right away when he's re-evaluated in three to four weeks. Tomlin wasn't projected to crack the rotation ahead of Opening Night and was penciled in as an emergency depth option.

5106268.h: Tomlin (back) won't play in Tuesday's preseason game against the Magic, Serena Winters of FanDuel Sports Network Ohio reports.
5106268.s: Tomlin is away from the team while tending to a back injury. He carries no timetable for a return.

5106268.h: Tomlin (back) is out for Sunday's preseason game against the Magic, Serena Winters of FanDuel Sports Network Ohio reports.
5106268.s: Tomlin will miss a second straight contest to open the preseason due to lower-back soreness. His next chance to suit up comes Wednesday against the Magic.

5106268.h: Tomlin (back) won't play in Thursday's preseason game against Boston, Serena Winters of FanDuel Sports Network Ohio reports.
5106268.s: Tomlin is dealing with lower-back soreness and will be held out of Cleveland's preseason opener. His next chance to suit up in the preseason will come Sunday against Orlando.

5106268.h: Head coach Kenny Atkinson said Friday that Tomlin is "fighting to be in the rotation," Chris Fedor of Cleveland.com reports.
5106268.s: The Cavaliers acquired Peyton Watson (hamstring) from the Nuggets and signed Mario Hezonja this summer, adding to an already deep roster. The club also has Jaylon Tyson and Sam Merrill, so Tomlin will have significant competition for playing time. The 25-year-old forward is no stranger to being buried on the depth chart, though he's proven he can handle meaningful playing time in the NBA. Over 64 regular-season…

5106270.h: The Thunder plan to waive Oweh (Achilles) on Friday.
5106270.s: Oweh, a rookie second-round pick, was set to be a two-way player for Oklahoma City but suffered a ruptured right Achilles tendon in a preseason game, which will sideline him for the entire 2026-27 campaign. Following a long road to recovery, Oweh might have to settle for an Exhibit 10 deal next summer.

5106270.h: Oweh (Achilles) underwent surgery Wednesday and will miss the entirety of the 2026-27 season, Brandon Rahbar of DailyThunder.com reports.
5106270.s: Oweh exited Tuesday's preseason game against the Pacers with a non-contact injury that was later diagnosed as a ruptured right Achilles tendon. The No. 41 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft already faced an uphill battle for playing time on a loaded Thunder roster and will now miss his entire rookie campaign. Depending on his recovery progress, Oweh could be a candidate to participate in the 2027 Summer League.

5106270.h: Oweh was helped to the locker room after sustaining an apparent lower right leg injury in the overtime period of Tuesday's preseason game against the Pacers, Rylan Stiles of SI.com reports.
5106270.s: Oweh suffered a non-contact injury and immediately grabbed at his lower right leg. The 23-year-old required assistance getting back to the locker room and is not expected to return in the final minutes of the game. He'll finish with eight points (3-5 FG, 2-2 FT) and three rebounds in 15 minutes.

5106270.h: Oweh will come off the bench for Tuesday's preseason matchup against Indiana, Justin Martinez of The Oklahoman reports.
5106270.s: Oweh will shift to a reserve role as Oklahoma City starts Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Cason Wallace, Alex Caruso, Jalen Williams and Isaiah Hartenstein. With several established regulars returning to the starting lineup, the rookie could see fewer opportunities than he received during the Thunder's previous preseason contests.

5106270.h: Oweh is starting Monday's preseason game against the Hawks, per Justin Martinez of The Oklahoman.
5106270.s: The Thunder are resting their typical starters Monday. Only nine players are available for OKC, likely setting Oweh up for heavy playing time.

5106283.h: Mitchell is likely to serve as emergency depth for the Celtics in his rookie season.
5106283.s: Boston signed the St. John's product to one of its two-way roster spots after selecting him in the second round of the 2026 NBA Draft, which means the bulk of the forward's reps should come with the G League's Maine Celtics. The 22-year-old showed flashes during Summer League, averaging 13.0 points, 5.0 rebounds, 2.7 steals, 1.3 assists and 1.3 blocks in 26.0 minutes per game over his three appearances, and he…

5106283.h: Mitchell (rest) has been ruled out for Saturday's Summer League game against the Magic, John Karalis of BostonSportsJournal.com reports.
5106283.s: Mitchell will sit out the Celtics' Summer League finale, marking his second straight game on the inactive list for rest purposes. Over three Las Vegas Summer League outings, he averaged 13.0 points, 5.0 rebounds, 2.7 steals, 1.3 assists and 1.3 blocks in 26.0 minutes per showing.

5106283.h: Mitchell (rest) is out for Wednesday's Summer League game against the Kings, per Bobby Krivitsky of Forbes.com.
5106283.s: The Celtics are managing the rookie second-rounder's reps Wednesday. Mitchell has made three Summer League appearances already, averaging 13.0 points, 5.0 rebounds and 2.7 steals in 26.0 minutes per game.

5107157.h: Conwell has made a strong early impression on teammate Klay Thompson during his first training camp with Miami, according to Heat reporter Brendan Tobin.
5107157.s: Thompson praised Conwell's conditioning, defense and left-handed jumper, noting that the rookie picked up full-court defensively during practice and had previously beaten him in a shooting drill this summer. The No. 37 overall pick averaged 18.8 points while attempting 9.6 three-pointers per game during his final collegiate season at Louisville, and his combination of shooting and defensive effort could help him…

5107157.h: Conwell (hip) won't play again during the Las Vegas Summer League, per Tim Reynolds of the Associated Press.
5107157.s: The Heat are erring on the side of caution while the rookie second-rounder tends to a hip injury. Conwell has plenty of time to heal up ahead of training camp in the fall, when he'll likely be competing with Dru Smith for the backup point guard role behind Davion Mitchell for 2026-27.

5107157.h: Conwell (hip) won't play in Monday's Summer League game versus Cleveland, Anthony Chiang of the Miami Herald reports.
5107157.s: Conwell played in three games during the California Classic but has appeared in only one game in Las Vegas, finishing with 19 points, one rebound, three assists and one block across 27 minutes in Friday's 119-86 win over Milwaukee. The rookie will now miss a second consecutive game, meaning his next opportunity to suit up will come Thursday versus Toronto. However, it's reasonable to assume the team may keep him off…

5107157.h: Conwell (rest) won't play in Saturday's Summer League game against the Magic, Anthony Chiang of the Miami Herald reports.
5107157.s: Conwell will receive a rest day in the second leg of this back-to-back set. His next opportunity to play will come Monday against the Cavaliers.

5107173.h: Wolf (coach's decision) did not play in Wednesday's 110-103 loss to Charlotte.
5107173.s: The second-year big man didn't receive an opportunity in Brooklyn's defeat on Opening Night. Wolf will need to carve out a more substantial role in the Nets' frontcourt before becoming relevant in standard fantasy formats.

5107173.h: Wolf (rest) is ticketed for a reserve role in 2026-27 after the Nets acquired Julius Randle from Minnesota earlier this offseason.
5107173.s: Wolf closed last season as a starter while the Nets gradually began shutting down most of their key players, but the 2025 first-rounder might even struggle for a significant Opening Night role in 2026-27. Not only did Brooklyn add Randle as its starting power forward, but the team also signed Moritz Wagner and drafted Joshua Jefferson to further upgrade the frontcourt.

5107173.h: Wolf (rest) won't play in Sunday's Summer League game against the Thunder, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.
5107173.s: Wolf will sit out Brooklyn's Summer League finale for rest purposes. The 22-year-old big man will finish the Las Vegas Summer League with averages of 11.8 points, 5.8 rebounds, 1.8 assists, 0.8 steals and 0.8 blocks in 21.4 minutes per tilt across four outings.

5107173.h: Wolf (back) is out for Monday's California Classic Summer League Game against the Warriors Blue, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.
5107173.s: Wolf will miss a third straight Summer League game due to lower-back soreness. His next opportunity to play comes Friday against the Knicks in Las Vegas.

5107173.h: Wolf (back) has been ruled out for Sunday's California Classic Summer League game against the Bucks, C.J. Holmes of the New York Daily News reports.
5107173.s: Wolf is dealing with lower-back soreness and will miss a second consecutive Summer League contest. His next opportunity to play will come Monday against the Kings.

5107199.h: Jenkins will start Sunday's game against the 76ers, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.
5107199.s: Jenkins gets the start due to Ausar Thompson (ankle) being out. Jenkins holds averages of 7.5 points, 7.0 rebounds, 5.0 assists and 1.0 steals in 26.0 minutes per contest across two appearances this season.

5107199.h: Jenkins is in the starting lineup for Saturday's preseason game against the Wizards, Coty M. Davis of The Detroit News reports.
5107199.s: The Pistons won't start Cade Cunningham in Saturday's preseason contest, meaning Jenkins will get the nod at point guard. The former St. John's standout is expected to operate as Cunningham's backup as long as he stays healthy, so he'll get the chance to run with the first-team offense in this game. He averaged 9.3 points and 3.9 assists per game across 72 contests (19 starts) in the 2025-26 regular season.

5107199.h: The Pistons exercised their 2026-27 team option for Jenkins on Monday, Keith Smith of Spotrac.com reports.
5107199.s: This was basically a formality for the Pistons at $4 million. Jenkins was upgraded to a standard contract last season after a string of impressive performances. Across 72 regular-season games, he averaged 9.3 points, 3.9 assists and 2.3 rebounds on 40.8 percent shooting from the field, though he may face competition for backup backcourt minutes from rookie first-round pick Ebuka Okorie.

5107251.h: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.
5107251.s: With Nelson still in recovery mode from the left ankle surgery he underwent this summer, his path back to game action remains delayed for the early part of the season. The rookie big man is on a two-way contract with the Magic, so his short-term absence mainly affects his developmental timeline rather than Orlando's regular rotation.

5107251.h: The Magic announced Monday that Nelson will undergo surgery to repair a fracture in his left ankle, and he's expected to return to basketball activities in 3-4 months.
5107251.s: Nelson sustained the fracture during Sunday's Summer League win over Portland and is now in danger of missing the start of the 2026-27 campaign. The No. 51 overall pick in this year's draft signed a two-way contract with the Magic and isn't expected to have a consistent role with the parent club once he returns.

5107251.h: Nelson agreed to a two-way contract with Orlando on Wednesday, Paul Garcia of The Spot Up Shot reports.
5107251.s: Nelson was selected by Washington with the No. 51 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft and subsequently traded to Orlando. He began his collegiate career at Arkansas State before spending the 2025-26 campaign at South Florida. In 34 games, which included an NCAA Tournament loss to Louisville, the 22-year-old averaged 15.9 points, 9.6 rebounds, 1.2 assists, 1.4 blocks and 1.6 steals over 27.3 minutes. The Magic's…

5107897.h: Mogbo (rest) won't play in Tuesday's Summer League game against the Nets, Jason Anderson of The Sacramento Bee reports.
5107897.s: Mogbo will sit out the front end of this back-to-back set for rest purposes. His next opportunity to suit up in Las Vegas will come Wednesday against the Celtics.

5107897.h: Mogbo (undisclosed) is available and starting Thursday's Summer League game against the Clippers, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.
5107897.s: Mogbo didn't play in Monday's California Classic Summer League win over the Bucks, though he'll return to action Thursday. The 24-year-old forward signed a two-way pact with Sacramento earlier this month and will likely spend most of his time with the Kings' G League affiliate, the Stockton Kings, in 2026-27.

5107897.h: Mogbo will not play in Monday's California Classic Summer League game against the Bucks for undisclosed reasons, Sean Cunningham of Fox 40 Sacramento reports.
5107897.s: Mogbo played both games in the team's back-to-back set over the weekend and will get a night off for the third game in as many days. His next chance to suit up will come Thursday in the Las Vegas Summer League against the Clippers.

5107897.h: Mogbo will sign a two-way contract with the Kings, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports Wednesday.
5107897.s: Previously with the Raptors, Mogbo will become a developmental project for the Kings. Presumably, he will spend the bulk of his time in the G League early on. Mogbo made 40 regular-season appearances in 2025-26 for an average of 6.2 minutes per contest.

5107897.h: The Raptors declined their team option on Mogbo's contract for the 2026-27 campaign, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports Monday.
5107897.s: After spending the first two years of his career in Toronto, Mogbo will enter unrestricted free agency. The 24-year-old forward saw a significant decline in playing time in his second season, averaging 1.5 points and 1.7 rebounds in 6.2 minutes per game across 40 regular-season outings in 2025-26.

5108024.h: Niederhauser (foot) won't be ready for the start of the season, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.
5108024.s: Niederhauser is progressing from March surgery but won't be able to suit up to begin the year. The Clippers are likely to take a cautious approach with the 2025 first-rounder. Isaiah Jackson should occupy the backup center spot behind Brook Lopez early in the campaign.

5112087.h: Wells will start Wednesday's game against the Jazz.
5112087.s: The Grizzlies got a look at Kris Murray in the starting five in their preseason finale, though Wells will return to the first unit in the club's regular-season opener. The third-year wing took a bit of a step forward in 2025-26, averaging 12.5 points, 3.2 rebounds, 1.6 assists and 0.9 steals across 26.4 minutes per game in 69 regular-season appearances.

5112087.h: Wells will come off the bench in Friday's preseason finale against the Hornets.
5112087.s: Wells started in Memphis' first three preseason games, but Kris Murray will replace him in the first unit for Friday's final exhibition. Wells will be battling Murray, Jerami Grant and GG Jackson for minutes this season, so this could devolve into a value-killing timeshare situation at the small forward position in Memphis.

5112087.h: Wells faces competition for a starting spot on the wings in Memphis to begin the 2026-27 season, Damichael Cole of The Memphis Commercial Appeal reports.
5112087.s: Jerami Grant, Cedric Coward and Cam Spencer are all competing with Wells for a starting spot on the wings. The 23-year-old swingman has started 143 of his 148 career regular-season appearances since being drafted by Memphis with the 39th overall pick in the 2024 NBA Draft, and he averaged 12.5 points, 3.2 rebounds, 1.6 assists and 0.9 steals in 26.4 minutes per contest across 69 regular-season games (all starts) in…

5112087.h: Wells (toe) has been a full participant during training camp, Grizzlies president of basketball operations Zach Kleiman said, according to Memphis reporter Landon Speck.
5112087.s: Wells has been cleared for full basketball activities after undergoing toe surgery in March and is practicing without restrictions during camp. His availability should give him plenty of time to ramp up during the preseason while competing for a prominent role on the wing.

5113969.h: Carr (oblique) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Trail Blazers.
5113969.s: Carr will miss a fourth consecutive regular-season contest due to an oblique strain. The rookie's next chance to suit up will come Wednesday against the Clippers.

5113969.h: Carr (oblique) is out for Sunday's game in Utah, Khobi Price of The California Post reports.
5113969.s: This will be Carr's third straight game on the inactive list. His next chance to play will come Tuesday against the Trail Blazers, the first game of a back-to-back set.

5113969.h: Carr (oblique) is out for Friday's game against the Clippers.
5113969.s: Carr isn't quite ready to make his NBA debut, but he can continue to be considered day-to-day. His next chance to take the court will arrive Sunday in Utah.

5113969.h: Head coach JJ Redick said Carr (oblique), who is out for Wednesday's game against Golden State, is "ramping up" and can be considered day-to-day moving forward, Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com reports.
5113969.s: Carr will miss the Lakers' regular-season opener, though he can be considered questionable for Friday's game against the Clippers until further notice. With the rookie sidelined, Matisse Thybulle and Ziaire Williams are candidates for a bump in minutes.

5113969.h: Carr (oblique) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.
5113969.s: Carr has been dealing with an oblique injury. Considering the rookie hasn't been practicing, it appears his absence will extend beyond Opening Night. With Carr sidelined, Matisse Thybulle and Ziaire Williams are candidates for more playing time behind Quentin Grimes.

5124612.h: Edgecombe (abdomen) is out for Sunday's game against the Pistons, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.
5124612.s: Edgecombe sustained an abdominal contusion during Saturday's game against the Bucks, and although he was able to return, he has been ruled out for Sunday's game due to the injury. Kentavious Caldwell-Pope and Anfernee Simons figure to see larger roles in his absence.

5124612.h: Edgecombe has been downgraded to questionable ahead of Sunday's game against the Pistons due to an abdominal contusion.
5124612.s: Edgecombe exited Saturday's game briefly and could miss the second half of the team's back-to-back set due to an abdominal injury. Kentavious Caldwell-Pope and Anfernee Simons are candidates for extra minutes if Edgecombe is unable to go.

5124612.h: Edgecombe (groin) started the second quarter of Saturday's game against the Bucks, per the broadcast.
5124612.s: Edgecombe took a shot to the groin area and limped to the locker room in the opening quarter. However, the 21-year-old quickly returned to the bench and appears to be good to go for the remainder of the contest.

5124612.h: Edgecombe exited to the locker room in the first quarter of Saturday's game against the Bucks due to an apparent groin injury, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.
5124612.s: Edgecombe took a shot to the groin area and briefly stayed in the game before limping to the locker room. He can be considered questionable to return until more information comes to light.

5124612.h: The 76ers exercised the third-year team option on Edgecombe's contract for the 2027-28 season Monday, Derek Bodner of AllPHLY.com reports.
5124612.s: This was the expected move by Philadelphia, and it will result in Edgecombe taking home $12.2 million during the 2027-28 campaign. The 21-year-old will look to take another step forward in 2026-27 playing alongside plenty of veteran talent in Jaylen Brown, LeBron James, Joel Embiid and Tyrese Maxey.

5142620.h: Acuff (rest) is available for Friday's preseason finale in San Antonio, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.
5142620.s: Acuff skipped Tuesday's preseason loss to the Trail Blazers for rest purposes, but he'll be back in action for Friday's final exhibition game. Acuff's return will likely shift Elfrid Payton back to the second unit.

5142620.h: Acuff (rest) has been ruled out for Tuesday's preseason game against Portland, Matt George of ABC 10 Sacramento reports.
5142620.s: The Kings will be extremely shorthanded Tuesday, as they're resting several regulars. Acuff's final chance to play in the preseason will come Friday against the Spurs.

5142620.h: Acuff is projected to open the season as Sacramento's starting point guard, according to Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140.
5142620.s: Nunes views Acuff, Zach LaVine, Keegan Murray, De'Andre Hunter and Domantas Sabonis as the Kings' most likely starting five. If Acuff secures the starting job, the rookie should have an opportunity to handle significant minutes and playmaking responsibilities from the outset. Efficiency could be an issue early on given the learning curve at the position.

5142620.h: Acuff enters his rookie season with an opportunity to earn developmental minutes in Sacramento's backcourt after being selected in the first round of the 2026 NBA Draft.
5142620.s: The dynamic scoring guard could spend time learning behind the Kings' veteran guards while adjusting to the NBA game, but a starting role on Opening Night could be on the table. Acuff's long-term upside as a shot creator makes him one of Sacramento's top young prospects.

5142620.h: Acuff will be rested for Friday's Summer League game against the Hornets, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
5142620.s: Acuff will be rested for a second straight exhibition. The rookie made five appearances during Summer League play, posting averages of 19.2 points, 4.6 assists and 1.6 rebounds.

5142621.h: Cenac is not in the starting lineup for Tuesday's season opener against Detroit, per Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston.
5142621.s: This is an expected shift in role after Cenac started Boston's preseason finale. With the Celtics' frontcourt healthy, the rookie big man is not likely to see meaningful playing time.

5142621.h: Cenac will start Friday's preseason finale against the 76ers, Bobby Krivitsky of Forbes.com reports.
5142621.s: With all of Boston's regulars resting, the rookie will make his first career NBA start, albeit in preseason action. He's been off to a slow start during the preseason, but Cenac will have a major opportunity during the final exhibition.

5142621.h: Cenac received high praise from teammate Neemias Queta on Monday, with the veteran center saying the rookie has the potential to become a "juggernaut" in the NBA, Taylor Snow of the Celtics' official site reports.
5142621.s: Queta highlighted Cenac's combination of size, mobility and ability to defend multiple positions, adding that "the sky is the limit" for the 19-year-old. Cenac showed flashes of that defensive versatility during Summer League, but with Queta, Mitchell Robinson and Luka Garza among the experienced options in Boston's frontcourt, the No. 27 overall pick may have to earn his opportunities during his rookie campaign.

5142621.h: Cenac appears to be buried on the Celtics' depth chart ahead of his rookie season.
5142621.s: Boston signed Mitchell Robinson in free agency and still has Neemias Queta in the fold at center as well, likely leaving Cenac to fight for scraps with Luka Garza off the bench in 2026-27. Maluach does have Oso Ighodaro to overcome for the role, so fantasy managers should keep close…

5211175.h: Risacher won't start Monday's game against the Heat, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

5211175.s: Risacher was initially listed as questionable due to hip soreness, though he was eventually upgraded to probable before being cleared to play shortly thereafter. The 21-year-old figures to see significant minutes for the shorthanded Mavericks in the second leg of this back-to-back set, and he could step into the first unit if Max Christie (shin) is downgraded from questionable to out.

5211175.h: Risacher (hip) has been upgraded from questionable to probable ahead of Saturday's game against San Antonio.
5211175.s: Risacher was initially tagged as questionable due to right hip soreness, but the third-year pro is trending in the right direction of Saturday's contest. Cooper Flagg (shoulder) has already been ruled out, and with Kyrie Irving (knee) now doubtful, Risacher and the other Mavericks role players are in line for more responsibilities against the Spurs.

5211175.h: Risacher is questionable for Saturday's game against the Spurs due to right hip soreness.
5211175.s: A final call on Risacher's status will be made closer to Sunday's 8 p.m. ET tipoff. The Frenchman has seen considerable playing time off the bench in the early days of the season, logging at least 27 minutes in his two appearances and averaging 7.5 points, 6.0 rebounds, 3.0 steals, 1.5 assists and 1.5 blocks per contest.

5211176.h: Salaun said Monday that he's focused on becoming a more versatile contributor as he competes for playing time in Charlotte's rotation, Sam reports.
5211176.s: The third-year forward identified facilitating, efficient catch-and-shoot play, screening and the ability to defend all five positions as areas that could help him earn minutes. Salaun also made improving his physicality a priority during the offseason. After averaging 6.1 points and 4.7 rebounds across 62 regular-season appearances in 2025-26, he'll face increased competition for playing time in a deeper Hornets…

5211983.h: Dadiet (undisclosed) will play in Thursday's Summer League game against Golden State, James L. Edwards III of The Athletic reports.
5211983.s: Dadiet appears to have been held out as a precaution Monday and will be back in the mix for Thursday's matchup. 5211983.h: Dadiet (undisclosed) is out for Monday's Summer League game against the Pistons, James L. Edwards III of The Athletic reports.
5211983.s: This is likely a maintenance day for Dadiet. His next chance to play comes Thursday against the Warriors.

5214637.s: Penda suffered the hamstring tear in Friday's 136-115 preseason win over the Heat. It's unknown how long the injury will keep the 21-year-old off the floor. Penda, the No. 32 overall pick in the 2025 NBA Draft, averaged 3.8 points, 3.2 rebounds and…

5214637.h: Penda won't return to Friday's preseason game against the Heat due to right hamstring tightness, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports. He'll finish with one steal in two minutes.
5214637.s: Penda was limited at the start of training camp due to a right hamstring injury, and he's now in danger of missing Wednesday's regular-season opener against Atlanta. If the 21-year-old is forced to miss time, Jamal Cain could see a slight bump in minutes.

5214637.h: Penda exited Friday's game against the Heat with a right hamstring injury and went straight to the locker room, Cody Taylor of USA Today reports.
5214637.s: Penda came up grabbing his right hamstring and trainers wasted no time getting him to the locker room for further evaluation. Penda notably dealt with the same injury at the start of training camp. His status for the rest of this game, as well as the regular-season opener against the Hawks on Oct. 21, could be in jeopardy.

5214637.h: Penda (hamstring) isn't listed on the Magic's injury report for Sunday's preseason game against Cleveland.
5214637.s: Penda missed the preseason opener after tweaking his hamstring in late September. He's been involved in recent practices, though it wouldn't be surprising to see the Magic limit his minutes during his first game back.

5214637.h: Penda (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's preseason game in Memphis, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
5214637.s: Penda has been working his way back from a hamstring injury, and while he was able to participate in Sunday's practice, he's not quite ready for game action. His next chance to play will come Sunday in Cleveland.

5214640.h: Jakucionis (coach's decision) is in the starting lineup for Wednesday's preseason game against Chicago.
5214640.s: Jakucionis didn't see any action Sunday against Charlotte but will move into the starting lineup Wednesday against Chicago with several Milwaukee regulars resting. In 53 regular-season appearances (12 starts) with Miami last season, the Illinois product averaged 6.2 points, 2.6 rebounds and 2.6 assists in 17.8 minutes per contest.

5214640.h: Jakucionis (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's preseason game against Charlotte, Justin Garcia of the Milwaukee Bucks Radio Network reports.
5214640.s: Jakucionis was a DNP-CD in Monday's 116-97 preseason loss to Minnesota, and he then logged 18 minutes in the two-point win over Oklahoma City on Wednesday. However, Jakucionis will take a seat once again Sunday, with his next opportunity to play being this coming Wednesday versus Chicago.

5214640.h: Jakucionis was a DNP-CD during Monday's 116-97 preseason loss to the Timberwolves.
5214640.s: Jakucionis was one of several Bucks who didn't see the floor despite Milwaukee using 14 players. The second-year guard was acquired from Miami during the offseason and should have additional opportunities to make his preseason debut as Milwaukee evaluates its revamped backcourt rotation.

5214640.h: Jakucionis (rest) didn't play in Saturday's 96-94 Summer League win over Philadelphia.
5214640.s: Jakucionis took a seat for both of Milwaukee's final three Summer League outings. Over two Las Vegas Summer League contests, he averaged 9.0 points, 5.0 assists, 2.5 steals and 1.5 rebounds in 21.7 minutes per tilt.

5214640.h: Jakucionis (rest) isn't playing in Wednesday's Summer League contest against the Hornets, according to Eric Nehm of The Athletic.
5214640.s: Jakucionis is expected to operate as a backup option in the Bucks backcourt after he was acquired in the trade that sent Giannis Antetokounmpo (knee) to Miami. The second-year guard will aim to return to the hardwood when the Bucks play their next Summer League game over the weekend. Jakucionis is averaging 9.0 points and 5.0 assists per game in two Summer League appearances.

5214989.h: Markovic (undisclosed) started Monday's California Classic Summer League game against the Kings, per the broadcast.
5214989.s: Markovic was held out of Sunday's loss to the Nets -- the second leg of a back-to-back-to-back set -- for undisclosed reasons. However, he was cleared to return for the Bucks' final California Classic contest.

5214989.h: Markovic (undisclosed) didn't play in Sunday's 89-69 California Classic Summer League loss to the Nets.
5214989.s: After posting 16 points (8-12 FG, 0-3 3Pt, 0-1 FT), six rebounds, three assists and one steal over 25 minutes during the Bucks' 97-83 win over Warriors Blue on Saturday at the California Classic Summer League, Markovic sat out the second leg of a back-to-back-to-back set. The 2025 second-round pick didn't report to the Bucks last season, but he could be part of their 2026-27 plans, especially after trading away…

5214989.h: The Bucks signed Markovic to a second-round pick exception Wednesday, per Jake Fischer of BleacherReport.com.
5214989.s: Markovic, who was the No. 47 overall pick in the 2025 NBA Draft by Milwaukee, appears ready to contribute at the NBA level. The 20-year-old big man spent the 2025-26 campaign playing internationally, and it's also possible he sees plenty of reps for the G League's Wisconsin Herd next year.

5217746.h: Hansen (illness) is available for Monday's Summer League game against Minnesota.
5217746.s: Hansen will return Monday, marking his second appearance of the Las Vegas Summer League. The 21-year-old last played in Friday's 81-79 loss to Phoenix, finishing with 12 points, nine rebounds and four assists across 26 minutes.

5217746.h: Hansen (illness) has been ruled out for Sunday's Summer League game against the Magic.
5217746.s: Hansen is under the weather and will miss the front end of this back-to-back set. The big man's next chance to play will come Monday against the Timberwolves.

5231919.h: Lopez (knee) is active for Monday's game against the Jazz.
5231919.s: After missing Sunday's contest against the Kings with a bone bruise in his right knee, Lopez will suit up for the second leg of the Grizzlies' back-to-back set. Even when he was healthy prior to the absence, the rookie first-rounder was not a part of the regular rotation for Memphis, and that will likely be the case again in Utah.

5231919.h: Lopez (knee) is questionable for Monday's game in Utah.
5231919.s: The rookie first-rounder has a chance to be cleared for his NBA debut Monday. However, Lopez may not see meaningful playing time even if he's available Monday.

5231919.h: Lopez (knee) is out for Sunday's game in Sacramento.
5231919.s: Lopez is dealing with a bone bruise in his right knee, so it wouldn't be shocking if this turned into a multi-game absence for the rookie. That said, he has not been in the rotation this season, so this injury won't impact Memphis' game plan.

5231919.h: Lopez (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Kings.
5231919.s: Lopez was a late addition to the injury report due to a right knee bone bruise. He has yet to make his regular-season debut, so his potential absence wouldn't affect the rotation.

5231919.h: Lopez (undisclosed) is out for Sunday's Summer League championship game against the Warriors, Drew Hill of The Daily Memphian reports.
5231919.s: Lopez will be inactive for a second straight game to close out the Grizzlies' stint in Las Vegas. The No. 21 overall pick dealt with a hamstring injury throughout Summer League, so the team could just be playing it safe with him.

5238230.h: Johnson (rest) is likely to revert to a bench role to open 2026-27 after finishing last season as a starter.
5238230.s: The Wizards are set to send out a new starting lineup this year, now headlined by veteran stars Trae Young (quad) and Anthony Davis (finger) as well as rookie No. 1 overall pick AJ Dybantsa, and they're also set to get Kyshawn George and Alex Sarr (foot) back in the fold. Washington does have a rather thin backcourt behind Young and George, however, so both Johnson and Bub Carrington should remain involved to a…

5238230.h: Johnson (rest) has been shut down for the remainder of the Las Vegas Summer League, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.
5238230.s: Johnson appeared in just one game for the Wizards this summer, posting 26 points (11-20 FG, 2-8 3Pt, 1-1 FT), two rebounds, one assist and one steal across 28 minutes in Thursday's win over Utah. AJ Dybantsa and Will Riley have also been shut down for the remainder of Summer League.

5238230.h: Johnson (undisclosed) won't play in Sunday's Summer League game against the Kings, Joshua Valdez of ClutchPoints.com reports.
5238230.s: The Wizards may have seen enough from Johnson this summer after he dropped 26 points in Thursday's win over Utah. His next chance to play will come Tuesday against Chicago.

5239561.h: Richardson is in the starting lineup for Sunday's game against the Knicks, Cody Taylor of USA Today reports.
5239561.s: Richardson will make his first start of the season Sunday due to the absence of Paolo Banchero (ankle), and the second-year guard will share the backcourt alongside Jalen Suggs, with Desmond Bane and Franz Wagner at the three and four, respectively. Richardson is averaging 4.0 points and 3.0 assists in 14.0 minutes per game in two bench appearances this season.

5239561.h: The Magic exercised Richardson's team option Wednesday, per Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel.
5239561.s: This is an expected transaction after Orlando chose Richardson in the first round of last year's draft. Richardson is cleared to play through a back injury for Opening Night, but he's unlikely to play a significant role Wednesday.

5239561.h: Richardson (back) is off the injury report for Wednesday's season opener against the Hawks.
5239561.s: Richardson is cleared to play through a back injury for Opening Night. However, he's unlikely to play a significant role Wednesday.

5239561.h: Richardson (back) is considered day-to-day, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
5239561.s: Richardson exited Friday's 136-115 preseason win over Miami due to back soreness. While he hasn't been officially ruled out for Opening Night against Atlanta, it appears there's a chance he won't be available for that game. With Noah Penda (hamstring) ruled out and Franz Wagner (shoulder) dealing with an injury, Tristan da Silva and Anthony Black could see more minutes.

5239561.h: Richardson logged seven minutes before exiting Friday's 136-115 preseason win over the Heat due to lower-back soreness. He contributed two rebounds and two assists.

5241364.h: Stirtz is in the starting lineup for Monday's preseason game against Atlanta, Justin Martinez of The Oklahoman reports.

5241364.h: Stirtz will start in Tuesday's preseason game against the Pelicans, Justin Martinez of The Oklahoman reports.
5241364.s: Stirtz is getting the start with Jalen Williams, Cason Wallace and Alex Caruso all sitting out Tuesday's exhibition. Stirtz played well for the Thunder at Summer League, so it'll be interesting to see what he can do against tougher competition in the preseason.

5241364.s: The No. 16 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, Stirtz is not dealing with an injury, but the Thunder are happy with the amount of reps he's received. Through five exhibitions, he averaged 13.6 points, 3.4 assists and 1.6 rebounds.

5242496.h: Essengue (head) is available for Monday's game against Boston.
5242496.s: Essengue was held out of Saturday's clash against Washington after being diagnosed with a head contusion, but the issue won't force him to miss any additional action. 5242502.h: Saraf (coach's decision) did not play in Wednesday's 110-103 loss to Charlotte.
5242502.s: Brooklyn opted not to use Saraf in its season opener, leaving the young guard outside the initial backcourt rotation. His playing time could remain sporadic while the Nets evaluate their other perimeter options.

5242502.h: Saraf (rest) is in line for a reserve role in 2026-27 after the Nets drafted Mikel Brown earlier this summer.
5242502.s: The 2025 first-rounder bookended his rookie campaign as a starter, but a bench role appears more likely to open this season now that Brown is in the fold and Egor Demin is healthy. 5242502.h: Saraf (rest) has been ruled out for Sunday's Summer League game against the Thunder, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.
5242502.s: Saraf is healthy but will be sidelined for the Nets' Summer League finale for rest purposes. 5242502.h: Saraf (undisclosed) is available for Monday's California Classic Summer League game against Warriors Blue, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.
5242502.s: Saraf sat out Sunday's win over the Bucks -- Brooklyn's second game of a back-to-back-to-back set -- due to undisclosed reasons. 5254165.h: Wagler is not in the starting lineup for Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Kings, Farbod Esnaashari of SI.com reports.
5254165.s: Wagler will come off the bench to begin his NBA career, but he should still see quality minutes with Max Strus (foot) and Bradley Beal (knee) out. The Clippers selected Wagler with the No. 5 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, so he should be a big part of their plans this season.

5254165.h: Head coach Ty Lue said Wednesday the Clippers are going to give Wagler a lot of on-ball opportunities, per Joey Linn of SI.com.
5254165.s: With Brandon Ingram (Achilles) sidelined to begin the season, Los Angeles is already short on proven playmakers beyond Darius Garland. 5254165.h: Wagler (rest) has been ruled out for Wednesday's Summer League game against the Wizards, Joey Linn of SI.com reports.
5254165.s: Wagler will get a break after playing in each of the Clippers' first three games of the Summer League, and his next chance to play is Friday against the Timberwolves. Wagler averaged 17.9 points, 5.0 rebounds and 4.3 assists over 33.9 minutes per game last year with Illinois.

5258459.h: Okorie registered two points (2-2 FT) across two minutes during Sunday's 106-93 victory over Philadelphia.
5258459.s: Okorie made his NBA regular-season debut Sunday, scoring his first points at the charity stripe. The rookie first-rounder is unlikely to see meaningful playing time early on unless Cade Cunningham or Daniss Jenkins misses time.

5258459.h: Okorie (coach's decision) didn't play during Tuesday's 121-113 win over the Celtics.
5258459.s: While the Pistons traded up in the draft to acquire Okorie's services earlier this year, the team doesn't look to be ready to throw the rookie first-rounder into the fire. Okorie appears to have more fantasy value in dynasty leagues.

5258459.s: Okorie hit the game-winning bucket during Monday night's preseason game against the Suns as the team continues to evaluate where the young guard will fit into the rotation. Bickerstaff has been particularly impressed by Okorie's maturity and poise, and his ability to take care of the basketball. The 19-year-old was selected by the Pistons with the No. 17 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft and is in a position to…

5279129.h: De Larrea is doubtful to return to Monday's game against the Heat due to a right knee strain.
5279129.s: De Larrea suffered the injury during the second quarter while trying to corral an inbound pass. Walter Clayton could pick up a few additional minutes in the second half, assuming de Larrea doesn't return.

5279129.h: De Larrea went to the locker room during the second quarter of Monday's game against the Heat with an apparent right ankle injury, Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com reports.
5279129.s: De Larrea took a hard fall while trying to catch an inbound pass, and he hobbled to the locker room shortly after. He can be considered questionable to return at this time.

5279130.h: Nets general manager Sean Marks said Sunday that Traore (knee) is healthy and ready to participate in training camp, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.
5279130.s: Traore underwent a procedure on his right knee in June after dealing with soreness during the 2025-26 campaign, causing him to miss Summer League. The second-year guard appears to have completed his recovery on schedule and should enter camp with mild restrictions as he competes for a role in Brooklyn's crowded backcourt.

5279130.h: Brooklyn general manager Sean Marks announced Monday that Traore underwent right knee surgery and won't play in Summer League, C.J. Holmes of the New York Daily News reports.
5279130.s: Although Traore won't play in Summer League, he's expected to be 100 percent by training camp. During his rookie campaign, Traore averaged 8.9 points, 3.8 assists and 1.8 rebounds while shooting 38.0 percent from the field in 22.2 minutes per showing across 56 regular-season games (31 starts).

5279133.h: Beringer won't start Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Heat.
5279133.s: Beringer started Friday's preseason finale with Rudy Gobert (rest) receiving a maintenance day, though the veteran big man is back in his usual starting role for the regular-season opener. Beringer figures to operate as Gobert's primary backup to begin the 2026-27 campaign.

5279133.h: Beringer will start Friday's preseason finale against the Bulls.
5279133.s: With Minnesota resting all of its regulars, Beringer will start alongside Zyon Pullin, Terrence Shannon, Jaylen Clark and Cody Williams. Beringer recorded 10 points (3-4 FG, 4-4 FT), seven rebounds, one block and one steal across 18 minutes in Wednesday's 128-106 preseason loss to Detroit.

5279133.h: Beringer is in the starting lineup for Saturday's preseason matchup with Miami.
5279133.s: Rudy Gobert (rest) won't play Saturday, so Beringer will get some time to shine as a starter. He has elite defensive instincts, but he also has a tendency to find himself in foul trouble.

5279133.s: After logging just 7.9 minutes per game last regular season, the 2025 first-rounder is now slotting in as Minnesota's No. 2 center behind Rudy Gobert now that Reid is out of the frontcourt mix. Beringer dominated at times during the 2025-26 G League regular season, averaging 15.3 points, 11.3 rebounds and 2.4 blocks per game while shooting 64.0 percent from the field.

5279133.h: Beringer (back) has been ruled out for Friday's Summer League game against the Clippers.
5279133.s: Beringer will end up missing the Timberwolves' final four games of the Summer League due to lower-back tightness. The 2025 first-rounder averaged just 7.9 minutes per game across 40 regular-season contests during his rookie campaign. However, with Naz Reid now in Charlotte, Beringer figures to operate as Minnesota's backup center behind Rudy Gobert for the 2026-27 season.

5281370.h: Steinbach (coach's decision) did not play in Wednesday's 110-103 win over Brooklyn.
5281370.s: The rookie big man remained on Charlotte's bench throughout the Opening Night victory. With the Hornets having other frontcourt options available, Steinbach may face an uphill battle for consistent playing time early in the season.

5289900.h: Diawara will come off the bench in Tuesday's regular-season opener against the 76ers, Kristian Winfield of the New York Daily News reports.
5289900.s: Diawara started New York's final two exhibition games with Josh Hart nursing a minor ankle injury, but Hart is back and starting for Opening Night, so Diawara will shift back to a reserve role. As a member of the second unit last season, Diawara averaged 3.2 points and 1.2 rebounds in 8.2 minutes per game.

5289900.h: Diawara is starting Thursday's preseason game against the Raptors.
5289900.s: Diawara will draw a second straight start at power forward ahead of Josh Hart in the final matchup of the preseason. Diawara finished with 13 points, three rebounds, one assist and one steal in 29 minutes in his previous appearance Tuesday, also against Toronto.

5289900.h: Diawara is starting Tuesday against Toronto, Jared Schwartz of the New York Post reports.
5289900.s: The Knicks are resting their usual starting lineup. Diawara is trying to make a case for an Opening Night role.

5289900.s: Diawara missed the Knicks' final three Las Vegas Summer League games due to the finger injury, though he should be ready to go for Monday's preseason opener against the 76ers. The 21-year-old forward appeared in 69 regular-season games (seven starts) in his rookie season, averaging 3.6 points and 1.4 rebounds in 9.2 minutes per contest.

5289900.h: Diawara (finger) didn't play in Friday's 110-88 Summer League loss to the Mavericks.
5289900.s: The severity of the finger injury is unknown, though it kept Diawara from playing in New York's final three Las Vegas Summer League outings. Over two outings in Las Vegas this summer, he averaged 3.5 points and 5.5 rebounds in 24.7 minutes per tilt.
